jobs.title: Contract Recruiting Operations Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Founded by Arianna Huffington in 2016, Thrive Global is a leading behavior change technology company with the mission to improve productivity and health outcomes – one Microstep at a time.
jobs.description:
Founded by Arianna Huffington in 2016, Thrive Global is a leading behavior change technology company with the mission to improve productivity and health outcomes – one Microstep at a time. Thrive helps individuals and organizations improve well-being, performance and mental resilience with its AI-powered behavior change technology platform. Thrive’s Microsteps – small, science-backed steps to improve health and productivity – have been adopted by employees at more than 230 organizations in over 160 countries, from frontline and call center workers to executives at multinational companies. For more information, visitwww.thriveglobal.com.

As our Contract Recruiting & Talent Operations Specialist, you will be a key driver of how Thrive Global grows. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role that combines candidate sourcing, recruiting coordination, and stakeholder management. You'll work closely with hiring managers across the company to understand their talent needs, identify promising candidates, and manage the recruiting process from initial outreach through offer acceptance.

You'll be the person who keeps everything moving, anticipating bottlenecks, following through on details, and ensuring candidates and hiring teams have what they need at every stage. We're open to candidates with backgrounds in recruiting, talent acquisition, HR, or operations who have demonstrated strong sourcing, coordination, and project management capabilities.

How You’ll Contribute

This role blends hands-on recruiting execution with close partnership across the business. You will keep hiring moving quickly while maintaining a high bar for quality and candidate experience.

Source & Engage

  • Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements, sourcing criteria, and ideal candidate profiles.
  • Proactively identify potential candidates using LinkedIn, online platforms, referrals, and creative sourcing strategies.
  • Present qualified candidate profiles to hiring managers, gather feedback, and refine searches accordingly.
  • Coordinate candidate outreach and maintain an active pipeline for current and anticipated hiring needs.

Own Recruiting Operations

  • Manage recruiting workflows from candidate identification through offer acceptance, ensuring each step is completed accurately and on time.
  • Coordinate interviews, candidate communications, feedback collection, and hiring decisions.
  • Maintain clean, accurate, and up-to-date ATS data to support reporting and compliance, including accurate candidate records, interview notes, and recruiting documentation.
  • Track and report on pipeline health, time-to-fill, and other key recruiting metrics.
  • Prepare interview packets and ensure hiring managers and executives have relevant candidate information ahead of interviews.
  • Track pipeline progress, flag bottlenecks, and provide regular recruiting status updates.

Partner & Align

  • Build strong working relationships with hiring managers and stakeholders across the company.
  • Proactively follow up on outstanding actions, feedback, and decisions to keep searches progressing.
  • Collaborate with the People team, Finance, and leadership on headcount priorities and offer approvals.
  • Help refine job descriptions, sourcing strategies, and interview processes based on hiring manager feedback and market insights.
  • Adapt quickly to changing priorities and urgent hiring needs in a fast-paced environment.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline recruiting workflows and improve the candidate and hiring manager experience.

Who You Are

  • A relationship builder who earns trust quickly with hiring managers and candidates alike.
  • Resourceful and scrappy: You find creative ways to solve problems and don't need a detailed playbook to get started.
  • Energized by a fast-paced environment; you stay organized, adaptable, and calm as priorities shift.
  • Highly organized: You keep track of moving pieces, anticipate next steps, and don't let things fall through the cracks.
  • A clear, warm communicator who creates a candidate experience that reflects Thrive's values.
  • Curious and data-minded, using metrics to spot bottlenecks and keep searches moving.
  • Self-directed and accountable; you ramp quickly and deliver results with minimal oversight.
  • Passionate about Thrive's mission to improve wellbeing, performance, and resilience.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university required.
  • 5+ years of direct hands-on recruiting experience in recruiting, talent acquisition, HR, people operations, or a similar role involving candidate sourcing and process coordination.
  • Provide experience with an applicant tracking system (ATS); Rippling experience is a plus..
  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally with hiring managers and stakeholders across multiple teams.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced startup or high-growth environment.
  • Full-cycle recruiting experience across a range of roles and functions.
  • Confidence working directly with senior leaders and busy hiring managers, including proactively driving follow-through and accountability.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Comfort learning new systems, using technology and AI tools, and improving existing workflows.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

✨ What We Offer:

  • 🌍 Mission-Driven Impact: Be part of a company that’s truly making a difference in people’s lives around the world.
  • 🚀 Career Growth: Develop within the company and help shape our growth strategy.
  • 💙 Human-Centric Culture: Thrive in a supportive environment with a range of wellness perks and benefits.
  • 💰 Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a comprehensive and rewarding total compensation package.
  • 🩺 Health & Financial Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage plus a 401(k) program with company match.
  • 🌴 Time to Recharge: Generous paid time-off programs designed to help you rest, reset, and recharge — including Thrive Time, a benefit unique to Thrive that gives employees additional paid time off after major projects or intense periods of work to truly recharge and recover

Compensation:

Compensation for this contract position is expected to fall within the range of $50–$75 per hour, depending on experience, expertise, and overall qualifications.

  • Please note that, as this is a contractor role, compensation will be provided on an hourly basis and the selected candidate will not be eligible for employee benefits, bonus programs, equity, or other company-sponsored benefit plans. The final hourly rate will be determined based on the candidate's background, experience, and market considerations.

Thrive is deeply committed to creating a safe and welcoming work environment free of discrimination and harassment so that all employees can bring their whole selves to work.

Thrive is proud to ensure equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, genetics, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, family or parental status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

Thrive is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. Please inform Thrive’s Recruiting team if you need any assistance completing any forms or to otherwise participate in the application process.

jobs.excerpt: Our client, an international e-commerce company with a strong presence in the USA, is seeking a AmazonGraphic Designer who can create high-quality, conversion-focused visuals for Amazon and e-commerce channels.
jobs.description:
Our client, an international e-commerce company with a strong presence in the USA, is seeking a AmazonGraphic Designer who can create high-quality, conversion-focused visuals for Amazon and e-commerce channels. This full-time remote role combines product visualization, listing design, and brand asset creation to support growth and maintain a premium brand image. If you are passionate about creating clean, modern, high-end visuals and understand how design impacts conversion and customer perception, we'd love to hear from you.

About the company

The company is a premium pet brand known for its high-quality, durable bulky pet products and accessories. Built for both professionals and devoted pet owners, the brand's products are designed with attention to detail, functionality, and longevity. The brand is committed to creating elevated, practical experiences for pets and their people—and is looking for a Graphic Designer to help scale that mission by delivering high-impact visual assets across all customer touchpoints.

Key Responsibilities

Amazon & E-commerce Visual Design

  • Design high-converting Amazon listing images and A+ content.
  • Create clear, benefit-driven visuals that communicate product value.
  • Ensure all assets comply with Amazon guidelines and best practices.

Product Visualization & 3D Rendering

  • Create and refine photorealistic product renders.
  • Develop visuals that clearly explain product features and functionality.
  • Use compositions, overlays, and layouts to improve clarity and appeal.

Conversion-Focused Design

  • Translate customer pain points into visual solutions.
  • Improve listing clarity, trust, and perceived product value through design.
  • Optimize visuals for better engagement and conversion.

Brand & Marketing Assets

  • Maintain consistent premium brand identity across all materials.
  • Design packaging, manuals, inserts, and labels.
  • Create visuals for ads (Google, Meta) and social media.
  • Support video editing and product presentation content.

Tools & Skills Required

  • Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere or similar).
  • Experience with using AI tools to refine & streamline the design process (Nanobanana, Seedance, etc).
  • 3D software for modeling and rendering.
  • Experience with Amazon listing design and A+ content.
  • Strong understanding of layout, composition, and visual hierarchy.
  • Ability to create clean, modern, high-end visuals.
  • Basic understanding of e-commerce and conversion principles.

Success Indicators

  • High-quality, consistent visual output aligned with brand standards.
  • Clear and effective product communication through visuals.
  • Improved performance of product listings through design updates.
  • Timely delivery of assets across multiple product lines.

Ideal Candidate

  • Experience designing for Amazon or e-commerce brands.
  • Strong portfolio with product-focused visuals and renders.
  • Up to date with tools and AI.
  • Able to work independently and execute quickly.

Why Join Us

  • Play a key role in shaping the visual identity of a premium pet brand on Amazon.
  • Own the design and visual communication across product listings and marketing assets.
  • Work remotely from anywhere.
  • Competitive salary and flexible working hours.
  • Collaborate with a creative, forward-thinking team dedicated to innovation in the pet space.
  • Make a tangible impact on a brand that values quality, customer experience, and design excellence.

jobs.excerpt: Note: If you are CURRENTLY employed at Children's and/or have an active badge or network access, STOP here.
jobs.description:
Note: If you are CURRENTLY employed at Children's and/or have an active badge or network access, STOP here. Submit your application via Workday using the Career App (Find Jobs).

Work Shift

Day

Work Day(s)

Monday-Friday

Shift Start Time

8:00 AM

Shift End Time

4:30 PM

Worker Sub-Type

Children’s is one of the nation’s leading children’s hospitals. No matter the role, every member of our team is an essential part of our mission to make kids better today and healthier tomorrow. We’re committed to putting you first, and that commitment is at the heart of our company culture: People first. Children always. Find your next career opportunity and make a difference doing what you love at Children’s.

Job Description

Establishes and maintains an efficient and timely coding process while ensuring the accuracy and quality of coded and abstracted information for all patient types across all hospital campuses, physician services, and remote facilities of the Children's Healthcare of Atlanta system. Provides ongoing education to coders, physicians, and other clinical staff. Serves in a management and advisory capacity to the Coding staff and in an educational and advisory capacity to the clinical staff and physicians as it relates to documentation, coding, and regulatory compliance. Works effectively with the Director, HIS & Coding to increase and improve coding services.

Experience

  • 3 years of experience in health information management or coding management in a hospital or physician practice/clinic setting

Preferred Qualifications

  • N/A

Education

  • Associates degree in Health Information Management/Health Information Technology, or related healthcare field, or 3 years of managerial experience in Health Information Management or Coding

Certification Summary

  • Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA), Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT), Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), Certified Coding Specialist – Physician (CCS-P), or Certified Professional Coder (CPC)

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Proven knowledge base in complete and accurate clinical documentation in all healthcare settings and for all healthcare disciplines
  • Demonstrated knowledge base and experience in acute care hospital and physician/clinic coding and billing practices
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the conventions, rules, and guidelines for multiple classification systems, including ICD-10 diagnosis and procedures, CPT and Evaluation & Management coding systems
  • Knowledge of multiple reimbursement systems (e.g., Medicare Severity-Diagnosis Related Groups (MS-DRG) and Ambulatory Payment Classification (APC)
  • Knowledge of clinical documentation improvement methodologies
  • Ability to accurately interpret and implement regulatory standards, including the National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) and Medically Unlikely Event (MUE) policies.
  • Ability to establish rapport with physicians and other healthcare practitioners
  • Must have strong analytical and critical thinking skills to support problem solving and associated change management.
  • Must be able to successfully pass the Basic Microsoft Office Skill Assessment at 80% or higher rating during pre-employment interview process

Job Responsibilities

  • Manages the daily operations of the Hospital Coding Department to promote steady workflow and data integrity.
  • Manages the daily operations of the Physician Practice Coding Department to promote steady workflow and data integrity.
  • Research coding questions and provide coder feedback - Ensures timely correction of coding errors and edits.
  • Ensures coding audits are performed concurrently and that the areas being audited are updated in conjunction with the department policies.
  • Oversees the monitoring of the aging and DNB accounts to ensure that accounts are coded in a timely manner and that performance is within established coding quality and productivity benchmarks.
  • Conducts regular audits and coordinates monitoring of coding accuracy, productivity, and available clinical documentation.
  • Ensures that audit reports are reviewed, accurate, and corrective action plans implemented.
  • Provides feedback and assists in facilitating and/or coordinating focused educational programs regarding coding and clinical documentation best practices to Coding and clinical staff as needed.
  • Interviews, hires and trains employees; plans, assigns and direct workflow, appraises employee performance; addresses complaints and resolving problems; and proactively manages production and quality control efforts.
  • Conducts trend analysis to identify patterns and variations in coding/documentation practices and case mix index.
  • Identifies process improvement opportunities within the Coding department and implements solutions.
  • Reviews claim denials and rejections pertaining to coding and medical necessity issues and implements corrective action plans as needed/required.
  • Works with Coding Supervisors to provide all Coding staff with annual, quarterly, semi-annual ICD-10-CM/PCS and/or CPT code changes and coordinates with Information Systems & Technology to ensure timely system updates.
  • Maintains all coding information and provides updated manuals, resources, and other coding material.
  • Monitors, verifies, and reconciles expenditures of budgeted funds, compiling information reflecting expenditures, and develop cost- comparisons. - Identify cost savings within the operation.
  • Actively participates in the Internal Audit Process exit conferences, providing clarification and supporting information necessary.
  • Collaborates with other coding managers outside of the organization to ensure consistent implementation of coding policies, procedures, and practice - Maintain strong communication with Director(s) and business partners in reporting of unbilled activities related to coding.
  • Mentors team members to encourage personal and professional growth.
  • Encourages ongoing skill development by providing opportunities for continued education.
  • Applies critical thinking, problem solving and change management skills to lead the process and team in identifying and resolving systemic issues.

Children’s Healthcare of Atlanta is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, sex, religion, national origin, citizenship, age, veteran status, disability or any other characteristic covered by applicable law.

jobs.excerpt: About Corporate TravellerAt Corporate Traveller, we’re on a mission to take business travel to the next level.
jobs.description:
About Corporate Traveller

At Corporate Traveller, we’re on a mission to take business travel to the next level. And when it comes to our people, we know we are next level. We are anything but ordinary. Part of the corporate division of the Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), Corporate Traveller is one of FCTG's most successful brands, globally. Our mission is to make end to end travel experience faster, simpler and easier for our customers and to demonstrate ongoing value to decision-makers, travellers and bookers. We provide our customers with the perfect blend of personal, local service blended with our expert technology suite and the great choice and value which comes with being part of the FCTG family. We lead with passion, ambition, and a hunger to do better. We do whatever it takes to get the best results, for ourselves and our customers. We are committed to helping our customers and each other grow and smash our goals. And at our core, we believe that together we can do anything. Together, we are here to take it to the next level.

About the role

When travel plans change unexpectedly, flights are disrupted, or urgent assistance is needed outside of normal business hours, our Emergency Assist team steps in. We're looking for a customer-focused Emergency Assist Travel Consultant who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys solving problems, supporting travellers, and delivering exceptional service when it matters most.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a highly collaborative team where no two shifts are the same. You'll work with corporate travellers, helping them navigate travel disruptions and providing expert support across a variety of travel scenarios. As one of the first points of contact for customers, you'll play a vital role in delivering a world-class service experience

As an Emergency Assist Travel Consultant, you'll:

  • Provide outstanding customer service and travel support in an after-hours environment
  • Manage urgent travel requests, itinerary changes and disruptions
  • Build strong relationships with customers, travellers and internal teams
  • Utilise your travel expertise to identify solutions quickly and effectively
  • Maintain high service standards while meeting operational targets and KPIs
  • Advocate customer-first solutions while supporting preferred supplier strategies
  • Collaborate with colleagues to ensure seamless support for travellers around the globe

About you

We're keen to hear from travel professionals who are passionate about customer service and enjoy finding solutions in challenging situations.

You'll likely have:

  • A minimum of 2 years' experience as a Travel Consultant
  • Experience using Amadeus GDS or similar
  • Strong travel industry and fares knowledge
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
  • A proactive, solutions-focused approach
  • The ability to multitask and remain calm under pressure
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering exceptional service
  • A genuine team-player mindset and willingness to support colleagues and customers alike

Shift Pattern

16.25 hours per week

  • 1 Weekend Shift: 08:30 - 20:30
  • 1 Weekday Shift: 17:00 - 22:30
  • Bank Holidays: As rostered

The weekend shift operates on a rotating basis:

  • Work Saturday one weekend
  • Work Sunday the following weekend

Your weekday evening shift will rotate across the week to support operational requirements.

What's in it for you

  • Exclusive Travel Discounts: As part of Flight Centre Travel Group, you gain access to exclusive industry rates and discounts through our in-house travel team.
  • Career Development: With Flight Centre Travel Group’s global presence, spanning 30+ brands in over 20 countries, you’ll have clear career pathways and the resources you need to achieve your professional goals, including training and support.
  • Vibrant Culture & Social Perks: Experience our fun, industry-renowned culture with exciting social events such as monthly awards nights, global conferences, end-of-financial-year balls, and more.
  • Active Hour: Prioritise your well-being with an hour dedicated each week to focus on your fitness or personal wellness.
  • Comprehensive Health Cash Plan: Get reimbursed for a variety of medical services, including dental, optical, and chiropractic care, with our bronze-level health cash plan.
  • Health & Wellbeing Challenges: Stay engaged with monthly health and wellbeing challenges designed to keep you motivated and healthy.
  • Financial Wellbeing Support: Access expert financial services, including mortgage advice, regulated financial guidance, and money coaching to help you manage your finances.
  • And Much More: Enjoy a range of additional benefits, including company-matched charitable donations, an excellent pension scheme, share options, an electric vehicle scheme, and a variety of salary sacrifice benefits.

THE ROLE

We are looking for an Client Onboarding Concierge to help new customers successfully move through the first steps of their journey with us.

This is a hands-on, client-facing role with a strong focus on phone communication, fast response times, and consistent follow-up.

You will welcome new customers, help them book their required calls, guide them through basic setup and activation steps, follow up when actions are incomplete, and make sure they are prepared and ready for onboarding.

You will not deliver the formal Intro or Onboarding calls. Your job is to make sure customers are contacted, booked, prepared, supported, and moving forward.

THE COMPANY

A multi-8-figure ARR business with 200+ team members, bootstrapped and profitable. The company launches and scales information and software products on a marketing and sales engine refined across a dozen product launches and $100M+ in ad spend.

This seat sits inside the onboarding org, dedicated to a fast-growing product line. Your job is to make sure customers who come in the door finish, renew, and refer.

What You Will Do:

  • Contact new customers quickly after they purchase, with a target of making the first phone attempt within 30 minutes
  • Welcome customers and explain their next steps
  • Book and confirm Intro and Onboarding calls directly with customers
  • Follow up consistently by phone, SMS, and email when customers do not respond
  • Help customers access our platforms and complete required setup and preparation before their calls
  • Follow up with customers who miss appointments and help get them rebooked
  • Resolve simple login, booking, and platform issues
  • Escalate more complex customer concerns to the appropriate team
  • Keep accurate notes and records of customer interactions, progress, and next steps
  • Continue following up until the customer successfully progresses through onboarding

Requirements

What We're Looking For:

  • Strong spoken and written English
  • Confident and comfortable speaking with customers by phone
  • Previous experience in Customer Support, Customer Success, Appointment Setting, Onboarding, or a similar client-facing role
  • Friendly, professional, and patient communication style
  • Persistent with follow-up without being pushy
  • Strong organisation and attention to detail
  • Comfortable using CRM systems and learning new technology
  • Able to manage multiple customers and priorities at the same time
  • Reliable, coachable, and comfortable working toward clear performance targets

Benefits

  • Full-time opportunity
  • Independent Contractor Agreement
  • $2,000 USD monthly base
  • Up to $1,000 USD monthly variable compensation
  • Fully remote
  • Opportunity to grow into broader Customer Success, Onboarding, or leadership roles

jobs.description:
We’re always interested in connecting with experienced Customer Support Engineers who could be a great fit for our team as Verge.io continues to grow.

As a Customer Support Engineer at Verge.io, you’ll work directly with customers to help them deploy, operate, and get the most out of VergeOS, troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues and guiding implementations and migrations along the way. It's a hands-on technical role for someone who enjoys solving hard problems and working directly with people.

You’ll also help turn what you learn into better documentation and repeatable processes, using AI as a practical tool to research issues, analyze logs, and find better ways to solve recurring problems.

The Role

You’ll work directly with customers throughout their experience with VergeOS, from implementation and migration through ongoing support, optimization, and upgrades. That includes:

  • Troubleshooting and resolving technical issues across the VergeOS platform
  • Managing escalations and complex customer inquiries
  • Guiding customers through implementations and migrations
  • Helping customers optimize their environments and follow platform best practices
  • Providing technical guidance for upgrades, maintenance, and other platform changes
  • Partnering with Engineering to investigate and resolve complex technical issues
  • Documenting technical solutions and contributing to our internal and customer-facing knowledge base
  • Identifying recurring issues and turning solutions into repeatable processes
  • Using AI to research issues, analyze information, improve responses, and build more efficient support and deployment workflows
  • Participating in an on-call rotation as needed

Who You Are

Successful Customer Support Engineers at Verge.io are technical problem-solvers who genuinely enjoy figuring out how things work, and why they sometimes don't.

You’re comfortable digging into Linux, virtualization, networking, logs, and infrastructure configurations to get to the root of a problem. You can work independently when needed, but you also know when to pull in Engineering or other members of the team.

You’re equally comfortable working with people. You can take a complicated technical issue and explain it clearly to a customer, keep communication moving while an issue is being resolved, and build confidence even when the answer isn't immediately obvious.

You also look beyond the individual ticket. When you solve something, you think about how we can document it, automate it, or improve the process so the next customer, and the rest of the team, benefits from what you learned.

The Experience We’re Looking For

We typically look for:

  • Significant experience in technical support, infrastructure engineering, systems administration, or a similarly hands-on technical role
  • Strong Linux administration skills, ideally within Debian-based environments
  • Hands-on experience with virtualization technologies, including KVM/QEMU or similar platforms
  • A strong understanding of networking concepts and experience troubleshooting a variety of network configurations
  • Experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues and working through problems methodically
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly
  • Experience working directly with customers in a technical capacity
  • Comfort working independently in a remote, fast-moving environment
  • Practical experience using AI in your work, with examples of how it has helped you research, troubleshoot, automate, document, or work more effectively

Additional Experience That’s Valuable

  • Experience in any of the following areas can be especially helpful:
  • VMware, Nutanix, Hyper-V, or other virtualization platforms
  • AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or other cloud environments
  • Scripting or automation using Python, Bash, Go, or similar languages
  • REST APIs and systems integrations
  • GitHub projects or code samples, particularly projects involving automation or AI-assisted workflows

A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field can be helpful, but it isn't required. We value demonstrated technical experience and the ability to solve real-world problems.

jobs.description:
Electrical PE

Company: LRS Federal

Location: Corporate / Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Senior Level

Position Overview

LRS Federal is seeking a high-caliber, licensed Electrical PE with an extensive background in federal and defense sectors to join our corporate engineering team. This is not a purely administrative role; we are looking for a senior technical expert who possesses 15+ years of experience and continues to actively perform physical electrical engineering design work.

The successful candidate will lead the design, analysis, and quality control of complex electrical infrastructure projects for the Department of Defense (DoD), Department of Energy (DOE), and civil federal agencies (GSA, VA).

Mandatory Qualifications ("Must-Haves")

Candidates who do not meet all of the following criteria will not be considered:

  • Licensure: Active Professional Engineer (PE) license in electrical engineering (with the ability to obtain reciprocity in additional states as required).
  • Experience: Minimum of fifteen (15) years of progressive experience working explicitly on Federal and Department of Defense (DoD) infrastructure and facility projects.
  • Active Design Footprint: Proven track record of actually performing physical electrical design work within recent roles (producing calculations, single-line diagrams, layouts, and specifications; not just reviewing the work of junior staff).
  • Federal Standards Expertise: Deep, practical mastery of Unified Facilities Criteria (UFC), National Electrical Code (NEC), NFPA standards, and federal sustainable design mandates.

Key Responsibilities

  • Hands-on Electrical Design: Personally execute and oversee the production of comprehensive electrical design packages (Concept through 100% / Issued for Construction) for federal facilities, including medium-voltage distribution, interior power, lighting, grounding, lightning protection, and emergency/standby power systems.
  • Engineering Calculations: Perform and seal critical engineering calculations including short-circuit analysis, overcurrent protective device coordination, arc flash studies (using SKM or ETAP software), and voltage drop calculations.
  • Design-Build Support: Act as the lead corporate electrical technical authority on major Federal Design-Build (DB) and Design-Bid-Build (DBB) proposals and executed contracts.
  • Quality Assurance & Mentorship: Provide rigorous independent technical reviews (QA/QC) for multi-discipline federal design projects while mentoring mid-level and junior electrical designers.
  • Client Interfacing: Serve as the technical point of contact during design review conferences with DoD engineering components (e.g., USACE, NAVFAC) and civil agencies.

Technical & Professional Skills

  • Expert-level proficiency in electrical engineering design software (e.g., SKM PowerTools, ETAP, AGi32).
  • Advanced production capabilities in AutoCAD and Revit MEP for generating construction documents.
  • Thorough understanding of physical security, visual/auditory signaling, and telecommunications infrastructure integration within federal footprints.
  • Excellent written communication skills for authoring design narratives, basis-of-design (BOD) documents, and physical condition assessment reports.
Salary: $140k-$175k

Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

About the role

As Circle expands the customers and payment methods it serves, our fraud exposure grows and changes. We rely on conservative limits and third-party models today, and we are building our own.


As a Senior Data Scientist on Fraud Analytics, you will own the prediction side of our fraud loop. You will turn labels into features and models, measure their accuracy, and shift Circle from vendor scores to in-house models. You will work with Fraud Strategy, Fraud Operations, Risk Engineering, and Compliance.


What you’ll do

  • Build and evaluate fraud models for onboarding, login, account changes, and money movement. Target risks include account takeover, scams, money mules, and stolen and synthetic identity.
  • Evaluate third-party risk signals and design the path from vendor models to Circle models, from shadow mode to production.
  • Define the label taxonomy and data requirements with Fraud Operations and Risk Engineering, so every event, decision, and outcome becomes training data. This includes the fraud we miss.
  • Design holdout and exploration sampling to measure false negatives and the rate at which we wrongly block good customers.
  • Track fraud rate, dispute rate, fraud loss rate, and precision across customer segments. Help set thresholds against an agreed loss budget.
  • Work with Fraud Strategy to tune thresholds and rules and respond to emerging attacks.
  • Backtest, monitor drift, and retrain models on Circle’s fraud platform.
  • Help build AI agent workflows for transaction review, fraud-ring analysis, and rule drafting, and evaluate their accuracy against human labels.

Core Requirements

  • 5+ years in data science or applied ML on fraud, risk, or financial crime
  • Advanced Python and SQL, and experience with XGBoost, LightGBM, or similar
  • Experience building models with sparse, delayed, or biased labels, including cold start, reject inference, and chargeback lag
  • Strong statistics: anomaly detection, graph or network methods, experimentation, and threshold optimization
  • Experience taking models to production and monitoring them
  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical partners
  • Comfort working through ambiguity and limited historical data

Preferred Requirements

  • Fintech, payments, crypto, or card fraud experience, including chargebacks and disputes
  • Experience with device intelligence, behavioral signals, or consortium data
  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics, AML, and KYC
  • Experience evaluating LLM or agent-based review workflows

This is a remote position.

Job Title: SNAP EBT Test Lead

Work Arrangement: Remote

Location: Remote, United States

Employment Type: Contract (approximately 29 months, starting on or about January 1, 2027; hours vary by project phase)

Engagement Type: W-2 or 1099 ($50 to $55 per hour)

Final Interview:

Position Summary

Dhaka Technologies Limited Company is hiring a SNAP EBT Test Lead on behalf of its client, a state human services agency. The Test Lead will plan and manage testing of the agency's new Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT) system, working with the state project team and the EBT processor to verify that the system meets program requirements, design specifications, performance standards, usability expectations, capacity demands and security requirements, in line with current U.S. Department of Agriculture, Food and Nutrition Service (USDA FNS) regulations and FNS Handbook 901. Hours are expected to be lighter during the early planning phase and to increase through system testing and acceptance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and manage a comprehensive test plan covering unit, integration, performance, end-to-end, user acceptance, regression, and fail-safe testing.
  • Coordinate testing activities with the State and EBT processor.
  • Establish test team responsibilities, test databases, test cases, scripts, schedules, acceptance procedures, and Go/No-Go criteria.
  • Develop contingency plans, including procedures for reverting to the legacy system when necessary.
  • Lead System Acceptance Testing addressing functionality, security, recovery, system controls, and exception scenarios.
  • Train State staff to conduct acceptance testing and participate in test execution, results reviews, interface reviews, and regression testing.
  • Prepare written evaluations of test results for USDA/FNS review and required approval.
  • During the planning phase, help define the testing requirements written into the EBT services RFP and maintain requirements traceability through testing.

Required Qualifications

  • 10 or more years of software or system testing experience, including at least 3 years as a test lead or test manager.
  • Experience leading system acceptance testing or user acceptance testing for a state government system, preferably in human services or public benefits (SNAP, WIC, TANF or Medicaid).
  • Experience writing comprehensive test plans, test cases and scripts, acceptance procedures and Go/No-Go criteria.
  • Experience coordinating testing with a third-party vendor or system processor and managing defects through resolution.
  • Experience training business users to perform user acceptance testing.
  • Strong written communication skills, including writing formal evaluations of test results for executive or federal review.
  • No current employment with, or contract to, an EBT processor.
  • Available for the full engagement, starting on or about January 1, 2027.
  • Three professional references from previous engagements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience testing EBT, eWIC, payment card or other financial transaction systems.
  • Familiarity with FNS Handbook 901 (Section 3.5.24, Test Plan) and federal requirements for SNAP or other FNS systems.
  • Experience with Medicaid Enterprise System (MMIS) or CMS certification testing.
  • Experience with test management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps or ALM.
  • ISTQB or a similar testing certification.

How to Apply

Send your updated resume and three professional references (name, title, organization, phone number and email address) to with "SNAP EBT Test Lead" in the subject line. Please include your current location and your availability to start on or about January 1, 2027.

jobs.title: Vice President(VP) of Growth
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT EVERYDAY DOSEEveryday Dose is a functional coffee company on a mission to help people feel better, think clearer, and perform at their best, without the crash that comes with regular coffee.
jobs.description:
ABOUT EVERYDAY DOSE

Everyday Dose is a functional coffee company on a mission to help people feel better, think clearer, and perform at their best, without the crash that comes with regular coffee. We're a fast-growing, nine-figure D2C brand with a loyal, high-retention subscriber base, and we're scaling our retention function to match our ambitions.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Vice President, Growth to own Everyday Dose’s direct-to-consumer acquisition and retention engine. Reporting directly to the CEO, you’ll lead paid acquisition, conversion, retention and lifecycle, creative strategy, and growth analytics—and be accountable for growth and cohort health as a single result.

The mandate is to drive aggressive new-customer growth while protecting what makes the business valuable: strong retention and customer lifetime value. We need a leader who understands that sustainable growth isn’t simply about buying more volume. You’ll build an acquisition engine that maintains or improves cohort quality as we scale while operating within a disciplined 12-month payback ceiling.

This is a senior leadership role with ownership of the DTC growth strategy and P&L, significant media investment, and a multidisciplinary Growth team spanning Performance Marketing, Retention & Lifecycle, Creative Strategy, and Growth Analytics.

This role is full-time and can be based at our Austin, TX headquarters or remotely within the U.S. Austin is preferred. Travel of up to 20% may be required for HQ visits, team offsites, and agency and partner meetings.

Requirements

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

You’ll take primary ownership of the core pillars of our DTC growth engine:

  • Growth Strategy & DTC P&L: Set the annual and quarterly DTC growth plan, targets, and budget, owning new-customer volume, CAC, payback, and M3/M12 retention as one scorecard.
  • Paid Acquisition & Media: Lead performance and upper-funnel media across paid social, search, TV/CTV, creators, and affiliates.
  • Conversion & Funnel Performance: Own the customer journey from first impression through first order, including landing pages, offers, site experience, and subscription checkout.
  • Retention & Lifecycle: Lead subscription onboarding, email and SMS, win-back, churn reduction, and broader lifecycle strategy with a focus on improving cohort retention.
  • Creative Strategy: Direct creative strategy and testing across acquisition channels and build a repeatable process for briefing, testing, and scaling creative.
  • Measurement & Growth Analytics: Own cohort-level reporting, incrementality testing, attribution, and the measurement framework behind growth investment.
  • Team Leadership: Hire, develop, and lead a multidisciplinary Growth organization while partnering closely with Finance, Operations, Product, and Brand.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Set the growth strategy: Build the annual and quarterly DTC growth plan, establish targets and budgets, and manage new-customer volume, CAC, payback, and retention together rather than as isolated metrics.
  • Own the DTC P&L: Maintain a clear view of growth performance and tradeoffs and communicate results and recommendations to the CEO and leadership team.
  • Lead paid acquisition: Set strategy across paid social, search, TV/CTV, creators, and affiliates and allocate spend based on cohort quality and payback—not CPM or volume alone.
  • Build the right media model: Manage agency partners, hold them accountable to clear outcomes, and determine which capabilities should be built in-house.
  • Improve conversion: Own the path from first impression through first order and improve landing pages, offers, site experience, and subscription checkout without relying on deep or evergreen discounting.
  • Drive retention: Lead onboarding, email and SMS, win-back, and churn-reduction programs with a focus on improving M3 and M12 retention by acquisition cohort.
  • Connect acquisition and retention: Evaluate acquisition programs based on downstream retention and contribution, not simply first-order volume.
  • Lead creative strategy: Build a structured, repeatable process for briefing, testing, learning, and scaling creative that attracts high-retention customers.
  • Own measurement: Maintain cohort-level reporting, incrementality testing, attribution, and other measurement approaches needed to understand what’s actually driving growth.
  • Maintain budget discipline: Enforce the 12-month payback ceiling, establish clear decision rights for exceptions, and move quickly when CAC increases or cohort quality deteriorates.
  • Build the team: Hire, develop, and lead the Growth organization with clear goals, high standards, and candid, timely feedback.
  • Partner cross-functionally: Work closely with Finance, Operations, Product, and Brand on forecasting, inventory, pricing, launches, and other decisions that affect growth.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 12+ years of experience in growth, performance marketing, or DTC e-commerce, including 5+ years leading multidisciplinary Growth teams at the Director level or above.
  • Experience personally leading a subscription consumable brand through 20%+ annual growth while maintaining or improving month-12 retention—and the ability to show the cohort data behind it.
  • Experience at a DTC brand with $25M+ in revenue; experience scaling a business beyond $100M is strongly preferred.
  • Deep command of cohort economics, including CAC, LTV, payback, contribution margin, and M3/M12 retention.
  • Experience operating under a defined payback ceiling and the judgment to reduce spend when CAC or cohort economics no longer support continued investment.
  • Hands-on knowledge across paid social, search, TV/CTV, creator, and affiliate channels.
  • Experience with incrementality testing, media mix modeling, and attribution.
  • Strong understanding of conversion metrics beyond CPM, including impressions-per-new-customer and first-order conversion rate.
  • Deep subscription and lifecycle expertise across onboarding, email and SMS, churn reduction, and win-back.
  • A retention-led approach to growth. You’re focused on acquiring customers who stay rather than generating short-term volume through aggressive discounting or inefficient media.
  • Strong creative judgment and experience building structured creative testing programs.
  • Data-native and comfortable working directly in the numbers while partnering closely with analytics.
  • Experience building strong in-house capabilities while holding agencies accountable to measurable outcomes.
  • Strong executive communication skills and the ability to clearly communicate performance, tradeoffs, and recommendations to senior leadership and investors.
  • A leadership style grounded in empathy, high trust, candid feedback, and high standards.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience scaling a DTC brand beyond $100M in revenue.
  • Experience within coffee, functional beverage, supplements, or another subscription consumables category.
  • Experience leading Growth within a subscription-first business with significant recurring revenue.
  • Experience balancing aggressive new-customer growth with long-term cohort retention and contribution economics.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Within your first two quarters, you’ve established a clear DTC growth strategy and operating rhythm across acquisition, conversion, retention, creative, and analytics. The organization has one clear scorecard connecting new-customer volume, CAC, payback, and M3/M12 retention, and investment decisions are being made based on cohort quality and long-term economics rather than short-term volume.

You’ve built strong accountability across the Growth organization, established disciplined media and creative testing processes, and created clear visibility into what’s driving incremental growth. We’re scaling new-customer acquisition while protecting retention and maintaining our 12-month payback ceiling, and the CEO and leadership team have a clear view of performance, tradeoffs, and where we’re investing next.

Benefits

COMPENSATION RANGE

The typical salary range for this position is: $250,000 - $300,000

This role is also eligible for a 20% bonus incentive.

The actual salary offer will take into account multiple factors including skills, experience, education and location. Please note that the salary details listed in role postings reflect the base salary only, not total compensation, which includes bonus and benefits.

BENEFITS

Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance

Everyday Dose offers comprehensive medical, vision, dental, and prescription plan coverage for all team members working 32+ hours per week. Eligibility begins on the first of the month following your start date, and we cover 75% of employee premiums.

401K Match

Starting on the first day of your fourth month with the company, you are eligible to participate in our company-sponsored 401(k) plan. The company offers a match of up to 80% of your contributions, capped at 5% of your salary.

Flexible Wellness Credits

At Everyday Dose, we prioritize your health and well-being. To support you, we provide salaried employees a $500 monthly wellness credit through JOON, which can be used for a variety of health and wellness-related services.

Helpr Support for Families

At Everyday Dose, we know that supporting our team means supporting their families too. That’s why we partner with Helpr — a modern backup childcare and family support platform that gives employees access to vetted, reliable caregivers. Helpr is here to make sure our team has trusted childcare support when they need it most — at home and at work.

Summary:

JOB SUMMARY Habitat for Humanity's Terwilliger Center for Innovation in Shelter seeks a graduate-level intern — MPH or MSc — to support Habitat's thematic work around healthy housing during the academic year, between 6- 8 months. The intern will contribute directly to an evidence base and a technical framework. This role will bolster the growing body of evidence that housing conditions are among the most powerful and modifiable social determinants of health outcomes. The intern will consolidate data and evidence around thermal comfort and heat-related illness, vector-borne disease and structural housing modifications, indoor air quality and respiratory health, climate resilience and disaster risk, and WASH integration that points to the contributions of housing conditions and health.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES

  • Conduct an evidence review across housing and health domains — synthesizing peer-reviewed literature and program learnings.
  • Produce an annotated evidence map linking housing conditions to health outcomes

  • Support the development of the theory of change with the evidence base and indicators for mapping change— how housing improvements lead to health outcomes, for whom, through what mechanisms
  • Draft language that will consolidate into an organizational technical framework
  • Produce a final learning product — a structured policy brief or evidence synthesis— in consultation with academic supervisor and the organization

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

Current enrollment as a student at an accredited college or university; pursuing a degree at the intersection of public health evidence and practice. Candidates pursuing their MPH (Master of Public Health); MSc Public Health; Health Policy; Environmental Health; Global Health; Urban Health and Implementation Science.

  • Comfortable with the use of AI in supporting research gathering and data analysis
  • Can turn academic evidence into clear, accessible practitioner language in English.
  • Writes well for non-academic audiences — development practitioners, donors, NGO leaders

Habitat for Humanity, founded in 1976, is a global, Christian-based nonprofit organization that grew out of an intentionally multi-racial community in rural Georgia. Working alongside each other, we help families and individuals build and improve places to call home and achieve the strength, stability and self-reliance they need to build better lives for themselves. jobs.description:
Position Title

Capital Planning & Stress Testing Program Manager

Location

Nationwide, MI 48098

Job Summary

The Capital Planning & Stress Testing Program Manager leads Flagstar’s stress testing and capital planning processes, reporting to the Director of Capital Planning & Stress Testing. This role coordinates cross-functional teams to execute stress test plans, ensure regulatory compliance, and align with capital management policies. Responsibilities include developing and integrating stress testing processes, overseeing documentation, guiding scenario design, and preparing reports for senior management and regulators. The manager ensures that capital planning is effective, meets governance standards, and supports strategic decisions. This role exists to ensure the bank’s capital planning exercises are executed efficiently, meet regulatory expectations, and support sound strategic decision-making.

Job Responsibilities:

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Program Leadership & Plan Coordination: Leads the bank’s stress testing program, coordinating input from multiple departments to collect and integrate all necessary data and materials. Maintains and updates key capital planning documents (e.g., capital plan narrative, policies, contingency plans) to ensure the stress testing process is cohesive and aligned with business objectives.
  • Scenario Design & Challenge Oversight: Leads internal stress test scenarios informed by the bank’s idiosyncratic risks (Risk ID inventory) and evaluates capital adequacy under adverse conditions. Manages review/challenge sessions on forecasted results (e.g., PPNR, credit losses), addressing key assumptions and limitations through sensitivity analysis and appropriate overlays.
  • Reporting & Regulatory Submission: Prepares and submits regulatory stress testing reports and the final capital plan document, ensuring accuracy and timeliness. Produces clear summaries of stress test results and recommended capital actions for senior management and Board review and performs ad-hoc capital analyses (such as peer comparisons) to support decision-making.
  • Quality Assurance & Compliance: Ensures the consistency and reliability of stress test results through strong quality controls and data governance. Maintains an inventory of critical capital planning data elements, working with Data Governance to resolve data issues, and verifies adherence to internal risk management standards. Supports and addresses any findings from regulatory, risk, or internal audits and ensures continuous compliance with all relevant policies and regulatory requirements throughout the stress testing cycle.
  • Proactively manage examination requests, company resources, program risks, and required deliverables, as well as the day-to-day planning and resource allocation.
  • Responsible for talent management functions including: employment, performance evaluations, staff development/training, disciplinary actions, succession planning and ensuring all staff comply with compliance requirements.

ADDITIONAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Strategic Alignment: Works under the direction of the CPST Director to ensure that stress testing activities support the bank’s strategic goals for capital adequacy and risk management. Provides input to senior leadership on opportunities to improve capital efficiency or risk mitigation based on stress test insights.
  • Governance and Policy Adherence: Upholds the governance framework for capital planning. Ensures that all activities follow the approved Capital Planning & Stress Testing policies and the governance standards set by management committees (CMC, ERMC) and the Board. All documentation and processes should withstand regulatory scrutiny and internal audit standards.
  • Continuous Improvement: Stays current on evolving regulatory expectations (e.g., Federal Reserve guidance for Category IV banks, Basel capital standards) and industry best practices in stress testing. Recommends and implements enhancements to the stress testing program, such as process improvements, model updates (in partnership with model development teams), and improved coordination mechanisms, to continually strengthen Flagstar’s capital planning capabilities.
  • Performs special projects, and additional duties and responsibilities as required.
  • Consistently adheres to regulatory and compliance policies and standards linked to the job as listed and complete required compliance trainings. Accountable to maintain compliance with applicable federal, state and local laws and regulations.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Required Qualifications:

  • Education level required: Undergraduate Degree (4 years or equivalent) in Finance, Economics, Business, Mathematics or a related field (or equivalent work experience in a related discipline).
  • Minimum experience required: 6+ Years experience in financial risk management, capital planning, or stress testing. Involvement in enterprise stress testing processes or regulatory capital plan preparation.
  • Technical Skills: Knowledge of regulatory capital requirements and stress testing frameworks (e.g., DFAST/CCAR, Basel III). Proficiency in financial modeling and scenario analysis; advanced Excel skills.
  • Leadership & Communication: Proven ability to lead cross-functional projects or teams. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex financial analyses to senior executives. Collaborative team player who can influence and coordinate stakeholders across departments.
  • Analytical & Detail-Oriented: High attention to detail and accuracy. Strong analytical problem-solving skills to interpret model results and identify trends or issues. Effective at managing multiple priorities and deadlines, especially during peak stress testing cycles.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Education level preferred: Master's Degree (or Postgraduate equivalent) in Finance, Business Administration (MBA), Economics, or a related field or professional certification (CFA, FRM).
  • Experience working at a bank subject to regulatory stress testing (e.g., DFAST/CCAR submissions) and dealing with regulatory examinations.
  • Familiarity with data governance and model risk management practices related to capital planning. Exposure to liquidity risk or resolution planning.
  • Familiarity with data analysis tools or statistical modeling.

Job Competencies:

  • Regulatory Acumen: Understanding of capital planning regulations and expectations. Able to ensure the stress testing program meets regulatory standards.
  • Project Management: Organized and able to develop timelines, delegate tasks, and drive projects to completion on schedule.
  • Collaboration: Effective at building relationships and coordinating with various teams to gather information and achieve consensus.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable working under tight deadlines and changing requirements; remains calm and flexible during high-pressure periods.
  • Integrity: Maintains confidentiality of sensitive information and upholds high ethical standards. Ensures all activities comply with company policies and regulatory guidelines.
  • Demonstrates a strong ability to build and maintain effective relationships with stakeholders by communicating clearly, engaging in proactive collaboration, and leveraging cross functional insights. Aligns relationship building efforts with enterprise goals to accelerate performance and drive strategic results.
  • Builds trusted client relationships, whether internal or external, by identifying needs and delivering tailored solutions to enhance the overall client experience.
  • Fosters a positive work culture and productive work environment, driving strategy and displaying importance of effective relationships with customers and stakeholders to influence and coach.
  • Travel requirements: 10% or less
  • Physical demands (ADA): No unusual physical exertion is involved.

Actual starting base pay will be determined based on location, experience, and other non-discriminatory factors permitted by law. Total compensation may also include variable incentives, bonuses, commissions, or other awards as outlined in the offer of employment. Flagstar provides teammates access to a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, as well as a comprehensive leave program. jobs.excerpt: Our team members are at the heart of everything we do.
jobs.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Cencora is shaping the future of healthcare by providing solutions that enable better access to medical care. We are looking for an innovative Customer Experience (CX) Research Lead to join our growing Research and Insights Practice. We're seeking a highly collaborative, thoughtful, and creative researcher to lead complex research initiatives, shape research strategy, and translate customer insights into actionable business, experience, and product decisions. Reporting to the Director of Insights and Intelligence and partnering closely with members of the CX Strategy Team, this role will develop a deep understanding of our customers and ensure their needs, behaviors and experiences inform priorities across the enterprise.

The CX Research Lead will serve as a senior research practitioner and team lead, independently leading high-impact research, while guiding, developing, and overseeing the work of other researchers. This individual will help maintain research standards, elevate the quality and strategic impact of the team’s work, and foster partnerships with stakeholders across product, strategy, marketing, and other business functions. This role provides the unique opportunity to influence product, experience, and business strategy within a Fortune 10 organization and help advance the maturity and impact of customer research across Cencora.

About You

  • Experienced customer experience (CX) researcher or research professional with deep expertise in both qualitative and quantitative methodologies. You bring a strong foundation in research design, behavioral science, and data-driven analysis, applying rigorous research practices to solve complex business and customer challenges in fast-paced environments.

  • Skilled communicator who excels at building trusted relationships across stakeholders and translating research insights into clear, actionable recommendations. Comfortable navigating ambiguity, you can see the bigger picture and identify opportunities where research can drive meaningful customer impact and business value.

  • Passionate about advancing the discipline of research through collaboration, coaching, and mentorship, helping others grow while elevating the quality and influence of research across the organization. You continuously look for ways to improve research tools, processes, and methodologies to increase effectiveness, scalability, and impact.

  • Most importantly, you are confident communicating complex findings to senior leaders and executive audiences, influencing strategic decisions through compelling storytelling and evidence-based insights.

Responsibilities

  • Lead complex, high-impact research initiatives, end-to-end, from defining business questions and research strategy through execution, synthesis, storytelling, and activation of insights.

  • Develop strategic research plans and roadmaps in partnership with business and product leaders, identifying where research can have the greatest impact on customer experience and business outcomes.

  • Serve as a trusted research advisor to cross-functional partners, helping to translate ambiguous business challenges into clear research questions and evidence-based decisions.

  • Establish and champion research best practices, standards, and frameworks that maintain consistency, quality, and build scalability of research across the organization.

  • Conduct and oversee a broad range of quantitative, qualitative, and mixed-methods research, spanning generative, exploratory, and strategic research.

  • Synthesize insights across studies and data sources to identify broader customer needs, experience gaps, emerging trends, strategic opportunities.

  • Translate research findings into clear, compelling narratives and recommendations for senior leaders.

  • Provide day-to-day leadership to researchers, including research direction, prioritization, coaching, feedback, and development.

  • As the function grows, assume formal people leadership responsibilities, including management and development of direct reports.

  • Contribute to the continued development of Cencora’s research practice and culture of customer-centered, evidence-based decision-making.

Education and Work Experience

  • 7+ years in customer experience, market, or related research, with demonstrated experience independently leading complex research initiatives with impactful outcomes.

  • 3+ years of mentoring, coaching, or providing research direction to other researchers; prior formal people management experience preferred.

  • Demonstrated formal training in research methodology, behavioral science, study design, and analysis.

  • Bachelor’s degree in market research, Psychology, Cognitive Science, Human Centered Interaction (HCI), Human Factors, Sociology, Anthropology, or another research-intensive discipline with formal training in research methodology and design.

  • Advanced degree (Master’s or Doctorate) preferred.

  • Certification in market research, data analytics, or equivalent preferred.

  • A portfolio demonstrating past work experience and deliverables (e.g., surveys, user study designs, research reports, etc.).

Skills and Knowledge

  • Advanced proficiency in qualitative quantitative methodologies, including survey design, in-depth interviewing, and other appropriate research approaches.

  • Proficiency with survey and research platforms, such as Qualtrics, UserTesting, Medallia, and other similar tools.

  • Working knowledge of statistical analysis and data interpretation, including descriptive and inferential statistical techniques. Experience working with data analysis and visualization tools, such as Excel, Tableau, SPSS, SAS, Jamovi, R, Python, etc.

  • Experience synthesizing and analyzing qualitative and quantitative datasets to identify patterns and generate actionable insights.

  • Experience conducting or strong familiarity with Bayesian statistics.

  • Familiarity with collaboration tools such as Mural, Miro, or similar platforms.

What Cencora offers

We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day. In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. This encompasses support for working families, which may include backup dependent care, adoption assistance, infertility coverage, family building support, behavioral health solutions, paid parental leave, and paid caregiver leave. To encourage your personal growth, we also offer a variety of training programs, professional development resources, and opportunities to participate in mentorship programs, employee resource groups, volunteer activities, and much more. About the role: 
Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Director serves as a leader within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group, establishing oneself as a credible voice within their designated market at local, regional and global levels. Utilizing exceptional research and analytical skills, a Director plays a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations. 

 

A Director possesses a keen eye for identifying gaps, problems and solutions within the market they serve. They use their knowledge to help clients make better decisions, solve complex issues and execute new practices that propel clients’ businesses toward key objectives and publish these pragmatic and/or provocative insights. Additionally, they reinforce Gartner’s value every day by engaging clients via in-person and virtual meetings, sales support visits, Gartner conferences and industry events. This role is an opportunity to join Gartner’s growing Human Resources Practice. This group is dedicated to tracking the leading edge of HR innovation — notably the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) on HR and the workforce — and advising Chief Human Resources Officers (CHROs) and other HR functional leaders on related HR strategies, initiatives and investments.  Senior Directors are expected to offer flexibility in what they can cover and how they channel their expertise. 
 
What you will do:  

  • Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have” insights offering compelling, objective and actionable advice for Gartner clients in multiple formats (i.e., writing, video, infographics, podcasts) on topics including (but not limited to) focusing on AI in HR strategy creation, use case implementation, workflow redesign, governance, and value realization 

  • Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act 

  • Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward 

  • Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing insights positions across a team of analysts 

  • Bring provocative, independent insights into Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda 

  • Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts, including relevant regulatory environments, to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights; track and work closely with vendors, market trends, emerging technologies and practices to remain ahead of the curve within the AI-driven HR technology space 

  • Deliver individualized advice rooted in quantitative and qualitative data and specific to a client role to CHROs and other senior HR leaders through video-based presentations and discussions 

  • Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings 

  • Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business 

  • Provide high quality and timely content peer review 

  • Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy 

  • Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community 

  • Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery 

  • Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members 

  • Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions 

   

What you will need:  

  • Bachelor's degree and 10+ years of relevant field or industry experience in HR functional and/or technology leadership roles or an equivalent combination of education and experience

  • Profound understanding of the challenges CHROs face as leaders within the enterprise and familiarity with the CHRO workflows and priorities. 

  • Experience with successfully designing, implementing and managing HR AI in HR strategies and transformation initiatives. 

  • Deep first-hand knowledge of the HR tech landscape, including market dynamics, vendors, products and emerging use cases, particularly with respect to AI and generative AI, and their impact on HR strategies, use cases, processes workflows, team structures and data governance, and ROI governance. 

  • HR compliance experience, specifically understanding how relevant regulatory environments impact HR operations  

  • Demonstrate executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders 

  • Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high-quality deliverables 

  • Demonstrate excellence in research and writing ability 

  • Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions 

  • Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges 

  • Strong communicator who can explain complex concepts concisely and simply 

  • Subject matter expert comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements 

  • Strong business and financial acumen 

  • Deep knowledge of the global and competitive landscape within subject area as well as the interplay in that market 

  • Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team 

  • Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments 

  • Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels 

  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable) 

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

CHEP helps move more goods to more people, in more places than any other organization on earth via our 347 million pallets, crates and containers.
