What does that mean for you? You’ll join an international organization big enough to take you anywhere, and small enough to get you there sooner. You’ll help change how goods get to market and contribute to global sustainability. You’ll be empowered to bring your authentic self to work and be surrounded by diverse and driven professionals. And you can maximize your work-life balance and flexibility through our Hybrid Work Model.

Job Description

Are you an engineering leader who thrives at the intersection of technology, operations, and continuous improvement? Do you enjoy solving complex challenges, influencing cross-functional teams, and driving the evolution of innovative solutions at scale? Join CHEP's Supply Chain Digital Readiness team as a Serialization (S+) Process Solutions Lead, where you'll play a pivotal role in advancing our S+ serialization ecosystem across North America and beyond. In this highly visible global role, you'll partner with engineering, operations, digital, and supplier teams to optimize processes, enhance equipment performance, lead pilot initiatives, and drive the successful scaling of cutting-edge serialization technologies. This is an opportunity to combine technical expertise, strategic thinking, and operational excellence to shape the future of supply chain innovation.

Key Responsibilities May Include:

  • Develop and manage large-scale capital engineering projects for automation, IoT and continuous improvement solutions, ensuring alignment with long-term business goals and objectives.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Operations, Health & Safety, Finance, Quality) and external suppliers to drive project success, managing stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Lead the preparation of Capex documents, including cost estimates, project justifications, equipment layouts, and technical specifications, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within budget.
  • Manage equipment installation and commissioning, including contractor supervision, safety compliance, and ensuring adherence to all environmental regulations and legislative requirements.

Manager, Content Partnership Marketing

About Our Team

Elsevier’s Academic & Government (A&G) group helps our communities establish, discover, and share knowledge in an effort to advance human progress. We do this by turning scientific discoveries into peer-reviewed knowledge, hosting the world’s richest corpus of research content, enabling users to unlock insights from information, and measuring the quality and impact of research.

Within the A&G Marketing organization, the Researcher & Library (R&L) Audience team is responsible for driving awareness, adoption, and engagement across Elsevier’s researcher solutions portfolio. As LeapSpace continues to scale globally, strategic content partnerships are increasingly central to the product experience, institutional value proposition, and long-term growth strategy.

The Content Partnerships Marketing team plays a critical role at the intersection of Product, Partner Development, Sales, Communications, and Field Marketing. This function ensures that content partner relationships are translated into compelling customer value, scalable marketing programs, and consistent commercial messaging across the organization.

Joining the team means operating in a fast-moving AI and research technology environment where collaboration, strategic thinking, and operational rigor are essential.

About the Role

As Manager, Content Partnerships Marketing, you will lead the development and execution of marketing strategies that support LeapSpace’s content partner ecosystem. You will work cross-functionally with Product, Global Communications, Legal, Sales, and Marketing teams to operationalize partner-related messaging, support partner awareness and co-marketing initiatives, and enable customer-facing teams to confidently communicate the value of content partnerships.

This role requires strong stakeholder management, messaging discipline, and the ability to navigate complex partner relationships in a highly matrixed global organization. You will serve as a central coordination point between Product and commercial teams, ensuring partner-related marketing activities are strategically aligned, contractually compliant, and commercially effective.

This role reports into the LeapSpace Solution Marketing organization within the R&L Audience Marketing team. The responsibilities align closely with Elsevier’s broader post-launch GTM and sales enablement priorities for LeapSpace.

Responsibilities

Value Proposition & Messaging

  • Partner with Product, Global Communications, and Legal teams to maintain partner-related messaging frameworks and ensure consistent market positioning.
  • Translate Product-defined value propositions into messaging kits and customer-facing narratives for Marketing, Sales, ACE, and Field teams.
  • Ensure messaging stays current as partnerships, product capabilities, and market dynamics evolve.

Partner Enablement & Relationship Management

  • Coordinate partner marketing approvals, including branding, logos, and IP-related usage across LeapSpace marketing assets and experiences.
  • Develop scalable co-marketing approaches and maintain relationships with partner marketing and communications stakeholders.
  • Stay aligned on contractual obligations and partner sensitivities through ongoing collaboration with Product and partner management teams.

Promotion & Market Awareness

  • Support partner business development and product awareness through websites, showcase pages, collateral, webinars, events, and coordinated marketing campaigns.
  • Partner with Global Communications on press releases, social media, and partner announcements.
  • Coordinate with ACE and Field Marketing teams to execute integrated promotional activities.

Sales Enablement

  • Maintain consistent sales messaging related to partnerships, content coverage, and strategic positioning.
  • Develop and update sales-facing assets including pitch deck content, briefs, FAQs, and training materials.
  • Serve as the primary contact for partner-related sales questions and enablement support.

Requirements

  • Have 5+ years of experience in B2B marketing, partner marketing, product marketing, or related roles within SaaS, information services, publishing, or research technology.
  • Deliver strong messaging, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Legal, Communications, Sales, and Marketing teams.
  • Experience supporting partner or ecosystem marketing initiatives and sales enablement programs.
  • Have exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a matrixed organization.
  • Able to translate complex partnership structures into clear, customer-centric messaging.
  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving, post-launch, or transformational environments
  • Familiarity with academic research workflows, scholarly publishing, or research information services. (Valued not required).
  • Experience supporting AI-enabled products or technology platforms.
  • Experience working with strategic partnerships, licensing relationships, or content ecosystems. (Highly valued).
  • Experience coordinating global marketing programs across regions and audiences.
  • Have bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communications, Business, or related field; advanced degree is valued.

Work in a Way That Works for You
We promote a healthy work-life balance and offer flexible working options. Our benefits include wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals—supporting both your immediate responsibilities and long-term goals.

Working for You
We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including:

Health benefits: medical, dental, and vision coverage
Retirement benefits: 401(k) with match and Employee Share Purchase Plan
Wellbeing: wellness platform, Headspace subscription, and Employee Assistance Programs
Insurance: short- and long-term disability, life, accidental death, critical illness, and hospital indemnity
Family benefits: parental leave, adoption, and surrogacy support
Savings accounts: HSA, FSA, dependent care, and commuter benefits
Paid time off, plus volunteer and Employee Resource Group participation days

About the Business
As a global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes. By combining trusted content with advanced analytics, we support research, education, and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to solving global challenges and building a more sustainable future.

Experience the satisfaction of building a business whose success carries your fingerprints. Your ambition will have room to breathe. Your decisions will matter. And your proudest achievement can be what keeps growing after that first breakthrough: customers who stay, partners who believe, and a team inspired by what you made possible. Build something you’ll be proud to look back on—and excited to wake up to.

ROLE SNAPSHOT —

  • Pay: Base salary plus performance pay tied directly to new customers, active buyers, monthly product revenue and customer acquisition cost.
  • Location/Schedule: Remote/ Full-Time
  • Purpose: Grow revenue from Mercola’s existing supplements, new supplement launches and at-home lab tests through profitable customer acquisition, repeat purchasing and partnerships.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES —

  • Own revenue outcomes for the existing supplement line and at-home lab tests.
  • Lead new supplement launches from go-to-market planning through sustained sales.
  • Increase new customers, active buyers, repeat purchases and reorder rates.
  • Run paid acquisition through Hawke Media, setting targets, reviewing results weekly and holding the agency accountable for customer acquisition cost and revenue.
  • Reallocate channel spend based on measured return and growth efficiency.
  • Turn the Florida practitioner-clinic and UK gym bone-screening partnerships into measurable sources of customers and product revenue.
  • Monitor commercial performance and improve acquisition cost while scaling volume profitably.
  • Operate directly across acquisition, agencies and partnerships before building a team.

  • Proven experience growing a direct-to-consumer health or supplement business.
  • A demonstrated record of reducing customer acquisition cost while scaling customer volume.
  • Experience managing performance agencies against business results.
  • Direct accountability for acquisition and revenue outcomes.
  • Documented results with specific numbers, including customers acquired, revenue growth, acquisition cost and repeat purchase performance.
  • A hands-on commercial approach, sound economic judgment and willingness to take direction and adjust quickly.

  • Leadership experience at a direct-to-consumer health, wellness or subscription brand, or a supplement brand that scaled online.
  • Experience launching supplements into an existing customer base.
  • Experience selling diagnostics or at-home lab tests directly to consumers.
  • Revenue generation through practitioner, clinic or fitness-facility partnerships.
  • Experience operating in both US and UK markets.

Are you a collaborative Machine Learning Ops Engineer looking to work for a mission driven global organization?

Are you looking to drive cutting edge products that have a true societal impact?

About the team, this team that powers Elsevier’s Health platforms: Clinical Key AI, Sherpath AI, and AI-driven automated clinical and content workflows. You will bridge Data Science and Engineering to turn experimental NLP/IR/GenAI models into secure, reliable, and scalable services. Our systems operate over one of the world’s largest medical and scholarly landscapes.

About the role, as a Senior Machine Learning Engineer you’ll work on AI-based features (GenAI, Agentic AI, RAG, etc.) search/ranking quality, and knowledge graph aware retrieval while enforcing content rights and editorial confidentiality.

Key Responsibilities

ML & LLM Engineering, Search and Recommendation Engines

  • Automate and orchestrate machine learning workflows across major cloud and AI platforms (AWS, Azure, Databricks, and foundation model APIs such as OpenAI).
  • Maintain and version model registries and artifact stores to ensure reproducibility and governance.
  • Develop and manage CI/CD for ML, including automated data validation, model testing, and deployment.
  • Implement ML Engineering solutions using popular MLOps platforms such as AWS SageMaker, MLflow, Azure ML.
  • Scale end-end custom Sagemaker pipelines.
  • Design and implement the engineering components of GAR+RAG systems (e.g., query interpretation and reflection, chunking, embeddings, hybrid retrieval, semantic search), manage prompt libraries, guardrails and structured output for LLMs hosted on Bedrock/SageMaker or self-hosted.
  • Design and implement ML pipelines that utilize Elasticsearch/OpenSearch/Solr, vector DBs, and graph DBs .
  • Build evaluation pipelines: offline IR metrics (NDCG, MAP, MRR), LLM quality metrics (faithfulness, grounding), and A/B testing.
  • Optimize infrastructure costs through monitoring, scaling strategies, and efficient resource utilization.
  • Stay current with the latest GAI research, NLP and RAG and apply the state-of-the-art in our experiments and systems.

Collaboration

  • Partner with Subject-Matter Experts, Product Managers, Data Scientists and Responsible AI experts to translate business problems into cutting edge data science solutions
  • Collaborate and interface with Operations Engineers who deploy and run production infrastructure.

Qualifications

  • Current experience in ML Engineering, MLOps platforms, shipping ML or search/GenAI systems to production.
  • Strong Python, Java, and/or Scala experience will be considered a plus.
  • Hands-on‑ experience with major cloud vendor solutions (AWS, Azure and/or Google)
  • Experience with Search/vector/graph technologies (e.g., Elasticsearch / OpenSearch / Solr / Neo4j).
  • Experience in evaluating LLM models.
  • A strong understanding of the Data Science Life Cycle including feature engineering, model training, and evaluation metrics.
  • Background in health technology and/or medical content workflows is preferred.
  • Familiarity with ML frameworks, e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, PySpark.
  • Experience with large-scale data processing systems, e.g., Spark.
  • Experience with statistical analysis, machine learning theory and natural language processing.

Elsevier is a renowned global information analytics company that primarily focuses on providing scientific, technical, and medical (STM) research content, tools, and services. It is one of the largest publishers of academic journals and scholarly literature in the world. Elsevier operates in various domains, including science, technology, medicine, social sciences, and more. They publish a vast number of peer-reviewed journals covering a wide range of disciplines. These journals act as platforms for researchers and academics to share their findings and contribute to the advancement of knowledge in their respective fields.

jobs.excerpt: A Mgr, Product is a product leader responsible for defining strategy, driving outcomes, and developing product talent for one or more complex engineering platforms.
jobs.description:
A Mgr, Product is a product leader responsible for defining strategy, driving outcomes, and developing product talent for one or more complex engineering platforms. In this player-coach role, the Manager, Product combines deep product management expertise with people leadership to help teams build scalable, self-service capabilities that improve how engineers build, deliver, secure, and operate software across Thrivent.

The Mgr, Product is accountable for the long-term vision, strategy, adoption, and measurable outcomes of their products. In Engineering Productivity, this means helping create the platforms, practices, automation, insights, and developer experiences that enable engineering teams to deliver software faster, more safely, and with less friction. Success is measured not only by feature delivery, but by improving developer experience, reducing cognitive load, simplifying software delivery, and enabling teams to operate independently through well-designed product experiences and paved-road solutions.

This leader partners closely with Engineering Managers, Principal Engineers, Architects, and stakeholders across the enterprise to identify systemic challenges, understand customer needs, and translate those insights into product strategy and execution plans. They are expected to balance customer feedback, business outcomes, data, engineering constraints, and organizational priorities to make informed product decisions that create durable leverage across the software development lifecycle.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES: 

  • Responsible for the long-term product roadmap as part of a larger business strategy. Develops a compelling product strategy through analysis of personas, use cases, customer benefits, and solution value propositions. 

  • Consistently and iteratively ensures that business strategies are being executed through product roadmaps. 

  • Leads team collaboration to manage and prioritize product roadmap and releases across multiple products. 

  • Collaborates to resolve conflicts in a constructive manner when they arise. 

  • Accountable to ensure that product teams understand the business outcomes needed, and that business outcomes are tied to a broader business goal or objective. 

  • Identifies and tracks performance metrics both evergreen key performance indicators to monitor the overall health of the product and objectives to focus efforts on making specific, measurable improvements to experiences that drive positive outcomes.

  • Facilitates conversations and coaching with product teams and relevant stakeholders to address gaps and necessary improvements to delivering specific improvements.

  • Identifies and tracks Key Performance Metrics; accountable to ensure that KPIs are delivering the necessary business value. 

  • Ensures outcomes on the roadmap fit within capacity constraints and are prioritized and sequenced in order to maximize value to the customer. 

  • Engages with customers and users on a regular basis to uncover implicit and explicit needs and translate to product hypothesis which are tested and refined to deliver solutions. 

  • Collaborates across product teams to develop and roll out operational plans. 

  • Researches and identifies industry best practices and trends to increase effectiveness. 

  • Acquires, maintains and applies advanced knowledge of the business, its products and processes, and an academic understanding of Product Management. 

  • Recruits, develops, and sustains a high-performing team while promoting a culture of shared accountability, operational excellence, and partnership across the organization.

  • Models Thrivent’s leadership competencies – Model the Way, Rally the Team, and Deliver Outcomes. ​

  • Supports and/or develops an environment in which Thrivent employees and colleagues are focused on continuous improvement, exceptional employee engagement, and an unwavering commitment to our clients. Shapes and/or supports a culture that represents the Thrivent purpose, promise and values, ensuring that Thrivent’s trust and reputation remain strong with its clients.

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS:  

 Required:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience. 

  • 10+ years relevant business experience, including in product manager role, product owner role or similar. 

  • Understand fundamentals of iterative development, software development process and procedures. 

  • Expertise in the principles of Agile Product Management, stakeholder management, market and user research, technology management, and process design. 

  • High-level of organization and attention to detail. 

  • Passion and understanding of new technology and trends. 

  • Excellent communication, collaboration and influence skills among all organizational levels; strong facilitation and executive communications skills. 

Preferred:

  • Certified Product Manager or similar certification. 

  • Mayhave prior supervisory experience. 

  • Strong ability to effectively manage and resolve conflicting priorities. 

  • Experience in developing and delivering product strategy, articulated in terms of value and outcomes with relevant and compelling metrics and measurements. 

  • Expertise with foundational product management tools, techniques and principles across discovery, design, build, release, and measure cycle. 

  • Proven experience in leading and influencing cross-functional teams. 

  • Demonstrated experience with user interface design and best practices for usability. 

  • Experience working in large, complex organizational initiatives. 

  • Advanced skills in MS Office Suite with particular emphasis on Excel and Powerpoint. 

  • Adept at financial management to administer budgets across multiple products and ensure the product meets its requirements for return on investment.

As part of our Blue Team, at the heart of our SOC, you will participate in identifying abnormal behavior or vulnerabilities to protect our customers’ information systems.

  • Assist your customer base in protecting their information systems by identifying abnormal behavior.
  • Develop and submit a remediation plan adapted to your customers’ situation and business risks.

  • Guide and advise your customers’ operational security team when they deal with a security incident.

  • You are tech-savvy: being able to recognize attacks is vital to stop them.

Location:

  • Munich (Germany) or
  • Remote (from anywhere in Germany)

💪 Your team

In Germany we are a fast-growing team of passionate people. We are travelers, musicians, sports and concert enthusiasts, parents, early birds, night owls and many more.

Who are you? Looking forward to getting to know you soon!

🤲 Career starter, career changer, or best-ager ?
Whatever your degree or background, we are above all looking for attitude, skills, values and motivation.

We are keen to integrate profiles from different backgrounds, and we are very proud of this because we are convinced that our team is enriched in this way and that diversity is an invaluable source of creativity and innovation. Therefore, this job profile exists in different seniority flavors.

If you are up for a challenge, and you would like to take part in an innovative business project, then come and join us!

📢 Together Ahead

Joining aDvens means joining a European leader in Cybersecurity, but above all it means joining specialists who are passionate about protecting organizations that are increasingly exposed, to help them to accomplish their often-essential missions.

It also means deciding to become part of a team that puts its performance at the service of high-impact projects (socially and ecologically).

🌎 European player on a global mission

Our 600 experts are present throughout France, Germany, Italy and Spain as well as in Canada and Tahiti. We are now established in the DACH region with an office in Munich/Germany.

Our mission to protect organizations from cyber threats guides us and drives us every day. But that’s not enough for us. If Cybersecurity keeps the world go round, then our performance must help to change it for the better.

Together and ahead of the game: since our very beginnings, we have been driven by four strong values. More than just a trademark, they're our driving force to act today and do better tomorrow: #Boldness #Collective #Impact #Integrity

You have a social project you want to support? Use our internal team fundraising and collect money from colleagues and the company monthly.

Position Summary

The Chief Risk Officer (CRO) – Retail Banking is responsible for establishing and leading the enterprise-wide risk management framework for the retail banking business. The CRO oversees credit, operational, market, liquidity, compliance, fraud, cyber, conduct, and reputational risks while ensuring alignment with the bank's strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite.

The role provides independent oversight and challenge to business activities, safeguarding the institution's financial stability, customers, and reputation while enabling sustainable growth.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Risk Management

  • Develop and maintain the retail banking risk management framework.
  • Establish risk appetite statements, risk limits, and governance standards.
  • Ensure effective identification, assessment, monitoring, and mitigation of risks.
  • Provide independent oversight of business decisions and strategic initiatives.
  • Promote a strong risk culture throughout the organization.

Credit Risk Management

  • Oversee retail credit portfolios, including:
    • Mortgages
    • Personal Loans
    • Credit Cards
    • Auto Loans
    • Consumer Finance Products
  • Establish underwriting standards and credit policies.
  • Monitor portfolio quality, delinquency trends, and loss performance.
  • Lead stress testing and credit risk scenario analyses.
  • Recommend risk-adjusted lending strategies.

Operational Risk Management

  • Develop frameworks to identify and manage operational risks.
  • Monitor operational incidents, control failures, and emerging risks.
  • Oversee business continuity and operational resilience programs.
  • Strengthen internal controls and risk reporting mechanisms.
  • Ensure effective risk and control self-assessment processes.

Regulatory Compliance & Conduct Risk

  • Ensure compliance with banking regulations and consumer protection laws.
  • Oversee conduct risk management and fair customer treatment initiatives.
  • Maintain strong relationships with regulatory authorities.
  • Lead regulatory examinations and risk-related audits.
  • Ensure implementation of regulatory changes and risk controls.

Fraud & Financial Crime Risk

  • Oversee fraud prevention, detection, and investigation programs.
  • Strengthen anti-money laundering (AML) and counter-terrorist financing controls.
  • Monitor financial crime risks and emerging threats.
  • Ensure effective transaction monitoring and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Collaborate with law enforcement and regulatory agencies when necessary.

Market & Liquidity Risk Oversight

  • Monitor interest rate risk and liquidity risk exposures.
  • Evaluate balance sheet vulnerabilities and stress scenarios.
  • Support asset-liability management activities.
  • Ensure adherence to regulatory capital and liquidity requirements.

Cybersecurity & Technology Risk

  • Oversee technology and cyber risk governance.
  • Assess cybersecurity threats and resilience capabilities.
  • Ensure robust controls for digital banking platforms.
  • Monitor third-party and vendor risk exposures.
  • Support digital transformation initiatives through effective risk management.

Governance & Reporting

  • Present risk reports to Executive Management, Risk Committees, and the Board.
  • Develop key risk indicators (KRIs) and risk dashboards.
  • Ensure timely escalation of significant risk issues.
  • Maintain effective risk governance structures and committee frameworks.

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead risk management teams across multiple disciplines.
  • Develop future risk leaders and succession plans.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, integrity, and transparency.
  • Promote collaboration across business, compliance, audit, and technology functions.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Administration, Risk Management, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree (MBA, Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field) preferred.

Professional Certifications

Preferred certifications include:

  • Financial Risk Manager (FRM)
  • Professional Risk Manager (PRM)
  • Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA)
  • Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS)

Experience

  • 15+ years of progressive banking and risk management experience.
  • Extensive experience within retail banking risk management.
  • Proven leadership experience overseeing enterprise risk functions.
  • Experience interacting with regulators, boards, and executive committees.
  • Strong understanding of consumer lending, deposits, payments, and digital banking.
  • Experience leading large, multidisciplinary risk teams.

Technical Competencies

  • Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)

  • Operational Risk

  • Fraud Risk Management

Leadership Competencies

jobs.description:
who we are

Evora Group is a specialist SAP consulting and services partner with deep expertise in SAP Cloud ERP transformation. We help mid-market and enterprise organizations across North America unlock operational efficiency and scalability through SAP S/4HANA Cloud, SAP BTP, and adjacent SAP solutions. We are a trusted partner within the SAP ecosystem and are growing our North American sales presence to capitalize on significant market demand.

We are looking for a driven, experienced Account Executive to own and grow our SAP Cloud ERP sales motion in North America. This is a high-impact individual contributor role built around three core pillars: owning complex enterprise sales cycles end-to-end, cultivating deep relationships within the SAP field organization, and proactively generating your own pipeline. This is not an overlay or a channel role - you will carry a quota and be expected to build and close business.

who we are looking for

Full SAP Cloud ERP Sales Cycle Ownership

  • Manage end-to-end sales cycles for SAP Cloud ERP opportunities - from initial qualification through discovery, solution design, business case development, negotiation, and close.
  • Develop account and territory strategies that maximize win rates and average deal size.
  • Work cross-functionally with presales, delivery, and leadership to craft compelling, customer-specific proposals and demonstrations.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline hygiene and forecasting in CRM (HubSpot), with a consistent methodology across stages.
  • Meet and exceed annual quota targets; operate with a sense of urgency and accountability throughout the quarter.
SAP Ecosystem Relationship Building
  • Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with SAP Territory Managers, Account Executives, and Partner Business Managers across your assigned North American territory.
  • Position Evora Group as the go-to implementation and transformation partner for SAP-led Cloud ERP opportunities - ensuring inbound referrals and co-sell motions flow to you.
  • Participate in SAP field events, QBRs, partner days, and industry meetups to deepen relationships and stay visible within the SAP ecosystem
  • Develop a systematic approach to tracking SAP territory alignment and ensuring warm, reciprocal relationships at the local and regional level.
  • Collaborate on joint account plans with SAP field teams where opportunities exist for coordinated pursuit.
Self-Generated Pipeline & Market Intelligence
  • Proactively source new opportunities through your personal network, outbound prospecting, referrals, and strategic outreach - not solely through SAP-referred leads.
  • Monitor market intelligence for pipeline triggers: leadership changes, ERP system end-of-life signals, funding events, M&A activity, and organizational growth inflection points.
  • Represent Evora Group at industry conferences, SAP user groups (ASUG), trade shows, and networking events across North America.
  • Develop and execute account-based prospecting campaigns in collaboration with marketing to penetrate target verticals and accounts.
  • Build a reputation as a trusted SAP Cloud ERP advisor - leveraging thought leadership, social presence, and community engagement to drive awareness and inbound interest.

what you bring

Required Skills:

  • Energetic attitude with a passion to succeed in quota attainment and teamwork.
  • 5+ years of B2B enterprise software sales experience, with at least 3 years selling Cloud solutions (S/4HANA Cloud, SAP ERP, ByDesign, or adjacent Cloud portfolio).
  • Demonstrated track record of managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles (typically 6–9 months) and closing six-to-seven figure deals.
  • Existing relationships within the SAP field organization - Territory Managers, Account Executives, or Partner channels - that can be activated from day one.
  • Strong hunter mentality: you can self-source pipeline and don't rely on inbound alone to hit your number.
  • Experience selling ERP transformations to C-suite buyers (CFO, COO, CIO) and navigating complex organizational buying processes.
  • Proficiency with HubSpot CRM and standard enterprise sales methodologies.
  • Excellent communication, discovery, executive presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to travel, up to 25% minimum, as needed within North America for customer meetings, SAP events, and industry conferences.
Preferred Skills:
  • SAP Partner certification, SAP Activate methodology knowledge, or formal SAP sales training.
  • Experience at an SAP reseller, VAR, or systems integrator (SI) environment.
  • Existing warm prospect network or book of business in North American mid-market or enterprise segments.
  • Familiarity with SAP partner program structures, deal registration, and co-sell motion mechanics.
  • Knowledge of key SAP Cloud ERP verticals: manufacturing, professional services, retail, or life sciences.

what we offer

  • Competitive base salary with uncapped commission - OTE commensurate with experience.
  • Generous PTO, comprehensive medical, dental & vision coverage, and 401(k) with employer match.
  • Remote-first culture with flexibility and autonomy over how you manage your territory.
  • Access to Evora Group's SAP partnership resources, enablement, and technical presales support.
  • A collaborative, expert team with deep SAP delivery credibility behind every deal.
  • Clear career path as we scale our North American presence.
  • Company-supported attendance at key SAP and industry events.

jobs.description:
Somos a maior companhia tech brasileira para o agronegócio, conectando pessoas, soluções e tecnologia para transformar a gestão das empresas do setor. Nosso objetivo é simplificar processos complexos por meio de produtos digitais, principalmente nas áreas fiscal, contábil e regulatória.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Business Analyst com forte conhecimento fiscal e contábil, especialmente com domínio das mudanças trazidas pela Reforma Tributária (IBS, CBS e novo modelo de tributação).

Mais do que conhecer a legislação, buscamos alguém que consiga propor soluções inovadoras dentro do produto, ajudando nossos clientes a atravessarem esse momento de transição com segurança. Essa pessoa terá papel estratégico em entender as novas regras, acompanhar o mercado, identificar oportunidades e transformar tudo isso em funcionalidades claras, eficientes e escaláveis.

Você fará parte de um time colaborativo, orientado a dados e focado em resultado, que valoriza autonomia, clareza na comunicação e protagonismo na construção do produto.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Acompanhar tendências do mercado e soluções que estão sendo adotadas por outras empresas;
  • Traduzir as novas regras em funcionalidades claras, escaláveis e alinhadas com o produto;
  • Desenhar fluxos, regras de negócio e comportamentos do sistema considerando o novo modelo de tributação.

Métricas e análise de produto

  • Definir e acompanhar métricas de produto relacionadas às funcionalidades fiscais e contábeis;
  • Analisar adoção de funcionalidades, comportamento dos usuários e impacto das entregas;
  • Propor melhorias com base em dados e indicadores;
  • Acompanhar evolução de métricas como uso de funcionalidades, redução de erros fiscais, eficiência de processos e valor gerado para o cliente.

Discovery e priorização

  • Conduzir entrevistas, workshops e análises de dados para identificar dores relacionadas a processos fiscais e contábeis;
  • Levantar impactos da Reforma Tributária no produto e nos clientes;
  • Apoiar na priorização das demandas com base em impacto regulatório, adoção e valor para o negócio.

Modelagem e especificação

  • Mapear processos fiscais e contábeis de ponta a ponta;
  • Elaborar fluxos, fluxogramas e diagramas UML (casos de uso, sequência e classe);
  • Escrever User Stories com critérios de aceite claros e testáveis;
  • Definir regras de negócio, validações, mensagens e comportamentos esperados das funcionalidades;
  • Apoiar na definição de integrações, APIs e regras de validação de dados fiscais.

Qualidade e entrega

  • Apoiar o time de QA na definição de cenários de teste;
  • Validar entregas com stakeholders e clientes;
  • Acompanhar a evolução das demandas dentro das sprints;
  • Garantir que as regras fiscais e contábeis estejam sendo aplicadas corretamente nas entregas.

Requisitos obrigatórios (Hard Skills)

  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos como Business Analyst, Analista Fiscal, Analista Contábil ou função equivalente;
  • Conhecimento prático em rotinas fiscais;
  • Apuração de tributos;
  • Obrigações acessórias fiscais e contábeis;
  • Documentos fiscais eletrônicos (NF-e, NFC-e, CT-e, MDF-e);
  • Conhecimento em Reforma Tributária (IBS, CBS, Imposto Seletivo e novo modelo de tributação);
  • Capacidade de analisar a legislação e transformar em solução dentro do produto;
  • Experiência com métricas de produto ou análise de dados de uso de funcionalidades;
  • Experiência estruturando:
  • User Stories com critérios de aceite claros;
  • Regras de negócio detalhadas;

  • Experiência colaborando com times de tecnologia (back-end, front-end e QA);

  • Conhecimento básico de SQL ou leitura de modelos de dados.

Diferenciais (muito valorizados para a vaga)

  • Experiência com sistemas fiscais ou contábeis;

Soft skills que valorizamos

The Forest Legacy Program Manager is responsible for administering all aspects of the Department of Forestry and Fire Management's (DFFM) Forest Legacy and Community Forest Legacy (CFLP) Programs. This position develops and implements strategies, plans and budgets, recruits projects for submission to available national Request for Project Proposals, conducts stakeholder engagement and outreach, coordinates due diligence and land acquisitions, and monitors and reports on all funded projects.

This position is 100% grant-funded; funding is reviewed annually.

This position offers the ability to work remotely, within Arizona, based upon the department's business needs and continual meeting of expected performance measures.

The State of Arizona strives for a work culture that affords employees flexibility, autonomy, and trust. Across our many agencies, boards, and commissions, many State employees participate in the State’s Remote Work Program and are able to work remotely in their homes, in offices, and in hoteling spaces. All work, including remote work, should be performed within Arizona unless an exception is properly authorized in advance.

Job Duties:
  • Work with partners to administer the Forest Legacy Program (FLP) and Community Forest Legacy Program (CFLP). Liaise, build and maintain relationships with the US Forest Service, Local and Regional governments, non-governmental organizations, private landowners, contractors and other partners and stakeholders in FLP and CFLP initiatives.
  • Oversee grant and budget administration for all aspects of the FLP and CFLP. Compile and review applications; draft narratives and submit comprehensive funding proposals for federal consideration; manage multi-million dollar budgets, ensuring proper allocation of federal capital and partner match; track metrics and compile annual accomplishment reports for federal partners and state leadership.
  • Navigate terms for complex land acquisitions with private landowners. Draft and review legally binding conservation easement documents. Coordinate due diligence processes, including property appraisals, mineral evaluations, and baseline documentation reports. Oversee annual monitoring of all existing FLP-funded conservation properties to ensure easement compliance.
  • Develop, manage, implement, and evaluate a comprehensive Forest Legacy and Community Forestry Program Strategic Plan. Review, revise, and maintain the Assessment of Need Report delivered with the 10-year USFS Forest Action Plan. Participate in annual and 5-year program reviews, maintain state program guidance document for FLP and CFLP. Implement program priorities, funding, and policies and maintain program records.
  • Administer FLP and CFLP cost-share project awards and other related programs, including awards and master agreements. Manage pass through awards, projects, contracts, and annual program budgets for staff and special projects. Engage and oversee providers, manage contracts for services (legal, survey, appraisal, minerals determination, stewardship plans, etc.). Track project status using the USFS data management systems.Conduct site visits.
  • With the Stewardship Program Manager, co-coordinate and provide oversight to the Forest Stewardship Statewide Advisory Committee and participate on statewide and national FLP advisory boards.
  • Other duties as assigned as related to the position.

Knowledge of:

  • State and Federal Forest Legacy Program and Community Forest Legacy Program policies and protocols., and grant regulations (Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200).
  • Basic forestry measurements, stewardship planning, and best practices.
  • Conservation easements, property titles, boundary surveys, due diligence and land appraisal standards.
  • Strategic Planning and Program Evaluation.

Skills in:

  • Legal and process document review.
  • Communication, including writing, editing, talking, listening, educating, and public speaking.
  • Project and budget management and use of project management tools and databases. Organizing internal and external teams to complete work by stated deadlines.
  • Legal document review.
  • Organization of ideas and documents.
  • Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and spatial analysis.
  • Creating and maintaining interpersonal relationships.
  • Research and analytical skills.

Ability to:

  • Review and understand complex legal and process documents.
  • Plan work independently, adhere to schedules and set and meet deadlines.
  • Envision and execute strategies.
  • Build diverse partnerships, recruit and motivate partners to submit project elements on a deadline.

  • Drive on state business with possible overnight stays.

jobs.description:
AlphaGov is seeking an Impact Fee & Housing Nexus Study Consultant to prepare technical analyses and fee recommendations for a local government engagement. You will evaluate how new development affects public infrastructure and housing demand, document the basis for proposed fees, and support the client through review and adoption.

This engagement requires direct experience developing defensible studies that connect development impacts, documented needs, and proposed fees under applicable state requirements.

What you’ll do

  • Review existing fee programs, development forecasts, capital improvement plans, housing data, and relevant prior studies.
  • Coordinate with planning, finance, public works, housing staff, and legal counsel to establish study assumptions and requirements.
  • Analyze infrastructure needs attributable to new development and distinguish them from existing deficiencies.
  • Prepare housing nexus analyses connecting the development types under study to associated housing demand.
  • Develop transparent calculation models, allocation methods, and proposed fee schedules with supporting documentation.

jobs.excerpt: Ready to guide the CMC path for one of the first gene therapies built for a prevalent, age-related disease, from CDMO kickoff to first-in-human?
jobs.description:
Ready to guide the CMC path for one of the first gene therapies built for a prevalent, age-related disease, from CDMO kickoff to first-in-human?

The Journey and Destination:

Gordian is a therapeutics company whose mission is to cure age-related disease. Our Mosaic Screening platform pools interventions in living animals, giving causal validation for hundreds of targets at once. You can read more on ourwebsite and in ourpreprint.

The engine is working. We have results across six disease areas and have mappednearly as many targets as the field reported in 20 years. Anovel osteoarthritis candidate is in IND-enabling studies, and we've started an obesitydrug-discovery collaboration with Pfizer. Now we're taking our first AAV program toward the clinic, and what we do here will set the precedent for gene therapies in prevalent disease.

The Project

We're looking for an AAV CMC expert to help take our first gene therapy program to first-in-human, on an aggressive timeline. You'll size up where our CMC stands, shape our strategy with our external CDMO, and run the regular working meetings that keep the CDMO moving fast and delivering the right quality and quantity of material, on time. You bring the expertise and the recommendations; Gordian makes the final program calls.

This is a hands-on engagement, not a name on a slide. You'll set the agenda for CDMO meetings, bring sharp recommendations on process, analytics, and release, turn every meeting into clear next steps, and follow up until the CDMO delivers, pushing timelines when they need pushing. How you get there is up to you.

What You'll Deliver:

In the first month, you'll run a thorough CMC gap analysis against our target product profile and hand us a prioritized plan for closing any gaps you find. You'll also bring your technical eye to our CDMO master services agreement and the initial process development and manufacturing plan.

Through months 1–6, you'll run the CDMO working meetings, turn each one into written next steps with owners and due dates, and chase deliverables to the finish line. You'll guide upstream, downstream, and analytical development, including a phase-appropriate potency assay strategy, and draft Module 3 for our pre-IND package so we get the most out of our FDA interaction.

By six months, the CDMO's non-GMP engineering run will have delivered material for our GLP-tox study, and you'll have drafted Module 3 content for our pre-IND and IND submissions. You'll prepare the CMC briefing and walk into FDA meetings as our CMC expert, ready to take the agency's questions.

And You

You're an independent CMC consultant who has done this before and wants to do it again on something first-of-its-kind. You bring the judgment of a seasoned CMC pro, make well-supported recommendations, and are comfortable holding a CDMO accountable to timelines and quality. When a manufacturing question needs an answer, you go back to the science to settle it.

You must have:

  • Taken an AAV gene therapy through CMC to a first-in-human Phase 1 trial
  • Experience with a triple-transfection HEK293 suspension process
  • Managed external vendors with strength in project management, conflict resolution, and holding timelines.
  • Written or substantially contributed to Module 3 of a pre-IND and IND application

Bonus points if you have:

  • Directly managed CDMOs for AAV manufacturing
  • Taken multiple products through successful INDs and GMP batches
  • Experience with analytical development in a GLP/GMP setting
  • Broad fluency across CMC: process development, analytical development, drug substance, drug product, and supply chain
  • Taking an AAV into later-phase trials or commercialization
  • Designing large-animal IND-enabling or toxicology studies
  • Sharp regulatory judgment

The Details:

  • Independent consulting. You'll work as an independent contractor under a consulting agreement, with the specifics set out in a Statement of Work once we've found the right fit. You're free to keep working with your other clients barring any conflict of interest.
  • Timing. A project of roughly six months, kicking off in December 2026.
  • Flexible hours. Roughly 20–40 hours a week depending on the phase, on your own schedule around CDMO meetings and milestones.
  • Remote, with occasional trips to Gordian HQ to present major deliverables and to the CDMO as manufacturing ramps up. Travel expenses are covered.

Application Due Date: 10/30 and will be evaluated on a rolling basis

If you want to guide a first-of-its-kind gene therapy to the clinic, we'd love to hear from you.

In this role, you’ll partner with product managers, UX designers, developers, architects, and business stakeholders to turn complex processes into intuitive digital experiences. If you’re curious, collaborative, and energized by solving meaningful customer and business problems, we’d love to hear from you.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:

  • Estimated salary:

    • Business Systems Analyst III: $75,000 - $83,000, plus annual bonus opportunity.
    • Business Systems Consultant I: $83,000 - $95,000, plus annual bonus opportunity.

  • 401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match.

  • Work-life balance with vacation, personal time, and paid holidays.

  • Comprehensive benefits and programs that support your well-being and career development.

  • Applicants for this position must not now, nor at any point in the future, require sponsorship for employment.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Represent the customer throughout product discovery and delivery, using research and stakeholder input to identify needs and pain points.

  • Elicit, analyze, document, and manage business and functional requirements, including user stories, acceptance criteria, and process requirements.

  • Analyze current- and future-state processes, workflows, and customer journeys to identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve experiences.

  • Define and manage digital content, forms, notifications, workflows, and information structures within content management and workflow platforms.

  • Partner closely with UX designers and product teams to contribute business and customer insights to interaction design, information architecture, task and user flows, wireframes, prototypes, responsive and mobile-first experiences, content design, accessibility, and the effective use of design systems and component libraries.

  • Facilitate workshops and discovery sessions, translating clearly across business, technical, and customer perspectives.

  • Create, maintain, and execute automated tests using JSON and frameworks such as Playwright, Karate, or Selenium to validate business requirements, user flows, integrations, and digital experiences; analyze results and partner with delivery teams to resolve issues.

  • Use customer feedback, usability findings, behavioral data, and business measures to evaluate and improve outcomes such as task completion, adoption, customer effort, accessibility, error reduction, and operational efficiency.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, plus 3+ years of experience in business analysis, product analysis, process analysis, or a related field, including 2+ years supporting digital products, services, or customer-facing applications. 2+ years of experience with automated testing platforms or tools such as Selenium, Tosca, Playwright, Postman, UFT, or similar technologies.

  • Demonstrated business analysis capabilities within Agile delivery environments, including discovery, requirements elicitation and analysis, process and customer journey mapping, facilitation, stakeholder engagement, problem-solving, and cross-functional communication.

  • Experience using customer or user research, feedback, behavioral data, and stakeholder insights to identify needs, frame problems, and inform digital-experience and solution decisions.

  • Experience partnering closely with UX designers and cross-functional product, business, engineering, technology, and operations teams; contributing business and customer insights to interaction design, information architecture, task and user flows, wireframes, prototypes, responsive or mobile-first experiences, content design, usability, accessibility, and design systems; and translating UX designs and decisions into requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, content and data needs, test scenarios, and delivery plans.

  • Ability to balance customer desirability, business viability, technical feasibility, risk, and delivery effort; connect digital-experience improvements to measurable customer or business outcomes; adapt to new tools and priorities; and support automated testing using JSON and one or more frameworks such as Playwright, Karate, or Selenium.

  • You promote a culture of diversity and inclusion, value different ideas and opinions, and listen courageously while remaining curious in all that you do.

  • Ability to work remotely with access to a high-speed internet connection and be located in the United States or Puerto Rico.

PREFERRED:

  • Experience applying human-centered or user-centered practices within business analysis, product delivery, process improvement, or digital transformation work.

  • Experience using customer or user research methods such as interviews, surveys, contextual inquiry, research synthesis, affinity mapping, personas, Jobs-to-be-Done, concept testing, usability testing, heuristic evaluation, or service blueprinting.

  • Experience with content management, workflow, or business process management platforms, including Contentful.

  • Experience using research, design, prototyping, collaboration, or analytics tools such as Figma, FigJam, Miro, UserTesting, Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, or comparable tools.

  • Experience creating or executing test scenarios and using usability, quality, behavioral, or business results to support measurable customer and operational improvements.

We value diverse experience, skills, and passion for innovation. If your experience aligns with the listed requirements, please apply!

  • Here, your skills spark progress. You’ll solve meaningful problems, collaborate with passionate teammates, and grow in a space where innovation is the norm—not the exception.

jobs.excerpt: At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential.
jobs.description:
At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

  • Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

  • Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

Role

As Security Operations Lead, you'll lead our SecOps squad and own how Sword detects, investigates, and responds to threats. You'll help structure how this function operates — setting the direction on SIEM architecture, detection engineering, and incident response — and use automation and AI to scale a focused team across a fast-growing, multi-continent footprint. You'll be a core voice in our security strategy, and the systems, processes, and culture you build will set the bar for how Sword protects 700,000+ members.

To get to know more about our Tech Stack, check here.

What you’ll be doing

  • Serve as the hands-on technical lead for Sword’s Security Operations Center. Setting the technical direction — architecting the SIEM, engineering detection logic, executing incident response, and building the technical roadmap to scale our defenses as the company grows.

  • Own the SIEM end-to-end (architecture, data sources, normalization, retention, cost, and tuning) and evolve detection-as-code content aligned to MITRE ATT&CK and Sword’s threat model.

  • Lead the SOC/CSIRT team technically — mentoring detection and response engineers, raising the bar on investigations, running on-call and escalation models, and acting as commander for major incidents.

  • Set the strategy and technical direction for Sword’s Security Operations Center — defining the operating model, SIEM and detection architecture, incident response capability, and the roadmap to scale them as the company grows.

  • Drive an AI- and automation-first transformation of security operations: design SOAR playbooks, agentic and LLM-assisted triage workflows, and ML-driven detection to reduce MTTD/MTTR, expand coverage, and let a lean team operate at enterprise scale.

  • Lead high-severity incident response from detection through containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review, partnering with engineering, IT, legal, and executive stakeholders during critical events.

  • Run the threat intelligence and threat hunting programs, converting emerging TTPs into new detections, proactive hardening, and informed risk decisions.

  • Advanced Incident Response & Threat Hunting: Lead end-to-end incident investigations in Google SecOps, leveraging complex telemetry correlation to proactively hunt for threats, contain active incidents, and drive root-cause remediation.

  • Define and report on SOC performance — MTTD, MTTR, coverage, automation rate, false-positive rate, on-call health — and use those metrics to drive measurable, continuous improvement.

  • Influence security architecture and engineering decisions across the company, ensuring detection, response, and recovery are built into new products, platforms, and infrastructure from day one.

  • Detection & Automation Leadership: Architect, refine, and maintain custom YARA-L detection rules and SOAR playbooks in Google SecOps to automate triage, alert enrichment, and initial incident response.

What you need to have

  • Required: Public Trust Clearance - Candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a US public trust clearance.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or equivalent professional experience.

  • 7+ years experience in Security Operations

  • Proven experience scaling a SOC through automation and AI — SOAR, hyperautomation, LLM-assisted triage, agentic workflows, or ML-driven detection — with measurable impact on MTTR, coverage, or analyst leverage.

  • Hands-on experience structuring a SOC, either building one from the ground up or maturing one through significant transformation — SIEM selection, implementation or migration, detection engineering practice, runbook libraries, on-call rotations, and operating metrics.

  • Deep SIEM expertise (Splunk, Sentinel, Google SecOps/Chronicle, Elastic, or similar) — ingestion architecture, detection-as-code, query optimization, and coverage-versus-cost tradeoffs.

    • Highly preferred: Google SecOps/Chronicle

  • Prior experience as the technical lead of a SOC or CSIRT team — owning the full incident response lifecycle, mentoring analysts and engineers, and acting as on-call/incident commander during major incidents.

  • Strong incident response track record — leading high-severity investigations, root cause analysis, digital forensics, and post-incident reviews that produced durable improvements.

  • Solid experience in cloud environments (AWS and/or GCP), with strong understanding of cloud-native threats and controls.

  • Strong scripting and development skills (Python, Go, Bash, or similar) for building automation, integrations, and internal tooling.

  • Working knowledge of EDR/XDR, identity, and network detection telemetry, and how to combine signals into high-fidelity detections.

  • Fluency with security frameworks and standards (NIST 800-61, CIS Controls, MITRE ATT&CK, ISO 27001) and the judgment to apply them pragmatically.

  • Background in threat modeling, adversary emulation, and risk-based alert tuning.

  • Excellent communicator — able to brief executives during a Sev1, write a clear post-mortem, and translate technical risk into business language for non-technical audiences.

  • Proven track record of leading cross-functional efforts in high-pressure situations and fostering collaboration across InfoSec, IT, and engineering.

  • Forensics experience, investigating incidents and preserving digital evidence.

Public Trust Clearance

Candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a US public trust clearance.
Please note that US citizenship is required to obtain and maintain a government security clearance.

*The range below reflects base, variable, and equity for this role.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Head of Client Success

Job Location: Boston, MA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

The Head of Client Success will drive enterprise retention through product adoption and drive long-term customer value creation the client portfolios. If you're ready to lead transformational client success initiatives and make a lasting impact on our business and our clients, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

    • Develop and execute customer success strategy aligned with company growth objectives, customer business outcomes, retention, and long-term customer value creation
    • Own customer retention and supporting sales in revenue expansion across the customer portfolio, renewals, net revenue retention, cross-sell, upsell, and overall account growth
    • Lead strategic account planning and governance in partnership with Sales, establishing account plans, executive engagement models, and processes to identify and capture growth opportunities
    • Drive customer adoption and time-to-value by developing success plans that accelerate implementation, product utilization, business impact, and realization of customer ROI
    • Establish customer health frameworks and performance metrics to measure adoption, engagement, customer satisfaction, renewal risk, retention, expansion, and overall portfolio performance
    • Use data, analytics, and experimentation to identify opportunities, evaluate program effectiveness, optimize customer engagement, and continuously improve customer success strategies
    • Lead executive customer relationships by serving as a trusted advisor, executive sponsor, and escalation point for strategic accounts and complex customer challenges
    • Partner cross-functionally with Sales and Product to align customer priorities with product strategy, commercial objectives, and service delivery
    • Translate customer insights into business strategy by identifying emerging customer needs, market trends, adoption barriers, and opportunities for product innovation and go-to-market improvement
    • Design scalable customer success operating models that balance high-touch strategic engagement with digital, programmatic, and self-service approaches to improve efficiency and customer lifetime value
    • Establish operational rigor and accountability through standardized processes, success methodologies, portfolio reviews, forecasting, performance dashboards, and continuous improvement initiatives
    • Lead, develop, and scale a high-performing organization by recruiting, coaching, retaining, and developing talent; establishing clear performance expectations; and building leadership succession
    • Champion AI adoption and digital transformation across the customer success organization, identifying opportunities to automate administrative work, improve decision-making, and enable teams to focus on strategic customer engagement
    • Communicate business performance and strategic priorities to executive leadership, presenting customer insights, retention and growth results, operational performance, risks, and recommendations
    • Represent the company as a strategic partner and industry thought leader through executive engagements, customer forums, and external industry relationships

Requirements

    • 15+ years of progressive experience in client services, account management, customer success, or related client-facing leadership roles, with a track record of managing complex client relationships and driving business growth
    • 7+ years of experience leading client services, account management, or customer-facing teams, including developing talent, scaling operations, and delivering measurable client and business outcomes
    • Demonstrated experience managing complex enterprise accounts and building trusted relationships with C-suite executives and senior stakeholders
    • Experience in healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, medical technology, or other regulated industries
    • Proven track record of driving customer adoption across the product portfolio
    • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including account growth strategy, revenue forecasting, customer lifetime value, and return on investment
    • Experience building and implementing scalable Customer Success strategies, operating models, processes, and governance frameworks
    • Demonstrated ability to use customer data, analytics, and performance metrics to assess customer health, identify risks, and drive business outcomes
    • Experience partnering cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Marketing to achieve customer and company objectives
    • Proven ability to lead organizational change, improve operational effectiveness, and drive continuous improvement
    • Exceptional executive communication, negotiation, influencing, and relationship management skills
    • Demonstrated ability to recruit, coach, develop, and retain high-performing teams while establishing a culture of accountability and continuous learning
    • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience

Nice to Have

    • Proven track record of driving customer retention, renewals, revenue expansion, and net revenue retention across enterprise customer portfolios
    • Experience building and scaling digital, tech-touch, or programmatic Customer Success models that serve large customer populations efficiently
    • Experience implementing AI-powered customer engagement, agentic workflows, and automation to improve customer outcomes and team productivity
    • Experience designing customer lifecycle programs, including digital onboarding, adoption campaigns, lifecycle communications, and self-service experiences
    • Familiarity with experimentation frameworks, behavioral analytics, leading indicators, and data-driven optimization of customer engagement programs
    • Experience in enterprise SaaS, cloud software, CRM, data platforms, or other technology-enabled business solutions
    • Experience translating customer insights and market trends into product strategy, roadmap priorities, and go-to-market initiatives
    • Experience developing customer health scoring, predictive retention models, adoption metrics, and portfolio performance dashboards
    • Experience managing global or geographically distributed customer success teams and enterprise customer portfolios
    • Experience establishing executive customer advisory programs, strategic partnerships, and industry thought leadership
    • Master's degree in business, technology, or a related discipline

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A personality assessment
        3. A practical case exercise
        4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
    • Retirement programs
    • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

    • Base pay: $200,000 - $270,000
    • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. Position Overview

Job purpose

This position is intended to perform the necessary Finance & Accounting activities in their focus area with minimal management oversight & a high degree of independence. Core responsibilities include but are not limited to month end closing entries, account reconciliation & analysis, process management & improvement and ad-hoc assignments in support of the Director Finance & Accounting or VP Finance.

Company Overview

At FUJIFILM Healthcare Americas Corporation, we’re on a mission to innovate for a healthier world, and we need passionate, driven people like you to help us get there. Our cutting-edge healthcare solutions span diagnostic imaging, enterprise imaging, endoscopic and surgical imaging, as well as in-vitro diagnostics.

But we don’t stop at healthcare; our Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) team harnesses advanced radiography solutions to keep transportation infrastructure, aerospace, and oil and gas assets safe and running smoothly.

Ready to innovate, collaborate, and make a difference? Join us and bring your big ideas to life while working in a dynamic, flexible environment that fuels your creativity and drive.

Our headquarters is in Lexington, Massachusetts, an inspiring healthcare research hub in a historic town.

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit:

Job Description

Duties and responsibilities

  • Assist in the month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing processes, ensuring transactions are in accordance with GAAP, JSOX, and internal policies and procedures are followed
  • Prepare monthly journal entries and support, in line with communicated closing schedule
  • Prepare monthly and quarterly account reconciliations and analysis
  • Assist with analyzing financial statements and provide recommendations to improve business performance or efficiency
  • Prepare documentation & support internal and external audit requirements as needed
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to manage & improve financial, business & internal control processes on a continuous basis
  • Perform ad-hoc assignments or special project work for the Director Finance & Accounting or the VP Finance
  • Comply with all applicable U.S. Food and Drug Administration (U.S. FDA) medical device regulatory requirements, applicable ISO 13485 standard requirements and all other applicable laws, regulations, and standards

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance or Accounting.
  • 6+ years of Finance & Accounting experience
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks and meet deadlines
  • Strong organization and analytical skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent MS Excel skills; SAP experience preferred.
  • Must be flexible to work late hours if needed.

Physical requirements

The position requires the ability to perform the following physical demands and/or have the listedcapabilities:

  • The ability to sit up 75-100% of applicable work time.
  • The ability to use your hands and fingers to feel and manipulate items, including keyboards, up to 100% of applicable work time.
  • The ability to stand, talk, and hear for 75% of applicable work time.
  • The ability to lift and carry up to ten pounds up to 20% of applicable work time.
  • Close Vision: The ability to see clearly at twenty inches or less.

Travel

  • Occasional (up to 25%) travel may be required based on business need.

Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Digital Analytics Pleno para atuar na mensuração, análise e evolução da performance do nosso e-commerce.
Essa posição terá atuação tanto analítica quanto técnica, sendo responsável por garantir que as principais jornadas e interações dos clientes estejam corretamente mensuradas, além de transformar esses dados em insights para os times de E-commerce, Marketing, Produto e Tecnologia.
Procuramos alguém com experiência prática em Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), implementação de eventos e estruturação de dataLayer, preferencialmente em operações de e-commerce.
Experiência com VTEX será considerada um diferencial importante.

Principais responsabilidades:

Tracking e implementação

  • Criar, configurar e manter tags, triggers e variáveis no Google Tag Manager (GTM).
  • Implementar e evoluir o tracking do e-commerce no Google Analytics 4 (GA4).
  • Definir e implementar eventos, parâmetros e conversões de acordo com as necessidades do negócio.
  • Estruturar especificações de dataLayer para implementação pelo time de desenvolvimento.
  • Validar tecnicamente a implementação do dataLayer e dos eventos do e-commerce.
  • Implementar e validar eventos de e-commerce, como:
  • view_item_list;
  • select_item;
  • view_item;
  • add_to_cart;
  • remove_from_cart;
  • view_cart;
  • begin_checkout;
  • add_shipping_info;
  • add_payment_info;
  • purchase.
  • Criar eventos customizados para mensuração de jornadas e interações específicas do site.
  • Realizar troubleshooting de problemas de tracking e inconsistências de dados.
  • Testar implementações utilizando ferramentas como GTM Preview/Debug, GA4 DebugView e ferramentas de desenvolvedor do navegador.
  • Validar novas funcionalidades e releases do e-commerce sob a perspectiva de analytics e tracking.
  • Documentar o plano de mensuração, eventos, parâmetros e regras de implementação.
  • Apoiar a governança e organização dos containers do GTM.
Analytics e performance do e-commerce
  • Monitorar e analisar a jornada completa do cliente no e-commerce.
  • Construir e acompanhar funis de conversão.
  • Identificar pontos de abandono, fricção e oportunidades de melhoria da experiência digital.
  • Acompanhar indicadores como:
  • sessões e usuários;
  • taxa de conversão;
  • add-to-cart;
  • abandono de carrinho;
  • abandono de checkout;
  • receita;
  • pedidos;
  • ticket médio;
  • performance por canal;
  • performance por dispositivo;
  • performance de categorias e produtos.
  • Criar e manter dashboards de performance digital.
  • Desenvolver análises ad hoc para apoiar decisões de E-commerce, Marketing, Produto e Tecnologia.
  • Identificar anomalias de comportamento ou mensuração e investigar suas causas.
  • Apoiar análises de campanhas e canais de aquisição.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de CRO, experimentação e testes A/B.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência prática com Google Analytics 4 (GA4).
  • Experiência sólida com Google Tag Manager (GTM).
  • Experiência criando e implementando tags, triggers e variáveis.
  • Experiência implementando eventos e parâmetros no GA4.
  • Conhecimento de Enhanced Ecommerce / GA4 Ecommerce.
  • Experiência com implementação e validação de dataLayer.
  • Capacidade de elaborar especificações de tracking para times de desenvolvimento.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de debug e validação de tags.
  • Conhecimento dos principais KPIs e funis de uma operação de e-commerce.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados como Looker Studio, Power BI ou similares.
  • Capacidade de investigar problemas de dados e tracking com autonomia.
  • Conhecimento básico/intermediário de HTML e JavaScript para implementação e troubleshooting de tags.
Diferenciais
  • Experiência com VTEX / VTEX IO.
  • Experiência implementando analytics especificamente em ambientes VTEX.
  • Conhecimento de SQL.
  • Conhecimento de BigQuery e exportação do GA4 para BigQuery.
  • Conhecimento de Google Ads e Meta Ads.
  • Experiência com pixels e tags de plataformas de mídia.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de comportamento digital, heatmaps e session replay.
  • Experiência com CRO e testes A/B.
  • Conhecimento de LGPD, cookies, Consent Mode e plataformas de gestão de consentimento (CMP).
  • Conhecimento de server-side tagging.

Informações adicionais

Diferenciais:
