About the Company

Our Client is a U.S.-based healthcare practice specializing in therapeutic services for individuals with developmental and behavioral needs. Their team is dedicated to providing personalized, compassionate care while supporting therapists, clients, and families through coordinated services.

They are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Healthcare Administrative Virtual Assistant to help manage Medicaid authorizations, maintain accurate client records, coordinate administrative follow-ups, and support therapist onboarding and compliance.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys keeping things organized, takes initiative, and can provide dependable administrative support. Previous ABA experience, Medicaid authorization expertise, and Omni Practice proficiency are not required, as training and an operations manual will be provided.

Scope of Work / Responsibilities

1. Medicaid Authorizations (Top Priority)

  • Track Medicaid authorizations, monitor expiration dates, and follow up on pending approvals.
  • Help ensure clients have active authorizations before scheduled therapy sessions.
  • Maintain organized authorization records and communicate outstanding requirements.
  • Previous Medicaid authorization experience is preferred but not required; training will be provided.

2. EHR Documentation & Administrative Follow-Ups

  • Enter therapist-provided progress notes into Omni Practice following established procedures.
  • Organize client records, upload documents, and track missing paperwork.
  • Follow up with therapists and practice leadership regarding pending documentation, authorizations, and incomplete tasks.
  • Maintain accurate records and ensure administrative deadlines are met.

3. Therapist Onboarding & Compliance Management

  • Assist with onboarding new therapists and collecting required documents.
  • Track training requirements, certificates, and annual compliance updates.
  • Monitor missing or expiring documents and coordinate necessary follow-ups.
  • Training will be provided for onboarding and compliance processes.

4. Claims, Billing & Payroll Administration

  • Assist with claims processing, billing follow-ups, and payment-related concerns.
  • Coordinate with case managers to resolve outstanding billing issues.
  • Organize therapist session information needed for payroll preparation.
  • Maintain accurate billing and payroll-related records.

5. Email & General Administrative Support

  • Respond to routine emails and coordinate with therapists and case managers.
  • Assist with administrative matters involving Wayne County and other service areas.
  • Provide regular updates on pending tasks, deadlines, and follow-ups.
  • Help address existing administrative backlogs and maintain organized workflows.

6. Future Responsibilities

  • Handle inbound and outbound phone calls as needed.
  • Provide additional ABA-related administrative support once the initial backlog has been addressed.

Top 3 Priorities

  1. Medicaid Authorizations: Track authorization statuses, expiration dates, and pending approvals to help prevent interruptions in therapy services.
  2. EHR Documentation & Administrative Follow-Ups: Maintain accurate records in Omni Practice and consistently follow up on incomplete documentation and outstanding tasks.
  3. Therapist Onboarding & Compliance Management: Assist with onboarding requirements, certifications, training records, and annual compliance updates.

Requirements

Experience Requirements

  • Previous healthcare administrative experience is highly preferred but not mandatory.
  • Experience with Medicaid authorizations, claims, billing, or insurance follow-ups is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with EHR/EMR systems is preferred; experience with Omni Practice is a plus but not required.
  • ABA therapy or behavioral health administrative experience is an advantage.
  • Previous virtual assistant experience is preferred but not mandatory.
  • No medical degree, clinical license, or professional healthcare certification is required.
  • Must have relevant administrative experience and be willing to learn client-specific healthcare workflows.

Basic Requirements

  • Must be proficient in speaking and writing English clearly and professionally.
  • Must have relevant administrative, documentation, or coordination experience.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to accurately monitor deadlines, authorizations, and records.
  • Highly organized, proactive, and capable of managing tasks independently without constant supervision.
  • Patient, compassionate, and supportive, with the ability to provide gentle reminders and help practice leadership stay accountable.
  • Resourceful and comfortable coordinating with therapists and case managers across multiple counties.
  • Strong communication skills, including providing regular updates and following through on outstanding requirements.
  • Understanding of HIPAA and patient confidentiality requirements.
  • Willingness to learn new systems and processes using client-provided training and an operations manual.
  • Must be able to submit an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance background check before onboarding (mandatory).
  • Must be available for video meetings with the camera on when needed.

Technical Requirements

  • Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
  • Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.

jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Please Note: While assigned hours are generally consistent from week to week, there are no guaranteed minimal hours and positional needs will vary depending on Chaplain availability and Client requirements.

Position Summary

Chaplains are the frontline staff fulfilling the mission and Christian ministry of MCHAP, by using their gifts and talents to serve company employees and their immediate families.


Part Time, Burlington, VT


Essential Functions and Responsibilities
• Serves as a messenger and conveyor of faith, mission, and purpose.
• Interacts with companies, their employees, and the community in a manner that exhibits character through personal and spiritual disciplines.


Ministry

  • Makes regular visits to company worksites (usually weekly) to interact with employees and build relationships of trust and friendship motivated by Christian faith.
  • Visits employees or immediate family members wherever care can be expressed and help given: hospitals, nursing homes, funeral homes, family residences, or other sites.
  • May provide confidential pastoral discussions for problem issues of employees and their immediate family members including, but not limited to family matters, divorce, serious illness, care of aging parents, death and grief recovery, parenting, financial situations that may include debt discussions, budgeting, and other life issues related to financial stress, as well as any other personal issues. Provides referral service and acts as coordinator for specialized assistance to employees and/or immediate family members with specific needs.
  • May assist in the planning, conduct or attend funerals for employees or immediate family members, including follow-up support and encouragement to immediate family members during the grief period.
  • May make jail visits to employees and immediate family members.
  • Works with companies to serve notifications of death and serious injuries to families and other employees, encouraging those impacted by various tragedies.
  • May provide post-termination care for laid-off or terminated employees in order to foster a smooth transition to another work environment.
  • May facilitate, but not lead, spiritual enrichment activities, as an employee-sponsored and led activity will usually be more fruitful than a chaplain led event.
  • Provides, as appropriate/requested, literature and other resources to assist company employees with life issues.
  • Represents companies to clients/customers where it would be appropriate to ministry services involved (i.e., serious illness, accidents, traumatic events, and funerals).
  • Participates in new employee orientation to explain the Employee Care Service and the role of the Chaplain Team.
  • With Executive Director of Operations (EDO) permission, responds positively and assertively to other duties and services requested by executive leadership of companies, within the scope of the Letter of Agreement between MCHAP Chaplains and the company.

Requirements
1. Has ability to work as member of interdisciplinary group and in an interfaith setting. Possesses ability to accept different lifestyles, cultures, beliefs, and values.

2. Skills to effectively listen and interact with clients, employees, and their families. Skills to deliver community presentations. Skills to deal effectively with family members and staff under stressful circumstances. High regard for the dignity and worth of clients, employees and their families. Skills to cope with stressful situations and able to document accurately according to standards.

3. Spiritual maturity and commitment to a Christian lifestyle and to MCHAPs Ministry values. Incorporates Christian values and beliefs in day-to-day activities and in the performance of job duties. Has a fundamental understanding of the Holy Bible and its proper application. Attests to a saving faith in Jesus Christ and actively participates in a biblically based church.

4. Demonstrated ability to interact professionally with diplomacy, patience, and courtesy with diverse groups; ability to establish and maintain effective and cooperative working relationships while providing exceptional customer service. Ability to make administrative and procedural decisions and judgments on sensitive, confidential issues.

5. Demonstrated excellent oral and written communication skills to communicate and interact effectively with leadership, colleagues, employees, and families. Ability to maintain emotional stability to cope with human suffering, emergencies, and other stresses.

6. Demonstrated skill in analyzing information to define and follow up on problems or objectives. Ability to identify solutions and solve problems. Demonstrated skill in interpreting policy and procedures related to the position and keeping others informed.

7. Demonstrated computer proficiency using Google Suites, Microsoft Office, or other equivalent software, internet, email messaging, and web-based software applications. Ability to understand and learn new technology programs.

Conditions of Employment
Must pass a pre-employment background check.


Work Environment
This is a remote position in the field, and the work environment is dependent upon the clients’ worksite. Work environments can include manufacturing, hospitals, office buildings, and funeral homes with differing levels of temperature, noise, and light exposure.

jobs.excerpt: About Us We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability.
jobs.description:
About Us

We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead. 

Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!

Job Description:

Drive growth at the intersection of cold chain technology, compliance, and customer success. As an Account Executive with Copeland Cold Chain - Monitoring Solutions, you'll lead the expansion of our fixed monitoring solutions business across Industrial and Retail Pharmacy markets, building new strategic accounts and distribution partnerships while leveraging the strength of the Copeland brand. Representing industry-leading solutions from Cooper Atkins, TempTrak, and Dickson, you'll help customers protect critical products, maintain compliance, and gain confidence through reliable temperature monitoring. Industrial markets may include food processing, manufacturing, aerospace, and other markets where temperature monitoring is required.

AS AN ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE, YOU WILL:

  • Achieve annual sales goal, margin, and growth objectives for the assigned territory.
  • Develop and execute a strategic sales plan for the Industrial and Retail Pharmacy channels.
  • Develop relationships across multiple levels of key customer organizations.
  • Fully understanding Cooper Atkins, Dickson, and TempTrak products and strategic plans so customer opportunities can be matched to product offerings.
  • Selling solutions and SaaS offerings to customers, as well as hardware products.
  • Evaluate market conditions, competitive intelligence, industry knowledge, and effectively communicate this information internally.
  • Prospect as necessary to develop the business and achieve targets, estimated at 80% of activity.
  • Build a qualified sales pipeline capable of delivering established growth plans. Appropriately track opportunities in Salesforce and interface with other internal Copeland partners including other sales teams, product management, engineering, legal, and operations.
  • Attend industry tradeshows and represent Copeland at industry events.

REQUIRED EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, & SKILLS:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 10+ year sales experience in B2B sales.
  • Demonstrated experience developing new accounts and building a territory or market.
  • Willingness to travel 50% but could require more than that as needed.

PREFERRED EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, & SKILLS:

  • Prior experience selling technical solutions and SaaS products
  • Prior experience selling to corporate retail pharmacy.
  • Prior experience with environmental monitoring systems.

Remote Work Arrangement:

This role is fully remote. As a remote colleague, you may be required to travel to a Copeland site regularly to collaborate with your team or customers as needed. Copeland is committed to fostering a productive and connected culture, so you will have the opportunity to work with your team and leader to understand your team operating principles to collaborate effectively.

Our compensation philosophy is simple: we pay a competitive base salary, within the local market in which we operate, and reward performance during our annual merit review process. The pay range for this role is $125,000-$140,000 annually which includes bonus incentives, commensurate with the skills, talent, capabilities, and experience each candidate brings to a role.


Our Commitment to Our People

Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial.

Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal - to make the world a better place. We invest in the end-to-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally.

Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs: medical insurance plans, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) and more. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave, vacation and holiday leave. 

Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team!

Our Commitment to Inclusion & Belonging

At Copeland, we cultivate a strong sense of inclusion and belonging where individuals of all backgrounds, and with diverse perspectives, are embraced and treated fairly to enable a stronger workforce. Our employee resource groups play an important role in culture and community building at Copeland.

Work Authorization

Copeland will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1 with OPT or CPT, H-1, H-2, L-1, B, J or TN, or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Copeland is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, political affiliation, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace free of any discrimination or harassment.

jobs.description:
• Desenvolvimento de aplicações web e mobile utilizando tecnologias modernas de desenvolvimento front-end, sempre pensando em manutenibilidade, reusabilidade de componentes com foco em uma ótima experiência para o usuário final;
  • Revisar código produzido pela equipe;
  • Participar das especificações técnicas de novas features;
  • Garantir a qualidade de código, com testes de unidade e integração;
  • Utilizar ferramentas de IA (ex: Claude, Copilot) no dia a dia para acelerar entregas, revisar código e resolver problemas com autonomia.

Buscamos uma Pessoa Engenheira Frontend Sênior para ser referência técnica das interfaces do Admin.

Uma parte do trabalho é construir: telas, componentes e fluxos que os operadores internos usam todos os dias para resolver a operação.

Outra parte é definir padrões: componentes reutilizáveis, arquitetura de frontend e critérios de qualidade que a célula e os times de domínio seguem ao construir no Admin.

Stack principal: React e TypeScript no frontend, e TypeScript no backend. Como a base é TypeScript dos dois lados, a pessoa tem espaço para colaborar com o backend quando a entrega pede.

Como o papel se encaixa na CAJU A Jornada do Operador Caju (JOCA) é como a empresa cliente vive dentro da plataforma. O Admin é a camada que sustenta o trabalho dos operadores internos da Caju em diversas dessas jornadas, e por isso conversa com vários times de domínio ao mesmo tempo.

O Admin funciona como uma célula pequena, full stack e AI-native: produto, design e engenharia trabalham juntos, com poucas camadas e fronteiras de papel menos rígidas.

A pessoa Sênior trabalha em par com o Tech Lead, o Tech Manager, a Product Manager e Product Design do Admin, e é quem traduz necessidade do operador interno em interface confiável e simples de usar.

  • Arquitetar e evoluir o frontend do Admin em React e TypeScript: estrutura de componentes, gestão de estado, roteamento, performance e acessibilidade.
  • Definir e manter, junto com Product Design, os padrões de UI e a biblioteca de componentes reutilizáveis do Admin, para que telas novas nasçam consistentes.
  • Analisar construções de frontend dos times de domínio que entregam no Admin, apontando riscos e recomendando padrões de componente, arquitetura e performance.
  • Avaliar, junto com a célula, se as demandas de interface que chegam são responsabilidade do Admin, com base na matriz de responsabilidade do time.
  • Desenhar com o backend os contratos de API consumidos pelas interfaces, e contribuir no código quando a entrega pedir.
  • Contribuir para uma estrutura automatizada de validação do código de frontend que chega ao Admin, combinando pipelines de CI/CD e revisão assistida por IA.
  • Cuidar da observabilidade do frontend (erros em produção, performance percebida, Core Web Vitals) e responder pelos incidentes de interface.
  • Garantir testes automatizados de frontend (unitários, de integração e de fluxo completo) e boas práticas de segurança e privacidade em contexto regulado.
  • Escrever e defender RFCs de frontend, com cenários alternativos e trade-offs claros, e planejar entregas em lançamentos menores, com feature flags quando fizer sentido.
  • Atacar proativamente a complexidade das interfaces existentes e identificar oportunidades de pagar dívida técnica.
  • Entender as regras de negócio, a operação base e os papéis das jornadas que o Admin atende, para desenhar interfaces que reduzam esforço e erro do operador.
  • Escrever documentação técnica clara: padrões de componente, decisões de arquitetura e guias de contribuição para outros times.
  • Mentorear pessoas engenheiras Plena e Júnior quando houver e participar do recrutamento, atuando como embaixadora da cultura e da excelência técnica.
  • Métricas de sucesso O sucesso deste papel é medido pela saúde técnica das interfaces que a pessoa constrói e pela qualidade dos padrões e recomendações que ela define. Especificamente: Estabilidade das interfaces construídas: taxa de erro em produção, tempo de resolução de incidentes de frontend. Performance percebida: tempo de carregamento e resposta das telas do Admin, acompanhado por métricas de web performance. Velocity com qualidade: entrega frequente sem regressão visual ou funcional. Consistência das telas do Admin com os padrões e componentes definidos. Qualidade das RFCs, das análises entregues aos times de domínio e da documentação técnica.
  • Experiência como pessoa engenheira de software sênior, com foco principal em frontend e passagem por aplicações web complexas em produção.
  • Domínio de React e TypeScript, incluindo arquitetura de aplicações de médio e grande porte, gestão de estado e organização de componentes.
  • Domínio de design patterns aplicados ao frontend e capacidade de reconhecer design smells em código de terceiros.
  • Experiência construindo ou mantendo design systems e bibliotecas de componentes reutilizáveis.
  • Experiência com performance de interface (profiling, otimização de renderização, carregamento) e acessibilidade.
  • Experiência com testes automatizados de frontend (Jest, Testing Library, Playwright, Cypress ou equivalentes).
  • Consumo de APIs REST e autenticação (OAuth, JWT); familiaridade com para colaborar com o backend da célula.
  • Vivência com CI/CD, observabilidade de frontend (Sentry, Datadog RUM ou equivalentes) e estratégias de rollout com feature flags.
  • Uso de assistentes de IA no dia a dia de desenvolvimento (Claude Code, Claude Agent SDK ou equivalente) como parte da prática de engenharia do time, com critério para revisar e validar código gerado e sem abrir mão da responsabilidade técnica sobre o que vai para produção.
  • Disposição para entender como o negócio se organiza, a atuação base da operação e os papéis das pessoas que usam o Admin.
  • Interesse por interfaces de trabalho intenso, com muitos dados e ações críticas, onde clareza e prevenção de erro valem mais que efeito visual.
  • Capacidade de conversar com PM, Product Design, operação e times de domínio, entendendo o problema antes de propor solução.
Soft skills:
  • Comunicação e negociação: escrita e falada claras; sabe argumentar sobre escopo e padrões com outros times.
  • Capacidade crítica: questiona a demanda e a solução proposta antes de executar, e sustenta a posição com critério.
  • Influência e consenso: faz os padrões de frontend serem adotados por convencimento, não por imposição; cria pontes com outros times.Dono técnico: se responsabiliza pelas decisões de frontend, com discernimento para escalar ao Tech Lead e ao Tech Manager quando faz sentido.
  • Pragmatismo: entrega funcionando primeiro, evolução em seguida.
Diferenciais:
  • Experiência com Angular, além de React.
  • Experiência contribuindo em backend e TypeScript.
  • Experiência construindo pipelines de CI/CD com validações automatizadas de frontend (lint, testes visuais, análise estática).
  • Experiência criando prompts ou agentes (via Claude ou equivalente) para revisão e validação automatizada de código.
  • Passagem por produtos de backoffice ou ferramentas internas usadas por times de operação.
  • Experiência prévia em fintech, meios de pagamento ou emissoras de cartão.
  • Vivência com Storybook, Figma, Jira, Notion, Sentry ou equivalentes.

Nå ser vi etter norsktalende kundeservicemedarbeidere som liker å jobbe med mennesker og ønsker genuint å skape gode kundeopplevelser, samt trives i et dynamisk arbeidsmiljø med høyt tempo.

Hos Transcom blir du en del av et inkluderende og internasjonalt arbeidsmiljø hvor du blir tatt godt imot og får støtte fra første dag. Vi investerer i våre medarbeidere og deres utvikling.

Netthandel er i stadig utvikling, og hos Transcom er vi opptatt av å skape gode kundeopplevelser i alle deler av kjøpsreisen.

I denne rollen vil du hjelpe kunder med spørsmål og utfordringer knyttet til deres kjøp – fra bestilling til levering og videre. Du vil lytte til kunden, forstå behovene deres og finne gode, effektive løsninger.

Vi ser etter deg som er positiv, løsningsorientert og genuint opptatt av å hjelpe andre.

Hvordan er det å jobbe hos Transcom?

Hos Transcom er du aldri bare en medarbeider – du blir en del av et globalt fellesskap.

Vi er over 33 000 kundeopplevelsesspesialister i 29 land, fordelt på 90 lokasjoner, og leverer tjenester på 33 språk til internasjonale merkevarer innen en rekke ulike bransjer.Vi fortsetter å vokse og investerer i våre medarbeidere. Hos oss blir initiativ, samarbeid og engasjement høyt verdsatt.Vi støtter hverandre, heier på hverandre og jobber sammen for å skape positiv og varig utvikling – både i teamene våre og i lokalsamfunnene våre.Hos Transcom skal du kunne være deg selv fra første dag. At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly organized Project Coordinator to manage project tracking, timelines, documentation, and cross-functional coordination.

Project Tracking & Timeline Management

  • No important tasks or follow-ups fall through the cracks

Cybersecurity Control Analyst

This is a US-based remote role. You will be required to interview in person.

About SailPoint
SailPoint is defining the next era of identity security. Our unified, AI-powered platform seamlessly secures both the Human Fabric of your workforce and the Agentic Fabric of AI and non-human identities, completely eliminating organizational blind spots.


Built on core principles like zero-standing privilege and contextualized risk, our platform transforms identity from a vulnerability into a strategic business advantage. Today, we are trusted by some of the largest, most complex organizations in the world to deliver intelligent, autonomous identity security at scale.

About the Role
As a Cybersecurity Control Analyst, you will play a key role driving Cybersecurity’s control assessments and compliance program with applicable standards, requirements, and policies. This is a challenging and impactful role where you will have the opportunity to work with both internal and external stakeholders while driving the continuous improvements for our GRC program.

About the Team
You will join the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) team, a collaborative group dedicated to maintaining best-in-class security across SailPoint’s SaaS and enterprise software solutions. The team works closely with partner functions across engineering, IT, compliance, and product teams to translate complex control requirements into clear, actionable business insights.

Roadmap for Success

  • 30 Days: Complete onboarding, familiarize yourself with SailPoint's Control Testing processes, policies, and security tooling, and establish working relationships with the CISO team and key stakeholders.
  • 60 Days: Shadow and begin creating plans for the upcoming round of control testing. Start collaborating on GRC tool evidence gathering integrations.
  • 90 Days: Independently lead prep work for the upcoming round of control testing following current processes. Consult on control advisory requests with technical and business partners.
  • 6 Months: Drive enhancements to the control testing process, collaborate on continuous strategic planning for the cybersecurity organization, and lead control advisory sessions with technical and business partners.
  • 1 Year: Serve as a subject matter expert and thought leader in cyber control advisory, mature the continuous testing process, and collaborate to align SailPoint’s risk posture, control effectiveness and emerging threats to industry frameworks.

Requirements

  • Bachelors degree in related field, or equivalent professional experience
  • 3+ years of related professional experience in Security, Risk, and Compliance
  • Strong understanding of industry security frameworks and standards such as NIST, ISO, FAIR, OWASP, and CIS

jobs.description:
Welcome to Perena: Your Risk Layer on Solana

Perena is a decentralized financial protocol on Solana that offers USD STAR (USD*), a yield-bearing asset. USD* is fully collateralized and earns yield from diversified, real sources such as delta-neutral strategies and secured borrow-lend market positions. Its value grows automatically, making it a simple, secure way to save on-chain.

USD* is fully collateralized by a diversified portfolio of yield-generating assets and positions, including:

Delta-neutral hedged positions on centralized and decentralized exchanges (e.g., BTC, ETH, SOL)

Secured borrow-lend market positions involving on-chain stablecoins

Real-world assets, such as the reinsurance fund by OnRe

Perena actively manages asset allocation and diversifies across multiple strategies to reduce single points of failure and optimize for sustainable, consistent yield performance.

Built on Solana’s high-performance blockchain, Perena is creating a liquid, yield-bearing digital dollar that anyone can access with a sustainable, risk-managed approach.

Looking ahead, Perena is building a full suite of on-chain stablebanking products to expand access to real yield across crypto and traditional finance. The goal is a sustainable financial experience for anyone to transact, save, and invest on-chain.

Perena is founded by a team of builders from the Solana ecosystem with backgrounds in TradFi and DeFi. We believe deeply in pushing financial architecture forward — and in doing it with transparency, resilience, and speed.

We’re backed by some of the best in the world, including:

  • Solana co-founders Anatoly Yakovenko and Raj Gokal

  • Investors from Citadel, Jane Street, IMC, and Susquehanna

  • Borderless Capital, Binance Labs, Primitive Ventures, Maelstrom, Anagram, Breed, and others

Perena was a sponsor of the Colosseum Hackathon Stablecoin Track, helping fund the next generation of stablecoin projects on Solana. Our growing community spans over 20,000 developers, users, and builders aligned around one goal: reinventing how money works.

What You’ll do

  • Turn ambiguous product ideas into well-designed, production-ready systems. This person should be able to challenge requirements, make sound architectural decisions, write the technical plan, and deliver quickly with limited supervision.

  • Design flow-of-funds orchestration across venues and chains — bridging, routing, rebalancing between custodial and non-custodial systems — with reliable settlement, reconciliation, and failure handling as first-class concerns

  • Develop custody and key management patterns that meet institutional-grade security requirements across custodial and non-custodial environments

  • Build on-chain settlement and payment flows, including integrations with DEXs, lending markets, custodians, and bridge infrastructure — starting on Solana (Rust) and extending across EVM and other chains as we scale

  • Build and maintain the systems that move Perena's money: minting/redeeming USD*, allocating collateral, and routing capital between on-chain protocols, centralized custodians/exchanges, and partner bank rails

What We’re Looking ForDefining characteristics

  • 3+ years building financial systems where correctness and settlement guarantees are non-negotiable — payment rails, custody/settlement infrastructure, or trading systems

  • Built and shipped a DeFi, fintech, trading, or infrastructure product in a small team.

  • Has owned meaningful systems from design through production.

  • Strong smart-contract and backend/infrastructure fundamentals.

  • Experience with EVM; Solana experience is valuable.

  • Understands vaults, asset management, yield products, or onchain financial primitives.

  • Familiar with institutional concerns such as custody, permissions, compliance integrations, accounting, and operational controls.

  • Ideally a former founder or early engineer—even if the company or protocol ultimately failed.

  • Comfortable working directly with founders and translating commercial opportunities into scoped products.

Defining characteristics

  • Product-minded: Begins with the user, business objective, and operating constraints (not just the requested implementation)

  • High agency: Identifies gaps, proposes solutions, and keeps moving without waiting for granular direction.

  • Bias for action: can take a half-formed spec and run with it, iterating quickly rather than waiting for full direction.

  • Architecturally credible: Someone whose judgment on system design can be trusted with minimal oversight.

  • Constructively challenging: Pushes back when requirements are unclear, risky, or cannot meet a proposed timeframe.

  • Clear communicator: Produces concise technical specifications before significant implementation

Earlier in your career? Apply anyway if you can show real campaign ownership, sharp writing, and a clear point of view on the market.

Why Perena?

Stablecoins are transforming how the world stores, moves, and grows value — and we’re still early. This is a once-in-a-generation shift: from legacy money to programmable, accessible, internet-native finance. Building here isn’t just technically interesting — it’s globally meaningful.

We own our future — we trust each other to take initiative. Voices are heard and outcomes matter.

We treat our work as craft — thoughtful, opinionated, and precise.Many of us come from design, art, or cultural backgrounds.

We think from first principles — Perena is a reimagining of financial infrastructure. That starts with reimagining how we build.

We work in public — we value clarity, writing, and sharing progress openly within the team and with our community.

The Opportunity

RS&H is currently seeking a BIM Coordinator to support our Buildings business unit and advance high-quality, model-based project delivery.

This position will partner with architects, engineers, designers, project managers, and Digital Delivery leaders to implement BIM and digital delivery workflows across multidisciplinary building projects. The ideal candidate has strong technical proficiency in Revit and related Autodesk platforms, enjoys solving complex modeling and coordination challenges, and can guide project teams in the consistent application of BIM standards and best practices. The BIM Coordinator will play an important role in project setup, multidisciplinary coordination, model quality management, and the implementation of project-specific digital delivery requirements.

Job Summary

This position serves as a technical subject matter expert in digital design and engineering, independently performing complex modeling, coordination, and troubleshooting tasks using BIM, CADD, GIS, and related technologies. The BIM Coordinator oversees the implementation of processes and workflows used to develop project deliverables, supports project teams throughout the project lifecycle, integrates data from multiple sources into coordinated design models, and helps ensure that digital deliverables meet RS&H standards, project requirements, and client expectations. The position also provides technical guidance to project teams and junior staff, supports quality control activities, and contributes to the continued development of standardized digital delivery workflows.

Responsibilities

  • Produce and support high-quality digital design deliverables for complex building projects using Revit, AutoCAD, Forma, Navisworks, and related Autodesk technologies.
  • Plan and implement project-specific BIM and Digital Delivery workflows in alignment with RS&H standards, client requirements, and BIM Execution Plans.
  • Support project startup by establishing model configurations, coordinates, templates, file structures, worksharing protocols, and Common Data Environment requirements.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary building models across architecture, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, and other disciplines to mitigate conflicts and maintain model integrity.
  • Lead federated model reviews and clash-detection activities in Navisworks and related platforms, including documenting, assigning, tracking, and supporting resolution of coordination issues.
  • Perform quality control reviews to confirm digital deliverables meet technical milestones, applicable codes, project standards, and client requirements.
  • Process and integrate survey information, point clouds, imagery, drone-captured data, GIS information, and other source data into coordinated building design models.
  • Investigate and troubleshoot complex Revit, AutoCAD, Forma, Navisworks, interoperability, model management, reference, and Common Data Environment issues.
  • Evaluate and recommend innovative design solutions, emerging technologies, automation, and visualization tools that improve project quality, efficiency, and delivery outcomes.
  • Provide technical direction, mentoring, training, and day-to-day guidance to project teams and junior staff on BIM standards, modeling practices, coordination, and Autodesk workflows.
  • Support model development, milestone reviews, and deliverable production throughout the project lifecycle to promote complete, coordinated, and consistent submissions.
  • Capture project lessons learned and contribute to standardized templates, content libraries, workflows, training resources, and best practices that reduce rework and advance continuous improvement.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited program with a focus in architecture, engineering, construction management, GIS, information systems, or another related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum of four years experience working in digital design and Digital Delivery methods, supporting model-based delivery on complex, multi-discipline projects.

Video Editor

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We’re looking for a creative and detail-oriented Video Editor to produce engaging, high-quality video content across short-form and long-form formats. You’ll work closely with the design team to transform raw footage and creative briefs into polished videos that align with the company’s visual identity and creative direction.

From pacing and storytelling to motion graphics, color grading, and sound design, you’ll take ownership of the editing process from the first cut through final delivery. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical editing skills with creative judgment, takes pride in their craft, and works well in a collaborative environment.

What You’ll Own

Short-Form Content Production

  • Edit engaging short-form videos for social media platforms.
  • Align each video with the company’s visual identity, creative direction, and project goals.
  • Adapt content to suit different platforms and audience needs.

Long-Form Video Editing

  • Edit longer video projects from raw footage through final export.
  • Manage pacing, structure, and storytelling to create cohesive viewing experiences.
  • Refine cuts based on project requirements and creative feedback.

Motion Graphics & Visual Enhancement

  • Apply motion graphics, transitions, and visual effects where appropriate.
  • Perform color grading and sound design to improve overall video quality.
  • Maintain visual and audio consistency across deliverables.

Asset & Project Organization

  • Maintain organized libraries of footage, project files, and final exports.
  • Keep files structured and accessible to support efficient collaboration.
  • Ensure project assets are managed properly throughout the editing process.

Creative Collaboration & Feedback

  • Work closely with the design team to understand briefs and creative expectations.
  • Share progress cuts and incorporate feedback in a timely, professional manner.
  • Contribute creative ideas that improve storytelling and strengthen the final product.

Quality Control & Final Delivery

  • Review edits before submission to identify and correct technical issues.
  • Check audio synchronization, export settings, visual artifacts, and overall presentation.
  • Deliver polished videos in the required formats and aspect ratios.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Demonstrated experience as a video editor, supported by a portfolio showcasing a range of content types and styles.
  • Proficiency in industry-standard editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or equivalent.
  • Solid understanding of color grading, audio mixing, and motion graphics fundamentals.
  • Experience editing videos for vertical, square, and widescreen formats.
  • Strong understanding of pacing, composition, and visual storytelling.
  • Ability to interpret creative briefs and translate them into effective video content.
  • Comfort receiving feedback and making revisions within agreed timelines.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and time management.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of projects from the first cut through final delivery.
  • You care about the quality of your work and continuously look for ways to improve your editing skills.
  • You communicate proactively when timelines change or creative direction needs clarification.
  • You respond constructively to feedback and collaborate to achieve the best final result.
  • You balance creativity with technical precision and consistency.
  • You work independently while keeping teammates informed of progress and project status.

What Success Looks Like

  • High-quality short-form and long-form videos that align with the creative direction.
  • Strong pacing, storytelling, and visual consistency across deliverables.
  • Accurate exports that meet platform and project specifications.
  • Organized project files and efficient asset handoffs.
  • Timely delivery of edits and revisions.
  • Consistent collaboration with the design team and proactive communication throughout the editing process.

Typical Day

You’ll start by reviewing new project briefs, footage, and assets shared by the design team. Your primary editing work may involve building a long-form cut, refining a short-form video based on feedback, or preparing final exports in multiple formats.

Throughout the day, you’ll share progress cuts, communicate with teammates asynchronously, incorporate revision notes, and review your work for technical and visual quality before delivery. Most of your time will be dedicated to editing, with regular touchpoints for collaboration and file handoffs.

  • Initial Screening
  • Recruiter Interview
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Onboarding

Senior DevOps Engineer – Infrastructure & Platform

Reports to:Head of Infrastructure / Director of Platform Engineering

Team:Leads a DevOps team of 3

Experience:8–10+ years in DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure Engineering

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to own our infrastructure and lead a small, growing team. We work with sensitive data belonging to vulnerable populations, so security and privacy aren't afterthoughts — they're core to how we build. You'll run multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, MongoDB Atlas), champion open-source tooling over vendor lock-in, and help shape an engineering culture that takes both craft and mission seriously.

What You'll Do

Infrastructure & Reliability

Design and operate secure, highly-available infrastructure across AWS and GCP. Own MongoDB Atlas end-to-end (provisioning, scaling, backups, performance tuning). Drive infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/Ansible) so environments are consistent and reproducible.

Security & Privacy

Apply security best practices by default — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management (OpenBao/Vault), vulnerability scanning. Treat data protection as a first-class requirement given the sensitivity of the populations we serve, not just a compliance checkbox.

Open-Source Tooling

Evaluate, self-host, and own the lifecycle (upgrades, HA, patching) of open-source tools like SigNoz, SonarQube, and OpenBao — reducing vendor dependency without compromising reliability.

Monitoring & Incident Response

Build observability stacks (metrics, logs, traces) and intelligent alerting that cuts noise, not signal. Define SLIs/SLOs. Be a senior escalation point for major incidents and drive blameless postmortems.

CI/CD & Automation

Maintain CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins/GitLab CI/GitHub Actions) with quality and security gates built in. Manage Kubernetes-based container orchestration and automate routine operational work.

Leadership & Collaboration

Lead and develop a team of 3 DevOps engineers — workload, mentorship, growth. Build good processes, not just good infrastructure. Work closely with engineering, product, and security teams, and stay genuinely invested in why the work matters.

What We're Looking For

  • 8–10+ years across DevOps/SRE/Infrastructure, including experience leading or mentoring a team

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, and hybrid/on-prem environments

  • Proven track record self-hosting and operating open-source infrastructure tools in production

  • Solid grounding in security and privacy engineering — this matters more here than in a typical infra role

  • Experience with Kubernetes, Terraform/Ansible, and modern CI/CD

  • Strong Linux administration and scripting (Bash, Python or Go)

  • A genuine interest in our mission — this isn't a "just infra" role; you'll be working on systems that serve vulnerable communities, and that context should matter to you

  • Clear communicator who can work across technical and non-technical teams

Good to have:MongoDB Atlas experience, observability/AIOps tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, SigNoz), FinOps/cost optimization, relevant certifications (AWS, GCP, CKA).

About SpartanX LLC

At SpartanX, our approach is straightforward: we pair top-of-the-line solar technology with unmatched value. We deliver reliable solutions for homeowners while empowering our teams to grow, lead, and make a lasting impact. To be a Spartan means to lead with purpose, embrace challenges, and create meaningful change. Our mission is driven by innovation, integrity, and a commitment to excellence in solar energy. Join our community of professionals shaping the future of clean energy, where every project reflects our promise of Solar Done Right.

Solar Permitting Manager

Department: Permitting

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Compensation: $75-80k/Year

We Need Someone Who Knows Solar Permitting Inside and Out.

Not someone who simply submits permits.

We're looking for an exceptional Solar Permitting Manager who understands the complexities of residential solar permitting, knows how to navigate challenging jurisdictions, and has the experience to lead a high-performing permitting operation.

Someone who understands that a permit isn't just paperwork. It's a critical step in keeping a project moving, an installation on schedule, and a customer informed.

If you're the person everyone turns to when an AHJ throws a curveball, we want to talk to you.

What You'll Own

Permitting Operations & Project Execution

  • Lead and oversee the residential solar permitting process from initial application through final permit approval.
  • Manage permitting workflows across multiple jurisdictions, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and compliance.
  • Oversee permit submissions, corrections, resubmissions, approvals, and outstanding requirements.
  • Identify permitting bottlenecks and implement solutions that improve turnaround times.
  • Monitor permitting timelines, workloads, and team performance to ensure projects move forward.
  • Coordinate with Engineering, Design, Sales, Installation, and other operational departments to resolve issues impacting permit approvals.

AHJ Requirements & Regulatory Compliance

  • Demonstrate extensive knowledge of Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs), municipal permitting requirements, and residential solar regulations.
  • Navigate varying jurisdictional requirements, documentation standards, and approval processes.
  • Understand applicable building, electrical, and fire code requirements as they relate to residential solar installations.
  • Resolve permit rejections, plan review comments, and compliance issues quickly and effectively.
  • Maintain current knowledge of changing permitting requirements and ensure internal processes reflect those changes.
  • Build productive working relationships with AHJs and other regulatory stakeholders.

Team Leadership & Accountability

  • Lead, coach, and develop a permitting team capable of managing a high-volume project pipeline.
  • Establish clear expectations for quality, productivity, turnaround times, and accountability.
  • Identify training opportunities and strengthen team knowledge of jurisdictional requirements.
  • Balance workloads, establish priorities, and ensure timely follow-through.
  • Create and improve standard operating procedures that support accuracy, consistency, and scalability.
  • Use operational data to identify recurring issues, measure performance, and drive continuous improvement.

Communication, Escalation & Problem Resolution

  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex permitting issues.
  • Communicate confidently and effectively with internal leadership, cross-functional teams, AHJs, and external partners.
  • Recognize when an issue requires immediate escalation, direct intervention, or a different approach.
  • De-escalate challenging situations professionally while maintaining accountability and urgency.
  • Provide clear, accurate updates regarding permitting delays, risks, and resolution plans.
  • Anticipate problems before they impact installation schedules or customer expectations.

What You Absolutely Must Bring

  • Extensive hands-on residential solar permitting experience. This is nonnegotiable.
  • Proven experience managing or leading solar permitting operations and teams.
  • Comprehensive understanding of AHJ requirements, permit application processes, plan reviews, corrections, and approvals.
  • Strong working knowledge of applicable residential solar building, electrical, and fire codes.
  • Demonstrated success managing permitting across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Experience overseeing high-volume permitting pipelines and competing deadlines.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and team accountability skills.
  • Proven ability to resolve complex permitting challenges independently.
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and operational judgment.
  • Ability to pivot quickly, prioritize effectively, and make sound decisions under pressure.
  • Experience developing workflows, improving processes, and measuring operational performance.

The Person We're Looking For

You're the person who knows that "we're waiting on the city" isn't a strategy.

You know when to follow up, when to investigate, when to escalate, and when the problem is actually on our side.

You don't allow applications to sit unnecessarily. You don't accept recurring corrections as business as usual. And you don't confuse activity with progress.

You understand that every jurisdiction is different, every delay has consequences, and every successful permitting operation depends on knowledgeable people, effective processes, and consistent accountability.

You can lead a team, challenge an inefficient process, handle a difficult conversation, and solve a complicated problem—sometimes all before lunch.

You don't just manage permits. You manage outcomes.

Why SpartanX?

At SpartanX, we value operational expertise, accountability, initiative, and people who take ownership of their responsibilities.

We're looking for a leader who can strengthen our permitting operations, develop our team, improve efficiency, and help create a more consistent, scalable process.

This is an opportunity to bring your expertise to a role where your knowledge, judgment, and leadership can make a meaningful difference.

Ready to Lead?

We're not looking for someone who needs to learn how solar permitting works.

We're looking for someone who knows it well enough to lead it, improve it, and solve the problems everyone else struggles with.

If that's you, apply today.

jobs.description:
Company Overview:Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody. Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients.

BlinkRx is the world’s first pharma-to-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world-class support on this first-of-its-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock.

We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!

Hours: Full-time, salaried (40hrs/week), Mon-Fri, 7:30am-9pm ET rotating shifts and rotating Saturdays 7:00am-5pm ET

The Opportunity:

As a BlinkRx Pharmacist, you are the clinical backbone of our closed-door facility. You will verify prescriptions with speed and precision, provide proactive phone-based patient counseling, and collaborate with prescribers to keep medications moving without compromising safety. This role is ideal for pharmacists who thrive in a structured, high-throughput environment and are passionate about improving patient outcomes at scale.

Responsibilities:

Prescription Verification and Dispensing

  • Review and clinically verify new and refill prescriptions for therapeutic appropriateness, drug-drug interactions, contraindications, and dosing accuracy
  • Validate prescription data entry performed by pharmacy technicians, ensuring transcription accuracy from provider orders and transfer records
  • Perform pharmacist verification of filled prescriptions in a closed-door fulfillment environment, confirming accuracy of drug, dose, quantity, NDC, and labeling prior to release for shipment
  • Perform daily prospective drug utilization review (DUR) to identify and resolve clinical flags before fulfillment
  • Manage specialty medication handling requirements including cold-chain verification

Patient Care

All patient interaction at BlinkRx is conducted by phone or digital platforms. Our pharmacists are the primary clinical contact for patients and must deliver a high standard of care in every call.

  • Provide proactive outbound patient counseling calls for new prescriptions, addressing drug education, expected side effects, dosing instructions, storage requirements, and adherence strategies
  • Handle inbound clinical patient calls related to counseling and clinical inquiries, while directing non-clinical inquiries, such as refill status and delivery questions, to the patient support team.
  • Document all patient interactions thoroughly in the patient profile within the pharmacy management system
  • Support Spanish-speaking patients with bilingual counseling where applicable

Prescriber Collaboration and Clinical Outreach

  • Contact prescriber offices via phone and electronic messaging to clarify incomplete, ambiguous, or clinically inappropriate prescriptions prior to dispensing
  • Partner with prescribers on therapeutic substitutions, DAW overrides, and formulary alternatives to reduce dispensing delays

Pharmacy Technician Supervision and Workflow Management

  • Supervise pharmacy technicians across data entry, prescription processing, packaging, and fulfillment workflows in accordance with state board regulations and in collaboration with technician management
  • Conduct real-time quality checks on technician work product, providing immediate corrective feedback to maintain accuracy standards
  • Identify and escalate technician performance trends to pharmacy leadership; participate in coaching and training as directed

Compliance, Safety and Quality

  • Ensure strict compliance with HIPAA, state pharmacy practice acts, federal DEA regulations, and all BlinkRx corporate policies
  • Oversee proper handling, documentation, and destruction of PHI-containing records and materials in alignment with privacy protocols
  • Participate in quality assurance activities including internal audits, prescription error tracking, and near-miss reporting
  • Report adverse drug events and medication errors through established pharmacovigilance channels, when applicable
  • Maintain fulfillment area compliance standards, including proper storage of temperature-sensitive medications

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with pharmacy leadership, patient services, clinical, compliance, and technology teams to drive operational and clinical improvements
  • Coordinate with the shipping and fulfillment team to resolve packaging errors, return-to-sender issues, and delivery failures affecting patient medication access
  • Provide clinical input on technology enhancements, workflow tools, and software configurations that affect the pharmacist verification or patient counseling experience
  • Participate in team huddles, quality reviews, and department meetings to support continuous improvement initiatives

Qualifications:

Required

  • Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) degree from an ACPE-accredited College of Pharmacy
  • Active Pharmacy License in good standing with your state Board of Pharmacy AND Idaho Board of Pharmacy
  • Strong command of the English language (written and verbal); bilingual Spanish preferred for phone-based patient counseling
  • Demonstrated ability to perform high-volume prescription verification with strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to learn pharmacy management systems, verification platforms, and internal workflow tools

Preferred

  • 3+ years of experience in a mail order, specialty, retail or closed-door fulfillment pharmacy
  • Active pharmacy licensure required in home state; candidates must obtain licensure in 3 additional states from the list below within the first 9 months of hire (prior licensure in any of the following states is a plus):
    • AK, AL, AR, CA, ID, IL, KS, KY, LA, MA, MD, MI, MS, NE, NV, OK, OR, TN, TX, VA, WV
  • Familiarity with pharmacovigilance or adverse drug event reporting protocols

What Success Looks Like:

  • Prescription verification queues are processed accurately and on time without sacrificing clinical quality
  • Every patient who receives a counseling call feels informed, supported, and confident in their therapy
  • Prescriber outreach is proactive and efficient, minimizing dispensing delays caused by incomplete or unclear orders
  • Compliance and quality standards are upheld without exception in a fast-paced environment
  • You are a trusted clinical partner within the BlinkRx team — shaping the patient experience from behind the scenes

#blinkindeed

Why Join Us:It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population. At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year. Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.

About TrueContext

#CareersThatKickSaaS! TrueContext is a field intelligence platform that connects frontline workers to enterprise systems of record, so teams in the field can capture, act on, and learn from structured data in real time. We serve enterprise customers in Med Tech, Building Systems, Utilities, and Oil and Gas. Backed by Battery Ventures, we are scaling the platform and building the defining name in field intelligence.

About the role

TrueContext is hiring a Product Operations Analyst to help our product team make faster, better-informed decisions. You'll own the data, processes and tools that connect product management with engineering, customer success, sales and support.

You'll report to the SVP of Product and work closely with product managers on planning, launches and customer feedback. This is a hands-on role for someone who likes turning messy inputs into clear systems and useful insight.

What you'll do

  • Product data and reporting: Build and maintain dashboards that track adoption, feature usage, retention and other product health metrics. Answer ad hoc questions from PMs and leadership with clear, well-sourced analysis.
  • Customer feedback loops: Collect, tag and synthesize feedback from support tickets, sales calls, surveys and in-app channels. Turn recurring themes into evidence PMs can use to prioritize.
  • Planning and roadmap operations: Run the mechanics of quarterly planning, roadmap reviews and OKR tracking. Keep the roadmap and backlog accurate and visible to stakeholders.
  • Launch coordination: Manage release checklists, readiness reviews and internal communication so sales, support and marketing are ready on launch day.
  • Process and tooling: Own and improve product tools such as Jira, Confluence and our product analytics platform. Document workflows, set standards and automate repetitive manual work.
  • Measurement and experiments: Help PMs define success metrics before a launch and report on results after it. Support in-app surveys, onboarding flows and A/B tests.
  • Internal communication: Write release notes, product updates and monthly reports that keep the company informed about what shipped and why.

What you'll bring

  • 2 to 4 years of experience in product operations
  • Hands-on experience with a BI or product analytics tool, such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Amplitude, Pendo or Userpilot
  • Working knowledge of agile development and tools like Jira and Confluence
  • Clear writing and speaking, including the ability to explain data to non-technical audiences
  • Strong organization and the ability to run several projects at once without dropping details
  • A habit of simplifying: you notice repeated manual work and fix it

What success looks like

We are a female-founded scale-up, currently made up of around 100 AltoVitians. Our fully-remote team hails from 26 different countries and collectively speaks 29 languages. As we look to scale our Global Commercial engine, today is a particularly exciting time to join our team. This next chapter won’t always be a smooth ride, but it will be filled with innovation, excitement and opportunities. If you are ambitious, commercially hungry and ready for the challenge (and the fun!) of growing with us, we would love to hear from you.

What we do

AltoVita is a multi-award winning accommodation platform that enables enterprises to consolidate accommodation programmes through the power of proprietary technology paired with a human centric approach.

AltoVita’s unique offering sets us apart in the market, providing a network of 10 million+ verified and vetted properties are all duty of care compliant, backed by a four-tier quality control process; located in over 35,000 cities & 165 countries world-wide. The Director of Sales, US, will support AltoVita's Sales and Business Development efforts in the region, reporting into the SVP Sales, US. This is an external facing role focused on building credible relationships, opening doors with new prospects, and creating qualified opportunities.

This is a mid-level opportunity for someone ambitious, commercially hungry, and highly coachable, with real potential to grow into a more senior sales role at AltoVita as you prove yourself.

  • Clearly and consistently communicate pipeline progress to your line managers and internal stakeholders.

  • Hand off qualified opportunities to the enablement/closing team at the right stage, ensuring a smooth transition and a clear client handover.

jobs.description:
Senior Project Manager, Marketing PMO

As a Senior Project Manager on Intapp’s Marketing PMO team, you will lead complex, high-priority, cross-functional marketing initiatives from planning through completion while helping mature how the Marketing organization plans and delivers work. You will bring structure to ambiguity, facilitate collaboration across teams, drive accountability, and ensure projects deliver against their intended outcomes. This role is ideal for an experienced project leader who combines strong PM fundamentals with the judgment, initiative, and communication skills to independently drive complex work and know when to escalate.

What you will do

  • Lead complex projects end-to-end: Own high-visibility, cross-functional marketing initiatives, translating business objectives into clear scope, plans, milestones, deliverables, owners, dependencies, and timelines. Manage scope and changes throughout the project lifecycle and apply the appropriate level of project management rigor based on the complexity and needs of the initiative.
  • Drive execution, governance, and accountability: Establish and maintain appropriate project governance, facilitate working sessions and project meetings, identify next steps, manage risks and issues, resolve blockers, and keep teams moving toward outcomes. Independently address issues where appropriate and escalate material risks or decisions to the Director, Marketing PMO with clear context, options, and recommendations.
  • Partner across the organization: Collaborate with Marketing, Creative, Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Events, Communications, Operations, and other stakeholders to align priorities and drive accountability without direct authority. Work closely with other PMs to create consistency and share effective practices across the team.
  • Strengthen PMO processes and methodology: Help develop and mature project management methodology, governance, templates, documentation, and standards. Identify gaps and inefficiencies, implement practical improvements, and use lessons learned to continuously improve how projects are planned and delivered.
  • Create visibility and institutional knowledge: Manage projects in Asana and other PM tools, maintain accurate project plans, risks, issues, decisions, actions, and status, and provide clear, actionable reporting. Ensure project outcomes, decisions, and lessons learned are captured to build institutional knowledge and support a consistent, scalable PMO.

What you will need

Intapp is looking for intellectually curious, self-motivated professionals who like to get hands-on to contribute to the overall success of the business and their team. To apply for this Senior Project Manager role, you will ideally have:

  • Strong project management fundamentals and demonstrated experience independently leading complex, cross-functional projects from initiation through completion.
  • A track record of taking ownership, anticipating next steps, solving problems, managing scope and change, and driving projects forward rather than simply tracking activity.
  • Strong facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and create accountability across teams and work effectively with senior stakeholders.
  • Experience creating structure in ambiguous or evolving environments and improving project management processes, methodologies, governance, and ways of working.
  • Experience in a marketing, creative, agency, technology, professional services, SaaS, or similarly complex environment, along with familiarity with Asana or comparable project management tools.

What you will gain

At Intapp, you’ll get the opportunity to bring your talents and intellectual curiosity to create better outcomes for our people and our clients. You’ll be part of a growing public company, with a modern work environment that’s connected yet flexible and where your professional growth and well-being are top priorities. We’ll collaborate and grow together, supporting each other in a positive, open atmosphere that fosters creativity, innovation, and teamwork.

Here, you will have the opportunity to:


  • Expand Your Skills: Unlock your potential with professional development opportunities supported by a community of experienced professionals. We offer reimbursement for training and continuing education to help you stay ahead in your career.
  • Enjoy Where You Work: Thrive in our modern, open offices designed to inspire creativity and collaboration. Our complimentary lunches and fully stocked kitchens ensure you have everything you need to stay energized throughout the day.
  • Support What Matters Most: Our comprehensive wellness and flexible time off programs and our benefits are designed to care for you and your family. Our family-formation benefits and support during your family-building journey ensure you have the resources you need when it matters most. We believe in giving back and supporting our communities with paid volunteer time off and a donation matching program for the causes you care about.

Join us and be a part of a collaborative and welcoming culture where your contributions are valued, and your professional growth is a priority. Together, we are building a company of long-term value that we can all be proud of.
