jobs.description:
Ready for a challenge?

Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We’re a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience.

Whether it’s a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe.


About this role


We are looking for a Senior Java Developer to join our Logistics Areas and Fees team. If you are passionate about building scalable, high-throughput backend services and thrive in a fast-paced, high-scale environment, this role is for you. This role is open to candidates based in Toronto, Montreal, Ottawa or Winnipeg.


As a Senior Java Developer within our Logistics domain, you will play a key role in architecting, developing, and operating the core services and distributed systems that power delivery areas & fees related calculations. You will own backend systems end-to-end, from system architecture and API design to deployment, observability, and performance optimization, ensuring high availability and low-latency execution across our platform.


Your mission is to deliver robust, performant, and resilient Java-based services, working closely with cross-functional teams of engineers, product managers, and data analysts to ship critical backend infrastructure that our internal operators and the wider logistics platform rely on every day. You will champion modern Java standards, system reliability, and software engineering best practices, while mentoring team members and helping shape the technical direction of backend engineering within the organization.


In short, you’ll combine deep Java and backend expertise with a strong system design mindset to power mission-critical logistics operations at scale.


Location: Remote - Alberta, Manitoba, Ontario

Reporting to: Technology Manager

These are some of the key components of the position:

  • Maintain existing and develop new microservices using Java 21. Extend the functionality of existing applications per Business requests.
  • Maintain existing and develop new infrastructure resources on the AWS platform using Terraform.
  • Work with a microservices architecture using REST API and Message Brokers.
  • Design, build, and maintain high-performance, scalable backend services and APIs using Java.
  • Participate in architectural decisions, RFCs, and technical design reviews across the Logistics domain
  • Collaborate with Product, QE, and Data colleagues to ship high-quality releases on a continuous delivery cadence
  • Own your work throughout the entire product development lifecycle, from technical design and planning to market release.
  • Review the code of peers in a team.
  • Support and mentor team members, helping grow backend engineering as a discipline
  • Identify improvements, highlight risks vs benefits, and translate them into technical requirements.
  • Work with the product team, providing technical knowledge and expertise, helping to design the future of our products.
  • Participate in paid on-call rotation.

What will you bring to the team?

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience architecting and building scalable, high-performance enterprise applications and leading complex software development projects.
  • Be curious, with a strong appetite for new knowledge.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, design patterns, testing, and debugging.
  • Solid understanding of consuming, producing, and designing RESTful web services.
  • Experience with Java (Spark or Quarkus framework).
  • Experience with streams and list operations is a nice-to-have.
  • Solid grounding in design patterns for designing distributed systems (bounded contexts, sagas, eventual consistency, and the outbox pattern) (must have).
  • Experience in Domain-Driven Design (DDD) is a strong nice-to-have.
  • Experience with message brokers (Kafka, Amazon SQS, RabbitMQ).
  • Production experience deploying to AWS and running services on Kubernetes (EKS).Experience with System logging and monitoring using tools such as Grafana, AWS CloudWatch and DataDog.
  • Experience with data persistence in relational, MySQL, unstructured and/or cached forms.
  • Strong experience with Redis for caching, rate limiting and distributed locks is a plus.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure-as-a-Code (Terraform) is nice-to-have.
  • Understanding of continuous delivery, deployment, and integration.
  • Familiarity with Version Control (Git) and related tools.

AI & Modern Engineering Capabilities

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex or similar is required
  • Experience making repositories agent-ready, maintaining clear in-repo documentation, AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md files, structured code conventions, and reproducible local setups so AI coding agents can contribute effectively
  • Experience using AI agents to drive end-to-end engineering tasks (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor agents, or similar) for code generation, refactoring, debugging, and automated PR workflows
  • Experience integrating AI into backend engineering workflows (e.g., AI-assisted code review, test generation, log/incident analysis, intelligent on-call triage)
  • Understanding of prompt engineering and evaluation of AI-generated outputs in a software engineering context
  • Awareness of best practices for AI-driven development, including reliability, reproducibility, security, and governance, particularly as they apply to production backend systems

At JET, this is on the menu:

Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment.

Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth and about celebrating every aspect of our JETers. Thanks to them we stay one step ahead of the competition.

Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging

No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day.


What else is cooking?

Want to know more about our JETers, culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people's stories, blogs, podcasts and more JET morsels


Are you ready to take your seat? Apply now!


What We Offer:


Team Vibes: Thrive in a collaborative culture where your ideas matter.

Tasty Perk: Enjoy a monthly Skip spend allowance – treat yourself!

More Time Off: Generous PTO with a buy and sell program with up to 5 extra days!

Family First: Up to 20 weeks top up for parental leave.

Premium Benefits: Flexible medical & dental insurance for you and your family.

Keep Learning: Access world-class training resources to power your success.

Perks Galore: Exclusive offers from Workperks from hundreds of top brands.

Future Funded: RRSP contributions with diverse investment portfolios.

We’ve Got You: We’ve got you covered. Access paid sick time to care for yourself or your family when life happens & access to our well-being support programs.

Digital Nomads: Family abroad or just want a change of scenery? Enjoy the freedom to work from almost anywhere in the world for 4 weeks a year.

Career Growth: Fuel your personal and professional evolution through our dedicated mentorship, global mobility pathways, and a wellness-first culture rooted in true diversity and inclusion.


NOTE:

All employees will be asked to sign a Consent for Disclosure of Personal Information in order to complete a background check. Job offers will be conditional upon results that the Company determines to be satisfactory.

Compensation range: $102,000.00 - $128,250.00

Final compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and internal equity.

Corporate Travel Consultant (AMDOC Team)

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend four weeks (paid). This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Other duties and tasks as assigned
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully
  • Reliable, high-speed internet connectivity required to support core job responsibilities, including but not limited to video conferencing, access to company systems, and secure handling of company data.

It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

The contractor manages a book of up to 18 restaurant clients and reports directly to the firm’s owner.

Role overview

You will meet with each client for a 60-minute working session every week by video and screen share. Between sessions, you will do the work that keeps each client’s catering program growing, including building and maintaining catering assets, tracking performance against each client’s targets, and bringing issues or opportunities to the owner as they arise. This is a self-directed role that requires strong organization across many clients at once.

Responsibilities

  • Lead weekly 60-minute sessions with each client in English or Spanish.
  • Build and update catering menus, per-person pricing, and catering listings.
  • Keep each client’s Google Business Profile and website current.
  • Write catering procedures, packing guides, and staff training materials.
  • Prepare forms and applications for clients to review, sign, and submit themselves. The contractor never signs documents on a client’s behalf.
  • Guide clients through local zoning and state liquor permit processes, with the client completing and submitting each application. The contractor provides procedural support only and does not provide legal, financial, or tax advice. Those questions are referred to the client’s own professionals.
  • Track orders and weekly meal volume, and help each client reach their catering targets.
  • Keep a session log after every meeting recording the actions taken by the contractor, the actions taken by the client, and any documents the client signed.
  • Escalate problems, opportunities, and SEO or social media requests to the owner promptly. SEO and social media work is handled by a separate team member, so these requests route through the owner.

Requirements

  • Fluent written and spoken English.
  • Professional Spanish, strongly preferred.
  • At least two years of experience in account management, client success, or marketing, ideally with restaurants, hospitality, or small businesses.
  • An MBA or equivalent business experience at that level.
  • Comfort with Google Workspace, video meetings, CRM tools, and website editors.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage many clients without close supervision.
  • Full-time availability during U.S. Eastern business hours, with client sessions mainly scheduled between 9:30 and 11:00 a.m. and 2:00 and 4:30 p.m. ET. Candidates in other time zones must confirm they can cover these windows.

  • Experience with online ordering or catering platforms.
  • Graphic design or menu design skills.

jobs.title: Head of Go-to-Market, AI Care Operations
jobs.excerpt: At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential.
jobs.description:
At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

  • Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

  • Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

AI Care Operations (previously Sword Intelligence), is Sword's AI care management division. We don't deliver a clinical program to members. We deploy AI Care Managers, trained on more than 14 million real care interactions, to run the operations of providers, payers and national health systems.

It started as an internal problem. On the way to freeing over a million people from pain, Sword hit the same wall every healthcare organization does: we didn't have enough hands to scale the care we needed to provide. Instead of hiring our way out, we built AI to do it, certified it for clinical use, and ran it in our own operations before offering it to anyone else.

Today we sell two families of solutions:

  • Triage — a certified Clinical Triage Line that guides every patient to the right care, 24/7, across voice and digital channels.
  • Care Orchestration — care navigation, population health campaigns (screenings, vaccinations, medication adherence), surgery prehab and rehab, and readmission prevention.

We've announced a partnership with the Hellenic Ministry of Health to build an AI-powered front door for Greece's 10 million citizens, and we work with other national health systems, health plans and providers across the US and Europe. The US is now our biggest growth opportunity, and this role is central to capturing it.

The role

We are hiring a Head of Go-to-Market for AI Care Operations in the US. The role sits at the intersection of product marketing, competitive intelligence and commercial enablement. It is one of the leadership roles on the AI Care Operations team, reporting to the General Manager.

Here's the opportunity. "AI agents for healthcare" is one of the most crowded categories in the market right now. Voice AI startups, EHR vendors, care management platforms and outsourcers all claim to automate care operations, and to a buyer they can sound alike. Very few of them have certified medical devices, national-scale partnerships, or AI proven on hundreds of thousands of their own members before it was sold to anyone else. We have all three. Your job is to make that difference unmistakable.

You will own three things:

  1. Make our value impossible to miss. Build the narrative, positioning and competitive differentiation that make it obvious why AI Care Operations is categorically better than AI point solutions, legacy nurse lines and call centers, and the care management platforms buyers already have. That means the core messaging architecture across Triage and Care Orchestration, positioning by buyer (health plan, health system, value-based care, employer, government), battle cards, ROI frameworks, and the demos and proof that move a skeptical COO or VP of Care Management.
  2. Make sure the commercial team can tell that story. Sword's segment sales teams sell many solutions and can't be experts in all of them. When the health plan team is in front of a Medicare Advantage plan, or the employer team is pitching a front door for a self-insured population, they come to you to scope the workflows, walk the buyer through how the agents actually work, and answer the hard questions on safety, integration and ROI.
  3. Find, surface and pursue the opportunities. You will canvass the US and international markets systematically for the accounts, RFPs, procurements, contract renewals and budget signals that would otherwise go unnoticed: a health plan rebuilding its care management operation, a health system under readmission penalties, a state agency tendering a nurse line. You'll use AI tooling to do this faster and wider than a traditional GTM team could, then partner with the relevant segment leader to make sure each opportunity is pursued and won.

AI proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword, and every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework: Explorer (uses AI daily for personal productivity), Builder (creates workflows and tools that lift the whole team) and Integrator (embeds AI into products and processes at scale). This role requires Builder at minimum. Come ready with real examples.

What you'll be doing

  • Core positioning, messaging house and narrative architecture for AI Care Operations and each of its solutions
  • The category story: why AI care management that does the work beats both headcount and AI tools that only assist the people doing it
  • Competitive intelligence and battle cards across voice AI and agentic AI vendors, nurse line and call center outsourcers, and care management platforms
  • Buyer-facing materials: one-pagers, ROI and capacity calculators, demo scripts and recorded agent calls, case studies, RFP response library, sales decks
  • Proof architecture: turning deployments into case studies and outcome metrics (contacts handled, cost per interaction, gap closure, time to care, readmissions) that a CFO will sign off on
  • Solution specialist team (direct reports), paired with segment sales reps across health plans, health systems, value-based care, employers and government
  • Sales and customer success enablement: training, playbooks, discovery guides, certification on each solution
  • Market opportunity mapping and systematic canvassing across US segments, with a lighter watch on international tenders
  • Message consistency across Sword's commercial segments and geographies, including where AI Care Operations is sold as part of the broader AI Care platform
  • Voice of the market into product: what buyers ask for, where we lose, and what competitors are shipping

We'd love to see

You are currently at, or recently from, a Lead, Head, Director or VP-level GTM or product marketing role where you owned the full stack: launching products, positioning, competitive differentiation, sales enablement and market strategy. You've built things that measurably changed how deals were won.

You can sell something that isn't a product category yet. jobs.description:
Job Title: Medical Billing & Coding Specialist (Primary Care)

Position Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Daylight Time

Work Days: Monday to Friday

Salary: $6 - $7 per hour, depending on experience

Workplace: Remote

Preferred Candidate Location: Philippines

Our client is a growing U.S.-based healthcare organization dedicated to providing high-quality, patient-centered care. We are seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and experienced Medical Billing Specialist (Primary Care) to support accurate claims processing, timely reimbursement, and efficient revenue cycle operations.

In this role, you will take ownership of assigned medical billing responsibilities, including claims submission, insurance follow-ups, denial and rejection management, accounts receivable (AR), and billing-related documentation reviews. You will also help identify potential reimbursement risks, resolve outstanding claims, and maintain accurate reporting to support a smooth transition to an in-house billing process.

The ideal candidate has at least 1 year of hands-on U.S. medical billing experience, a solid understanding of medical coding concepts and payer requirements, and the ability to independently manage billing tasks with accuracy and accountability.

Experience in primary care and/or behavioral health billing is highly preferred.

If you are an organized, proactive medical billing professional who enjoys solving complex billing issues, improving reimbursement outcomes, and contributing to a growing healthcare team, we'd love to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

Medical Billing & Claims Management

  • Prepare, review, submit, and track medical claims accurately and within payer filing deadlines.
  • Apply knowledge of ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS, and Evaluation & Management (E/M) billing concepts to identify potential claim errors and documentation gaps.
  • Investigate pending, rejected, denied, downcoded, or unpaid claims and determine appropriate next steps.
  • Process claim corrections, resubmissions, reconsiderations, and appeals as needed.
  • Follow up with insurance payers to resolve outstanding claims and reimbursement issues.
  • Identify unfiled claims, approaching filing deadlines, and billing backlogs.
  • Promptly escalate potential reimbursement risks or unresolved billing concerns.
  • Maintain accurate records of submitted, pending, corrected, and resolved claims.

Insurance Verification & Revenue Cycle Management

  • Verify patient insurance information, eligibility, and coverage when needed.
  • Communicate with insurance representatives regarding claims, reimbursement, and coverage concerns.
  • Manage assigned accounts receivable (AR) and follow up on outstanding balances.
  • Investigate underpayments, payment discrepancies, and delayed reimbursements.
  • Resolve payer denials, rejections, and downcoding issues through appropriate corrections and appeals.
  • Assist with payment posting, reconciliation, and billing adjustments.
  • Identify recurring billing issues and contribute to denial prevention efforts.
  • Follow applicable payer policies, reimbursement guidelines, and billing requirements.

Clinical Documentation, Compliance & Risk Mitigation

  • Review billing-related clinical documentation to ensure completeness and alignment with submitted claims.
  • Identify missing, incomplete, or inconsistent documentation that may affect reimbursement.
  • Coordinate with providers and internal staff to clarify documentation discrepancies.
  • Verify that documentation supports billed services according to applicable payer requirements.
  • Perform assigned documentation reviews, compliance checks, and risk mitigation tasks.
  • Document findings accurately and escalate material compliance or reimbursement concerns.
  • Stay informed of relevant payer requirements, billing policies, and regulatory updates.
  • Maintain patient confidentiality and follow HIPAA requirements and organizational procedures.

Reporting, Accountability & Operational Support

  • Maintain accurate daily progress reports detailing claims submitted, pending tasks, follow-ups, and unresolved issues.
  • Verify claim submission status and supporting documentation before marking tasks as completed.
  • Maintain transparent and accurate records of billing activities and outcomes.
  • Collaborate with providers, internal staff, and billing colleagues to resolve issues.
  • Identify opportunities to improve billing workflows, accuracy, and efficiency.
  • Support the organization's transition to in-house medical billing operations.
  • Assist with billing documentation, records management, and related administrative responsibilities.
  • Communicate potential delays, unresolved concerns, and reimbursement risks promptly.

Top 3 Priorities

1. Accurate Claims Submission & Timely Filing

Ensure medical claims are complete, accurate, and submitted within payer deadlines. Proactively identify errors, documentation gaps, and unfiled claims to prevent avoidable denials, delayed payments, or lost reimbursement.

2. Accounts Receivable, Denial Resolution & Payer Compliance

Take ownership of assigned outstanding claims, denials, rejections, downcoding issues, and appeals. Maintain consistent insurance follow-ups while applying payer requirements and supporting accurate reimbursement.

3. Accountability, Communication & Risk Mitigation

Maintain accurate records of completed work, provide transparent progress updates, promptly flag billing and compliance concerns, and collaborate effectively with providers and the internal billing team.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Medical Billing Specialist consistently demonstrates:

  • Accurate and timely claims submission.
  • Strong follow-through on denied, rejected, downcoded, and unpaid claims.
  • Effective management of assigned accounts receivable.
  • Timely identification and escalation of filing deadlines, billing backlogs, and reimbursement risks.
  • Accurate documentation reviews and adherence to payer requirements.
  • Clear and transparent reporting of completed and outstanding work.
  • Effective communication with providers, insurance representatives, and billing colleagues.
  • Proactive identification of billing discrepancies and opportunities for improvement.
  • Consistent compliance with HIPAA and billing-related policies.
  • Reliable, independent performance while supporting the growth of the in-house billing team.

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of proven, hands-on U.S. medical billing experience.
  • Strong understanding of the U.S. medical billing and revenue cycle process.
  • Experience preparing, reviewing, submitting, and tracking electronic medical claims.
  • Working knowledge of ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS, and E/M billing concepts.
  • Familiarity with payer reimbursement guidelines, billing requirements, and timely filing deadlines.
  • Hands-on experience managing accounts receivable, unpaid claims, denials, rejections, downcoding, and appeals.
  • Experience communicating directly with U.S. insurance payers regarding claim status and reimbursement issues.
  • Ability to identify billing errors, documentation gaps, payment discrepancies, and unresolved claims.
  • Experience performing claim corrections, resubmissions, and insurance follow-ups.
  • Ability to review clinical documentation for billing completeness and payer-specific requirements.
  • Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.
  • Ability to manage assigned tasks independently, meet deadlines, and maintain accurate records.
  • Strong commitment to accuracy, accountability, and transparent reporting.
  • Ability to collaborate professionally with providers, insurance representatives, and internal team members.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Demonstrated reliability, integrity, responsiveness, and willingness to escalate concerns promptly.

Clinical Documentation & Compliance Knowledge

  • Understanding of medical documentation requirements related to claims submission and reimbursement.
  • Ability to identify incomplete or inconsistent documentation.
  • Familiarity with payer policies, billing compliance requirements, and relevant regulatory updates.
  • Ability to coordinate with providers and internal staff regarding documentation concerns.
  • Understanding of billing-related risk mitigation and appropriate escalation procedures.
  • Knowledge of HIPAA requirements and patient confidentiality standards.

Technical & Administrative Skills

  • Proficiency with EHR/EMR systems and practice management software.
  • Experience using medical billing platforms and electronic claims submission tools.
  • Comfortable working with spreadsheets, claims trackers, and billing reports.
  • Ability to maintain accurate records of claims, payments, adjustments, and follow-ups.
  • Strong documentation and administrative skills.
  • Ability to prioritize outstanding claims and manage competing deadlines.
  • Comfortable adapting to established workflows and new billing processes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience supporting U.S. primary care or behavioral health practices.
  • Experience in family medicine, internal medicine, or multi-provider outpatient practices.
  • Familiarity with primary care diagnoses, E/M guidelines, and outpatient documentation standards.
  • Demonstrated success reducing claim denials or resolving downcoding issues.
  • Experience managing accounts receivable backlogs and improving collections.
  • Experience identifying billing workflow inefficiencies and recommending improvements.
  • Previous experience supporting a U.S.-based healthcare organization remotely.
  • Experience working with an internal or in-house medical billing team.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We're looking for someone who is:

  • Experienced: Has a solid foundation in U.S. medical billing, coding concepts, and revenue cycle workflows.
  • Detail-Oriented: Carefully reviews claims, documentation, and billing records to maintain accuracy.
  • Proactive: Identifies unfiled claims, denials, downcoding issues, and documentation gaps before they become larger problems.
  • Accountable: Maintains honest, accurate, and transparent records of completed work.
  • Organized: Effectively manages multiple claims, follow-ups, and deadlines.
  • Analytical: Investigates billing discrepancies and determines appropriate resolutions.
  • Collaborative: Communicates effectively with providers and other billing team members.
  • Independent: Takes ownership of assigned tasks without requiring constant supervision.
  • Compliance-Focused: Prioritizes HIPAA, payer requirements, and risk mitigation.
  • Adaptable: Comfortable supporting an organization transitioning to an in-house billing model.

Basic Requirements

  • Must be proficient in speaking and writing clear, professional English.
  • Must have at least 1 year of relevant U.S. medical billing experience.
  • Must be able to submit an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).
  • Must be available for video meetings with camera on when required.
  • Must be available to work full-time, Monday through Friday, from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Daylight Time.

Technical requirements

  • Device: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
  • Internet: High-speed connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Webcam for virtual meetings.
  • Workspace: Quiet, professional environment.

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, trainings, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

Overview

jobs.excerpt: Technical Recruiter (gn), remote, vollzeit, ab sofort.
jobs.description:
Technical Recruiter (gn), remote, vollzeit, ab sofort.

Du erkennst, ob hinter einem technischen Profil die Erfahrung steckt, die ein Projekt wirklich braucht? Und du hast Freude daran, passende Menschen zu finden und für eine Zusammenarbeit zu gewinnen? Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

Wir suchen eine_n_ Technical Recruiter (gn)_, der/_die uns bei der Besetzung unserer offenen Stellen unterstützt. Aktuell liegt der Schwerpunkt auf Softwareentwicklung. Perspektivisch suchen wir auch für Rollen im Produkt- und Projektumfeld, etwa Product Owner, Projektmanager:_innen und Business Analyst:_innen.

New Monday ist eine UX/UI-Agentur aus Berlin. Wir arbeiten an digitalen Produkten für Unternehmen wie Atruvia, DAK, SAP und Lufthansa sowie für junge Unternehmen wie NUMA Stays. Unser Team arbeitet zu 100% remote. Dabei setzen wir auf eigenständiges Arbeiten, kurze Wege und einen engen Austausch miteinander – digital und immer öfter auch bei persönlichen Treffen.

Aufgaben

  • Du begleitest die Besetzung unserer technischen Positionen – aktuell vor allem in der Softwareentwicklung, perspektivisch auch in Rollen wie Product Ownership, Projektmanagement und Business Analyse.
  • Du sichtest eingehende Bewerbungen, ordnest Profile fachlich ein und beurteilst, wie gut Erfahrung und Projekthintergrund zu unseren Anforderungen passen.
  • Bei Bedarf findest du passende Kandidat*innen über LinkedIn und weitere Recruiting-Kanäle und sprichst sie persönlich an.
  • Du führst erste Gespräche und klärst technische Erfahrung, Motivation sowie Rahmendaten wie Verfügbarkeit und Gehaltsvorstellung.
  • Du stimmst dich eng mit unseren fachlichen Ansprechpartner:innen ab, bereitest Interviews vor und begleitest Kandidat:innen verbindlich durch den gesamten Prozess.
  • Du pflegst unsere Bewerbungsprozesse im Bewerbersystem und sorgst dafür, dass Informationen an den Schnittstellen zwischen Recruiting, Fachbereichen und Geschäftsführung zuverlässig fließen.
  • Du beobachtest den Markt und gibst uns Rückmeldung, wie wir unsere Suche und Ansprache verbessern können.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Recruiting und Active Sourcing technischer Fachkräfte und hast insbesondere Positionen in der Softwareentwicklung bereits erfolgreich besetzt.
  • Du verstehst die Unterschiede zwischen Frontend-, Backend- und Fullstack-Profilen und kannst praktische Projekterfahrung gezielt hinterfragen. Idealerweise kennst du auch Profile aus dem Produkt- und Projektumfeld.
  • Begriffe wie Angular, TypeScript, Java, Spring Boot, REST-APIs, CI/CD und Kubernetes sind dir vertraut. Du musst nicht selbst entwickeln können, kannst technische Lebensläufe aber sicher einordnen und mit Kandidat*innen auf Augenhöhe sprechen.
  • Du arbeitest routiniert mit Bewerbermanagementsystemen und digitalen Recruiting-Tools. Erfahrung mit JOIN ist ein Plus.
  • Du kommunizierst wertschätzend und sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch – sowohl schriftlich als auch im Gespräch.
  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, strukturiert und transparent und behältst mehrere Suchprozesse gleichzeitig im Blick.
  • Du bist offen dafür, KI-Tools sinnvoll für Recherche, Ansprache und die Organisation deiner Arbeit einzusetzen und prüfst die Ergebnisse sorgfältig.

Benefits

Das erwartet dich bei New Monday

  • 100 % remote: Du arbeitest innerhalb Deutschlands von dem Ort aus, der für dich passt.
  • Flexibilität und Vertrauen: Du gestaltest deinen Arbeitsalltag eigenständig, mit kurzen Abstimmungswegen und ohne Micromanagement.
  • Ein Team, das sich auch persönlich trifft: Neben dem digitalen Austausch schaffen wir bewusst Raum für regionale Treffen und gemeinsames Coworking. Ein- bis zweimal im Jahr kommt das gesamte Team zusammen.
  • Zeit und Budget für deine Entwicklung: Wir fördern fachliche Weiterbildung und den Austausch im Team. Nach der Probezeit steht dir dafür ein Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.000 € zur Verfügung.
  • Entwicklung mit Perspektive: Wir arbeiten aktuell an einem Karriereentwicklungsplan, der Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und nächste Schritte bei New Monday transparenter machen soll. Deine eigenen Ziele und Interessen besprechen wir dabei regelmäßig mit dir.
  • 30 Tage Urlaub und zusätzlich zwei Tage für unsere Team-Events.
  • Arbeit mit Gestaltungsspielraum: Du bringst deine Erfahrung ein und hilfst uns, unser Recruiting für technische Rollen weiterzuentwickeln.

So geht es weiter

  • Erstes Kennenlernen: Wir erzählen dir mehr über New Monday und die Rolle. Du berichtest uns von deiner Erfahrung und kannst alle Fragen stellen, die dir wichtig sind.
  • Gespräch mit unseren Co-Foundern Laura Nielsen und Dario Zampetti: Wir lernen uns ausführlicher kennen und sprechen darüber, wie du technische Recruiting-Prozesse gestaltest und mit unseren Fachbereichen zusammenarbeiten würdest.
  • Fachliches Follow-up: Anhand konkreter Recruiting-Situationen sprechen wir darüber, wie du Bewerbungen einschätzt, passende Kandidat*innen findest und Entscheidungen vorbereitest. Du bekommst außerdem Gelegenheit, mit einer Person aus dem Team unter vier Augen zu sprechen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf – auch wenn du nicht jede Anforderung vollständig erfüllst.

New Monday fördert die Gleichstellung aller Beschäftigten. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität. Menschen mit Schwerbehinderung werden bei gleicher Eignung unter Berücksichtigung der Umstände des Einzelfalls bevorzugt.

jobs.excerpt: At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential.
jobs.description:
At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

  • Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

  • Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

About the Role

We are looking for a high-octane, deeply creative Senior Manager of Social Media to own, scale, and transform our presence across LinkedIn, X, and Instagram. You aren't just a poster; you are a narrative strategist, a visual storyteller, and an analytical hawk. You understand that LinkedIn needs sharp thought leadership, X requires real-time cultural fluency and wit, and Instagram demands top-tier visual aesthetics and reel-driven storytelling.

You will have end-to-end ownership of channel strategy, content creation, community engagement, performance analytics, and rapid campaign iteration.

Key Responsibilities

  • Multi-Platform Content & Creative Ownership:
    • Develop and execute distinct, audience-specific channel strategies for LinkedIn, X, and Instagram.
    • Conceptualize, write, and produce high-engagement assets including long-form posts, short-form video, carousels, and real-time commentary in partnership with the Marketing, Design, and Brand teams.
    • Balance brand guardrails with daring, disruptive creative experiments.
    • Occasional ghostwriting or content framing for executive leadership on LinkedIn and X.
  • Analytics, Metrics & Continuous Iteration:
    • Own core social KPIs: Organic Reach, Engagement Rate, Share of Voice, Click-Through Rate (CTR), and Audience Growth.
    • Establish a rigid weekly and monthly reporting cadence to analyze top-performing content, post-mortems, and channel trends.
    • Use performance data to rapidly iterate on content formats, hooks, posting schedules, and narrative angles.
  • Audience Segmentation & Voice Mastery:
    • Tailor tone, design, and messaging to match the profile of each platform's distinct audience without diluting the core brand identity.
    • Lead proactive community management, driving real-time conversations, thread participation, and executive engagement across channels.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Experience: 5+ years of dedicated social media management experience, with a proven track record of scaling organic accounts on LinkedIn, X, and Instagram.
  • Creative Portfolio: Demonstrable portfolio or links to accounts showing exceptional copywriting, creative concepting, and short-form video production/direction.
  • Data & Analytics Mastery: Proficiency with analytics platforms (e.g., Sprout Social, Hootsuite, native platform analytics, GA4) and a proven habit of making data-driven creative adjustments.
  • Platform Expertise: Expert-level understanding of platform-specific algorithms, format trends (e.g., Instagram Reels audio, LinkedIn text-only posts vs. pdf slides), and audience behaviors.
  • Execution Speed: Ability to move fast, jump on trending cultural moments, and turn around copy/visuals in real time.

*The range below reflects base, variable, and equity for this role.

This is a starting point, not a ceiling — once someone joins and proves they're outlier talent, we adjust quickly to make sure their compensation matches their impact.

jobs.title: Hardware Engineer - Physical Product Design
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT USRythm is the fastest-growing lab in America.
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Rythm is the fastest-growing lab in America. We redefined at-home testing with the world’s easiest blood test and created a culture around monthly lab testing from home. We’ve processed millions of tests across all 50 states, and we do everything in-house, from sample testing and logistics to code, marketing, and design. That vertical integration gives us the speed, control, and creativity to shape the future of health and wellness.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Hardware Engineer with medical device experience to take Rythm’s product ideas from early concept to production-ready parts. Hands-on experience designing medical-grade products or medical devices is required.

You’ll work closely with our design and manufacturing teams to turn design briefs into detailed 3D models, molds, and simulations that guide decisions about materials, tooling, and production. You’ll build prototypes, test them, and keep iterating until the product is right. Our products should feel well made, hold up to everyday use, and meet the standards health products demand, so you’ll need to balance design intent with what’s practical to manufacture.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll own your projects from first model through production and work largely independently. You’ll also get to know Rythm’s products and customers well enough to make engineering decisions that serve the people who use them. We value precision, practical problem-solving, and the persistence to get the details right.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Turn ideas into designs. Take design briefs, rough concepts, and product requirements and develop them into detailed 3D models with a clear path to production.
  • Listen and execute. Understand what the design team is asking for, ask good questions, and translate their intent into precise, buildable engineering.
  • Design for manufacturing. Create parts that are ready for injection molding, accounting for materials, tolerances, draft, wall thickness, and assembly from the start.
  • Build the molds. Design molds for injection molding and work through the details that determine how a part will be produced.
  • Run mold flow analysis. Simulate the injection molding process to predict how parts will fill, cool, and hold up, then use those results to refine the design before tooling.
  • Prototype and mock up. Build mockups and prototypes that let the team see, hold, and test a design early and often.
  • Iterate relentlessly. Take feedback from each round of prototyping, make changes, and keep refining until the product meets its goals.
  • Own your projects. Move each project from first concept through revisions and validation to production-ready designs, working independently and keeping things on track.
  • Collaborate with design and manufacturing. Work with the people who shape and build our products to understand what's practical to make and make sure the design holds up in production.
  • Hold a high standard. Bring the care and rigor that health products demand, so what we make is safe, reliable, and built to last.
  • Learn from the finished work. Review how products perform in production and in use, then apply those lessons to future designs.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • Required: hands-on experience designing medical-grade products or medical devices. This is mandatory for the role.
  • 7–10 years of experience in product engineering or physical product design.
  • Advanced proficiency in SolidWorks and Fusion 360.
  • Hands-on experience designing parts and molds for injection molding.
  • Experience running mold flow analysis and using the results to improve a design.
  • A portfolio or examples of products you've designed and taken into production, with a clear explanation of your contribution.
  • Experience building mockups and prototypes and guiding a product through many rounds of iteration.
  • The ability to listen closely to design requirements and execute on them with precision.
  • Practical judgment about when to add detail, when to simplify, and how to balance design intent with manufacturing constraints.
  • Comfort working independently and owning projects end to end.
  • Comfort receiving feedback, revising your work, and staying aligned with an established product vision.
  • Curiosity and a willingness to build deep knowledge of our company, products, and customers.
  • Follow-through and the ability to manage multiple projects, prototypes, and deadlines.
  • Your background could be in mechanical engineering, industrial design, medical device development, or consumer product engineering. We care most about what you've designed, what you've helped bring to production, and your ability to carry an idea through to a finished product.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

Rythm Health offers a competitive benefits package which includes:

  • Highly competitive base salary.
  • Meaningful equity aligned with the scope and impact of your role.
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment.
  • Generous Paid Time Off and company holidays.
  • 401(k).
  • Monthly Rythm membership with full access to at-home blood testing and personalized health insights.
  • Healthcare with monthly premium fully covered by the business.
  • High ownership and visibility from day one, with the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.
  • The chance to help shape the future of personalized health and preventative care.
  • A small, collaborative, mission-driven team that moves quickly and values great ideas regardless of title.

  • Technical Advocacy & Liaison: Serve as the main technical point of contact for strategic partners, helping them navigate product roadmaps, resolve complex integration challenges, and advocate for partner-specific requirements back to internal Product and Engineering teams.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.description:
Position Summary

Amerit Fleet Solutions is the leading Fleet Maintenance company in the U.S. We are seeking a detail-driven, finance-minded Vendor Invoice Escalations Analyst I to own escalated invoice exceptions and vendor-facing resolution across our mobile, on-site, and ERS vendor network.

This role sits above our offshore AP operations team (Confiance), which handles first-line invoice matching and routine PO exception processing. You will own what the offshore team can't resolve — escalations, judgment calls, and direct vendor conversations — while also spot-checking offshore output for accuracy and coaching on recurring error patterns. This is a financial-reasoning role, not a data-entry or QA-checklist role: you need to actually understand how a PO, a dispatch record, and a contracted labor rate should reconcile, and be able to explain — to a vendor, to Accounts Payable, or to Vendor Management — why they don't.

Ideal candidates have a real accounting or finance foundation — not just invoice-processing exposure — and a genuine interest in figuring out why something doesn't reconcile.

Compensation: Competitive Salary Pay - Paid weekly, every Friday! Salary Range: $65,000-75,000 depending on experience.

The benefits of belonging – what’s in it for you?

  • Full benefits within 30 days
  • Medical, dental, vision, prescription drug coverage, life insurance, disability insurance
  • 401(k) match program
  • Paid vacation, holidays, and sick time
  • Commitment to your safety through boot and prescription safety glasses reimbursement
  • Career and learning development with an extensive training program through our Amerit University
  • Employee referral program, up to $1,000 bonus
  • ASE certification program with fee reimbursement and bonus
  • Employee recognition platform that includes opportunities to redeem points for merchandise
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • 24/7 nurse triage line
  • Employee discounts on cell phone service and entertainment tickets
  • Employee resource groups (ERGs) that foster inclusion
  • Wellness and fitness programs through our providers

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Escalation & Exception Ownership: Take ownership of invoice exceptions escalated beyond the offshore team's first-line resolution — including complex or ambiguous cases across No/Invalid PO, Not Dispatched, Not Received, PO Canceled, PO Closed, Price Does Not Match, and Vendor Mismatch — applying accounting judgment to determine root cause and correct resolution.
  • Vendor & AP Communication: Serve as the direct point of contact with vendors on disputed or escalated invoice discrepancies, and with Amerit's Accounts Payable team on payment timing and exceptions — driving issues to closure professionally and with financial accuracy.
  • Offshore Quality Oversight: Spot-check invoice and PO exception resolutions completed by the offshore team; identify recurring error patterns and provide coaching/feedback to improve first-line accuracy and reduce re-escalation volume.
  • Credit Card Transaction Review: Review credit card transactions against supporting documentation, applying basic accounting principles to confirm proper billing and flag unsupported or inaccurate charges.
  • Invoice Review & Reconciliation: Apply financial and accounting fundamentals to match vendor invoices against purchase orders, dispatch records, and contracted labor rates for escalated or higher-complexity cases.
  • No PO/No Pay Compliance: Apply Amerit's no-PO/no-pay standards and help flag where existing escalation thresholds aren't working.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting: Monitor invoice aging and exception volume/type by vendor and by offshore vs. escalated resolution; compile recurring and ad hoc trend reports for leadership and Vendor Management.
  • Process Documentation & Improvement: Follow and help refine escalation criteria and exception-handling standards so the offshore/onshore split stays well-defined; recommend process changes that reduce recurring exception types.
  • Cross-Functional Support: Partner with Vendor Account Managers on rate-compliance questions and with Accounts Payable on payment timing, providing the financial detail behind vendor accountability decisions.

Key Competencies

  • Solid grounding in basic accounting and financial principles — understands how purchase orders, invoices, and payment terms should reconcile, not just how to key them.
  • Comfortable owning ambiguous, escalated cases rather than working from a fixed checklist — a financial-reasoning mindset, not a pure QA/admin skill set.
  • Confident communicating directly with vendors on disputed charges, including some ability to hold a firm, professional line in escalated conversations.
  • Able to review and coach the output of an offshore team — spotting patterns, explaining the "why," and tightening standards over time.
  • Clear written communication; able to document escalation criteria and exception standards so an offshore team can follow them consistently.
  • Comfortable using data to support a recommendation or flag a trend, even without formal authority to negotiate or decide.

Working Conditions

  • Primarily desk-based; minimal to no travel required.
  • Based within or near the assigned region (United States).
  • Regular coordination with an offshore operations team (Confiance); some flexibility across time zones may be needed.

Role Qualifications

  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field strongly preferred.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in accounts payable, accounting, or a related financial function, with real exposure to reconciliation and financial judgment calls — not solely high-volume processing.
  • Experience resolving escalated or disputed invoice, PO, or credit card discrepancies preferred.
  • Experience working alongside or overseeing an offshore/outsourced operations team a plus.
  • System and data skills to include Excel, Outlook; experience with ERP, AP, or procurement systems a plus.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered productivity tools (Co-pilot, Claude, Gemini, etc.) a plus.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Title: Manager, Software Engineering

Team: Patient Registration

Location: Remote (EST or CST)

Why This Role Exists

As a Manager of Software Engineering on the Patient Registration team, you’ll help shape the future of healthcare by leading a talented, distributed engineering team responsible for building and evolving products that improve the patient registration experience. You’ll partner closely with Product Management, Architecture, Engineering, and Quality Assurance to design, build, scale, and maintain innovative software solutions that drive patient activation and better healthcare outcomes.

This role combines people leadership, technical execution, and delivery accountability while helping your team thoughtfully adopt AI-assisted development practices to deliver secure, high-quality software at scale.

What You’ll Spend Your Time Doing

  • Lead and grow a high-performing engineering team. Hire, mentor, and support software engineers and QA professionals while fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performing team environment.
  • Drive successful software delivery. Lead project planning and execution, ensuring your team delivers high-quality, scalable software that meets business, customer, security, and technical requirements.
  • Champion responsible AI adoption. Facilitate the thoughtful adoption of AI-assisted development tools and establish team practices for validating and safely incorporating AI-generated code and technical recommendations.
  • Build and maintain great software. Contribute to software development by implementing required functionality, writing technical documentation, participating in design reviews, and maintaining software quality and security standards.
  • Own product health. Take ownership of existing products throughout their lifecycle by managing bug fixes, product maintenance, production support, and customer escalations.
  • Promote engineering excellence. Review code through pull requests, support CI/CD practices, encourage automated testing, and help continuously improve engineering processes and quality.

What Makes You a Great Fit

You don’t need to check every box — but this role will feel energizing if you:

  • Have deep experience building and supporting highly distributed applications using Microsoft .NET (C#) or Java.
  • Are passionate about developing and growing engineering talent through coaching and mentorship.
  • Enjoy collaborating across Product, Engineering, Architecture, QA, and other cross-functional teams to deliver customer-focused solutions.
  • Have experience designing, building, or integrating AI agents and LLM-powered workflows into production systems.
  • Have successfully adopted or led the use of AI-assisted development tools, including coding assistants, AI-powered testing, documentation generation, or code generation tools.
  • Have established engineering practices for reviewing, validating, and safely incorporating AI-generated code.
  • Have experience with SQL Server, MongoDB, NoSQL databases, cloud platforms, web services, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Have experience with QA automation tooling and leveraging AI-assisted tools to orchestrate testing and unit test generation.
  • Are a self-motivated, pragmatic problem solver who thrives in a distributed team environment.
  • Have excellent technical and non-technical communication skills.
  • Have experience managing contractors and external vendors.

We Do Have A Few Requirements To Check

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline required.
  • 8+ years of experience building and supporting highly distributed software applications.
  • 3+ years of people management experience leading software engineering teams.
  • 3+ years of project management experience delivering successful software releases.

Where You’ll Work

This is a remote role where you’ll collaborate closely with distributed engineering, product, and cross-functional teams to build software that improves the healthcare experience for patients and providers.

Why Phreesia

Phreesia is on a mission to make healthcare more human, connected, and efficient. Our SaaS platform powers digital check-in and engagement for healthcare organizations nationwide—helping patients feel informed and providers work smarter.

We’re proud to be:

  • A five-time Modern Healthcare Best Places to Work winner
  • Recognized on the Bloomberg Gender Equality Index
  • Deeply committed to inclusion, growth, and employee experience

Compensation & Rewards

  • Total Cash Compensation: CAD $145,000–$170,000, depending on qualifications.
  • A comprehensive Total Rewards package designed to support your whole life — not just your work.

Disclosure: This posting is to fill an existing vacancy.

Who We Are:

At Phreesia, we’re looking for smart and passionate people to help drive our mission of creating a better, more engaging healthcare experience. We’re committed to helping healthcare organizations succeed in an ever-evolving landscape by transforming the way healthcare is delivered. Our SaaS platform digitizes appointment check-in and offers tools to engage patients, improve efficiency, optimize staffing, and enhance clinical care.

Phreesia cares about our employees by providing a diverse and dynamic work environment. We’re a five-time winner of Modern Healthcare Magazine’s Best Places to Work in Healthcare award and we’ve been recognized on the Bloomberg Gender Equality Index. We are dedicated to continuously improving our employee experience by launching new programs and initiatives. If you thrive in a culture of recognition, value inclusivity, professional development, and growth opportunities, Phreesia could be a great fit!

Top-rated Employee Benefits:

  • Remote First: 100% Remote work + home office expense reimbursements+ monthly reimbursement for cell phone, internet and wellness.

  • Top of market rewards: Competitive compensation

  • Take time when you need time: Flexible PTO + company holidays

  • Top class healthcare benefits: Variety of healthcare benefits for you and your family (and your pets!) starting day one

  • Care about your families: Generous top-up for parental leave benefits

  • Support personal development: Continuing education and professional certification reimbursement

  • Connecting in person: Various offsite events and activities for team to connect and meet in person, to support team building and engagement.

  • Giveback to community: Local in-person volunteer events, and give back programs to our communities.

  • Recognition and perks: We have a company wide recognition tool (Phireworks) to celebrate milestones, recognize achievements and strengthen your bond with your teams. You can accumulate points and redeem them for a wide catalogue of items!

  • Diversity and inclusive environment: At Phreesia, all employees are encouraged to bring their authentic self to work, feel supported and perform at their best. We have a variety of Employee Resources Groups (ERGs) which bring together individuals from a wide range of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives, and seek to foster a sense of shared community and empowerment for employees who share a common social identity, such as gender, race, ethnicity, and sexual orientation.

  • Opportunity to join an Employee Resource Group. Learn more here:

We strive to provide a diverse and inclusive environment and are an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.excerpt: Our MissionAt Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life.
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

As an Onboarding Customer Success Manager (OB-CSM), you own the onboarding journey for a portfolio of enterprise/strategic customers across the Americas. Operating with a strong business value mindset, your mission is to accelerate time-to-value, establish clear success criteria, and drive customers towards their strategic outcomes.
Highly proactive and self-motivated, you will orchestrate cross-functional resources (Services, Support, Sales Engineering, Product, and Partners) to deliver a repeatable, programmatic onboarding experience. By successfully managing a high volume of accounts at scale, you will drive strong early adoption and lay the critical foundation for long-term expansion.
Key Responsibilities
  • High-Volume Portfolio Management: Effectively balance and drive >30 concurrent customer onboarding projects at any given time from contract signature to foundational value.
  • Value Realization: Apply a strong business value mindset to define success plans and measurable business outcomes in collaboration with customer sponsors; ensure early wins are documented and communicated.
  • Project Execution: Create and execute project plans, manage risk, track milestones, and keep executive stakeholders proactively informed.
  • Customer Training & Adoption: Guide customers through adopting the platform by running training sessions and helping their teams adjust to the new system. Connect them with the right learning materials (like self-service guides, partner resources, or training portals) to ensure they are set up for success.
  • AI & Process Innovation: Leverage AI tools and a continuous improvement mindset to refine how we work. Proactively identify ways to automate repetitive tasks, improve the onboarding playbook, and deliver a faster, better customer experience.
  • Governance: Establish a clear governance cadence—including steering calls and executive business review to validate value.
  • Proactive Block Removal: Monitor support cases and product telemetry to anticipate and remove adoption blockers quickly before they escalate.
  • Commercial Alignment: Partner with Sales on renewal and upsell strategy once foundational onboarding KPIs are met.
  • Product Feedback: Contribute feedback to Product Management on early-life customer experience and feature gaps discovered during onboarding.

Qualifications

Candidate Location: Must be based on the US East Coast. Candidates located in the Greater Boston area are highly preferred.
  • IGA Expertise (Required): Deep, hands-on experience with Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) platforms (e.g., SailPoint, Saviyant, RSA, Omada, One Identity).
  • CSM & Onboarding Experience: 5+ years of experience as a Customer Success Manager leading complex, multi-threaded software onboarding or implementation projects for enterprise customers.
  • Self-Starter Mentality: Highly self-motivated and proactive, with the proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and independently manage a heavy account load (>30 accounts).
  • AI & Tech Savvy: Comfortable using modern AI tools to boost productivity and always looking for innovative ways to improve existing workflows.
  • Executive Presence: Proven ability to manage executive-level relationships and navigate complex enterprise organizations.
  • Methodology: Demonstrable success using outcome-based frameworks (OKRs, Success Plans, CSAT/NPS) and project-management tools (Smartsheet, , Jira, or similar).
  • CS Tooling (Nice-to-Have): Experience with Gainsight or similar customer success platforms is a strong plus.
  • Technical Foundations: Strong general knowledge of Identity & Access Management (IAM), Windows/Active Directory, and one or more cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Travel: Willingness to travel up to 15% for key workshops and executive reviews.

Compensation Disclosure

The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/com-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.

$123,880.00 - $202,070.00/yr

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at .

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

jobs.excerpt: Assistant Professors are full-time employed faculty who provide a variety of educational services to degree, certificate, and non-degree learners.
jobs.description:
Assistant Professors are full-time employed faculty who provide a variety of educational services to degree, certificate, and non-degree learners. Assistant Professors are responsible for meeting the expectations and requirements of Capella University while establishing and maintaining effective relationships with learners, colleagues, staff, and administration. Assistant Professors are able to perform well in all key accountabilities of the role, are nimble and flexible and expected to be able and willing to take on essential roles and other duties as needed, within the department, school or university. Assistant Professors ensure that learners receive quality educational experiences consistent with stated course outcomes as well as HLC and any program accreditation standards. They provide high-quality, impactful, and inclusive experiences that deliver exceptional learning outcomes. Capella values the scholarly-practitioner model and expects Assistant Professors to continue learning and development through participation in scholarly activities or professional practice in the discipline. Among the responsibilities that Assistant Professors are expected to perform include: teaching (online), mentor and committee work (graduate level only), and contributing to curriculum development. Assistant Professors also participate in school governance through faculty committees and may participate in a variety of other activities based upon the university’s needs and the faculty member’s unique skill set.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Teaching and Instruction – Assistant Professors are highly engaged instructors in the courses and residencies they teach. They are sought out by learners and consistently exceed set expectations for faculty who teach courses at Capella. Assistant Professors use course data to constantly improve their individual teaching performance and contribute regularly to the improvement and refinement of the courses they teach. Regularly reviews course feedback and implements change to continually strengthen performance and enhance learner experience.

  • Doctoral Mentoring – Assistant Professors are highly knowledgeable about established dissertation and doctoral capstone processes and resources. They interact effectively with learners, develop strong relationships and offer guidance. They have demonstrated success in chairing and serving on doctoral committees. Assistant Professors facilitate highly interactive dissertation and capstone course-rooms and their learners are supported to timely completion of the dissertation or capstone product.

  • Curriculum and Course Development – Assistant Professors are knowledgeable in the Capella course development process and have demonstrated the ability to work successfully with cross functional partners across Capella to plan and deliver high quality course and curriculum in the area of their expertise. Participates in the design development and continuous improvement of courses and course materials including course plans, objectives, and outcomes, teaching aids, competency-based assessments, and authentic assessment tools. Ensures sensitivity diversity and inclusiveness in curriculum design, course content, and study materials as needed.

  • School and University Governance – Assistant Professors regularly demonstrate leadership roles in school and university governance. They willingly assume school and university committee roles as active participants and are effective in driving the positive impact of these governance structures. They are the role models and leaders among faculty and serve as peer mentors.

  • Professional Service and Practice – Assistant Professors are active in contributing their professional knowledge and skills to the needs of their local communities and within their professional network affiliations. They carry the “Capella Brand” and mission to their local regions and communities. Research and Scholarship – Assistant Professors stay current in their scholarly field(s) and demonstrate expertise through writing, speaking and conference attendance.

  • Leadership through Team Engagement – Assistant Professors are expected to take on essential roles and other duties as needed, within the department, school or university. Bringing their unique skills and perspectives, Assistant Professors regularly contribute to departmental leadership whether it be through specific roles, active contribution of innovative ideas, or taking on challenging tasks. All full-time faculty are depended on, and relied upon, for immediate and unplanned needs and must be nimble and adjust to changes as they occur.
