The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**

Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. jobs.description:
Risepoint is an education technology company that helps regional universities launch and grow online programs for modern learners. Risepoint supports more than 100 universities and colleges across five countries, with programs concentrated in high-demand fields including nursing, healthcare, teaching, business, technology, and public service. Our suite of products and services supports the full student journey and each university’s long-term goals. Together, we increase access to affordable education that delivers a strong return on investment for learners and meets employer and community needs. Learn more at risepoint.com.


The Impact You Will Make

This role is the connective tissue between Paid Media investment and business outcomes — translating platform-level performance (spend, CPL, CPA) into full-funnel results, from lead and application through enrollment, and ultimately into student LTV and ROAS. With secondary support for web analytics infrastructure, this person gives Paid Media, Channel, Strategy, and Executive Leadership the confidence to make faster, better-informed investment decisions.

How You Will Bring Our Mission to Life

What You Will Do

  • Analyze and connect Paid Media platform performance (spend, CPL, CPC, CPA) with full-funnel outcomes — from lead and application through enrollment — down to student LTV and ROAS
  • Partner closely with Paid Media and Channel teams to build attribution and measurement frameworks that link ad platform data to downstream enrollment and revenue outcomes

  • Independently deliver complex analytics initiatives across performance, marketing, channel media, and solutions domains
  • Design, build, and optimize scalable data models, pipelines, and transformation workflows using Databricks
  • Design, develop, and enhance Power BI dashboards and reporting experiences, including semantic modeling and advanced DAX
  • Support web analytics tagging validation and event data quality as a secondary function, ensuring clean inputs for paid media measurement
  • Support and contribute to Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) initiatives, including channel spend optimization, geo-experiments/lift tests, and budget allocation recommendations
  • Conduct advanced performance analysis, including funnel, cohort, channel, ROAS, LTV, conversion diagnostics, and forecast support
  • Translate complex datasets into clear, actionable business insights and strategic recommendations
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to develop and apply KPIs, performance frameworks, and measurement methodologies
  • Improve data quality, consistency, governance, and reporting reliability across paid media and analytics data sources
  • Drive workflow automation and process efficiency, reducing manual reporting dependencies
  • Present findings, trends, and strategic recommendations to Director, VP, and Executive stakeholders

What Success Looks Like

  • Paid Media performance is consistently connected to full-funnel outcomes — from platform spend to enrollment, LTV, and ROAS
  • Analytics Solutions’ dashboards and insights directly inform Paid Media, Channel, and Executive investment decisions
  • Manual reporting is reduced through automated, scalable pipelines and self-service BI

How Impact Will be Measured

  • Accuracy and consistency of the paid media-to-enrollment-to-LTV/ROAS measurement chain
  • Adoption of BI dashboards and analytics products by Paid Media, Channel, and Executive stakeholders
  • Reduction in manual reporting time and improvement in forecast accuracy

What You’ll Bring to the Team

You bring a rare mix of technical depth and business acumen — equally comfortable architecting a data pipeline and briefing an executive on what it means for the business.

Experience That Matters Most

  • Experience connecting paid media platform performance (spend, CPL, CPA) to full-funnel business outcomes, including enrollment, LTV, and ROAS
  • Strong experience with Paid Media measurement, including multi-touch attribution and campaign performance analysis across platforms (Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Experience with Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), media mix simulation, or geo-experiments/lift tests to validate channel effectiveness
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL (CTEs, window functions, query optimization, large-scale data transformation)
  • Strong hands-on experience with Power BI (semantic modeling, advanced DAX, dashboard UX/storytelling)
  • Strong experience with Databricks (Delta Lake, PySpark, notebooks, workflows)
  • Working knowledge of web analytics platforms (e.g., Adobe Analytics, GA4) sufficient to support tagging validation and data quality for paid media measurement
  • Strong executive communication and data storytelling skills
  • Ability to independently navigate ambiguity and lead through undefined problem spaces

Experience That’s Great to Have

  • Experience with LTV modeling or long-term value analysis (e.g., cohort-based retention or graduation value)
  • Experience with Python, statistical modeling, or advanced analytics workflows
  • Exposure to AI-enabled analytics, automated insight generation, or intelligent reporting frameworks
  • Experience in product analytics, experimentation, or growth analytics
  • Background in analytics engineering or modern data architecture
  • Experience with data clean rooms or audience data-sharing measurement (e.g., LiveRamp, Trade Desk, retail/media networks)
  • Experience working in high-growth, fast-paced environments

LanguageLine Solutions is Hiring!

At LanguageLine, we strive for a world in which language and cultural barriers no longer exist. Use your language skills to dramatically improve the lives of limited-English speakers, as well as the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing. Even better, you can do this while working from your own home.

We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Italian-English Video-Phone Interpreter


Job Title: Italian Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Video-Phone Interpreter

Pay: $15 - $17 per hour.

  • Compensation will not be less than any applicable state or local minimum wage.
    • For Colorado applicants, the expected pay range is $15.16 - $19.29 per hour.

We Offer:

  • Paid professional interpreter training and continuous development.
  • Incentives for meeting attendance targets.
  • Benefits include: Paid Sick Leave in accordance with applicable law, Medical, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Accident, Critical Illness & Life, AD&D, Insurance Package, Inpatient Hospital, Short Term Disability, and 401K Retirement.
  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.

Position Overview:


The Italian Video-Telephone- Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Italian and English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.


The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The video and audio interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.


This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The interpreters translate verbally.


**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment**


Essential Job Functions:

  • Respond to video and audio interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Participate in online, video and audio training sessions.
  • Deliver interpretation services via video and expediently type data on a dedicated device, such as a laptop, desktop computer, mobile phone, or tablet, in order to perform the essential functions of the job.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the video and audio interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during video and audio interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during scheduled work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inItalian and English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States.
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages – highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**


Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.
  • Restricted brands:
    • Kaspersky products.
    • Huawei hardware.
  • High speed Internet connection for work related electronic communication. This internet connection should provide download speeds of no less than 5 Mbps, upload speeds of 3 Mbps, Ping value of no more than 300 ms, Jitter value of no more than 30 ms.
  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer and webcam the majority of the workday.
  • Must use a headset for prolonged periods of time.
  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.
  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.
  • Able to lift up to 26 lbs.
  • May be exposed to moderate noise levels; i.e. computer, audio, telephone.

Applications will be accepted for Seven (7) days from the posting date of September 28, 2026.

Job Description Summary:

The Compensation Analyst will support the development, administration, and continuous improvement of compensation programs across FPW. This role will play a key part in centralizing compensation processes, strengthening governance and audit controls, improving compensation system data integrity, and enhancing reporting and analytics capabilities. The analyst will collaborate with Finance, HR, Payroll, Sales Operations, and business leaders to ensure accurate compensation administration while identifying opportunities to streamline processes, eliminate duplicate work, and increase organizational transparency.

Job Description:

Primary Responsibilities


  • Support the administration and execution of compensation programs across multiple FPW divisions
  • Assist with the centralization and standardization of compensation processes, policies, and procedures
  • Ensure timely and accurate processing of compensation-related transactions
  • Maintain and monitor compensation data within CRM, Orion and HCM
  • Perform regular audits and reconciliations to ensure data accuracy
  • Develop and maintain documentation for compensation processes, calculations, and system workflows
  • Establish and maintain audit trails for compensation transactions and approvals
  • Ensure compensation processes comply with company policies
  • Provide actionable insights to leadership through data-driven reporting and analysis
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual processes through automation and system enhancements
  • Support quarter-end and year-end compensation processes

Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Accounting, Analytics, or related field.
  • 1-3 years of experience in compensation, finance, payroll, sales operations, data analysis, or a related analytical role.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including but not limited to XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIFS, IF statements, etc
  • Experience working within CRM and large dataset to analyze
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewLMI is seeking a proactive and highly organized Project Management Specialist to support a U.
jobs.description:
Overview

LMI is seeking a proactive and highly organized Project Management Specialist to support a U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) program focused on suicide prevention and mental health.

This role will provide day-to-day project management, administrative, and operational support across multiple technical and programmatic workstreams. The successful candidate will work closely with Program Managers, Project Managers, technical teams, and client stakeholders to keep work organized, maintain visibility into priorities and commitments, and help ensure teams follow through on key actions and deliverables.

This position is ideal for someone who is comfortable working in the gray, takes initiative without waiting for every task to be assigned, and is eager to learn how complex federal programs are managed. We are looking for a dependable, curious, and resourceful teammate who is willing to jump in where needed, ask thoughtful questions, identify gaps, and continuously take on greater responsibility.

The role will also provide exposure to the technical side of the program, including work involving Microsoft Power Platform, SharePoint, data and analytics, and program evaluation. The ideal candidate does not need to be a developer or data scientist but should have an interest in understanding how technical solutions are designed, delivered, and managed.

This position offers a strong development path for an individual interested in growing into increasingly complex project and program management responsibilities.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and intelligence sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Support Program Managers and Project Managers across multiple projects and workstreams, providing day-to-day coordination, administrative support, and execution follow-through.
  • Maintain project schedules, calendars, trackers, action logs, risk and issue logs, decision records, and other project-management artifacts.
  • Coordinate meeting logistics, develop agendas, capture clear and accurate meeting minutes, track action items, and drive follow-up with responsible team members.
  • Help maintain visibility into project priorities, milestones, deadlines, dependencies, and outstanding decisions.
  • Coordinate inputs for contract deliverables, status reports, program reviews, leadership briefings, and client-facing materials.
  • Develop and maintain polished PowerPoint presentations, Excel trackers, dashboards, and other project-management materials.
  • Organize and maintain project documentation in SharePoint, including SOPs, templates, trackers, deliverables, meeting records, and other program artifacts.
  • Support onboarding and offboarding activities, including coordination of VA access, systems, tools, documentation, and program orientation.
  • Assist with Agile delivery activities, including sprint planning, backlog coordination, Scrum or Kanban ceremonies, action tracking, and maintenance of Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
  • Support Project Managers in gathering and documenting requirements, user needs, acceptance criteria, and project decisions.
  • Coordinate across technical, analytical, and program teams to ensure information is shared, commitments are understood, and work continues to move forward.
  • Gain familiarity with technical workstreams involving Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI, Power Apps, SharePoint, analytics, data, and program evaluation and support the associated project-management activities.
  • Proofread and quality-check client deliverables for completeness, consistency, accuracy, and presentation quality.
  • Support internal reporting activities, including program management reviews, quarterly reviews, staffing updates, and leadership briefings.
  • Proactively identify missing information, process gaps, upcoming deadlines, risks, or areas requiring follow-up and bring them to the attention of project or program leadership.
  • Take ownership of assigned tasks and smaller initiatives, working independently to drive them through completion.
  • Step in to facilitate meetings, coordinate activities, or provide additional support when project leadership is unavailable.
  • Seek opportunities to improve project processes, documentation, reporting, and team coordination.
  • Learn from Project and Program Managers and gradually take on increased responsibility for project planning, client interaction, Agile delivery, and workstream management.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, management, public administration, information systems, technology, public health, or a related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in project coordination, project management, consulting, program operations, business operations, or a related role.
  • Strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and competing priorities.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in environments where requirements or direction may not always be fully defined.
  • A proactive, self-starter mindset with the ability to identify what needs to be done, ask appropriate questions, and move work forward with limited direction.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing accurate, high-quality work.
  • Experience developing meeting agendas, capturing minutes, maintaining action items, and coordinating follow-through.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Teams, and SharePoint.
  • Ability to develop professional, client-ready presentations, trackers, reports, and other project materials.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and comfort working with team members and stakeholders across different disciplines and levels of seniority.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across technical, analytical, and operational teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, sound judgment, and willingness to take ownership of unfamiliar assignments.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and an appetite to learn and grow within the project and program management career path.
  • Interest in technology-enabled programs and willingness to develop greater familiarity with technical delivery concepts and tools.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the required background investigation or Public Trust.

Desired Qualifications

  • Prior experience supporting the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, Veterans Health Administration, or another federal government client.
  • Experience or interest in suicide prevention, mental health, behavioral health, healthcare, public health, or Veteran services.
  • Experience supporting Agile or hybrid delivery teams and familiarity with Scrum or Kanban practices.
  • Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, or comparable project-management tools.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, or related technologies.
  • Familiarity with program evaluation, performance measurement, data analytics, or data-informed decision-making.
  • Comfort working alongside developers, analysts, data scientists, evaluators, and technical subject matter experts.
  • Experience developing or maintaining project dashboards, status trackers, reporting tools, or management metrics.
  • Exposure to federal contract operations, staffing, deliverable management, or performance reporting.
  • Project management or Agile certification such as CAPM, CSM, PSM, SAFe, or equivalent, or demonstrated interest in pursuing certification.
  • Interest in progressing into a Sr Project Manager and eventually Program Manager role.

Target salary range: $110,000-$125,000

Disclaimer: The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

jobs.description:
LanguageLine Solutions is Hiring!

At LanguageLine, we strive for a world in which language and cultural barriers no longer exist. Use your language skills to dramatically improve the lives of limited-English speakers, as well as the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing. Even better, you can do this while working from your own home.

LanguageLine has been certified as a Great Place to Work, and is regularly listed as one of America’s top work-from-home employers.

Our interpreters serve clients across numerous industries, including health care, 911, first responders, education, government agencies, and all walks of business.

As an interpreter, you will receive training that is the best in the industry. We’ll ensure that you learn new skills while further developing your skillset. We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Fijian-English Phone Interpreter

Job Title: Fijian Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Phone Interpreter

Status: Independent Contractor

Pay: $1.25 - $1.40 per minute

We Offer:

  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.
  • **This is an independent contractor position and therefore not eligible for employee benefits.**

Position Overview:

The Fijian Telephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Fijianand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**

Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inFijianand English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages - highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**

Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.
  • Restricted brands:
    • Kaspersky products.
    • Huawei hardware.
  • High speed Internet connection for work related electronic communication. This internet connection should provide download speeds of no less than 5 Mbps, upload speeds of 3 Mbps, Ping value of no more than 300 ms, Jitter value of no more than 30 ms.
  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer the majority of the workday.
  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.
  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.
  • Able to lift up to 26 lbs.
  • May be exposed to moderate noise levels; i.e. computer, audio, telephone.

Applications will be accepted for One Hundred Eighty (180) days from the posting date of May 18, 2026.

LLS will reasonably accommodate employees and applicants with disabilities if the person is otherwise qualified to safely perform all of the essential functions of the position. Should you require accommodations to complete this application and/or the interview process, please let us know immediately.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race. color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, pregnancy, genetic information or any other consideration prohibited by law or contract.

The HRIS team is responsible for owning and managing Workday, supporting multiple business functions within the global business units at Lamb Weston. This team works closely with our stakeholders across HR, Process Innovation, Payroll, Performance, Compensation, Learning, Recruiting and Benefits, etc. to provide technology solutions and services to enable them for success in carrying out business operations & launching strategic business projects.

You will be the acting subject matter expert (SME) on assigned Workday modules (HCM, Core & Advanced Compensation) while having a working knowledge of other modules, and processes to engage and partner with leaders to architect solutions and implement them. You will be responsible for defining standards and best practices for Workday, both in implementation of configuration and support. You will act as a Workday champion and stay on top of Workday’s releases and features to implement the latest and greatest for your business stakeholders.

Job Description


  • This role will require thorough knowledge and understanding of core HR business processes, practices, and experience implementing and administering Workday for large enterprise companies. This role reports to the Manager of HR Systems.
  • Manage annual Global Advanced Compensation Process.
  • Participate in discovery sessions with business stakeholders and cross functional teams to analyze business requirements and translate into documented solutions.

  • Challenge existing business & IT processes, methods and systems for improving operations, security and scalability.

  • Participate in weekly resourcing updates and manage communications with business stakeholders, ensuring reliable project tracking, execution, and on time deliverables.
  • Support the reporting needs of business to design and develop insightful analytics solutions on the Workday platform. Skills to include extensive calculated fields, advanced report types, dashboards and Hubs.
  • Ability to understand the impacts of any changes to Workday processes and configuration on other technologies and on downstream systems ensuring the appropriate parties are advised.
  • Build reports and dashboards to drive self-service and to support reporting.
  • Stay abreast of the latest Workday releases to promote awareness, and adoption of Workday tools to drive more productivity and efficiency within HR operations.
  • Proactively share knowledge with HR Service Center support teams including assisting in the development of documentation, guidelines, end-user training resources and other materials as required.
  • Partner with team members through project collaboration and KT’s:
  • Gather, build and test requirements for multiple modules within Workday HCM, Payroll, Time Tracking, Absence, Benefits, Talent, Learning, Performance, Talent, Compensation and Recruiting as assigned.
  • Provides system mass update support via EIBs for all functional areas of Workday.
  • Collaborate with HRIS team members to support all escalated HRIS related Workday support tickets via Service Now within established service level agreement.
  • Provides support and collaborates on all integrations including the management of current integrations.
  • Effectively define, configure and document technical requirements for system configurations and enhancements.
  • Configure Annual Compensation Statements in Workday Documents and other documents as needed.
  • Lead the bi-annual Workday release management process for assigned modules to include analysis of updates, creation of testing scenarios and configuration validation.
  • Perform thorough review of business requirements to determine feasibility of the request, provide additional functional solutions and work with stakeholders to deliver the requirements.
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Basic & Preferred Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education/training/experience in Management Information Systems, Human Resources, or related field required.
  • Workday Certification is preferred
  • A minimum of five (5) years of Workday experience with three (3) years specific to the assigned Workday module (Compensation).

  • Strong technical and working knowledge of HR systems, applications, theory and practice.
  • PROFICIENCY_RATING_ADVANCED proficiency with data conversion and mapping.
  • Ability to provide, in user-friendly terms, sound ideas and solutions to end users on HR systems-related questions, tasks, projects and reports.
  • Demonstrates an understanding of business objectives both internally and externally which impact the company’s ability to achieve its objectives.

Coupled with our compensation and bonus incentive programs, our benefits deliver rewards that are market competitive. Some of the most attractive elements of our benefit programs include:

  • Flexible Spending Accounts for Health and Dependent Care, and Health Reimbursement Accounts

jobs.description:
Build the systems that deliver Simulation Technology knowledge to developers, partners, internal teams, and the AI agents that increasingly sit between them and our documentation. Our KnowledgeOps team sets the information architecture and quality standards for Omniverse, Isaac Sim, and OpenUSD documentation. You'll build the automation, pipelines, and AI-ready infrastructure that apply those standards at scale, and work with documentation leads to refine the architecture based on what you learn.


You're a writer who builds: as comfortable in Git, CI, or Python as in a style guide, and fluent with LLMs in daily work. We build systems where the right way is easier than the wrong way. For you, that means turning documentation, standards, and tribal knowledge into tooling, templates, and self-service paths, so fewer people have to ask "how do I…?"


What you'll be doing:

  • Collaborate with documentation leads on knowledge architecture, sharing implementation feedback (what works, breaks, and scales) to refine content models, information architecture, and AI-readiness patterns
  • Build and run docs-as-code pipelines: Git authoring, CI/CD builds, linting, link and code-sample validation, and publishing
  • Make knowledge AI-ready: structure and package content for RAG, internal assistants, and agentic workflows, including llms.txt, MCP-accessible sources, agent skills and context kits, and evaluation sets for answer accuracy
  • Automate the content lifecycle with LLMs and scripting, from drafting and updating to auditing, with checks for freshness, code accuracy, and terminology drift, and human review where judgment matters
  • Encode standards (user stories, release readiness, onboarding, security guidance) into templates, validators, and guided workflows rather than static documents
  • Capture tribal knowledge from engineering, product, and operations, and turn it into playbooks, decision guides, and self-service paths
  • Measure outcomes such as time-to-first-success, support deflection, repeat questions, and AI answer quality, and use the data to decide what to build, fix, or retire
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, Security, Developer Relations, and Partner Programs so every release ships documented, discoverable, and supportable

What we need to see:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience, plus 8+ years in technical writing, developer documentation, or developer experience for complex software platforms
  • Hands-on docs-as-code experience: Git, pull request review, Markdown/RST, static site generators (Sphinx, MkDocs, Docusaurus, or similar), and CI/CD
  • Working proficiency in Python or similar to automate content tasks, transform data, and integrate with APIs
  • Practical experience applying LLMs to content workflows (prompting, retrieval and grounding, output evaluation) and sound judgment about where AI can be trusted
  • Information architecture skills: content modeling, taxonomy, and metadata for both navigation and machine retrieval
  • Enough technical depth to read code and APIs, verify accuracy, and write working examples
  • A systems mindset: you fix the class of problem, not just the instance
  • A collaborative style: you turn design intent into working systems and give leads clear, constructive feedback grounded in implementation

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience building RAG pipelines, AI assistants, MCP servers, or agent skill and context libraries backed by documentation
  • Documentation experience in graphics, simulation, robotics, or real-time systems; familiarity with USD, Omniverse, Isaac Sim, or ROS
  • Content quality automation you've built, such as Vale or custom linters, doc test harnesses, or freshness monitoring
  • Measurable reductions in support load or onboarding time through self-service knowledge systems
  • Open source contributions or published work on docs-as-code, AI-assisted documentation, or knowledge engineering

What we're doing at Uscreen

Uscreen is the video monetization platform for businesses building recurring revenue from video content. Our customers replace a patchwork stack of separate hosting, community, courses, email, and app vendors with one branded experience across web, mobile, and TV.

The platform is only half of it. We believe growth requires behavior, not just software. Customers don't stall because a feature is missing. They stall because they priced wrong, never built an email list, or launched an offer nobody wanted. Coaching is how we fix that, and it's part of the product rather than an add-on.

The job

You own a segment.

We have a cohort of smaller video businesses where retention is not where it should be. Nobody owns it today. You will. That means the revenue that stays in that segment, and the revenue that grows inside it, is yours. Your lemonade stand, your numbers, your call on how to run it.

This is a coaching role measured in dollars. You'll be accountable for gross revenue retention in your cohort first, and expansion second. Not tickets closed, not calls booked.

It's also a one-to-many job. Your cohort is larger than a 1:1 book, so the work is designing coaching that scales: cohort programs, group sessions, office hours, triggered outreach when the data says a business is drifting. You'll build that motion rather than inherit it.

What you'll do

  • Own gross revenue retention and expansion for an assigned segment of customers
  • Find the pattern in why businesses in your cohort stall, and build coaching that addresses it at scale rather than one conversation at a time
  • Run group coaching sessions, cohort programs, and asynchronous coaching inside Membership+
  • Coach customers through the decisions that move revenue: pricing, packaging, positioning, offer design, email and funnel strategy, retention mechanics

Perle is building the data that teaches AI and robotics how real people move, work, and get things done. We are looking for contributors across the Indonesia & Malaysia to capture everyday footage and turn their ordinary routines into real income.

The role is simple: you wear a headstrap with your phone, press record, and go about your day. The footage is captured hands-free from your perspective, so you can keep both hands on whatever you are doing.

Contributors record everyday activities and real work. That includes things like:

  • Everyday activities: the small, ordinary moments that make up a normal day, captured naturally as they happen.

There is no script and no acting. The whole point is authentic, real footage of real life. If you can do your job and your daily tasks, you can do this.

Why This Is Worth Your Time

  • Earn while you already work: Record while you work or while you handle things at home. Your day does not change; you just capture it.

Step 2 Get your headstrap

We provide a budget to purchase the headstrap. You mount your phone, and you are ready to record hands-free.

Step 3 Record your day

Press record and go about your work and your routine. Capture at least 10 hours of footage a week, on your own schedule.

Step 4 Submit and get paid

Upload your footage through the app. Once it is reviewed and accepted, you are paid for every hour delivered.

Everything you record is submitted through a dedicated app, which is built to be fully compliant and private. Your footage is encrypted and handled securely from the moment you upload it.

jobs.description:
Senior Director, Revenue Forecasting

Position Summary

The Senior Director of Forecasting is responsible for leading enterprise-wide commercial forecasting, demand planning, and revenue analytics across the organization's portfolio. This leader serves as the primary steward of forecast accuracy, partnering closely with Commercial, Marketing, Finance, Market Access, and Executive Leadership to deliver actionable insights that support business planning, resource allocation, investor communications, and strategic decision-making.

Commercial Forecasting Leadership

  • Lead the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of short-term and long-range revenue forecasts.
  • Own forecast methodology, assumptions, scenario planning, and forecasting governance across all products and business segments.
  • Establish best-in-class forecasting processes, models, and tools that improve forecast accuracy and business predictability.
  • Deliver monthly, quarterly, and annual forecast updates to executive leadership.

Demand Planning & Business Analytics

  • Analyze market dynamics, customer utilization trends, testing volumes, competitive activity, and commercial performance drivers.
  • Translate commercial and market intelligence into revenue implications and forecast adjustments.
  • Develop predictive models and reporting that inform growth opportunities, risks, and mitigation strategies.
  • Monitor forecast performance and conduct variance analyses.

Strategic & Long-Range Planning

  • Partner with Finance on annual operating plans, strategic plans, and long-range financial outlooks.
  • Support portfolio planning, new product assessments, pricing initiatives, and commercial investment decisions.
  • Build business scenarios and sensitivity analyses to support executive decision-making.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as the primary forecasting partner to Commercial Leadership, Finance & FP&A, Marketing, Market Access, Business Development, and Corporate Strategy.
  • Facilitate consensus forecast reviews and align stakeholders around key assumptions and business risks.

Reporting & Executive Communications

  • Prepare forecast packages and executive summaries for leadership reviews.
  • Present key insights, risks, opportunities, and recommendations to senior executives.
  • Support earnings preparation, Board materials, and investor-related forecasting analyses as required.

Data & Forecast Excellence

  • Drive adoption of advanced forecasting methodologies, analytics, and forecasting technology.
  • Establish forecast accuracy metrics and KPI dashboards.
  • Ensure integrity and consistency of commercial and operational data used in forecasting.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Life Sciences, or a related field required.
  • MBA, Master's degree, or other advanced quantitative degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in commercial forecasting, strategic planning, analytics, finance, or commercial operations within diagnostics, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, healthcare, or related life sciences industries.
  • Deep expertise in revenue forecasting, demand planning, business analytics, and scenario modeling.
  • Experience forecasting within diagnostics, molecular diagnostics, precision medicine, laboratory services, or healthcare services businesses strongly preferred.
  • Proven experience supporting executive leadership, annual operating planning processes, long-range strategic planning, and investment decision-making.
  • Track record of influencing and driving alignment across cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong executive presence with exceptional analytical, communication, and presentation skills.

Success Measures

  • Forecast accuracy and predictability.
  • Quality and timeliness of executive forecasting deliverables.
  • Effectiveness of scenario planning and risk identification.
  • Stakeholder confidence and adoption of forecast outputs.
  • Contribution to commercial and strategic planning decisions.

EEO

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. In hiring and all other employment decisions, we prohibit discrimination and harassment on the basis of any protected characteristic, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. In accordance with applicable law, we make reasonable accommodations for applicants’ and employees’ religious practices and beliefs, as well as any mental health or physical disability needs.

Required

  • U.S. citizen or national
  • Green Card holder
  • Living full time in the USA

We take geographic location into account when determining base salary to ensure equitable and competitive compensation.

jobs.excerpt: About:Are you always ahead of the latest social media trends and passionate about brand storytelling?
jobs.description:
About:

Are you always ahead of the latest social media trends and passionate about brand storytelling? At Vanguard College Prep, we are seeking a detail-oriented Social Media Content Coordinator to manage and elevate our digital presence across all social channels. In this role, you will plan, create, and schedule daily engaging content across all our social channels. You will craft eye-catching visual and video assets, manage community interactions, and analyze post performance to drive measurable growth and engagement while fostering meaningful connections with our online community.

Compensation:

  • Starting Compensation: $16.00 – $19.00 depending on education, experience, and skill.
    • Work from home, occasional commute
    • Flexible Schedule
    • Career growth opportunities

What You’ll Do:

  1. Content Creation & Curation

  • Short-Form Video Production: Script, film, and edit vertical videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts using mobile editors like CapCut or desktop tools like Adobe Premiere Pro.
  • Graphic & Visual Asset Design: Create static graphics, carousel posts, infographics, and story assets using Canva, Photoshop, or Illustrator.
  • Copywriting: Draft engaging captions, call-to-actions (CTAs), video scripts, and post copy tailored to each platform's distinct tone and audience.
  • Brand Voice Maintenance: Ensure all visual design choices, messaging, and tone strictly follow established brand guidelines.

  1. Planning & Scheduling

  • Editorial Calendar Management: Build and maintain weekly/monthly content calendars aligned with product launches, marketing campaigns, and seasonal events.
  • Content Scheduling: Upload and schedule posts across platforms (Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Pinterest, Youtube) using scheduling platforms
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate with internal teams as needed to gather assets and information for upcoming posts.

  1. Community Management

  • Active Daily Engagement: Monitor active feeds and inbox messages daily to respond to comments, direct messages (DMs), and mentions.
  • UGC Curation: Identify user-generated content (UGC), engage with creators, and coordinate permissions to repurpose high-performing posts that apply to our brand.
  • Customer Support Routing: Flag customer complaints, technical issues, or public relations risks appearing on social channels and route them to support or leadership teams.

  1. Analytics & Reporting

  • Analytics & Reporting: Track key performance indicators (KPIs)—reach, impressions, engagement rates, follower growth, click-throughs, and conversions—and compile regular performance reports with actionable insights to optimize strategy.
  • Trend Identification: Research viral audio clips, trending video formats, and emerging platform features to pitch timely content opportunities.
  • Competitor & Industry Monitoring: Benchmark channel performance against industry trends and key industry competitors to refine publishing schedules and post styles.

Requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher
  • Work Experience: A minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience managing social media accounts, producing digital content, and/or coordinating organic social campaigns for a brand, business, or agency.
  • Communication Skills: Ability to write clear, engaging post copy, short hooks, and clear calls-to-action (CTAs) that match a brand’s specific voice and tone.
  • Analytical Skills: Ability to read social media platform insights (engagement rate, reach, impressions, click-throughs) and turn metrics into actionable content adjustments.
  • Work Setup: Reliable high-speed internet connection and a professional, distraction-free workspace suitable for video content production
  • Tech Proficiency: Strong proficiency with Google Workspace, social media platforms for posting content, and video editing platforms such as CapCut, Canva, Adobe Premiere Pro, Photoshop etc.

The ideal candidate will also possess:

  • The ability to work both independently and in a team environment
  • Excellent content creation and editing skills
  • Ability to create growth in the number of followers across all platforms
  • Strong organizational and time-management abilities to be able to meet content posting goals and create content when viral trends emerge
  • Manage multiple deadlines and content pipelines simultaneously
  • Experience with meeting social media related goals set by organizations
  • Ability to optimize post captions, alt text, and video metadata for social search engines using strategic keywords.

Why Work With Us?

  • Meaningful Impact: You will be able to provide the opportunity for more students to be able to use our services through social media reach
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for leadership and long-term career growth
  • Elite Peer Network: Join a tight-knit team that shares resources, celebrates wins, and supports each other through ongoing professional development and mentorship. Quickly-growing start-up environment that emphasizes creativity, collaboration, and mentorship.
  • Fully Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the autonomy of working from home with regular team collaboration and support.
  • Comprehensive Paid Onboarding: We invest heavily in your success with structured training covering our academic frameworks, objection handling, and marketing strategies.

About Us:

Vanguard College Prep is dedicated to equipping students with the strategic tools, expert test preparation, and personalized college counseling needed to confidently navigate an increasingly complex admissions system. As the education industry rapidly evolves, we are expanding our reach to ensure as many families as possible can access our top-tier programs and empower their students to reach their full potential. Our mission is to serve our community by creating future leaders that will revolutionize their respective fields.

Salary: $16 – $19 / hour

jobs.description:
About Dean Dorton

Dean Dorton’s team makes up one of the largest advisory firms in the United States. We thrive when you thrive! We are here to help you succeed in every step of your development and career as you work with nationally recognized experts in a recognized best place to work.

Our core values guide how we work, lead, and support one another every day. They are:

  • Integrity - We do the right thing, integrity guides our decisions.
  • Relationships - We value people, relationships drive our impact.
  • Collaboration - We win as one team, collaboration fuels our success.
  • Growth - We stay curious, growth is our mindset.

About the Team

Dean Dorton’s Technology Consulting practice empowers organizations to transform the way they operate through innovative, data-driven technology solutions. Our Software, Data & AI team partners with clients to design, implement, and optimize systems that enhance performance, strengthen decision-making, and accelerate growth. From ERP and business management software to advanced analytics and AI applications, we deliver secure, scalable, and integrated solutions that align technology with strategy—helping businesses work smarter, faster, and with greater confidence.

About the Role

The Sales Manager & Account Executive is responsible for driving revenue growth, leading business development strategy, and managing the performance of the Software, Data & AI sales team. This role combines individual sales responsibilities with sales leadership, coaching, and team development.

This role maintains a personal sales portfolio while overseeing Account Executive(s), ensuring consistent execution of sales processes, achievement of revenue targets, and alignment with Dean Dorton's growth objectives. This individual partners closely with practice leaders, consultants, marketing, and delivery teams to position Dean Dorton as a trusted advisor and technology solutions partner.

This role may not be for you if you prefer focusing exclusively on individual sales opportunities without coaching and developing others. It may also not be a fit if you are uncomfortable being accountable for both personal and team revenue performance, leading through influence, or balancing strategic planning with day-to-day sales execution.

This role may be for you if you enjoy building and leading high-performing sales teams while maintaining direct client relationships and driving business growth. You are energized by coaching others, developing sales strategies, and helping clients solve complex business challenges through technology solutions.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

The essential duties and responsibilities of the Sales Manager & Account Executive role are outlined below in correlation with Dean Dorton’s performance management impact areas.

Technical

Definition: Your specialized knowledge and expertise associated with the work you perform for/with clients (note: clients may be internal to Dean Dorton).

Individual Sales Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute sales strategies to drive new business and expand existing client relationships.
  • Maintain an individual sales quota and actively pursue opportunities within target markets.
  • Lead high-value discovery meetings and strategic client discussions.
  • Collaborate with solution architects, consultants, and delivery leaders to design and position tailored solutions.
  • Present proposals, pricing models, and solution recommendations to prospective clients.
  • Build executive-level relationships with prospects, clients, software partners, and referral sources.
  • Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipeline activity, and CRM data.

Leadership Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage the Software, Data & AI sales function.
  • Establish sales goals, pipeline targets, and performance expectations for Account Executive(s).
  • Monitor team performance against revenue, activity, and conversion metrics.
  • Conduct regular pipeline reviews and opportunity strategy sessions.
  • Provide coaching on prospecting, consultative selling, proposal development, negotiation, and closing strategies.
  • Ensure consistency in sales methodologies, CRM usage, forecasting, and reporting.
  • Partner with practice leadership to identify market opportunities, service offerings, and growth initiatives.
  • Assist in recruiting, onboarding, and developing sales talent.

Behavioral

Definition: The behaviors associated with performing your job (interpersonal skills).

  • Lead by example through strong client relationship management and professional sales practices.
  • Coach and mentor Account Executive(s) to improve performance and professional growth.
  • Foster collaboration between sales, consulting, marketing, and delivery teams.
  • Communicate complex technology and business solutions in a clear, client-focused manner.
  • Demonstrate accountability for individual and team revenue goals.
  • Resolve sales obstacles and escalations while maintaining positive client relationships.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement, learning, and collaboration.
  • Adapt strategies and priorities in response to changing market conditions and business needs.

Non-Charge

Definition: The contribution you make to Dean Dorton outside of client work.

  • Collaborate with leadership to develop annual sales plans, territory strategies, and growth objectives.
  • Partner with marketing on campaigns, events, webinars, and thought leadership initiatives.
  • Represent Dean Dorton at conferences, networking events, software partner functions, and industry organizations.
  • Provide leadership with insights on market trends, competitive activity, and client needs.
  • Contribute to strategic planning and practice development initiatives.
  • Support cross-selling efforts across all Dean Dorton service lines.
  • Champion firm culture, values, and employee development.
  • Participate in internal training and leadership development programs.

Requirements

Software & Tools

  • Sage Intacct
  • Sage Construction Management (SCM) / Sage CRE
  • ConnectWise
  • Microsoft Power BI, Azure, SQL
  • Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams)
  • Integration and data migration platforms

Benefits

The Fun Stuff

Work isn’t all work! We want to make your experience at Dean Dorton a great one. From your health and happiness to your long-term satisfaction, we focus on YOU! A few highlights are listed below:

  • Health insurance – medical, vision, dental
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Paid family leave, medical leave, and maternity/paternity leave programs.
  • Retirement benefits – 401(K) match and best-in-class automatic profit sharing
  • Telemedicine, mental health resources, and wellness program reimbursement
  • Life insurance and disability insurance

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by team members assigned to this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Additionally, responsibilities and duties may vary depending on business needs and individual circumstances.

Dean Dorton is an equal opportunity employer. We’re committed to growing and empowering an inclusive community within Dean Dorton and our industry which is why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of the best and brightest from all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives across the organization. We welcome anyone of any race, religion, color, national origin, political affiliation, pregnancy, ancestry, handicap, medical condition, disability, marital status, age, sexual orientation or gender.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

Zayo is seeking a Customer Account Manager, Federalresponsible for leading the post-implementation customer relationship, recurring-revenue strategy, and customer continuity for large and complex Public Sector Federal accounts, including U.S. Federal Civilian departments and institutions, and related public-sector organizations.


This role serves as a strategic customer partner and revenue steward, managing renewals, retention, churn risk, expansion opportunities, and complex customer requirements across Zayo's services. The CAM works closely with Sales and cross-functional partners to align customer priorities, procurement requirements, funding cycles, and network needs with Zayo's capabilities.


The role requires strong knowledge of the Public Sector – U.S. Federal market and the ability to navigate complex procurement environments, including RFP/RFQ processes, Federal contract vehicles, cooperative purchasing programs, and complex Federal pursuit activities. The CAM is expected to translate these market and procurement dynamics into proactive account, renewal, and growth strategies.


Location: This remote work position will consider applicants that reside in the continental United States.


MUST BE A U.S. CITIZEN - This position requires the selected candidate to possess the ability to obtain a Secret Clearance.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain strong operational, commercial, and executive relationships with Public Sector - Federal customers and their account teams.
  • Develop multi-year account, renewal, and network plans informed by customer priorities, service needs, contract position, funding cycles, procurement timelines, competitive risk, and financial exposure.
  • Own revenue protection, churn management, renewal execution, and expansion strategy for assigned accounts.
  • Lead complex, multi-service, multi-location, or multi-year renewals, RFP/RFQ responses, and executive business reviews.
  • Develop and execute customer strategies aligned to agency missions, technology roadmaps, budgets, acquisition plans, and Zayo capabilities.
  • Identify and advance growth opportunities in partnership with Sales by understanding customer infrastructure needs, funding availability, upcoming procurements, technology initiatives, and service expansion opportunities.
  • Navigate and leverage Federal contract vehicles, cooperative purchasing programs, Federal consortiums, and other public-sector procurement mechanisms to support renewals and growth.
  • Manage material churn forecasts and mitigation plans while balancing customer outcomes with pricing discipline, contract terms, margin, capital recovery, and long-term account value.
  • Develop and negotiate save, replacement, portability, migration, network-redesign, relocation, decommission, and contract-restructuring strategies appropriate to the customer and procurement environment.
  • Provide senior commercial judgment on credits, ETL, portability, contract exceptions, rate increases, renewal pricing, and appropriate revenue treatment.
  • Coordinate complex customer requirements and decisions across Sales, Sales Engineering, Finance, Billing, Legal, Deal Management, Service Assurance, Service Delivery, Product, and Operations.
  • Serve as a knowledgeable customer advisor on Zayo services and their alignment to Public Sector and Federal requirements, procurement processes, and funding programs.
  • Monitor changes in relevant funding, procurement, and market conditions and translate those changes into actionable account strategies.
  • Lead customer business reviews and executive engagements focused on service performance, business priorities, upcoming procurements, renewal readiness, funding opportunities, and future network requirements.
  • Mentor less-experienced CAMs and contribute to renewal playbooks, training, negotiation practices, and operating standards, particularly for Public Sector and Federal accounts.

Qualifications

  • Typically, 6+ years of experience in Customer Retention, Strategic Account Management, Client Services, Sales, or a comparable customer-facing role; senior assignments typically require 8+ years.
  • Demonstrated success managing large, complex Federal accounts, including Public-Sector and Federal government, or similarly procurement-intensive organizations.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, strategic, or high-revenue customer relationships with multiple stakeholders and extended buying cycles.
  • Manage complex Federal opportunities from qualification and RFI/RFP response through proposal, negotiation, award, and implementation handoff.
  • Work with appropriate internal teams to leverage Federal contract vehicles and acquisition pathways, including GWACs, IDIQs, BPAs, GSA MAS, NASA SEWP, and task orders.
  • Strong understanding of Federal procurement processes, including RFP/RFQ development, formal bid processes, state contract vehicles, cooperative purchasing programs, and education consortiums.
  • Familiarity with Federal government purchasing environments and the ability to navigate complex procurement, contracting, budgeting, and approval processes.
  • Advanced experience in renewals, retention, commercial negotiations, RFP/RFQ response, contract execution, and revenue preservation.
  • Strong understanding of churn, gross and net revenue retention, renewal performance, discount performance, and recurring-revenue management.
  • Significant telecommunications / digital infrastructure experience preferred.
  • Executive-level communication, presentation, negotiation, and facilitation skills, with the ability to build credibility across customer stakeholders ranging from operational users to senior decision makers.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, project-management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage complex timelines and multiple competing priorities.
  • Ability to work effectively across Sales, Sales Engineering, Finance, Legal, Operations, Service Delivery, Product, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Business, Sales, Public Administration, Federal, or a related field preferred.
  • Willingness and ability to travel based on customer and business needs.

Estimated Base Salary Range: $75,390 - $107,700 USD / annually.

Job Description Summary

GE Aerospace’s Propulsion and Additive Technologies (P&AT) Contracts Organization is seeking an experienced Senior Contracts Manager This role manages a mixed portfolio spanning civil and U.S. Government contracts. The Senior Contracts Manager will oversee the full contract lifecycle—from proposal strategy and negotiation through award, execution, and sustainment—serving as a trusted advisor to the business on customer relationships, regulatory compliance, contract terms, negotiation strategy, and scope management.
In this role, you will work across multiple business units and product lines spanning international and U.S. domestic operations, balancing near-term deliverables with long-term program goals. Success requires strong proficiency in managing diverse contract types—including complex development, production, non-disclosure, and sustainment contracts—for both civil and military/government customers, as well as comfort navigating cross-border business practices and regulatory frameworks.
**This role is location-flexible, but working hours must align with Eastern Time business hours**

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Serve as a contracts subject matter expert supporting all phases of the program lifecycle—proposal, negotiation, award, and post-award execution—including managing commercial issues, customer relationships, change management, claims, and disputes.
  • Act as the primary point of contact between GE Aerospace and its civil and government customers on all contractual matters, including contract interpretation and dispute resolution.
  • Provide end-to-end contract administration for assigned proposals and contracts, including drafting and reviewing contract terms and conditions, leading negotiations, and advising internal stakeholders on contract risk and compliance.
  • Serve as a liaison with internal functional owners—including finance, program management, engineering, sales, and legal—to align contractual commitments with program execution.
  • Guide proposal teams through solicitation assessment, including FAR/DFARS compliance, export control considerations (ITAR/EAR), and other business, legal, and compliance risks, and develop mitigation strategies.
  • Monitor contract compliance throughout the contract lifecycle, ensuring performance obligations, deliverables, and reporting requirements are met.
  • Participate in special projects as assigned, including process improvement initiatives across the contracts organizations.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher from an accredited institution; a Juris Doctor or advanced degree in business, contract management, or a related field is a plus.
  • 6+ years of experience in contract formation and execution across civil, U.S. Government, and international contracting environments.
  • Demonstrated expertise in the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), with particular emphasis on Part 12 (Acquisition of Commercial Items) and Part 15 (Contracting by Negotiation), as well as the Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) and applicable export control regulations (ITAR/EAR).

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience negotiating and drafting contracts for both civil/commercial and U.S. Government military customers.
  • Experience briefing stakeholders, including cross-functional team members and functional leadership, on contract status, risk, and compliance matters.
  • Ability to work effectively across international and domestic business contexts, including time zone coordination and cross-cultural business practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead negotiations on high-value or high-risk contracts.
  • Ability to work independently and cohesively with teams.
  • Prior experience as a U.S. Government contracting officer or in a similar military/government contracting role.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with ability to build relationships within GE Aerospace.
  • Ability to manage projects/assignments within tight deadlines
  • Continuous Improvement: Advocate for Flight Deck fundamentals and a lean mindset, leveraging digital tools and rigorous contracting practices to improve efficiency, quality of execution, and internal/external customer satisfaction.

The base pay range for this position is $131,000 - $145,000. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a percentage of your base salary/ commission based on the plan. This posting is expected to close on September 4th, 2026.

GE Aerospace offers comprehensive benefits and programs to support your health and, along with programs like HealthAhead, your physical, emotional, financial and social wellbeing. Healthcare benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; access to a Health Coach from GE Aerospace; and the Employee Assistance Program, which provides 24/7 confidential assessment, counseling and referral services. Retirement benefits include the GE Aerospace Retirement Savings Plan, a 401(k) savings plan with company matching contributions and company retirement contributions, as well as access to Fidelity resources and planning consultants. Other benefits include tuition assistance, adoption assistance, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and paid time-off for vacation or illness.

SAP HANA Solutions Architect – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: SAP HANA Solutions Architect
Location: 100% Remote (United States)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $175,000–$200,000 Annually
Experience: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP HANA Modeling and Performance Engineer to design, build, and optimize HANA-native data models and analytical objects supporting S/4HANA, BW/4HANA, and standalone HANA platforms. In this role you will translate complex business and analytics requirements into performant HANA models, and you will be the go-to expert for diagnosing and resolving HANA performance issues across the SAP landscape. The ideal candidate will combine deep expertise in HANA-native modeling — including calculation views, CDS views, AMDPs, and SQLScript — with strong performance-tuning skills and a clear understanding of HANA internals.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of SAP HANA development experience.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with calculation views, CDS views, AMDPs, and SQLScript.
  • Solid understanding of HANA architecture, including in-memory storage, columnar processing, and parallel execution.
  • Hands-on experience with HANA performance tuning tools and methodologies.
  • Experience with HANA replication tools (SLT, SDI, SDA).
  • Working knowledge of HANA security models, including analytic privileges and roles.
