Job Post: Healthcare Billing Specialist (ASC Billing)

Position Code: GJ-MHS

Position Type: Full-Time (40 hours per week)

Work Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM PDT

Work Days: Monday to Friday

Salary: Starting at $6 - 7 per hour (depending on experience)

We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Healthcare Billing Specialist specializing in Ambulatory Surgery Center (ASC) billing to support accurate claims processing, efficient revenue cycle management, and timely reimbursement for U.S. healthcare providers.

In this role, you will primarily handle ASC medical billing, including surgical claims submission, insurance verification, payer follow-ups, denial management, appeals, and accounts receivable. You will ensure claims are accurately processed according to ASC-specific billing requirements, coding guidelines, and payer policies.

The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience with ASC billing workflows, outpatient surgical procedures, CPT/HCPCS codes, modifiers, and reimbursement processes. Experience with home health billing, Notices of Admission (NOAs), and ALORA software is an added advantage.

Beyond billing responsibilities, you will also provide administrative, executive, and patient communication support to help maintain efficient daily operations.

If you are a proactive medical billing professional who enjoys resolving complex claims, improving reimbursement outcomes, and supporting healthcare providers, we'd love to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

ASC Billing & Revenue Cycle Management (Top Priority)

  • Manage full-cycle Ambulatory Surgery Center (ASC) billing, including claims preparation, submission, tracking, follow-ups, denials, appeals, and reimbursement resolution.
  • Prepare, review, and submit claims for outpatient surgical procedures, ensuring accuracy and compliance with payer requirements.
  • Apply knowledge of ASC-specific CPT/HCPCS codes, modifiers, and billing guidelines to identify potential claim errors.
  • Verify that surgical claims include accurate procedure information, appropriate modifiers, and required supporting documentation.
  • Navigate Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance billing requirements applicable to ASC services.
  • Review payer-specific reimbursement guidelines, including applicable ASC payment methodologies.
  • Investigate rejected, denied, underpaid, or unpaid surgical claims and determine appropriate corrective actions.
  • Process corrected claims, reconsiderations, and appeals to resolve reimbursement discrepancies.
  • Manage accounts receivable (AR) and follow up on outstanding ASC claims.
  • Identify coding-related discrepancies, missing documentation, and potential reimbursement issues.
  • Verify patient insurance eligibility, coverage, and benefits before claim submission when needed.
  • Coordinate with insurance representatives and internal teams to resolve billing concerns.
  • Ensure claims are accurate, complete, and compliant with applicable payer requirements.
  • Meet the daily productivity target of 45 claim follow-ups per day.
  • Upload, track, organize, and maintain Explanation of Benefits (EOBs).
  • Maintain accurate records of submitted, pending, denied, corrected, and resolved claims.

Home Health Billing Support

  • Assist with home health agency billing and revenue cycle management as needed.
  • Review and process Notices of Admission (NOAs) for accuracy, completeness, and timely submission.
  • Support home health claims submission, insurance follow-ups, and denial resolution.
  • Utilize ALORA for billing, documentation, and claim tracking when applicable.
  • Ensure home health billing activities follow applicable payer requirements.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and records of home health billing activities.

Administrative & Executive Support

  • Prepare and maintain billing reports, spreadsheets, claims trackers, and documentation.
  • Assist with administrative overflow and other operational responsibilities.
  • Provide executive and administrative support to ensure smooth daily operations.
  • Maintain organized records and communicate outstanding tasks or concerns promptly.
  • Support workflow improvements to increase billing efficiency and accuracy.

Patient Communication & Reception Support

  • Answer and manage inbound and outbound calls using Nextiva VoIP.
  • Respond to patient inquiries professionally, accurately, and promptly.
  • Provide receptionist-level support when needed.
  • Communicate with patients, insurance representatives, and internal staff regarding billing-related inquiries.
  • Maintain patient confidentiality and provide professional, empathetic communication.

Top 3 Priorities

1. Accurate ASC Claims Processing & Submission

Ensure outpatient surgical claims are prepared and submitted accurately using appropriate CPT/HCPCS codes, modifiers, supporting documentation, and payer-specific billing requirements.

2. ASC Denial Management, Accounts Receivable & Reimbursement

Proactively manage outstanding surgical claims, denials, rejections, underpayments, and appeals. Conduct consistent payer follow-ups while meeting the daily target of 45 claim follow-ups to support timely reimbursement.

3. Billing Compliance, Documentation & Operational Support

Maintain accurate billing records, follow ASC-specific payer requirements, identify documentation discrepancies, and support administrative operations while ensuring HIPAA compliance.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Healthcare Billing Specialist consistently demonstrates:

  • Accurate and timely ASC claims submission.
  • Strong knowledge of outpatient surgical billing requirements.
  • Effective resolution of denied, rejected, and underpaid ASC claims.
  • Consistent management of accounts receivable and outstanding reimbursements.
  • Achievement of the daily KPI of 45 claim follow-ups.
  • Accurate application of relevant CPT/HCPCS codes, modifiers, and payer requirements.
  • Organized and complete EOB documentation and claims tracking.
  • Proactive identification of billing errors and reimbursement discrepancies.
  • Reliable administrative support and professional patient communication.
  • Consistent compliance with HIPAA and healthcare billing policies.

Tools & Platforms

Experience with the following is preferred:

Billing, EHR & Practice Management Systems

  • ALORA
  • eClinicalWorks (eCW)
  • AdvancedMD
  • DrChrono
  • WebPT
  • Fair Bill
  • Elation
  • TheraBill

Communication Tools

  • Nextiva VoIP

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

  • Proven hands-on experience in U.S. Ambulatory Surgery Center (ASC) billing.
  • Strong understanding of ASC billing workflows, outpatient surgical claims, and revenue cycle management.
  • Experience preparing, submitting, tracking, and following up on ASC claims.
  • Working knowledge of CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10, and ASC-related modifiers.
  • Familiarity with Medicare and commercial insurance billing requirements for outpatient surgical procedures.
  • Experience managing denied, rejected, underpaid, and unpaid medical claims.
  • Hands-on experience with accounts receivable, insurance follow-ups, claim corrections, and appeals.
  • Ability to identify billing discrepancies, coding-related errors, missing documentation, and reimbursement issues.
  • Experience verifying insurance eligibility, coverage, and benefits.
  • Familiarity with EOBs, payment discrepancies, and claims tracking.
  • Ability to maintain accurate records and meet daily productivity targets.
  • Strong understanding of payer-specific billing requirements and reimbursement guidelines.
  • Excellent attention to detail, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and adapt to changing workflows.
  • Knowledge of HIPAA compliance and patient confidentiality requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting multiple Ambulatory Surgery Centers or outpatient surgical specialties.
  • Familiarity with ASC Medicare payment methodologies and commercial payer reimbursement processes.
  • Experience resolving complex ASC denials, underpayments, and coding-related reimbursement discrepancies.
  • Knowledge of surgical procedure coding and applicable modifiers.
  • Experience with home health agency billing and NOA review and processing.
  • Familiarity with ALORA or other home health billing platforms.
  • Experience using eClinicalWorks, AdvancedMD, DrChrono, WebPT, Fair Bill, Elation, or TheraBill.
  • Experience using Nextiva or similar VoIP systems.
  • Previous experience supporting U.S.-based healthcare billing organizations remotely.
  • Experience providing administrative, executive, or patient reception support.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We're looking for someone who is:

  • Experienced in ASC Billing: Has practical knowledge of outpatient surgical claims, payer requirements, and reimbursement workflows.
  • Detail-Oriented: Carefully reviews claims, codes, modifiers, and documentation for accuracy.
  • Proactive: Identifies billing discrepancies, denials, and reimbursement issues before they escalate.
  • Analytical: Can investigate complex claims and determine appropriate resolutions.
  • Organized: Effectively manages outstanding claims, follow-ups, and deadlines.
  • Productive: Consistently meets billing follow-up targets without compromising accuracy.
  • Adaptable: Comfortable handling additional home health billing or administrative responsibilities when needed.
  • Reliable: Takes ownership of assigned tasks and communicates progress transparently.
  • Patient-Focused: Maintains professional and empathetic communication with patients and healthcare teams.
  • Compliance-Conscious: Prioritizes HIPAA, payer requirements, and accurate billing practices.

Basic Requirements

  • Must be proficient in speaking and writing clear, professional English.
  • Must have relevant hands-on experience in U.S. medical billing, particularly ASC billing.
  • Must be able to submit an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).
  • Must be available for video meetings with camera on when required.
  • Must be available to work full-time, Monday through Friday, from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time.

Technical Requirements

  • Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
  • Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

This individual-contributor role has no direct reports and works under general supervision. The role evaluates operational needs and exercises independent judgment in selecting technical approaches, establishing workflow controls, and resolving complex process and integration issues within approved platforms, policies, and budgets.

Objective:

Advise marketing leadership and business owners on automation opportunities that improve operating efficiency, data quality, and decision-making. Analyze needs, define requirements, compare alternatives, and recommend priorities based on business impact, cost, feasibility, and risk. The role owns solution design and delivery for workflows used across teams, including content operations, reputation management, campaign tracking, reporting, and internal processes. Marketing leadership retains strategy, budget approval, and final business-priority decisions; the manager determines how approved objectives are achieved without step-by-step direction.

Responsibilities/Essential Functions:

•Evaluates cross-functional processes, identifies root causes of inefficiency, and recommends whether to redesign, automate, retain, or discontinue a workflow based on operational impact, risk, and cost.

•Defines business and technical requirements with stakeholders; independently selects workflow architecture, data structures, integration methods, and tools within approved platforms and budgets. Recommends new platforms or expenditures with documented trade-offs for approval.

•Analyzes reputation-management needs and designs review-intake, categorization, escalation, response-approval, and follow-up systems; recommends controls that improve responsiveness while preserving compliant human decision-making.

•Evaluates and redesigns internal processes such as print-material requests, purchasing approvals, fulfillment handoffs, task routing, and recurring reporting; determines automation logic and exception controls within established business policies.

•Advises campaign and partnership owners on scalable execution and measurement approaches; designs ownership, handoff, tracking, and reporting frameworks for approved marketing initiatives without assuming ownership of marketing strategy.

•Determines alert logic and investigation criteria for ranking changes, lead trends, reputation issues, and system failures; evaluates false positives and business impact and recommends corrective priorities to the responsible business owners.

•Designs and implements integrations among CRM, call-tracking, content, reporting, and project-management systems; establishes field mappings, data-validation rules, location identifiers, campaign tags, and reconciliation controls.

jobs.description:
About Vote Mama

Vote Mama builds the political power of moms.

Vote Mama Foundation, a 501(c)(3) organization, is the leading source of research and analysis on the political participation of moms. We are normalizing moms running for office and building a political system that is truly family-friendly.

Vote Mama Lobby, a 501(c)(4) organization, advocates to break the structural barriers moms face running for and serving in elected office, and mobilizes fed-up mamas to build their political power, elect moms, and pass truly family-friendly legislation.

Vote Mama PAC is the first PAC in the country dedicated to supporting Democratic moms. Through endorsements and financial support, we elect moms up and down the ballot and across the country.

About the Role

The Vice President of Development joins Vote Mama at an exciting moment in the organization’s history. Since its inception seven years ago, Vote Mama has grown revenue annually and built a strong base of early supporters. We now recognize the need to diversify and expand our funding base to sustain and fuel future growth.

Vote Mama seeks a seasoned, strategic, mission-driven political fundraiser to lead and expand on a strong foundation laid by the existing Development team, overseeing a comprehensive fundraising strategy for Vote Mama PAC, Vote Mama Foundation (501(c)(3)), and Vote Mama Lobby (501(c)(4)). As part of their role, the VP of Development will be responsible for creating and executing a multi-million-dollar political finance plan as well as fundraising plans for the Foundation and Lobby, leading revenue generation across all three entities. The role combines executive-level strategy with hands-on fundraising leadership: the VP will personally cultivate, solicit, and steward a significant portfolio of high-net-worth (HNW) and political donors while overseeing the systems, team, partnerships, and pipeline necessary for sustained organizational growth. The VP of Development reports to the Chief Operating Officer and works closely with the CEO, staff, and Vote Mama’s Board of Directors to meet the organization's fundraising goals. The VP is also charged with managing the Senior Director of the Mamas Network and the Development Operations Director, who are responsible for day-to-day management of revenue streams, including the institutional portfolio, the Mama Fund, events, and other donor engagement programs. Additionally, the role collaborates with programmatic, communications, and events team members to ensure seamless integration of fundraising priorities across organizational goals and objectives.

This role is responsible for designing and executing high-impact political fundraising strategies, with a particular focus on acquiring, cultivating, and stewarding HNW individual and political donors and overseeing the continued expansion of revenue across multiple channels (individual, institutional, corporate, and mission-aligned donors). We’re seeking someone who thrives in high-visibility, high-stakes environments, brings deep knowledge of the political fundraising landscape, has extensive experience as a finance director on federal or statewide campaigns, has worked in a senior fundraising role with a PAC or organization, has led high-impact teams, and is excited to lead the charge in diversifying and growing Vote Mama’s donor base.

Working at Vote Mama

This is a fully remote role with flexible scheduling. Candidates must have reliable internet access and be available for travel to in-person events as needed (roughly 5-7 trips annually, dependent on your location). We strongly prefer candidates based in New York City, with other key funding bases in the Bay Area and the East Coast generally.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: $150,000–$165,000, commensurate with experience

  • Health Coverage: Employer-funded medical, dental, and vision insurance (75% employer-paid)

  • Flexible Time Off: Unlimited PTO and sick leave, paid federal holidays, and six months of paid family leave

  • Retirement: 401(k) with 3% employer contribution after three months of employment

  • Workplace Culture:

    • Fully remote with employer-provided laptop and home office stipend

    • Summer and winter office shutdowns

    • Early-close Wellness Fridays

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Development Strategy & Execution (25%)

  • Oversee and steward Vote Mama's comprehensive, multi-year fundraising strategy across Vote Mama PAC, Foundation, and Lobby, translating organizational priorities into ambitious but achievable revenue goals.

  • Activate the CEO, COO, and the Board of Directors to pursue fundraising opportunities and priorities, with support from development team members.

  • Design and execute a multi-million-dollar political finance strategy that expands Vote Mama's national donor base and increases the organization's capacity to support moms running for and serving in elected office, fortifying candidate support services and fueling increased candidate contributions.

  • Build upon funding strategies to drive continued impact in Vote Mama’s research and advocacy programs.

  • Scale a fundraising model that is characterized by strategic, long-term, major-gifts-focused relationship development.

  • Oversee an ongoing prospecting strategy to acquire new donors across entities and revenue streams, fueling Vote Mama’s growth.

  • Strategically increase the organization’s fundraising capacities, developing new, high-dollar, long-term donors through deep, meaningful cultivation efforts while maintaining alignment between Vote Mama’s fundraising strategy and organizational priorities.

  • Empower and support the Development Operations Director and Senior Director of the Mamas Network in setting the vision for their portfolios and strategically growing their revenue over time.

Donor Portfolio Management (50%)

  • Personally manage a portfolio of major individual donors and achieve annual fundraising targets, expanding the portfolio of HNW individual donors, with particular focus on national political donors.

  • In partnership with the CEO, cultivate and manage relationships with HNW individual donors to ensure their continued engagement.

  • Oversee overall portfolio management and pipeline-building, ensuring strategic donor prospecting, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship across the development team;

  • Lead the diversification of institutional funding by cultivating and securing new funding prospects while stewarding existing major funders in partnership with the Leadership and Development teams.

  • Lead the growth of the Mama Fund's political giving circles program, executing political fundraising events, and other efforts to build support from grassroots and mid-level donor base, and increase overall donor pipeline in partnership with the Leadership and Development teams.

  • Provide strategic guidance on Vote Mama’s donor communications and materials, including email communications, case for support, proposals, reports, and other materials.

Team Management, Engagement & Development (25%)

  • Supervise the Development team (Senior Director of the Mamas Network and Development Operations Director), providing daily management and guidance to support their continued growth within the organization.

  • Provide intentional mentorship to the Director of Development Operations and the Senior Director of the Mamas Network to help them achieve their goals within the Development team.

  • Conduct performance reviews of direct reports, identifying areas for improvement, and offering constructive feedback and tailored development plans to ensure the ongoing success and advancement of individual skill sets.

  • Participate in and lead team, project, all-staff, and leadership meetings as needed.

  • In partnership with the Development Operations Director, uphold the infrastructure, systems, and processes supporting organizational fundraising, ensuring data integrity, efficiency, and alignment with organizational goals.

  • Guide key workflows and maintain operational excellence in key functions, such as gift processing and acknowledgments, event production, and supporting compliance reporting as needed.

  • Set a high standard for completing administrative tasks and attention to detail, such as organizing files, scheduling meetings, and maintaining documentation, particularly within the Salesforce CRM.

  • Follow organizational standards and ensure timely completion of administrative responsibilities, including managing expenses and timesheets.

  • Seek opportunities for professional growth through training, workshops, networking, and self-directed learning. Contribute to the team's success by continually improving your skills and staying informed about industry trends and best practices.

Who You Are

We are seeking a senior political fundraising executive who combines exceptional relationship-building skills with strategic vision, operational discipline, and a track record of delivering significant revenue growth.

  • Ability to travel as needed for Vote Mama events.

Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)

jobs.title: Interim Senior BI Analyst (All Genders)
jobs.excerpt: Across Europe, fleets are under enormous pressure.
jobs.description:
Across Europe, fleets are under enormous pressure. Fuel costs are rising. Regulatory requirements are tightening. The shift to low-emission vehicles is accelerating. And yet around 70% of European businesses still manage their fleets manually, with spreadsheets, disconnected tools, and processes that were never built for this moment. Shiftmove exists to make this simple.

We are a profitable B2B SaaS company and the fastest-growing fleet management platform in Europe, born from the merger of Avrios and Vimcar, and now serving tens of thousands of corporate customers across Germany, France, Spain, Switzerland, Poland, and beyond. Most recently, we acquired Optimum and Ocean in France, expanding our footprint and doubling down on one of Europe's largest fleet markets. Our AI-powered platform connects real-time vehicle data with intelligent software so that businesses can procure smarter, control costs, stay compliant, and lead the transition to cleaner mobility, all from one place.

About the role:

We are looking for an experienced InterimSenior BI Analyst to join us on an initial three-month contract, with the option to extend for a further three months.

As we integrate two acquired French businesses into our group, we need to bring their data into our standard reporting while transforming how our executive team accesses and uses business intelligence. Our existing Tableau dashboards have evolved over time, and we see an opportunity to make them clearer, more consistent and more actionable.

Reporting to our VP of Operations, Data & BI, you will work closely with the executive team, Head of FP&A, RevOps and Data Engineering. You will take ownership of rebuilding our executive reporting, responding to daily analytical requests and ensuring that acquired-company data is accurately reflected in group-wide reporting.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong technical BI skills with commercial acumen, sound analytical judgement and the confidence to challenge senior stakeholders when the data tells a different story.

What You'll Do

  • Rebuild executive reporting: Audit our existing Tableau dashboards and the underlying business logic. Decide which dashboards to retain, consolidate, redesign or retire, and rebuild the priority dashboards so executives can quickly understand performance and make informed decisions
  • Establish consistent metrics: Document and align metric definitions to ensure that business performance is measured consistently across dashboards, teams and entities
  • Own daily ad hoc reporting: Manage requests through our Jira-based data support queue, prioritising, scoping and delivering analyses on a daily basis. Translate ambiguous requests into clear business questions and identify recurring needs that can be addressed through standard reporting
  • Integrate acquisition data: Partner with Data Engineering as acquired-company data is migrated into Snowflake. Validate and reconcile data against source systems, build and maintain dbt models, and incorporate the data into existing Tableau dashboards so group reporting reflects all entities
  • Deliver commercial insights: Translate executive requirements into meaningful analysis of go-to-market performance, including pipeline, bookings, ARR, retention and churn
  • Partner with Finance: Work closely with the Head of FP&A to reconcile BI reporting with financial figures and establish a consistent view of business performance
  • Present findings and challenge assumptions: Communicate insights directly to the executive team, explain what the data means for the business, and challenge assumptions where the evidence supports a different conclusion
  • Enable a smooth handover: Document dashboards, data models, metric definitions and reporting processes so the permanent BI team can take ownership of the work at the end of the interim period

What You Need to Succeed

  • You bring extensive experience in BI or analytics, including at least three years working at a senior level
  • You have expert-level Tableau dashboard development skills, including experience redesigning dashboards for executive audiences
  • You have strong SQL skills and hands-on experience working with Snowflake
  • You have practical experience with dbt, including building and maintaining data models, tests and documentation
  • You understand go-to-market performance and are fluent in metrics such as pipeline, bookings, ARR, net and gross retention, and churn
  • You have a track record of translating executive requirements into analysis that informs business decisions
  • You have experience integrating acquired, migrated or otherwise disparate data sources into existing reporting environments
  • You are comfortable managing a Jira ticket queue and delivering reporting requests within daily turnaround expectations
  • You communicate exceptionally well in written and spoken English and are confident presenting to C-level stakeholders, including challenging assumptions when the data warrants it
  • You are based in Europe and available to work 35 hours per week for the duration of the contract

Nice to have:

  • French or German language skills
  • Experience in a SaaS or subscription-based business
  • Experience working with Salesforce, HubSpot or NetSuite data models
  • Experience building a semantic layer or self-service analytics capabilities for executive stakeholders
  • Experience reporting to private equity investors or preparing board-level reporting packs

What Success Looks Like

We want you to make a tangible impact from the start

  • By Day 30: Complete an audit of existing dashboards and underlying business logic, with a clear recommendation to retain, consolidate, redesign or retire each dashboard. Take ownership of the Jira queue and establish a reliable daily delivery rhythm
  • By Day 90: Have the priority executive dashboards rebuilt and in use, agree metric definitions with the Head of FP&A, and bring the first acquired-company data into standard group reporting
  • By Day 180 (if extended): Complete the rebuild of all in-scope dashboards, incorporate all migrated acquisition data into standard reporting, convert recurring ad hoc requests into standard reports, and complete the handover to the permanent BI team

Why Shiftmove

Why should you join us? At Shiftmove, you can contribute to an established, product-led company focused on delivering real value to its customers, with meaningful recurring revenue and an ambitious agenda for growth

Senior Director, Assessment Exceptions & Integrity

Operations, Assessment Delivery Operations

Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Type: This is a full-time position


About the Team

College Board’s Operations division is a best-in-class digital assessment delivery and customer engagement function that supports millions of students and thousands of test centers, annually. The Operations team is also leading exciting work to advance customer experience using innovative solutions, products, and technology to enhance the end-to-end delivery of digital assessments and all aspects of customer support. Within Operations, the Assessment Delivery Operations (ADO) team is responsible for the successful execution of digital assessments like the SAT and Advanced Placement examinations, working closely with partners across College Board, the education sector, and beyond to improve testing technologies, customer experience, and outcomes. The Resolve team serves as trusted experts in post-administration issue resolution for SAT and AP assessments, ensuring issues reported by educators and students are resolved efficiently, protecting the integrity of our assessments and the validity of student scores.


About the Opportunity

As Senior Director, Assessment Exceptions & Integrity, you will lead the team that resolves testing irregularities, incidents, and complaints for College Board assessments, protecting the integrity of our assessments and ensuring every student tests on a level playing field. You will set the strategy and operating model for how issues are identified, investigated, and resolved at scale, leading the shift from manual case handling to automated, insight-driven operations. You will directly manage a team of ~10 that owns Resolve’s day-to-day execution, building the habits and infrastructure to turn case trends, operational metrics, and root-cause findings into action. Partnering closely with Deliver, Technology, and Product leaders, you will drive the improvements that prevent issues before test day.


In this role, you will:

Set Resolve Strategy and Performance (40%)

  • Own the performance of post-administration issue resolution for College Board assessments, ensuring incident reports, irregularities, complaints, score holds, and score verifications are resolved accurately and on time
  • Set Resolve’s multi-year strategy for moving from manual case handling to automated, insight-driven operations, and secure the resources to deliver it
  • Design and evolve an operating model that scales with case volume and complexity
  • Partner with ADO leadership to align resolution strategy with pre-admin and test day operations, closing gaps between how issues occur and how they’re resolved
  • Define the KPIs and reporting that drive process improvements and leadership visibility
  • Represent Resolve’s strategy, performance, and risks to senior leaders across Operations, Technology, and Product

Lead Digital and AI-Enabled Transformation (35%)

  • Direct the evolution of Resolve’s systems, data, and workflows to surface actionable insights into test administration anomalies
  • Own the Resolve feature backlog: define outcomes and acceptance criteria, prioritize the features that advance Resolve’s efficiency and capability with Product and Technology partners, and work with engineering teams to deliver.
  • Drive adoption of automation and AI tools that measurably improve processing speed and accuracy
  • Translate case trends and root causes into upstream fixes that prevent issues before test day

Lead and Manage the Resolve Team (25%)

  • Lead a team of 10 that is responsible for post-administration issue resolution for College Board assessments
  • Set vision and priorities for the team, guide them through transformation, track and manage progress to goals, and provide coaching and support to ensure team members meet and exceed goals, remain engaged, and contribute meaningfully to our mission
  • Cultivate an inclusive and high-achieving culture that enables all team members to live out College Board’s Operating Principles effectively
  • Bring proven leadership experience and consistently embody College Board’s Manager Expectations in your work
  • Set standards for quality, speed, and consistency across Resolve’s work
  • Build team data fluency and proficiency so staff use trends and metrics to drive decisions

About You

You have

  • 10+ years of progressive experience leading teams and complex, high-stakes work, preferably in support of a digital platform, user success, or issue management work
  • Experience in product ownership, business analysis, program or project management, or a similar role translating business needs into features and outcomes
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, data science, operations, management (or other relevant field) or equivalent combination of education and experience; advanced degree a plus
  • Demonstrated ability to create a compelling vision and strategy for teams and functions, cultivating winning partnerships with stakeholders, and transforming long-term outcomes by adapting to changing needs and sustaining day-to-day results
  • A strategic and inclusive leadership style: you set clear priorities, build effective team structures, lead teams through change, plan for future needs, and foster a culture of belonging.
  • A proven ability to drive performance and growth: you set high expectations, deliver real-time, evidence-based feedback, and coach team members to take smart risks, stretch their skills, and achieve meaningful impact.
  • Strong command of Salesforce (or comparable CRM/case-management platform) as a system of record for case intake, tracking, and resolution workflows at volume
  • Working proficiency in JIRA (or similar) to manage and prioritize a feature backlog with Product/Technology stakeholders, and SQL proficiency to independently query and validate data for operational and scoring-anomaly investigations
  • Proven experience building or scaling a data-driven culture, using KPIs and dashboards (Tableau or equivalent) to make continuous improvement systemic
  • Comfort communicating strategy and recommendations to senior stakeholders through clear, compelling presentations
  • Experience applying automation or AI to case, customer service, or workflow processes is a plus
  • The ability to travel 4-6 times a year to College Board offices or on behalf of College Board business

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck: we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $104,000–$160,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

The CEO will have overall responsibility for the organization's strategy, P&L, business development, construction operations, real estate development, investment decisions, people leadership, and stakeholder management.

Develop and execute the company's short-, medium-, and long-term corporate strategy.

Lead business expansion across construction, property development, real estate investment, and related businesses.

Identify new markets, development opportunities, strategic partnerships, and investment opportunities.

Establish clear organizational objectives, KPIs, budgets, and performance targets.

Provide strategic recommendations and regular business updates to the Board.

2. P&L & Financial Management

Take full ownership of the company's P&L, cash flow, profitability, and financial performance.

Develop annual budgets, forecasts, capital plans, and investment strategies.

Improve margins, operational efficiency, working capital, and return on invested capital.

Oversee project economics, development feasibility, financing structures, and capital allocation.

Maintain strong relationships with banks, investors, institutional partners, and other financial stakeholders.

Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, to specification, and in compliance with applicable standards.

Establish strong project governance, cost controls, procurement processes, and risk-management frameworks.

Monitor contractor, consultant, supplier, and project-partner performance.

Ensure robust health, safety, quality, environmental, and regulatory standards across operations.

4. Real Estate Development & Investment

Lead the identification, evaluation, acquisition, development, and commercialization of real estate opportunities.

Oversee land acquisition, feasibility studies, master planning, development approvals, construction, sales/leasing, and asset disposition.

Evaluate development pipelines and investment proposals based on market demand, risk, and expected returns.

Build and maintain relationships with landowners, developers, investors, government authorities, brokers, and strategic partners.

Build relationships with major corporate clients, government entities, institutional investors, developers, and strategic partners.

Promote collaboration across construction, development, finance, commercial, legal, sales, and operations functions.

New business and development pipeline

Successful architects help clients understand what they should do — they don’t wait for clients to assign work.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage onboarding and facilitate workshops – Guide new clients through a structured onboarding process to ensure alignment. Partner with consultants to understand each client’s Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy, processes, and systems.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Application Security
jobs.excerpt: Fingerprint empowers enterprises to detect and stop online fraud with the world’s most accurate device intelligence.
jobs.description:
Fingerprint empowers enterprises to detect and stop online fraud with the world’s most accurate device intelligence. We lead our industry with bleeding-edge identification capabilities and work on turning new ideas and discoveries in the fraud detection space into reality. Our customers range from innovative startups to leading enterprise companies, including Plaid, Dropbox, and Booking.com.

Fingerprint is a globally dispersed, 100% remote company. We were named on on the 2026 Forbes Best Startup Employers list and ranked #803 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies.

We have raised $77M and are backed by Craft Ventures (Tesla, Facebook, Airbnb ), Nexus Venture Partners ( Postman, Apollo.io,MinIO, Druva) and Uncorrelated Ventures ( Redis, Rollbar, Gradle).

As Fingerprint scales with large enterprise customers in financial services and fraud prevention, we're investing in application security as a dedicated, first-class discipline. We're looking for a Senior Manager, Application Security to lead that investment, reporting directly to the VP of Engineering. You will personally own and build the AppSec program, and you will also manage a small team of experienced practitioners who run IT operations and compliance.

This is a VP-direct role with high autonomy and high visibility. Enterprise customers regularly ask about Fingerprint's security posture. You'll be the person who owns that answer.


Your Mission

  • Own and build application security — This is the center of gravity of the role. Define the AppSec roadmap, stand up the review and vulnerability management processes, and embed security-by-default practices across the engineering org. You set the standard, you hold it, and you work across teams to make it real
  • Lead a small team of experienced practitioners in IT and compliance — The Lead IT Engineer and Compliance Lead have deep domain expertise and drive their own work. You give them direction, context, prioritization, and air cover, and you ramp on their domains quickly enough to represent them credibly — you don't need to arrive as an IT or GRC expert
  • Be the security voice to customers and leadership — Enterprise customers, prospects, and partners evaluate Fingerprint's security posture. You represent it credibly, own the security questionnaire process, and communicate risk and posture to the VP and leadership team
  • Unify the function over time — Security, IT, and compliance have operated as separate workstreams. As you ramp, bring them under a coherent strategy with shared standards, shared risk language, and a roadmap that scales with the business


What You'll Do

Application Security (primary focus)

  • Define and own Fingerprint's application security roadmap: vulnerability management, threat modeling, and the security review process for new features and architectural changes — and partner with the Compliance Lead, who runs the penetration testing program today, to connect its findings to engineering remediation
  • Personally drive AppSec work in the early phase — triage findings, run security reviews, partner with engineers on remediation — while building the program so it scales beyond you
  • Build security-by-default practices into engineering workflows — secure SDLC, dependency and secrets hygiene, CI-integrated scanning (Snyk or equivalent) — not as a gate, but as a capability every engineering team has
  • Design the program AI-first: a small AppSec team covers the whole org only by leaning on AI-assisted triage and remediation, security review agents in the coding and CI loop, and AI-augmented testing. You set the direction for what that tooling is trusted to do and how its results are validated
  • Own the vendor security assessment process — Fingerprint handles sensitive customer data for major enterprise customers; you ensure third parties meet the bar
  • Define zero-trust security principles and partner with the Cloud Platform Sr. Manager to embed them in infrastructure: network security, IAM standards, security logging and alerting
  • Lead security incident response for application-layer issues and coordinate with Cloud Platform on infrastructure incidents

Leading IT & Compliance

  • Manage the Compliance Lead and the IT team (Lead IT Engineer plus an IT Engineer joining soon). They own their domains day to day — SOC 2 Type 2, policy, auditors, IT operations and tooling for a globally distributed org. You provide direction, prioritization, organizational context, and growth support
  • Make the cross-functional calls: what compliance frameworks are worth pursuing next to support business needs, where IT investment goes, and how work is prioritized across security, IT, and compliance
  • Own the seams between security and the other two functions — access reviews, identity governance, device posture, offboarding rigor, and the link between AppSec controls and compliance evidence — so the security program makes IT and compliance stronger rather than creating parallel work
  • Represent IT health and compliance status to leadership and in enterprise sales cycles alongside your team

Cross-functional Leadership & Communication

  • Proactively communicate security posture, compliance status, and IT health to the VP Engineering — come with recommendations, not status updates
  • Work with Engineering leadership to embed security practices across product teams — not as a compliance checkpoint but as a capability they value
  • Represent Fingerprint's security and compliance posture to enterprise customers, prospects, and auditors


What We're Looking For

Required

  • Application security depth: 7+ years in security with substantial hands-on AppSec experience — you've built or significantly matured an AppSec program, run security reviews and threat modeling, owned vulnerability management (Snyk or equivalent), and worked with penetration testers. You're credible in a room with senior engineers talking about secure design, OWASP, and real-world exploitation
  • Engineering fluency: You can read code, understand modern web/API architectures, and engage with engineers on remediation without needing a translator
  • People leadership: 2+ years managing people — you've led practitioners, including ones with deeper domain expertise than you, and you know how to give direction without micromanaging
  • AI-native operator: You use AI agents daily in your own work and understand how AI-driven security tooling and AI-generated code change the shape of an AppSec program — you'll be building one, not running a 2022 playbook
  • Fast learner across domains: You can grasp a new domain quickly, ask the right questions, and speak to it broadly and credibly within months — this is how you'll ramp on IT and compliance
  • Strategic communicator: You translate security complexity into business language for leadership and customers — risk framing, not technical jargon

Nice to Have

  • IT operations exposure: Identity and access management (Okta or equivalent), endpoint management, or remote workforce IT — helpful, but your IT team brings the operational depth
  • Compliance / GRC exposure: SOC 2, ISO 27001, or GDPR experience — helpful, but your Compliance Lead owns the program day to day
  • Security tooling stack familiarity: Snyk (vulnerability management), Wiz (cloud security posture), Cloudflare (WAF/edge), Okta — these are live in Fingerprint's environment
  • AI-native security tooling: You've run or evaluated AI-assisted code analysis, triage, auto-remediation, or autonomous testing in a real program, and have a view on how it changes what an AppSec team should look like and what it can safely be trusted to block or fix
  • Enterprise security questionnaire experience: You've answered rigorous due diligence questionnaires from financial institution InfoSec teams and know what "good" looks like on both sides of that process
  • Experience in a high-growth SaaS company where security had to keep pace with rapid product and customer growth without becoming a bottleneck


The Unique Shape of This Role

This role is AppSec-first with a management scope that spans IT and compliance. That shape is deliberate. Application security is where we're investing next, and we want someone who can personally build it — not just oversee it. At the same time, IT and compliance are already run by experienced practitioners who don't need a domain expert over them; they need a leader who gives them direction, context, and prioritization.

What this means in practice: you will be hands-on in AppSec and hands-off-but-accountable in IT and compliance. We don't expect you to arrive as an expert in IT operations or GRC. We do expect you to learn those domains quickly — well enough within your first few months to evaluate your team's work, make prioritization calls across all three disciplines, and represent each of them credibly to leadership and customers. The judgment to know when to rely on your team vs. when to drive the decision yourself is what distinguishes the right candidate.

This is a role for someone who is still a strong practitioner in AppSec and has grown into leading people — not for someone who has moved entirely out of technical work, and not for a pure individual contributor who hasn't managed before.


Why This Role?

  • Shape a dedicated AppSec function from its first days, with backing: This is a sponsored, prioritized investment, and you have the mandate and the VP's support to build it your way
  • VP direct line with genuine autonomy: You own the function. You come to the VP with recommendations, not requests for direction
  • A strong team already in place: The Lead IT Engineer and Compliance Lead are capable, experienced practitioners who drive their own domains. You're not building IT or compliance from scratch — you're giving them strategic leadership
  • High customer visibility: Fingerprint serves major enterprise customers in financial services, fraud prevention, and beyond. Security posture is a real differentiator in enterprise sales, and you're the person who owns it
  • Compliance maturity to build on: SOC 2 Type 2 is already achieved. The next horizon — expanded frameworks, deeper enterprise compliance requirements — is yours to shape with your Compliance Lead
  • A function getting dedicated leadership: Security, IT, and compliance have grown up inside a larger infrastructure group. This role exists because Fingerprint is giving them focused, strategic leadership to reach the next level


Compensation & Transparency

At Fingerprint, we believe in pay transparency — it's part of how we operate as a distributed, remote-first team. Salaries are based on function, level, and geographic location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies.

Because this role is open across the United States and can be based anywhere our team members work from, the salary range reflects that geographic breadth: $177k - $240k
Some example salaries for specific locations are below:

NYC: $209k - $240k

Chicago: $177k - $204k

Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including the successful candidate's location, experience, and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Due to regulatory and security reasons, there’s a small number of countries where we cannot have Fingerprint teammates based. Additionally, because Fingerprint is an all-remote company and people can join our workforce from almost any country, we do not sponsor visas. Fingerprint teammates need to be authorized to work from their home location.

We are dedicated to creating an inclusive work environment for everyone. We embrace and celebrate the unique experiences, perspectives and cultural backgrounds that each employee brings to our workplace. Fingerprint strives to foster an environment where our employees feel respected, valued and empowered, and our team members are at the forefront in helping us promote and sustain an inclusive workplace. We highly encourage people from underrepresented groups in tech to apply.

If you are applying as a resident of California, please read our CCPA notice here.

If you are applying as a resident of the EU, please read our GDPR notice here.

**We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Fingerprint recruiting email communications will always come from the @fingerprint.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Fingerprint via other sources should be ignored.

Job Title: Senior Product Manager - PromoMats

Job Location: Boston, MA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Vault PromoMats is the industry-leading platform that life sciences companies rely on to manage the full lifecycle of promotional content, from Medical, Legal, and Regulatory (MLR) review and claims management to digital asset management and multichannel content distribution. We are looking for an experienced product manager to own and grow core PromoMats capabilities that make our customers' marketing, commercial, and medical affairs teams more efficient and productive.

In this role, you will own the product strategy and roadmap for key PromoMats capabilities, such as claims management, MLR review workflows, and digital asset management. You will work closely with Engineering, UX, and customers to identify high-impact problems, define requirements, and ship solutions that balance ease of use with the rigor demanded by a highly regulated industry.

What You'll Do

    • AI & Product Strategy: Own the vision, strategy, and multi-release roadmap for your area of PromoMats, including where AI capabilities fit, balancing customer demand, market trends, and the realities of design and engineering
    • Customer Discovery: Engage directly with brand, marketing operations, medical, and regulatory teams at life sciences companies to understand how they create, review, and distribute content, and translate those insights into prioritized product requirements
    • Measurement & Impact: Define and track the metrics that prove customer value, reduction in MLR review cycles, time to approval, claims auto-link rates, and feature adoption, and use them to guide the next set of investments
    • Feature Definition & Delivery: Write clear specifications and partner with Engineering, UX, and QA through design, build, and release to ship capabilities that meet the scalability and quality standards of the Veeva Vault platform
    • Compliance & Automation: Deliver capabilities that reduce manual effort across the content lifecycle, automated claims linking, reference substantiation, workflow configuration, content reuse, and AI-assisted content checks, while preserving the auditability regulated customers require
    • Cross-Product & Go-to-Market Alignment: Partner with product teams across Vault to deliver connected experiences, and enable Sales, Services, and Support with the positioning, demos, and documentation needed to bring releases to market

Requirements

    • 5+ years of enterprise software product management, engineering, or consulting experience
    • 2+ years of hands-on focus on AI/ML applications, specifically LLMs and Generative AI
    • Technical Proficiency: Strong coding skills in Python and experience with AI Frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex) and APIs
    • Architectural Knowledge: Deep understanding of data flow design, prompt engineering, and model fine-tuning for highly regulated content
    • Communication: Ability to translate complex AI concepts into business value for non-technical stakeholders in Marketing, Legal, Medical, and Regulatory departments
    • Collaboration: Proven track record of working with UX and Engineering to build intuitive tools for complex workflows
    • Marketing Acumen: Experience in Marketing or Marketing Operations, or building products for marketing teams, with a working understanding of how brand strategy, campaign planning, and content production come together
    • Marketing Process Fluency: Familiarity with the methodologies brand teams run on, creative and campaign briefs, agency and studio workflows, brand guidelines and governance, modular content and content supply chain models, omnichannel planning, and launch readiness

Nice to Have

    • Domain Expertise: Direct experience with Veeva Vault PromoMats or Vault Medical
    • Life Sciences Experience: Familiarity with MLR review processes, 2253 submissions, or Medical Information (MedInfo) workflows
    • Data Background: Experience as a data scientist, machine learning, or data engineering role
    • Brand & Launch Experience: Hands-on involvement in brand strategy, brand or product launch planning, or global campaign rollout, including the content, claims, and approval cycles that support a launch
    • Marketing Technology: Working knowledge of the martech stack brand teams use alongside PromoMats, DAM and content platforms (e.g., Adobe Experience Manager, Aprimo, Sitecore), marketing work management (e.g., Adobe Workfront, Asana, Monday), marketing automation and CRM (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Marketo, Veeva CRM, Vault CRM), and campaign analytics tools

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
    • Retirement programs
    • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

    • Base pay: $120,000 - $200,000
    • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at .

Modern business has become the Tower of Babel: every industry has its own language. If you speak your client's language, you connect and find a way in. And if you don’t, you’re flying blind with a surface-level understanding. Companies spend millions on dull, slow, and unscalable solutions. The traditional go-tos – SMEs, in-house content, and live training – aren’t working.

We created a new way to learn an industry in under an hour (imagine the “I know kung fu” scene from The Matrix, but for business), using fun animated stories produced like a media product. Our primers are widely used by the world's top consulting and technology firms, with 90%+ completion rates, rave reviews, and hundreds of deals won and projects delivered.

Primerli is scaling fast, which means every process we have is up for a rethink. We are on a transformation journey to AI-native ways of working, which makes this a genuinely exciting time to join. If you're curious, resourceful, and ready to roll up your sleeves and make things happen, this role is for you.

This role works with every team in the business. You will report to the Head of Operations and support Sales, Customer Success, and Product.

Your first job is to keep the engine running: product delivery, client onboarding, data reporting, and admin processes. But there’s more to it - you’ll reinvent how we get work done alongside AI agents, and write the playbook for how Primerli operates. And when strategic problems pop up, you’ll help us crack them.

Primerli is a bootstrapped, early stage start-up that created the first and only engaging way to learn an industry in under an hour. We serve over 2 million professionals at global enterprises including MBB, Big Four, Google, and Microsoft. Get a feel for it yourself – check out our sample videos on YouTube:.

If you’re looking to make a meaningful impact and grow alongside the company, this is the kind of role where that can happen.

jobs.description:
The DIRECTV IT team builds experiences that efficiently offer our products to prospects, delight our customers, and create a connected omnichannel experience. Within this, the Existing Customer Lifecycle value stream builds experiences that enable customers to get the most from their DIRECTV service and empowers our front-line team members who help them with intelligent technology. Our scope includes customer-facing self-service capabilities on DIRECTV.com, our IVR (interactive voice response), and applications for our field technicians and customer care phone agents.

We are seeking an expert and highly motivated IT Software Engineer Principal 2 to join our technology team. This pivotal role is responsible for driving the technical design, implementation, and reliability of our next-generation Customer Experience (CX) orchestration platforms, centered on AWS, Genesys Cloud, and Salesforce Service Cloud. The successful candidate will be a deep technical expert, leading the adoption of cloud-native development practices (AWS), advanced automation (Terraform, CI/CD), conversational AI, advanced routing (Genesys Cloud), and critical integrations with platforms like Salesforce Service Cloud. You will act as a senior technical leader, guiding global, cross-functional teams in an agile environment to ensure our mission-critical CX systems are scalable, secure, and highly performant.

Here's what you'll do:

  • Guide development and modernization of critical customer and agent facing applications.
  • Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for designing, deploying, and managing core CX applications and infrastructure leveraging cloud services (AWS, Azure etc.) for contact center domain.
  • Lead development of data pathways between internal and external systems, especially with integration to CRM, AI Platforms, and APIs.
  • Govern all aspects of the application design including providing input on application architecture, modern technologies and development techniques, and patterns to create sustainable technology.
  • Ensure security and compliance for the data and services stored and passed by these systems.
  • Lead the development of new technologies based on best practices and a coaching mindset for more junior team members.
  • Govern vendor teams to develop to our desired technical vision, minimizing technical debt and ensuring productive, predictable output from our partners.
  • Serve as the domain technical expert, representing system capabilities to business and technology teams alike, understanding desired business outcomes, and guiding the solution to the most effective implementation; be comfortable communicating progress, roadblocks, and opportunities to all levels in the organization.
  • Participate in cross-functional teams to define and hone technical best-practices; evangelize these and support change across teams where needed.
  • Participate in defining and developing DevOPS best practices, including Production Support and deployment process, and additionally help troubleshoot critical production issues.
  • A strong communicator, able to effectively synthesize key points of a topic and turn them into a persuasive conversation, presentation, or email.

Here's what you'll need to be successful:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 5 – 7 years required, 8+ years desired of progressive experience in software development and architecture, with at least 4 years focused on high-scale Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS), CX enterprise software or Field Services enterprise software.
  • Expert-level, hands-on experience with Salesforce Platforms, APIs and custom solutions development. Experience with Agent force and prompt engineering.
  • Deep expertise in AWS services (e.g., Lambda, EC2, SQS, Kinesis) and proven production experience using Terraform for infrastructure provisioning.
  • Demonstrated success designing and maintaining sophisticated CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI) for cloud-native or CCaaS application deployments.
  • Extensive experience designing and building reliable integrations with major CRMs, specifically Salesforce Service Cloud.
  • Experience working with REST and SOAP based web-services preferred.
  • Experience with Postman, SOAPUI, Mockito preferred.
  • Proven ability to operate as a senior technical lead, driving technical consensus and solution delivery across global teams leveraging agile frameworks such as SAFe.
  • Strong understanding of security best practices, compliance standards (e.g., PCI, SOC 2), and performance optimization within a cloud-based CX platform.
  • Exceptional communication and documentation skills for translating complex technical decisions to both engineering and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • AWS Certification (e.g., Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer Professional).
  • Certification or advanced training specific to Genesys Cloud development/administration.
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with advanced predictive modeling or machine learning applications in a real-time routing context.

May require a background check due to job duties requiring routine access to DIRECTV and DIRECTV customer’s proprietary data. Qualified applicants with arrest and conviction will be considered for employment in accordance with local ordinances and state law.

This is a remote position that can be located anywhere in the United States, with the exception of Alaska.

Job Description:

This position drives the overall product strategy and execution, ensuring alignment with business goals and effective communication across teams. The Principal Product Manager owns the full product lifecycle for a specific product, from ideation to market launch and continuous optimization. This role plays a pivotal part in defining the product strategy, ensuring that it aligns with the company’s long-term goals, and works closely with cross-functional teams to execute the roadmap.


Job Function & Responsibilities:

Customer and Market-Driven Strategy

  • Lead customer and market research efforts to inform product strategy, ensuring customer pain points and market trends drive decision-making while optimizing product profitability and return on investment.

Stakeholder Alignment and Influence

  • Influence product decisions by aligning engineering, marketing, and leadership teams, ensuring strategic cohesion across all functions. Shape internal and external messaging to ensure product initiatives align with business objectives and customer needs.

Problem Solving/Autonomy

  • Tackle ambiguous, large-scale problems and drive resolution with minimal oversight.

Data-Driven Decision Making

  • Make high-level decisions based on data, balancing customer insights with business needs and performance metrics to guide product direction.

Domain Knowledge

  • Have a deep, nuanced understanding of the product and market landscape.

Leadership and Team Management

  • Lead the full matrixed team for your product, making key decisions, guiding team efforts, and driving product direction. Mentor junior team members.

Strategic Thinking and Vision

  • Own the tactical execution of the product strategy for your product, ensuring alignment with company objectives. Guide and make high-level decisions that shape the product’s future.
  • Provide leadership in creating cross-product innovation for a mid-term time horizon. Identify and define innovation opportunities that are not covered within a single product line.
  • Ensure Vertex competitiveness by creating continuous evolution of solutions derived from a tax-centric, market-driven perspective to identify opportunities not yet covered by existing individual solutions. Leverage tax technology, tax lifecycle, and tax process know-how to identify opportunities for automation and innovation that are currently not covered.
  • Identify opportunities for end-to-end solutions by integration and/or APIs between solutions and recommend harmonizing and standardizing roadmaps.
  • Participate as a trusted advisor to the suite owner to assist in the definition of individual solutions and their evolution.
  • Enable and advance Vertex innovation capability and speed by leveraging and exposing industry knowledge and experience.
  • Interface/Team across functional areas such as Strategy and Emerging Technology to create long-term product vision and concepts.
  • Participate in setting the mid-term strategic and product direction for Vertex.
  • Maintain frequent contact with customers, partners, and other market participants to identify pain points and derive innovation ideas.
  • Present and represent Vertex in conferences to showcase Vertex thought leadership.
  • Routinely attend trade shows and maintain excellent awareness and fluency in competitor offerings, driving differentiated product offerings and enabling sales and marketing differentiation in offerings.
  • Create and maintain mechanisms for receiving and tracking input on requirements from prospects, customers, internal staff, partners, trade shows, and industry analysts.
  • Occasional travel required.

Skills:

  • Understanding of “jobs to be done” in the global transaction tax space.
  • Must have excellent business acumen and knowledge of core, emerging, and competitive markets in the tax technology space.
  • Ability to articulate and translate business problems into solutions in a cloud environment.
  • Generally understand the impact of ecosystems and how to build solutions for and to integrate with them.
  • Excellent presentation skills with the ability to make presentations to top management.
  • Proven ability to work in a matrixed environment and lead by influence.
  • Proven ability to stay on task, overcome obstacles, meet deadlines and milestones, and deliver work by agreed-upon dates.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive results virtually with distributed global teams.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Engineering, or related field preferred.
  • Minimum of twelve (10) plus years of product management experience.
  • Previous experience with SaaS, Cloud solutions.
  • Successful track record of developing go-to marketing programs with measurable results.

COMMENTS:

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals in this position. Other functions may be assigned, and management retains the right to add or change the duties at any time.



Vertex Values: Together We Win


We're building a team of people who are passionate about making an impact for our customers and committed to how that impact is achieved. Our values define the behaviors, mindset, and culture that make Vertex a great place to grow and do meaningful work.


Play to Win or We Don't Play — If we choose to do something, we're choosing to do it because we plan to win. That mindset raises our bar on product quality, customer outcomes, and how we show up for one another.


Work As a Team, Putting the Customer At the Core — Our customers are our true north. Whatever your role, ask: how will this help a customer succeed today? We earn trust through outcomes, not promises.


Achieve Excellence With Integrity, Speed, and Agility — The market isn't slowing down. We'll move faster, adapt quickly, and never compromise on doing things the right way — for teammates, customers, and partners.


Innovate Boldly With a Growth Mindset — Progress demands smart risk. We'll try new approaches, learn fast, and keep pushing the boundaries — especially where AI can remove friction and unlock value.


Communicate with Care, Candor and Transparency — Honest, constructive conversations make us better. Let's speak plainly about what's working and what isn't and help each other improve.

Base pay offered to new hires may vary based upon factors including relevant industry and job-related skills and experience, geographic location, and business needs.* The range displayed does not encompass the full potential of the role, which allows for further growth and career progression.

In addition, as a part of our total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Vertex Bonus Plan (VOB), a role-specific sales commission/bonus, and/or equity grants.

jobs.description:
