We strive to generate value through providing specialist advice and making recommendations to optimize decision making, delivering transparent processes and implementing governance and controls to mitigate risk.

The Finance team’s goal is to be a trusted and collaborative partner to all the businesses and functional teams that we work with, bringing business acumen, financial expertise, and insights to aid decision-making and deliver value to our stakeholders. We strive to generate value through providing specialist advice and recommendations that optimize decision-making, delivering transparent processes, and implementing governance and controls that support growth and mitigate risk.

Let's talk about the team and you:

As part of the Global Revenue FP&A organization, this role sits at the center of Resmed’s commercial planning and performance management processes. Reporting directly to the Senior Director of FP&A, you will partner across our various business portfolios to support planning, forecasting, performance management, and executive decision-making.

This is a highly visible role that combines financial planning, business partnership, process improvement, and strategic analysis. You will work closely with regional FP&A leaders and Revenue stakeholders to build scalable planning processes, improve reporting and insights, and help drive better business outcomes globally.

Success in this role requires a self-starter who can create structure where it doesn't exist, proactively identify opportunities for improvement, and independently drive initiatives forward. The ideal candidate is comfortable working through ambiguity, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and influencing stakeholders across multiple functions and regions.

Let's talk about Responsibilities:

  • Own portfolio-level planning, forecasting, consolidation, and performance analysis across the Americas, EMEA, APAC, and SaaS businesses in close partnership with regional FP&A leaders

  • Partner with Revenue leaders to understand business drivers, challenge assumptions, and translate operational performance into actionable financial insights

  • Support the preparation of executive-level reporting, operational reviews, and business performance presentations for senior leadership

  • Design and implement scalable planning, reporting, and performance management processes that improve visibility, consistency, and decision-making across the organization

  • Develop reporting frameworks, KPIs, and performance metrics to help monitor business performance and identify opportunities for improvement

  • Support and enhance the global Commercial Management Review process as part of the Integrated Business Planning (IBP) framework, driving process improvements and helping improve forecast accuracy and cross-functional alignment

  • Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, and improve existing processes to accelerate time-to-insight and reduce manual effort

  • Lead ad hoc financial analysis, business cases, and strategic projects in support of Revenue and Finance leadership

  • Build strong partnerships across Finance, Commercial, Operations, and other functional teams to drive alignment and continuous improvement

Let's talk about Preferred Qualifications and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Mathematics, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline

  • 5-8 years of progressive FP&A experience with demonstrated growth in planning, forecasting, business partnership, and financial modeling responsibilities

  • Deep experience in FP&A, including forecasting, budgeting, long-range planning, financial modeling, and business performance analysis

  • Strong analytical and financial modeling skills with the ability to transform complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations

  • Experience building reporting frameworks, dashboards, KPIs, and management reporting processes

  • Proven ability to identify process improvement opportunities and successfully drive change across cross-functional teams

  • Strong business partnership and communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at multiple levels of the organization

  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment with ambiguity, competing priorities, and evolving business needs

  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling capabilities required; experience with planning and reporting tools such as Anaplan, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms preferred

  • Experience supporting Revenue, Commercial, or other growth-oriented business models is a plus

This is not a role where success is defined by maintaining existing processes. We are looking for someone who can identify opportunities, build scalable solutions, and help elevate how we plan, forecast, analyze, and communicate business performance globally.

Why join us

At Resmed, you’ll be part of a mission driven company focused on improving health and quality of life. This role offers high visibility, the chance to learn from senior brand leaders, and the opportunity to shape how Resmed shows up across global markets. You’ll grow your skills in brand strategy, cross functional collaboration, and brand governance at scale.

We are shaping the future at Resmed, and we recognize the need to build on and broaden our existing skills and continue to attract and retain the world’s best talent. We work hard to offer holistic benefits packages, provide flexible work arrangements, cultivate a workforce culture that allows employees to grow personally and professionally, and deliver competitive salaries to our team members. Employees scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week are eligible for benefits. This position qualifies for the following benefits package: comprehensive medical, vision, dental, and life, AD&D, short-term and long-term disability insurance, sleep care management, Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), commuter benefits, 401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and tuition assistance. Employees receive Flexible Time Off (FTO), receive 11 paid holidays plus 3 floating days and are eligible for 14 weeks of primary caregiver or two weeks of secondary caregiver leave when welcoming new family members.

Individual pay decisions are based on a variety of factors, such as the candidate’s geographic work location, relevant qualifications, work experience, and skills.

jobs.title: FIU Fraud Data Analyst
jobs.excerpt: The SouthState story is one of steady growth, deep community roots, and an unwavering commitment to helping our customers move forward.
jobs.description:
The SouthState story is one of steady growth, deep community roots, and an unwavering commitment to helping our customers move forward. Since our beginnings in the 1930s to becoming a trusted financial partner across the South and beyond - we are known for combining personal relationships with forward-thinking solutions.

We are committed to helping our team members find their success while maintaining the integrity of our values: building trust, fostering lasting relationships and pursuing excellence. At SouthState, individual contributions are recognized, potential is cultivated and team members are inspired to achieve their greater purpose. Your future begins here!

Summary

The FIU Fraud Data Analyst is responsible for using data, investigative judgment, and fraud analytics to identify, investigate, and mitigate internal and external financial crime risks against the Bank. This role analyzes large and complex datasets, fraud alerts, customer and transaction activity, and emerging fraud trends to support timely risk-based decisions, reduce fraud losses, strengthen controls, and ensure regulatory expectations are met. The position partners with FIU leadership, Fraud Operations, Digital Banking, Treasury Management, Information Technology, Information Security, Compliance, and other business partners to develop actionable insights, improve fraud detection strategies, and support effective reporting and escalation.

It is the policy of SouthState Bank to comply with the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), USA PATRIOT Act, and the requirements of the Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC), and other related anti-money laundering/ anti-terrorist financing initiatives. The Bank has established a Bank Secrecy Act/ Anti-Money Laundering/Office of Foreign Assets Control (BSA/AML/OFAC) Compliance Program, covering all requirements of the BSA, USA PATRIOT Act and OFAC rules and regulations. Upon completion of required training, the Board of Directors of SouthState Bank shall hold each employee accountable for adhering to the established operating procedures and internal controls as set forth in the Bank’s BSA/AML/OFAC Program. Continued instances of non-compliance or willful violation of law may result in disciplinary action, up to and including termination.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Evaluate fraud detection rules, monitoring logic, alert performance, false positives, and data quality issues; recommend enhancements to improve detection effectiveness and operational efficiency

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, recurring reports, trend analyses, and ad hoc data views to identify fraud patterns, emerging typologies, control gaps, and loss exposure

  • Identify emerging fraud trends, attack patterns, mule activity, account takeover indicators, synthetic identity concerns, suspicious online account opening activity, social engineering indicators, and other financial crime risks

  • Query, extract, validate, and analyze large datasets using SQL-based databases, Snowflake, Excel, and other approved analytical tools to support fraud investigations and strategy development

  • Analyze fraud alerts, account activity, customer behavior, transaction patterns, and other data sources to identify unusual, suspicious, or potentially fraudulent activity

  • Research and analyze high-risk transactions across payment channels, including digital banking, Zelle, Bill Pay, Bank-to-Bank transfers, debit card, wires, ACH, checks, and other products as applicable

  • Communicate internal control deficiencies, data limitations, system issues, and fraud vulnerabilities identified during analytical or investigative work

  • Provide analytical support, peer guidance, training, and subject matter expertise to team members as needed

It is the responsibility of this role to take ownership of all tasks and challenges that they encounter in the operation of their assigned position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Qualifications

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Finance, Accounting, Criminal Justice, Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field preferred.

  • Equivalent related experience may be considered.

Minimum Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of fraud, financial crimes, BSA/AML, banking operations, risk management, data analytics, or related experience in a financial institution or similar regulated environment;

  • Experience conducting fraud investigations, analyzing transactional activity, and identifying patterns indicative of fraud or financial crime;

  • Minimum of 2 years’ experience querying, analyzing, and reconciling large datasets using SQL-based databases, Snowflake, Excel, or similar tools;

  • Experience creating management reports, dashboards, trend analyses, or data-supported recommendations;

  • Experience with fraud detection systems, case management systems, digital banking platforms, core banking systems, payment channels, or transaction monitoring tools preferred;

  • Minimum of 2 years experience supporting fraud strategy, rule tuning, control enhancement, alert optimization, or loss mitigation initiatives preferred.

Licenses, Certifications, & Training

  • Working knowledge of SQL, Snowflake, relational databases, data extraction, data validation, and data quality concepts;

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, formulas, data cleaning, and analytical functions;

  • Knowledge of data visualization, dashboarding, or reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms preferred;

  • Familiarity with Python, R, SAS, model monitoring, statistical analysis, or machine learning concepts used in fraud detection preferred but not required;

  • In-depth knowledge of fraud typologies and associated bank fraud schemes, including online account opening, account takeover, social engineering, mule activity, mobile, digital, check, ACH, wire, debit card, and payment fraud;

  • Familiarity with payment types and digital banking products, including Zelle, Bill Payments, Bank-to-Bank payments, ACH, wires, checks, debit cards, and related customer authentication controls;

  • In-depth knowledge of BSA/AML regulations related to suspicious activity monitoring, escalation, and reporting;

  • Strong understanding of bank operations, including navigating banking systems, interpreting teller and customer transactions, and evaluating account relationships;

  • CAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist), CAFP (Certified AML and Fraud Professional), CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner), or data analytics-related certification preferred.

  • New Employee Orientation

  • Required annual compliance training

  • System-specific training as necessary to perform duties

  • FIU/Financial crimes training as assigned by the Chief BSA Officer

Additional Physical Demands

  • Must be able to remain seated or work standing in a confined area on a computer for a minimum of four (4) hours each workday.

  • Must be able to constantly use hands and fingers to enter data through or on a computer or answer a phone throughout most of an eight (8) hour shift.

  • Must be able to hear and communicate with coworkers and customers throughout the day.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Position may require regular before/after normal business hours.

  • Must be able to function in a professional, business office environment and act and dress appropriately for same, consistent with the Bank’s grooming and dress codes.

  • Must demonstrate excellent people skills with customers and coworkers.

  • Must be willing to function as a team member.

  • Must be willing to demonstrate commitment to South State Bank’s mission and goals.

These specifications are general guidelines based on the minimum experience normally considered essential to the satisfactory performance of this position. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required to perform the position in a satisfactory manner. Individual abilities may result in some deviation from these guidelines.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

  • Advanced analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and identify meaningful patterns, anomalies, and trends;

  • Strong investigative judgment and ability to identify fraudulent, unusual, or suspicious activity and determine when escalation is required;

  • Ability to query, analyze, reconcile, and summarize large datasets accurately and efficiently;

  • Ability to translate data findings into clear business recommendations, risk-based actions, and concise executive-level reporting;

  • Strong understanding of fraud typologies, payment risk, customer behavior, account activity, digital banking risk, and internal control concepts;

  • Sound judgment, discretion, and integrity when handling confidential customer, employee, investigative, and bank information;

  • Ability to work independently, prioritize competing deadlines, and make timely decisions in a fast-paced, high-risk environment;

  • Strong attention to detail, data quality, documentation, and audit trail requirements;

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and data visualization or reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms;

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical or analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders;

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with business lines, operations, technology, risk, legal, compliance, and management partners;

  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret applicable Federal and State banking regulations, internal policies, and procedures related to fraud, BSA/AML, OFAC, privacy, and information security.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

Physical Demands

  • Ability to communicate in person, on the phone, and through electronic channels

  • Ability to use a computer on a frequent basis, including typing and sustained attention to a monitor

  • Ability to sit, walk, and/or stand for extended periods of time

  • Ability to bend and reach

Work Environment

  • Office: If the position reports to a physical Company location, the setting will be a typical office environment.

  • Remote or hybrid: For remote or hybrid positions, a secure and distraction-free setting is required, with a reliable internet connection (cable or fiber preferred, mobile hotspots not acceptable). Hybrid positions will report to a physical Company location, as directed by the manager, and that setting will be a typical office environment.

jobs.title: IT Data Engineer IV
jobs.excerpt: The SouthState story is one of steady growth, deep community roots, and an unwavering commitment to helping our customers move forward.
jobs.description:
The SouthState story is one of steady growth, deep community roots, and an unwavering commitment to helping our customers move forward. Since our beginnings in the 1930s to becoming a trusted financial partner across the South and beyond - we are known for combining personal relationships with forward-thinking solutions.

We are committed to helping our team members find their success while maintaining the integrity of our values: building trust, fostering lasting relationships and pursuing excellence. At SouthState, individual contributions are recognized, potential is cultivated and team members are inspired to achieve their greater purpose. Your future begins here!

Summary


The IT Data Engineer IV serves as a senior technical lead for enterprise data engineering, responsible for designing, building, and improving scalable data platforms, Snowflake data solutions, and dbt-based transformation frameworks that support analytics, reporting, and operational decision-making across South State Bank. This role leads complex data engineering efforts, establishes standards for reliable and well-documented pipelines, and partners closely with business departments, data owners, architects, compliance, and technology teams to translate business needs into durable data solutions. The Data Engineer IV also mentors other engineers, drives continuous improvement in data quality and observability, and ensures data solutions align with enterprise architecture, governance, and regulatory expectations.


Duties & Responsibilities

  • Architect, design, and deliver enterprise data platform solutions leveraging Snowflake, dbt, SQL, Python, and modern data integration technologies, ensuring scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable data pipelines and analytical data products.
  • Establish and enforce data engineering standards, best practices, and governance frameworks for code quality, CI/CD, data testing, observability, documentation, metadata management, security, and operational excellence.
  • Partner with business stakeholders, data owners, architects, compliance teams, and technology partners to translate business requirements into data solutions, data models, integration patterns, and implementation roadmaps that deliver measurable business value.
  • Lead the support, monitoring, and continuous improvement of enterprise data platforms by resolving complex production issues, improving performance, enhancing data quality, and ensuring operational reliability.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and strategic direction for the data engineering practice, including architectural reviews, coaching engineers, evaluating emerging technologies, and supporting advanced analytics, AI/ML, and enterprise data initiatives.

It is the responsibility of this role to take ownership of all tasks and challenges that they encounter in the operation of their assigned position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


Qualifications


Education Requirements

  • Minimum: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Preferred: Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or related discipline.

Minimum Experience

  • 8-10+ years of progressive data engineering experience, with at least 3 years in a senior or lead technical capacity.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and optimizing solutions in Snowflake, including SQL development, data modeling, performance tuning, security/access patterns, and production support.
  • 5+ years serving in a senior engineer, technical lead, solution lead, or architecture-influencing capacity.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with dbt, including model development, testing, documentation, macros, environment promotion, and CI/CD integration.
  • 5+ years of experience with SQL and Python for data engineering, automation, transformation, and data quality validation.
  • 3+ years of experience with pipeline orchestration tools.
  • Experience partnering directly with business departments, data owners, reporting teams, architects, compliance, and other technology groups to gather requirements, communicate design decisions, and deliver production data solutions.
  • Experience supporting production data pipelines, troubleshooting data quality issues, conducting root cause analysis, and implementing monitoring or preventive controls.
  • Experience with streaming, lakehouse architecture, metadata management, data observability, or AI/ML data preparation is preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience architecting ML/AI data infrastructure including feature stores, MLOps pipelines, and LLM-based data processing workflows.
  • Prior experience in financial services, banking, or another regulated industry is strongly preferred.

Licenses & Certifications

  • Preferred: Cloud data platform certification such as AWS Certified Data Analytics – Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate, GCP Professional Data Engineer, or Snowflake SnowPro Certifications (Core, Associate, Advanced).
  • Preferred: dbt Certification or equivalent analytics engineering credential.

Additional Physical Demands

  • Ability to sit for extended periods and work extensively on a computer for sustained periods.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities


Data Engineering & Pipeline Orchestration

  • Expert-level ability to design maintainable data pipelines using SQL, Python, Snowflake, dbt, and enterprise orchestration patterns.
  • Strong understanding of production-grade engineering practices, including code reviews, version control, CI/CD, environment promotion, automated testing, documentation, monitoring, and incident response.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex pipeline, transformation, performance, and data quality issues across multiple systems.
  • Advanced command of dbt for analytics engineering: incremental models, snapshots, seeds, macros, tests, and multi-environment deployment strategies.

Cloud & Data Platform Expertise

  • Advanced hands-on experience with Snowflake, including schema design, role-based access patterns, warehouse sizing, query optimization, data sharing concepts, cost/performance tradeoffs, and integration with cloud storage and transformation tools.
  • Strong proficiency with cloud-native data warehouses and lakehouses: Snowflake, AWS Redshift, Azure Synapse Analytics, or GCP BigQuery.
  • Experience with lakehouse storage formats: Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, or Apache Hudi.
  • Working knowledge of modern cloud data architecture patterns across Azure, AWS, or GCP, with preference for experience integrating Snowflake into enterprise data ecosystems
  • Proficiency with containerization and orchestration: Docker and Kubernetes for deploying data workloads.

ML/AI & Advanced Analytics Integration

  • Demonstrated understanding of data engineering patterns that support AI/ML and advanced analytics use cases, including semantic model development, reusable feature data, model-ready datasets, feature store design and management, and scalable analytical data products.
  • Experience integrating AI-enabled workflows into data pipelines and analytics applications, including unstructured data processing, semantic search patterns, embedding-based approaches, and workflow orchestration.
  • Knowledge of MLOps and production analytics practices, including model lifecycle support, workflow automation, environment promotion, monitoring frameworks, governance considerations, performance monitoring, drift awareness, and continuous improvement of data inputs and outputs
  • Familiarity with orchestrating AL agent workflows and tool-calling patterns using frameworks such as MCP or similar technologies.
  • Exposure to vector databases or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines is preferred.

Streaming & Real-Time Data

  • Proficiency with real-time and event-driven data platform concepts, including message streaming, event ingestion, pub/sub patterns, and integration with enterprise data platforms.
  • Experience designing or supporting stream processing patterns for near-real-time transformation, enrichment, aggregation, and delivery of data to downstream consumers.
  • Knowledge of change data capture and incremental data movement patterns used to keep analytical, operational, and reporting data assets current and reliable.

Data Governance & Quality

  • Strong understanding of data quality frameworks, automated data observability and lineage tracking (Atlan, Monte Carlo).
  • Experience with metadata management, data cataloging (Collibra, Alation, or Apache Atlas), and data classification practices in regulated environments.
  • Familiarity with data mesh and data product ownership principles.

Architecture & Leadership

  • Ability to design scalable, cost-optimized data architectures applying medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), data vault, or dimensional modeling patterns.
  • Strong technical communication skills: able to produce architecture decision records (ADRs), design documents, and present complex technical concepts to both technical peers and non-technical business stakeholders.
  • Ability to facilitate requirements gathering and design sessions with business stakeholders and technical teams.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive consensus on enterprise data initiatives.
  • Proven ability to mentor engineers, lead code and design reviews, and drive adoption of engineering best practices across a team.
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical skills; able to organize complex data landscapes and identify actionable insights and improvement opportunities.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to facilitate requirements workshops, present architectural recommendations, document design decisions, communicate project status, and influence stakeholders across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated initiative and ownership in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.

Physical Demands and Work Environment


Physical Demands

  • Ability to communicate in person, on the phone, and through electronic channels
  • Ability to use a computer on a frequent basis, including typing and sustained attention to a monitor
  • Ability to sit, walk, and/or stand for extended periods of time

That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.

Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Position Summary

The Quality Engineer develops and executes test plans, performs exploratory and automated testing, and builds and maintains automated tests for the Evolent Platform web user experience. Working in an Agile, globally dispersed team, this role partners with developers, business analysts, and stakeholders to understand requirements and expected agent behavior, surface quality issues early, and report clearly on quality status.

This individual works with minimal supervision on assigned features, actively learning and adopting the testing methods, automation frameworks, and patterns defined for the role and by the team. The role is expected to use approved AI-assisted tools to accelerate testing and improve quality while remaining fully accountable for every delivered result.

AI-Assisted Engineering Expectations

Evolent engineers are expected to effectively leverage approved AI-assisted development and productivity tools (e.g., code assistants, copilots, automation agents, knowledge assistants, and analytics tools) to improve quality, efficiency, and innovation while maintaining accountability for all delivered work. These expectations span the full engineering lifecycle, not only code generation, including iterating with AI on test design and solution design, evaluating alternatives, and producing design artifacts. Engineers remain responsible for validating outputs, ensuring solution quality, protecting sensitive information, and complying with security, privacy, regulatory, and Responsible AI standards.

Key Responsibilities

Test Planning and Execution

  • Develop, document, and execute test plans and test cases for assigned features.
  • Perform exploratory and automated testing to ensure software functionality, reliability, and performance.
  • Conduct regression testing to ensure new code does not adversely impact existing functionality.
  • Collaborate with development teams to understand requirements, expected agent behavior, and human-in-the-loop flows, and identify potential quality issues early.
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and sprint planning, and contribute to the design and implementation of enhancements to the team’s test systems.

Test Automation and CI/CD

  • Create and maintain Playwright end-to-end tests and Vitest component tests using the team’s established frameworks and patterns.
  • Execute and maintain contract tests and API tests using the team’s established tooling.
  • Test streaming, loading, and error states, including slow and failed agent responses.
  • Execute automated test suites in GitHub Actions, evaluate results, and fix failing scripts to maintain a high pass rate.
  • Create and maintain synthetic test data.
  • Follow and help reinforce the team’s testing processes and automation standards, holding peers accountable constructively and making sure the team understands the risks of exceptions.

Accessibility Testing

  • Run automated axe-core accessibility checks and manual screen reader tests (JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver) against WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA.

Defect Management and Quality Reporting

  • Identify, isolate, document, and track defects, working closely with developers to ensure timely resolution.
  • Analyze test and evaluation results, generate quality metrics, and report on software quality status to the team and stakeholders.
  • Present work in Agile ceremonies, participate in knowledge-sharing sessions, and seek feedback to continuously improve skills.

AI-Enabled Quality Engineering

  • Utilize approved AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate test case design, test script development, test data generation, documentation, and troubleshooting.
  • Evaluate and validate AI-generated tests, scripts, and analysis for correctness, security, maintainability, compliance, and business appropriateness before use.
  • Learn and adopt the prompts, skills, agents, and AI-assisted testing patterns defined by the team and share improvements that benefit the team.
  • Identify opportunities to improve testing productivity and quality through AI-enabled workflows and automation.

Governance and Compliance

  • Follow enterprise policies governing AI usage, intellectual property protection, security, privacy, PHI handling, and Responsible AI practices.
  • Ensure no confidential, regulated, or protected information (including PHI in test data) is used with unapproved AI services or tooling; use synthetic data for testing.
  • Participate in peer reviews and validation processes for AI-assisted solutions.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in software quality assurance or testing, including hands-on UI test automation.
  • Experience with Playwright or similar end-to-end automation tools, preferably using TypeScript or JavaScript.
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript for test automation.
  • Familiarity with component testing frameworks such as Vitest or Jest.
  • Familiarity with API testing tools (e.g., Postman) and REST APIs.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions) and version control systems such as Git.
  • Familiarity with test management and defect tracking tools (e.g., JIRA, ALM).
  • Proficiency in software testing methodologies, including functional, regression, and performance testing.
  • Knowledge of Agile methodologies and experience working in an Agile development environment.
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with a focus on troubleshooting and problem-solving.
  • Excellent communication skills, openness to feedback, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to testing AI or LLM output using test datasets and scoring rubrics.
  • Familiarity with testing React applications and streaming user interfaces.
  • Familiarity with contract testing and basic load testing.
  • Working knowledge of accessibility testing, including axe-core and screen readers (JAWS, NVDA, or VoiceOver).
  • Exposure to AI-assisted testing tools such as GitHub Copilot or Playwright MCP.

• Familiarity with FHIR R4.

  • Experience in healthcare or other regulated environments handling PHI.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

The Director of Service Assurance Platforms will lead the product management, engineering, delivery, operation, and ongoing modernization of the technology platforms supporting the company’s Network Operations Center and service-assurance processes.


The role will serve as the technology owner for ServiceNow Telecommunications Service Management, including associated telecommunications service operations, event management, incident management, major incident management, problem management, customer-impact analysis, service-level management, and service-assurance workflow capabilities.

This Director will lead a multidisciplinary product and engineering organization responsible for designing, developing, integrating, releasing, operating, and supporting the Service Assurance platform. The platform will connect network events and alarms with network inventory, service inventory, customer services, locations, contracts, incidents, SLAs, and customer communications.


The Director will work closely with NOC and Service Assurance business leaders, who remain accountable for day-to-day network operations and incident response. This role is accountable for ensuring that those teams have a reliable, scalable, automated, and service-centric technology platform with which to perform their work.

What You'll Do

Shape the Service Assurance Strategy

  • Own the vision, strategy, roadmap, investment planning, and lifecycle management of the Service Assurance platform.
  • Serve as the senior technology product owner for ServiceNow Telecommunications Service Management (TSM) and related ServiceNow capabilities.
  • Partner with Network Operations and Service Assurance leaders to translate business needs into platform capabilities, automation opportunities, and operational improvements.
  • Establish governance, prioritization, and investment decisions aligned to customer impact, operational efficiency, risk reduction, and business priorities.
  • Manage platform budgets, software licensing, technology partners, and vendor relationships.

Lead Platform Engineering & Delivery

  • Lead a multidisciplinary team of product managers, architects, developers, integration engineers, data engineers, analysts, and support resources.
  • Drive the design, development, integration, testing, release, and ongoing enhancement of Service Assurance capabilities.
  • Establish modern engineering, DevSecOps, release-management, and quality practices that ensure scalability, reliability, maintainability, and security.
  • Deliver reusable, enterprise-scale solutions that support multiple network domains, products, customer segments, and operational teams.

Modernize Service Assurance Operations

  • Own the integration strategy connecting ServiceNow with monitoring, inventory, customer, workforce-management, communications, and analytics platforms.
  • Improve event management, service-impact analysis, incident management, workflow automation, outage communications, and operational visibility.
  • Advance automation, observability, AI, and operational-intelligence capabilities that improve incident detection, prioritization, and resolution.
  • Ensure platform data and workflows provide reliable visibility into network services, customer impact, locations, SLAs, and operational performance.

Ensure Platform Reliability & Operational Excellence

  • Own the operational performance, availability, security, resiliency, and support model for a platform supporting 24×7 network operations.
  • Establish service-level objectives, monitoring, escalation procedures, support processes, and disaster-recovery capabilities.
  • Lead platform incident management, problem management, and technical-debt reduction initiatives.
  • Continuously improve reliability and user experience through feedback, automation, and operational insights.

Drive Data Governance & User Adoption

  • Establish governance for CMDB, service models, topology data, operational data, and platform configuration standards.
  • Partner with Architecture, Inventory, and Data teams to improve data quality, accuracy, and trustworthiness.
  • Simplify operational workflows and improve productivity for NOC engineers, service-assurance analysts, incident managers, and customer operations teams.
  • Lead training, adoption, change-management, and continuous-improvement initiatives to maximize platform value.

Build & Develop High-Performing Teams

  • Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing Service Assurance product and engineering organization.
  • Define clear accountabilities across product management, architecture, engineering, testing, platform operations, and support functions.
  • Manage external implementation partners, software vendors, managed-service providers, and ServiceNow partners.
  • Foster a culture of product ownership, operational excellence, innovation, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

Success in This Role

Key measures of success include:

  • Platform availability and service-level performance
  • Release quality and delivery predictability
  • Automation and operational efficiency improvements
  • Incident management effectiveness and restoration times
  • Customer-impact visibility and service-assurance outcomes
  • User adoption and satisfaction
  • Data quality, CMDB maturity, and platform reliability
  • Technical-debt reduction and cost optimization
  • Business value delivered through the product roadmap

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Telecommunications, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of twelve (12) years of experience in enterprise platforms, telecommunications technology, ServiceNow, OSS/BSS, service assurance, or network operations systems.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of leadership experience managing product, platform-engineering, application-development, or technology-support teams.
  • Significant experience with ServiceNow TSM, TSOM, ITSM, ITOM, Event Management, CMDB, Service Mapping, or related capabilities.
  • Experience leading both technology delivery and production support for a business-critical enterprise platform.
  • Strong understanding of telecommunications service assurance, network events, incidents, services, inventory, topology, and customer impact.
  • Experience integrating ServiceNow with network-management, inventory, customer, field-service, data, and communications platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience developing product roadmaps and translating operational requirements into platform capabilities.
  • Experience with software-development lifecycle, DevSecOps, testing, release management, observability, and platform operations.
  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, financial management, and organizational leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in fiber, optical transport, Ethernet, IP, internet, cloud connectivity, or managed network services.
  • ServiceNow architecture, implementation, or product-owner certification.
  • Experience with ServiceNow Telecommunications Service Operations Management.
  • Experience with AIOps, event correlation, network observability, topology, and automated remediation.
  • Experience managing ServiceNow upgrades and reducing complex customization.
  • Familiarity with ITIL, SRE, platform engineering, and product operating models.
  • Experience supporting highly available, 24×7 operational platforms.

First-Year Priorities

In your first year, you will:

  • Establish clear ownership and a product operating model for the Service Assurance platform.
  • Assess the current ServiceNow implementation, architecture, integrations, data quality, support model, and technical debt.
  • Create a prioritized multi-year platform roadmap with measurable operational outcomes.
  • Improve platform stability, reliability, and operational performance.
  • Enhance integration across events, incidents, network inventory, service inventory, and customer data.
  • Increase automation for event enrichment, service-impact identification, routing, and incident creation.
  • Establish a sustainable ServiceNow engineering, testing, release, and upgrade process.
  • Improve the NOC user experience and reduce manual effort across operational workflows.

jobs.description:
Overview

Overview:

HealthEdge® offers AI-powered operational infrastructure for health insurance companies, guaranteeing an enduring financial edge in an increasingly competitive market. We're experiencing strong market momentum, with a growing number of health plans choosing HealthEdge to modernize their operations and compete more effectively. As we expand, we're investing in the people who power that growth, making this a pivotal moment to join us and shape the future of healthcare technology. Learn more at HealthEdge.com.

The FinOps Analyst is responsible for establishing and operating a comprehensive Cloud and SaaS Financial Management (FinOps) practice across HealthEdge's multi-cloud and SaaS ecosystem, alongside key enterprise SaaS and AI platforms. This role partners closely with Cloud Engineering, Architecture, Finance, Procurement, Security, and product teams to ensure cloud and SaaS consumption is cost-efficient, well-governed, transparent, and aligned to business priorities, both during the ongoing migration off on-premises, Azure, and GCP environments toward AWS, and throughout steady-state operation afterward. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical rigor with genuine curiosity about cloud infrastructure, and is comfortable operating at the intersection of finance and engineering in a newly-formed function.

Areas of Responsibility

FinOps Strategy & Operating Model

  • Establish and mature the FinOps operating model across IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS, implementing cost governance standards across AWS, Azure, GCP, and enterprise SaaS platforms.
  • Partner with engineering and architecture teams to build cost considerations into design and migration decisions, and maintain the FinOps playbooks, policies, and dashboards that drive continuous improvement.

Cost Visibility, Reporting & Unit Economics

  • Build spend visibility dashboards broken down by product, product feature, tenant/client, and team - not just aggregate business-unit totals - and own the production and delivery of cloud cost reports across all HealthEdge business units and environments.
  • Make cloud and AI spend billing data available in analytics and reporting tools, with automated export to finance systems.
  • Build unit economics capabilities - cost per customer, per operation, per API request, AI token usage - and work through the multi-tenant attribution challenge across product lines with defensible allocation logic.
  • Make sure visibility is never the bottleneck - cost that isn't visible can't be managed.

Cost Optimization, Controls & Anomaly Management

  • Continuously identify and quantify cost optimization opportunities across cloud vendors using cloud-native tools and Adaptive 6 - right-sizing compute, identifying idle or abandoned resources, and selecting the right service tier
  • Track and manage HealthEdge's portfolio of Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, and committed use discounts across cloud vendors, monitoring utilization, identifying coverage gaps, and making recommendations on purchases, exchanges, and expirations, and track SaaS contract utilization against commitments.
  • Define spend alarms based on budgets and forecasts, and own anomaly investigations from detection through root cause and resolution so surprises are caught early, not at month-end.
  • Identify process improvements to enhance cost transparency.

Financial Planning, Forecasting & Chargeback

  • Build cloud and SaaS spend forecasts that incorporate sales forecasts, product roadmap initiatives, and migration/modernization waves, and deliver executive-level reporting on spend, trends, and savings realized.
  • Support Finance-led chargeback and showback with clean, accurate, well-tagged cost data, owning data quality and flagging discrepancies before they become Finance's problem.

Tagging & Governance

  • Own the cloud tagging taxonomy and compliance program - defining standards, monitoring enforcement, and remediating gaps with engineering teams - the foundation that makes everything else in FinOps possible.
  • Partner with Finance, Risk, Compliance, and Vendor Management to extend financial controls across cloud and SaaS, and support audits with billing and subscription documentation.

FinOps Tooling, Automation & AI

  • Administer and continuously improve the FinOps tooling stack, developing platform fluency quickly rather than just consuming what's already configured.
  • Actively adopt AI tooling to automate reporting and anomaly triage and accelerate optimization analysis - AI adoption is a team-wide expectation at HealthEdge, not a voluntary experiment.

Cross-Functional Enablement & Vendor Collaboration

  • Partner with engineering teams, platform pillar leads, and Finance through regular cost reviews, building the relationships that make FinOps a collaborative practice rather than a policing function.
  • Collaborate with Procurement and Vendor Management on cloud and SaaS commercial agreements, serving as the key FinOps point of contact across Technology, Finance, and vendors.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Minimum 5-7 years of related experience in FinOps, cloud financial management, or IT financial analysis, including hands-on experience with cloud cost reporting, allocation, and optimization in a large-scale enterprise environment.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

You’ll report to the Global NPI and Sourcing Director and work closely with Category Managers, Engineering, Quality, NPI, Procurement, Should-Cost, Supplier Development, and other business stakeholders. While Sourcing Specialists lead and execute individual sourcing projects, you will orchestrate activities across the portfolio by aligning priorities and resources, providing sourcing and commercial guidance, removing roadblocks, facilitating cross-functional alignment, and managing escalations when needed.


You will bring strong sourcing experience, commercial judgment, and knowledge of complex manufacturing to guide the team and support fact-based supplier decisions. As a people leader, you will coach and develop the Sourcing Specialists in India, establish clear expectations, manage workload and performance, and build the team’s sourcing capabilities. You will also promote consistent application of the 6-Gate Sourcing Process and ensure sourcing activities remain aligned with Category Management strategy and broader business needs.

  • Providing commercial and sourcing guidance on supplier evaluations, complex proposals, negotiations, and supplier selection, while ensuring cost, capability, capacity, quality, lead time, and supply risk are considered.
  • Identifying and driving opportunities for cost reduction, cost avoidance, localization, supplier diversification, dual sourcing, and supply risk mitigation across the portfolio.
  • Removing barriers and serving as an escalation point for complex supplier, commercial, and cross-functional issues, engaging supplier or internal leadership when needed.
  • Coaching and developing Sourcing Specialists while communicating portfolio performance, key risks, opportunities, and decisions requiring leadership attention.

Skills You Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 8–10+ years of experience in sourcing, procurement, supply chain, or a related complex manufacturing environment, with strong Direct Materials sourcing experience.

  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and cost drivers, including machining, fabrication, and electromechanical assembly.
  • Experience supporting supplier transitions, qualification, cost reduction, localization, dual sourcing, and supply risk mitigation initiatives.
  • Strong judgment, coaching, facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to guide sourcing decisions and support Sourcing Specialists.

At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

  • Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

Sword is hiring a Senior Customer Success Manager to own a portfolio of approximately 20 to 30 enterprise employer relationships. You will proactively surface renewal blockers, manage retention and renewals, and help benefits leaders and their advisors connect member access, engagement, outcomes, and financial value to clear decisions.

This role is for someone who can move from executive strategy to operating detail. You will diagnose what is blocking customer value, involve the right partners across Sword, and maintain a credible customer plan even when the process or internal owner is unclear.

What you’ll be doing

  • Build proactive account and renewal plans, identify risk early, and focus high-touch engagement where it can materially change the outcome.

  • Own retention strategy, pricing and contracting coordination, executive relationships, and risk plans across a portfolio of consequential enterprise accounts.

  • Build multithreaded relationships with benefits leaders, consultants, finance, clinical, procurement, and operational stakeholders, adapting the value story to each decision-maker.

  • Use eligibility, enrollment, activation, engagement, outcomes, claims, billing, and ROI evidence to diagnose account performance; understand how file specifications and data-flow issues affect customer confidence and results.

  • Secure the customer access and communication permissions needed to reach eligible members and improve enrollment, activation, and sustained engagement.

  • Identify cross-functional breakdowns, engage the right partners across Sales, Growth Marketing, Implementation, Product, Clinical, Analytics, Finance, and Operations, and keep the customer informed through resolution.

What you need to have

  • Significant experience personally owning complex enterprise customer or client relationships after implementation, including renewals, retention, and account recovery.

  • Evidence of using quantitative customer-value data to make decisions and influence senior stakeholders.

  • Strong executive communication and the judgment to navigate competing customer, consultant, and internal priorities.

  • A record of identifying cross-functional breakdowns and engaging the right teams to execute a solution.

  • Comfort operating in a remote, fast-moving environment where priorities change and a process or owner may not yet be defined, while managing multiple consequential accounts and traveling up to 15%.

What we'd love to see

  • Employer health benefits, digital health, benefits navigation, wellbeing, PBM, or closely related experience.

  • Direct work with enrollment, utilization, claims, outcomes, ROI, billing, or member-engagement data.

  • Experience managing complex portfolios through multiple renewal cycles and organizational change.

How success will be measured

In your first year, you will establish proactive renewal and retention plans, surface blockers earlier, expand access to eligible members where access is limiting results, and build executive and consultant relationships that increase confidence in Sword's value.

jobs.excerpt: Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities.
jobs.description:
Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. With over four decades of experience and teams of highly experienced professionals across 50+ office locations, we deliver impactful strategic insight and business development guidance across all sectors through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms, performance coaching, and curated corporate event programmes. Based in 30+ countries, we create services that connect decision-makers, spark innovation, and drive real business growth.

ME Perform is the performance improvement consultancy of the Marcus Evans Group. We work differently from most of the training market: we diagnose what is actually holding an organisation's people back, design a programme specifically for them, deliver it over months rather than days, and measure whether behaviour genuinely changed, then hand the client written evidence of what improved. Because the design work is done in-house by our Programme Scientists, our trainers get something rare: a fully built, properly researched session, briefed to them in advance, delivered to a cohort who have already been diagnosed and who are expecting to work rather than watch.

Job Summary

You will deliver live sessions, typically 90 to 150 minutes, mostly online, working from a session design and a written brief prepared for you by the Programme Scientist.

This is a delivery role, and deliberately so. You are not asked to write content, find clients, or sell anything. You are asked to be outstanding in the room. Based on the seniority and ability of the applicant there will also be an opportunity extend this role to a follow-up coach with the same group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver live sessions to our designed structure, to a consistently high standard.

  • Prepare from the written brief you receive at least five working days before each session — preparation time is paid within the session fee.

  • Run structured practice: our sessions are built around participants doing the thing, not listening to it explained. Expect to spend much of each session facilitating small-group work, giving feedback, and coaching in the moment.

  • Manage the room — including the sceptical senior participant, the quiet group, and the one who wants to debate rather than practise.

  • Submit brief written session notes within 48 hours of every session, so the Programme Scientist can adjust what comes next.

  • Take part in accreditation before your first client session, and stay open to observation and feedback afterwards.

Qualifications

Essential

  • 5-10 years of substantial experience in facilitating live learning or development sessions for professional or managerial audiences in a corporate setting.

  • Genuinely strong online delivery — confident running breakout groups, keeping cameras on and energy up, and handling the mechanics without it disrupting the session.

  • Comfortable delivering material you did not write, to a structure you are asked to keep to. This is the single most important requirement of the role.

  • Skilled at running practice and giving direct, useful feedback to adults — rather than presenting.

  • Reliable on the administrative side: punctual, responsive, and consistent with session notes.

  • Fluent, credible professional English, and comfortable with senior audiences.

Desirable

  • Experience in one or more of: leadership and management development, communication and influence, collaboration, resilience and change, or working across cultures.

  • A coaching qualification, or experience delivering one-to-one as well as group work.

  • Additional languages, or experience delivering to international cohorts working in a second language.

  • Familiarity with evidence-based learning design — you do not need to be a researcher, but you should be interested in why a session is built the way it is.

How the engagement works

  • Paid accreditation first: a methodology induction, then you deliver a full session for our Programme Scientist to observe, paid at half the standard session fee. Accreditation is completed before any client-facing work.

  • You are then briefed and booked per session. Fees are paid per session with preparation included, invoiced on delivery, on 30-day terms.

  • Standard contract terms apply, including confidentiality, intellectual property assignment for anything created in connection with the work, and non-solicitation of our clients. These are shared in full before accreditation.

  • If a client cancels at short notice, you are protected: cancellations inside five working days are paid in full.

Marcus Evans is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Job Description

Job Description Summary
The Director, Enterprise Architecture & Technology Strategy will oversee architecture as a centralized, strategic function, ensuring that technology selection, integration, and innovation are approached holistically across the enterprise. This version emphasizes high-level strategic influence and governance, making it ideal for situations where enterprise technology decisions must align closely with business growth and innovation goals. The role serves as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, promoting architectural best practices and emerging technologies to enhance competitive advantage.
Job Description

What You’ll Do

  • Technology Strategy & Execution: Define and deliver enterprise technology and architecture strategies that enable business growth, innovation, and healthcare digital transformation. Ensure technology roadmaps are aligned with corporate strategy and product priorities.

  • Enterprise Architecture Governance: Establish and enforce architecture standards, principles, and reference architectures to ensure consistency, security, and scalability. Support the Architecture Review Board and ensure major initiatives comply with enterprise architecture guidelines.

  • Technology Decision Leadership: Provide strategic guidance on key technology decisions, from solution architecture to enterprise platforms. Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and vendors, balancing innovation with risk, cost, and long-term sustainability.

  • Integration & Modernization: Lead enterprise integration and modernization efforts, including APIs, data interoperability, clinical data exchange, and cloud transformation. Reduce technical debt and modernize legacy platforms to improve agility and speed to market.

  • Thought Leadership & Innovation: Monitor industry trends and emerging technologies to drive innovation and business value. Represent the organization’s technology vision with external partners and industry peers.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with business and IT leaders to align architecture with strategic objectives. Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and facilitate early architectural alignment on major initiatives.

  • Risk, Security & Compliance: Embed security, compliance, and risk management into all architecture decisions. Collaborate with Information Security and Risk teams to ensure alignment with regulatory and cybersecurity standards.

  • Financial Stewardship: Guide cost-effective architectural decisions that maximize platform reuse and optimize total cost of ownership. Provide architectural input into IT investment and budget planning.

  • Solution Design & Delivery Support: Provide oversight and guidance to solution architects to ensure scalable, secure, and resilient designs. Engage early in the delivery lifecycle to address complex design challenges and ensure alignment with standards.

  • People Leadership & Development: Lead and develop a high-performing architecture team through clear goals, mentorship, and continuous learning. Build leadership capability and succession within the architecture function.

  • Metrics & Value Realization: Define and track architecture KPIs to measure impact and value. Communicate outcomes in terms of business value, risk reduction, and cost efficiency to demonstrate return on investment.

What You Bring

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, with 15+ years of progressive IT experience, including at least 5 years in technology leadership roles(Director or above). A master’s degree is preferred but not required.

  • Domain Expertise: Demonstrated success leading technology strategy and enterprise architecture in complex environments, within healthcare, including experience with payer and provider organizations. Experience with healthcare standards such as X12/FHIR/HL7.

  • Technical Depth: Hands-on experience with modern technology stacks and architectural frameworks, including cloud platforms, microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, data analytics, AI/ML, observability/service management, and Dev/Sec/Data/AI/Ops practices. Proven experience with large-scale enterprise platforms—such as Facets, Salesforce, and Snowflake—as well as public cloud ecosystems like AWS, Azure, and GCP. While this is a strategic leadership role, the ideal candidate can effectively collaborate with engineering and architecture teams on platform- and solution-level design considerations as needed.

  • Strategic & Analytical Capability: Strong strategic planning and analytical skills, with a track record of developing multi-year technology roadmaps aligned to business objectives. Experienced in evaluating emerging technologies and making informed build, buy, or reuse decisions.

  • Leadership & Influence: Exceptional leadership and communication skills, with the ability to mentor technical teams and influence executive and senior stakeholders. Experienced in driving alignment and decision-making across diverse organizations.

  • Problem Solving & Execution: Extensive experience overseeing end-to-end solution delivery, proactively managing architectural risk, and addressing complex technical and organizational challenges while balancing near-term priorities with long-term strategy.

  • Team Development: Build and lead a high-performing architecture team through effective coaching, mentorship, and clear accountability. Establish performance objectives, conduct regular 1:1s and reviews, and promote a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.

The VMO Analyst’s role will be at the centre of building and establishing a new Value Management Office (VMO). Building this capability is not just about delivering change projects and dashboards. This will be helping to shape and build a new Change operating model. The focus will be on identifying and nurturing the flow of change outcomes and flexibility that add value to Cash Access and to its customers and builds talent, capability and innovation.

Responsibilities


Overview

The VMO Analyst will support the effective management of CAUK’s Change & Transformation portfolio, providing clear, accurate and insightful information to help leaders make better decisions about investment, priorities, capacity, delivery and benefits.

Working within a new, small, collaborative VMO, the role will combine portfolio analysis, governance, reporting, continuous improvement and building new capabilities. The successful candidate will be comfortable working with data, challenging information constructively and turning complex portfolio information into simple, actionable insight. This is a hands-on role in which the individual will help establish and continuously improve CAUK’s approach to portfolio management.

Key accountabilities include:

Portfolio Management & Analysis
  • Building and maintaining robust rolling portfolio planning, roadmaps and cadence in relation to approved change and transformation priorities in adherence with all relevant frameworks, controls, processes and best practice.
  • Analysing portfolio data to identify trends, emerging issues, capacity constraints, dependencies and delivery risk and driving conversations and action with impact leaders and stakeholders
  • Producing portfolio insights and recommendations for senior leaders and governance forums.
  • Supporting portfolio prioritisation and investment discussions through robust analysis and evidence.
  • Helping maintain an enterprise view of change demand, delivery capacity, resource modelling and strategic priorities.
  • Supporting quarterly and annual portfolio planning and re-prioritisation activity

jobs.description:
About Us

STACK is a leading provider of cloud-based construction estimating and takeoff software, committed to helping businesses transform how they work. We pride ourselves on fostering a collaborative, dynamic environment where team members have the opportunity to grow and make a real impact.

About the Role

STACK is looking for a Strategic Customer Success Manager to own a named book of our largest and most complex customer accounts. You'll be the primary relationship owner for multi-seat and enterprise customers – general contractors, specialty subcontractors, and preconstruction teams that run their bidding and estimating on STACK. You own renewals, expansion, and adoption across your book, and you're the voice of these customers inside STACK.

You'll report to the Manager, Customer Success, and work alongside the pod that covers our pooled single-seat accounts. The Enterprise motion is still taking shape, so the account plans, health signals, and business reviews you build will set the standard for how STACK runs named coverage.

What You'll Do

  • Named Book Ownership – Own a book of named accounts end to end: the relationship, the renewal strategy, and the expansion motion.
  • Executive Relationships – Build relationships beyond the day-to-day user. Know the owners, directors of preconstruction, and executive sponsors who make the buying decisions.
  • Renewals & Retention – Own gross and net retention for your book. Start renewal conversations early, spot risk before it shows up in usage, and build recovery plans that work.
  • Expansion – Find and drive growth: added seats, new offices or divisions, and adoption of Build & Operate alongside Takeoff & Estimate. Partner with Sales to close commercial expansion.
  • Adoption & Value Realization – Orchestrate onboarding for new strategic accounts and drive adoption across every team that touches STACK. Tie usage to outcomes the customer cares about, like more bids out the door and faster turnaround.
  • Success Plans & Business Reviews – Build account plans with clear, measurable goals and run quarterly business reviews with customer leadership.
  • Health Monitoring – Track health signals across your book, spot risk trends early, and act on them.
  • Voice of the Customer – Bring structured feedback to Product and advocate for your customers' priorities on the roadmap.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination – Partner with Sales, Support, CS Ops, and Product to keep handoffs, escalations, and account signals moving cleanly.
  • Forecasting – Keep an accurate renewal and expansion forecast for your book and present it in pod forecast reviews.

Your First 90 Days

  • Meet your book. Connect with the primary contact and executive sponsor for your Tier 1 accounts in your first 60 days, then tier the book by risk and growth opportunity.
  • Build the account plans. Publish a written success plan for each top-tier account, with goals the customer has agreed to.
  • Lock the renewal runway. Document a renewal plan for every account renewing in the next 180 days, with owners, risks, and next steps.
  • Run your first business reviews. Lead quarterly business reviews with your top accounts and capture the outcomes in a repeatable template.
  • Contribute to the signal library. Work with your manager to define the health signals that matter most for named accounts.
  • Tighten the Sales handoff. Agree with Sales on a handoff checklist for new enterprise deals so every customer starts with context, not a cold intro.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar customer-facing role in B2B SaaS, including at least 2 years owning enterprise or strategic accounts.
  • A track record of hitting or beating renewal, net retention, and expansion targets.
  • Executive presence. You're comfortable leading a business review with an owner or C-level sponsor and steering the conversation toward outcomes.
  • Commercial instincts. You can spot an expansion opportunity, build the business case, and work through a tough renewal.
  • Strong organization across a complex book – you manage many stakeholders and priorities without letting accounts go quiet.
  • Comfort with data. You can read a dashboard, spot a risk trend, and act on it.
  • Comfort building process where none exists yet. You'll help write the playbook, not just follow it.
  • Clear, confident communication with customers, internal teams, and leadership.
  • Experience in construction, real estate, or another vertical SaaS market is a plus, not a requirement.

Why Join STACK?

  • Opportunity to work in a fast-paced, growth-oriented, remote-first environment.
  • Async-friendly environment with a focus on ownership and deep work.
  • Be part of a dynamic, supportive team where your contributions are valued.

At STACK, our values shape how we work, collaborate, and serve our customers:

  • Radical Honesty: Communicate directly, respectfully, and transparently—even when conversations are difficult. Give and receive feedback with care.
  • Customer Obsession: Put the customer at the center of every decision. Solve real problems, follow through, and measure success by customer outcomes.
  • Move With Purpose: Take thoughtful action, remain accountable, and own both successes and mistakes. Anticipate what’s next and adapt as you learn.
  • Grow Together: Share knowledge, collaborate across teams, and invest in one another’s development. Celebrate collective wins and treat setbacks as opportunities to learn.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be.

We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas.

We take into account an individual’s qualifications, skillset, and experience in determining final salary. This role is eligible for health insurance (medical, dental & vision), life insurance, 401(k) & paid time off. The expected on target earnings is around $110k- $130k USD. The actual offer will be at the company’s sole discretion and determined by relevant business considerations, including the final candidate’s qualifications, years of experience, skillset, and geographic location.
