jobs.description:
AI2IO helps organizations navigate the complex landscape of technology solutions, from foundational IT services and system support to advanced software integration, automation, and cutting-edge AI implementations. Our expertise spans IT infrastructure management, custom software development, seamless system integrations, and optimization of low-code business automation, empowering clients to maximize their existing technology investments.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title Manager, Software Engineering

Position Location Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

Job Summary

AI2IO is seeking a Manager, Software Engineering to lead the people, capability, and operating environment behind software that extends Autodesk Revit and supports architecture, engineering, construction, commissioning, and design workflows. The team builds and supports Revit add-ins, Blazor applications, integrations, installers, deployment services, licensing components, and related tools that streamline specialized engineering work. This is a formal people-management role for all engineers and Software Engineer Technical Leads on the Engineering Tools team. Candidates must bring a strong software-engineering management foundation and meaningful AEC and Revit domain experience. Candidates who combine software-engineering management with hands-on Revit use in mechanical, electrical, BIM or design technology, commissioning, or comparable engineering workflows will be especially well aligned.

Essential Functions

This role grows from complete ownership of people leadership and the Engineering Tools delivery environment toward broader workforce strategy, AEC and Revit capability development, productization readiness, management-system improvement, and organizational leadership. As the organization grows, expand impact through multi-team capability planning, development of technical and people leaders, management-system improvement, workforce strategy, and resolution of organizational challenges beyond the assigned specialty.

Lead and Develop Engineers

  • Serve as the formal people manager for all engineers and Technical Leads assigned to the specialty team through regular one-on-ones, clear expectations, timely feedback, performance reviews, professional development planning, and credible support for every direct report.
  • Provide recognition and development feedback throughout the year and address sustained performance concerns through clear expectations, documented support, follow-through, and appropriate organizational processes.
  • Connect individual goals to meaningful assignments, coaching, learning, mentoring, and increasing ownership without promising advancement before readiness is demonstrated.
  • Partner with Technical Leads to understand technical contribution and development needs while retaining accountability for career evaluation, formal performance decisions, employee relations, and team health.

Build Team Capability and Leadership Depth

  • Maintain a current view of capacity, critical skills, experience distribution, key-person dependencies, succession risk, and staffing needs.
  • Identify capability gaps and coordinate learning, pairing, assignments, mentoring, hiring, and onboarding plans.
  • Develop future Technical Leads and management candidates through scoped assignments, calibrated feedback, explicit readiness criteria, and partnership with current leaders.
  • Reduce leadership and knowledge-continuity risk through distributed ownership, documentation, coverage, and succession options.

Own the Sustainable Delivery Environment

  • Ensure teams have sufficient staffing, capability, role clarity, decision pathways, tools, and organizational support to deliver sustainably.
  • Partner with Technical Leads and Project Managers on delivery health, risk, dependencies, capacity, and recovery without replacing technical or project-management ownership.
  • Ensure material delivery problems receive appropriate management intervention, including staffing changes, escalation, cross-team negotiation, or leadership decisions.
  • Review recurring delays, incidents, rework, quality concerns, support burdens, and workload imbalance to identify organizational or capability improvements.
  • Protect teams from sustained overload and commitments incompatible with available capacity.

Connect Software Teams With AEC and Revit Context

  • Use practical Revit and AEC fluency to help software engineers understand the design, BIM, commissioning, and project-delivery context surrounding Engineering Tools work.
  • Help Product Owners, Business Analysts, Technical Leads, and engineers clarify organization-specific Revit content, standards, parameters, families, model structures, workflows, and downstream constraints without assuming product or technical authority.
  • Recognize when staffing, sequencing, support, or training approaches do not reflect real design workflows, supported Revit versions, model integrity, user productivity, or discipline-specific needs.
  • Facilitate clear communication between software specialists and mechanical, electrical, commissioning, BIM, design-technology, and field stakeholders.
  • Promote solutions and practices that are understandable, supportable, maintainable, reusable, and appropriate for real engineering project conditions.

Build Specialized Engineering Tools Capability

  • Own workforce capability, staffing, development, and training plans spanning C#/.NET, Revit add-ins and API patterns, Blazor applications, data and integrations, installers, deployment, licensing, diagnostics, quality, support, and commercialization readiness.
  • Ensure the team has the mix of software-engineering and AEC-domain capability required to maintain internal tools while preparing selected products for broader use.
  • Develop learning plans that help software engineers understand Revit workflows and help domain practitioners work effectively with software teams.
  • Reduce single-person dependencies in organization-specific workflow knowledge, deployment, installer behavior, licensing, supported-version strategy, model-dependent testing, and operational support.
  • Support Productization, Deployment, and User Readiness • Partner with Technical Leads, Architects, Product Owners, Project Managers, Software Quality, Product Adoption, and support partners on releases, deployment, licensing, installation, compatibility, documentation, training, and support.
  • Plan the people, process, and capability changes required when selected internal tools are prepared for affiliate, contractor, client, or public use.
  • Use domain awareness to identify risks involving organization-specific content, external users, permissions, data handling, installer behavior, licensing, support, and adoption.
  • Ensure credible support and escalation coverage for Revit add-ins, Blazor applications, integrations, installers, deployment services, and licensing components.

Build Healthy, Candid Team Practices

  • Establish practices that support candid discussion of risks, uncertainty, mistakes, technical disagreements, workload concerns, and alternative viewpoints without individual blame.
  • Address observable patterns such as unresolved conflict, sustained overload, escalation failures, knowledge bottlenecks, or reluctance to surface delivery problems.
  • Maintain reliable communication rhythms so engineers understand priorities, decisions, role boundaries, and available support.
  • Address performance, conduct, and employee-relations concerns through appropriate management processes rather than transferring formal accountability to Technical Leads.

Lead Hiring, Selection, and Onboarding

  • Partner with the Director on workforce planning, role requirements, interview plans, evaluation criteria, and hiring priorities.
  • Lead structured and equitable selection processes, calibrate interviewers, document evidence, and make clear candidate recommendations.
  • Own consistent onboarding expectations, including role clarity, access, relationships, learning objectives, 30/60/90-day plans, and ramp check-ins.
  • Evaluate onboarding effectiveness through independence, role understanding, contribution, and feedback and improve the process based on evidence.
  • Identify retention risks early and coordinate appropriate responses.

Maintain Clear Leadership Boundaries

  • Partner with Technical Leads, who own technical feasibility, estimates, dependencies, execution health, engineering standards, implementation direction, and team-level technical decisions.
  • Partner with Architects, who own cross-team architecture, technical standards, governance, and long-term technical direction.
  • Partner with Project Managers, who own the integrated schedule, formal stakeholder communication, scope coordination, project governance, and overall delivery process.
  • Partner with Product Owners and Business Analysts while preserving their authority for product value, priority, requirements, workflow analysis, and backlog readiness.
  • Use technical and domain fluency to understand risk, ask informed questions, clarify context, develop people, and improve the environment without becoming the default Technical Lead, Architect, Product Owner, Business Analyst, or Project Manager.

Improve Management Systems and Organizational Effectiveness

  • Lead improvements to performance management, career development, hiring, onboarding, workforce planning, team operating practices, and leadership continuity.
  • Identify patterns spanning teams and coordinate improvements with peer Managers, Technical Leads, Architects, Project Managers, Product Owners, Business Analysts, and the Director.
  • Contribute to department-level capability planning, organizational design, role definition, career frameworks, cross-team staffing, leadership development, and organizational change.
  • Evaluate whether adopted practices improve clarity, fairness, staffing effectiveness, internal growth, management consistency, and sustainability.
  • Represent capacity, capability, succession, and organizational risk in department planning with concise evidence and decision-ready recommendations.
  • Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

What Success Looks Like

  • Direct reports understand expectations, receive timely feedback, and have credible development plans spanning software engineering, Revit, AEC workflows, deployment, quality, support, and product readiness.
  • The team has sufficient staffing, role clarity, technical leadership, domain fluency, training, and organizational support to deliver and support Engineering Tools sustainably.
  • Software Engineer Technical Leads retain technical authority while receiving effective management partnership and realistic AEC and Revit context.
  • Organization-specific Revit content, standards, parameters, families, model structures, and workflows become understandable context without exposing unnecessary proprietary detail or displacing product and technical owners.
  • Releases have appropriate organizational readiness for supported Revit versions, installers, deployment, licensing, documentation, training, support, and user adoption.
  • The team is increasingly prepared to support selected tools beyond internal users, including the people, process, product, quality, licensing, deployment, and support capabilities broader distribution requires.
  • Key-person risks across Revit knowledge, organization-specific workflows, add-in development, deployment, licensing, quality, and support are reduced.
  • Management practices remain consistent with the broader Software Engineering organization while adapting to model-dependent products and specialized AEC workflows.

Position Requirements

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering or closely related technical-delivery experience, including at least 2 years of formal people management within a software organization.
  • Meaningful professional experience with Autodesk Revit and AEC, BIM, design technology, engineering design, construction technology, or commissioning workflows, with practical understanding of how Revit dependent tools affect real project work.
  • Demonstrated experience managing software engineers and technical leaders while preserving Software Engineer Technical Lead and Architect authority over feasibility, estimates, standards, implementation, and architecture.
  • Experience managing performance, difficult feedback, recognition, development, reviews, promotions, and sustained performance concerns.
  • Experience with workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, skill-gap assessment, retention, succession, and staffing recommendations for specialized teams.
  • Sufficient software-engineering depth to assess C#/.NET and web application architecture, APIs, data, identity, security, testing, CI/CD, observability, dependency, delivery, and production-support risks without directing implementation.
  • Ability to communicate across software engineering, mechanical and electrical design, BIM, commissioning, product, quality, project delivery, adoption, and leadership audiences.
  • Experience supporting software across deployment, installers, licensing, version compatibility, documentation, training, support, or productization concerns.

The Senior Project Manager will be accountable for the successful delivery of Joint Target Operating Model (JTOM) initiatives with our strategic third-party vendor, FNZ. The role will have a strong external delivery interface, with day-to-day responsibility for managing activity across a variety of new joint operating model initiatives outside of the pure platform and associated Platform Transformation activities. It will focus on ensuring complex delivery initiatives are planned, governed and executed effectively, with clear ownership of scope, dependencies, risks, issues, reporting and stakeholder engagement.
Working closely with the TOM Portfolio Director, Business Leads and third-party suppliers, you will drive delivery across initiatives that support the future joint operating model. This will include coordinating plans and dependencies across business functional areas and FNZ while ensuring delivery remains owned, governed and directed through the appropriate internal portfolio and programme structures. The successful candidate will bring experience of delivering complex change in financial services, ideally in environments involving material vendor, platform or outsourced service arrangements.

Key Accountabilities
  • Lead the end-to-end daily management of joint operating model initiatives from mobilisation through to implementation and transition into operation.
  • Develop, maintain and actively manage integrated delivery plans, milestones, dependencies and roadmaps across internal teams and delivery partners.
  • Manage delivery risks, issues, assumptions and dependencies, ensuring appropriate escalation through portfolio governance or relevant programme governance based on sensitivity and impact.
  • Manage project governance activities including steering committees, working groups, delivery forums and executive reporting.
  • Prepare clear reporting, governance materials and decision support for senior stakeholders, portfolio governance and ExCo where required.
  • Coordinate stakeholder engagement across business, technology, operations, finance, risk and vendor teams to maintain alignment, delivery momentum and clear ownership across organisational boundaries.
  • Support transition planning, operational readiness and handover activity, ensuring new or changed services can be embedded effectively into business-as-usual operations.
  • Manage and resolve escalations while maintaining stakeholder confidence and delivery focus.

Knowledge, Skills & Experience
  • Experience of delivering complex change initiatives within Financial Services, ideally in platform, pensions, wealth, investment administration or outsourced servicing environments.
  • Strong understanding of outsourced service arrangements, including vendor delivery management, commercial sensitivities, service transition, operational readiness and supplier governance.
  • Experience of operational readiness or transition / transfer activities with businesses and vendors.
  • Proven experience managing multiple workstreams, complex dependencies and competing priorities across internal teams and external suppliers.
  • Strong understanding of project governance, risk management, controls and regulatory considerations in a financial services context.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, including C-suite engagement.
  • Experience preparing high-quality reporting materials and decision papers for senior stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation and presentation skills.
  • Ability to influence without direct authority in a matrix organisation and across supplier boundaries.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to bring structure and clarity to complex delivery challenges.
  • Good IT skills including all elements of Microsoft Office.
Desirable Experience
  • Direct experience working with FNZ, or a comparable platform, technology vendor or outsourced administration partner.
  • Experience supporting joint operating model transformation activity involving pension, wealth or investment administration platforms.
  • Experience managing delivery across outsourced service models where responsibilities are shared between internal teams and external providers.
Key Competencies
  • Strategic thinking and understands organisational objectives, aligning delivery activity to strategic outcomes.
  • Builds credibility and gains commitment from senior stakeholders across the organisation.
  • Resilience and adaptability in a highly regulated, deadline-driven environment
  • Strong negotiation and influencing skills
  • Commitment to high standards of governance and client outcomes
  • Drives projects to successful outcomes whilst balancing risk, quality, time and cost.
  • Delivers clear, concise and impactful communication tailored to different audiences.
  • Challenges existing approaches and drives improvements to processes, frameworks and ways of working.
  • Ability to flex time management responsibilities and stay calm under pressure.
  • Self-motivated and able to act on own initiative
A little about us 
We’re the Nucleus Financial Platforms group and we help make retirement more rewarding.
People come first - whether it’s our colleagues, or the advisers and customers we support, we know that working in partnership and collaboration leads to the best outcomes. Together, we’ve shaped the platform to how it is today. We work hard, and we celebrate hard too. 
Our ambition is to create a platform with a difference, putting the customer centre stage meant tearing up the rule book and starting from scratch. We’ve come a long way since then, but our mission remains just as focused. That’s why our culture, values, and social responsibility are things we keep at the top of our agenda – because we know they matter and have a big impact. 
Our culture is one of the many things that sets us apart from the pack. We want to have an environment where our people feel that they can make a real difference, know they’ll be rewarded for their efforts and more importantly, enjoy themselves at work. 
Inclusion and diversity at Nucleus 
As with most things in life, who cares, wins. We really care about inclusion. 
For us it’s not a tick box exercise; inclusion and diversity are embedded in our culture and everything we do. It’s a commercial imperative. It isn’t about being PC. It’s about being future-relevant and durable. We owe it to ourselves and the industry to ensure we are playing our part in creating a fair, balanced and transparent financial services sector. 
More diversity means broader experience, a wider set of perspectives and a better collective ability to problem-solve. And it means being more representative of customer groups, which supports areas such as product development. 
At Nucleus, we offer a generous blend of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including a non-contributory pension, bonus, enhanced parental leave, paid time off for emergencies, health and wellbeing initiatives and flexible working options.

jobs.excerpt: 🌎 About UsAt TeamSnap, we believe when the world connects through sports; the world becomes better.
jobs.description:
🌎 About Us

At TeamSnap, we believe when the world connects through sports; the world becomes better. TeamSnap is a sports and communication platform dedicated to taking the work out of play in youth sports. We also believe our jobs should excite us, our teammates should support us and our bosses should inspire us. We empower our people to bring big ideas and tiny egos, landing us on Outside Magazine’s list of “Best Places to Work" and Built In’s “100 Best Remote-First Places to Work."
TeamSnap is scaling fast, and our People Experience team needs a specialist who thrives on variety. Someone equally comfortable troubleshooting a benefits question, auditing HRIS data, and helping run orientation for new hires. This role exists to keep the day-to-day HR engine running cleanly across every function: operations, systems, benefits, compliance, and culture. You won't own one lane; you'll be the versatile, hands-on support that makes the whole People Experience team move faster. If you like learning across the full breadth of HR rather than specializing in one piece of it, this is your seat.

What You'll Do:

  • You'll be a first line of support for employee and manager HR questions (policies, benefits, systems, employee lifecycle changes) resolving routine inquiries directly and routing anything complex to the right specialist, so nothing employee-facing falls through the cracks.

  • You'll support HRIS (Paycor) data integrity across the employee lifecycle, processing new hires or offboarding employees, while updating data accurately and flagging discrepancies before they surface in an audit.

  • You'll partner closely with Payroll to ensure every employee change (new hires, terminations, compensation adjustments, leaves, and status changes) is communicated and reflected accurately and on time, so paychecks are always right and nothing slips between systems.

  • You'll own our parental leave practice end-to-end, walking employees through the process from the moment they share their news, coordinating timelines and paperwork, and serving as their main point of contact so they feel supported (not confused) through one of the biggest moments in their life. You'll bring a strong understanding of Paid Leaves and FMLA requirements, ensuring employees receive the full benefits and protections they're entitled to while maintaining clear communication throughout their leave.

  • You'll own the execution of annual benefits, open enrollment, drafting communications, answering employee questions, uploading rates into our HRIS, and supporting the broker relationship so the process runs smoothly from your seat in the room. This includes coordinating with Finance and Payroll to ensure rates are accurately loaded and communicated to employees.

  • You'll maintain compliance documentation (I-9s, leave paperwork, training trackers) so our records stay audit-ready across federal, state, and local requirements.

  • You'll run onboarding, orientation, and culture programming, making sure new TeamSnappers feel set up for success and that remote team-building efforts actually land.

What Will Set You Up for Success:

  • 3-5 years of experience in an HR, People Operations, or HR Generalist-type role. You don't need to have done everything here before, but you've touched at least a couple of these areas (employee support, HRIS, benefits, or compliance).

  • Comfort learning and working inside an HRIS platform (Paycor experience is a plus, not a requirement).

  • Careful attention to detail. You catch the small things before they become compliance or payroll problems.

  • Strong service instincts and communication skills. You can walk someone through a sensitive process, like parental leave, with clarity and empathy.

  • Ability to juggle several different types of work in the same week without losing track of details.

  • Comfort supporting a remote or distributed team.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Exposure to benefits administration or open enrollment cycles.

  • A natural eye for process improvement; you notice where a workflow is clunky and enjoy finding a better way to do it.

  • Familiarity with I-9 verification, leave administration, or other compliance documentation.

Got cold feet? If you’re thinking you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying. We’re all humans with special talents that go beyond what’s listed here.

Compensation

We’re committed to equitable compensation for all TeamSnappers. The minimum starting point for this role is $70,000, inclusive of base and bonus, with comp updated based on multiple factors. Our comp is highly competitive in our space and we adjust overall comp based on relevant experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location.

🖥 Location

TeamSnap is a fully remote company, so you need to be very comfortable working with people who aren’t in the same time zone as you. We are always expanding, but there is a small list of states we do not hire in, including Alabama, Alaska, Delaware, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Rhode Island, South Dakota West Virginia and Utah and while we love all parts of the world, we can only hire permanent US residents at this time.

🚀 Opportunities to Grow

At TeamSnap, we work hard to provide a culture of trust, accountability, inclusivity, and boundless opportunities to grow, along with the chance to make a lasting impact and have some fun while doing it.

🎩 Total Rewards

• We're proud to be remote-first. We've been remote since 2009, long before COVID made it cool
• Unlimited PTO and paid parental leave for ALL parents (not just primary or secondary)
• 100% premium coverage of medical/dental/vision for you and your family
• 401K to help you invest for the future
• $1,500 annual learning and development stipend
• Travel to fun locations for all-company meetings and team events
• Generous home office allowance to set you up for success
• TeamSnap SWAG to our store upon starting and a $50 credit on every work anniversary thereafter
• A monthly stipend reimbursement for health & wellness and so much more!
•TeamSnap Total Rewards
🏆 Working at TeamSnap
At TeamSnap, you're not a culture fit, you're a culture add. Check out our Culture Playbook and learn how we succeed at being remote-first, what makes our company so unique, and how we're inspired by our people, our customers, and our values.

🧡 Inclusion and Diversity

Creativity and innovation can't thrive when we're cookie-cutter images of each other. We’re quickly growing more diverse, but there's always room for improvement. We are committed to inclusion and diversity at TeamSnap, and we hold ourselves accountable for building an environment where everyone feels valued. If you need any disability-related adaptation during the recruitment process, just let us know! We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
Localize is seeking a Senior Platform Engineer to join our growing product engineering team. As Localize expands, the scalability, reliability, and performance of our infrastructure and applications have become paramount. As a critical member of our product engineering team, you will own and improve Localize’s technical infrastructure, databases, and platform tooling, including monitoring, alerting, and maintenance. Your scope extends beyond delivering product tickets: you will strengthen the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and be responsible for the scalability, stability, reliability, performance, and security of the Localize platform.

You will partner closely with leadership and fellow product engineers to translate business priorities and customer needs into execution, remove obstacles, and make thoughtful tradeoffs that keep the team moving forward. Like every product engineer at Localize, you are expected to be customer-obsessed and business-aligned: connect technical decisions to customer trust, product quality, and business outcomes. This role reports directly to the Engineering Manager.

This is a hands-on software engineering role as well as an infrastructure ownership role. You will be expected to operate at a senior backend engineering level, contributing production application code and owning complex changes from design through rollout and ongoing operation. You will also contribute across the stack when needed to deliver complete customer-facing solutions, balancing product development with infrastructure, security, and developer experience priorities.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Oversee and manage Localize's infrastructure across AWS and Cloudflare.
  • Design, build, test, and maintain backend services, APIs, and background processing workflows. Work hands-on in the Localize application, including the dashboard, public APIs, legacy workers, and BullMQ workers; not only the infrastructure that supports them.
  • Own complex product engineering work end to end: clarify requirements, propose pragmatic designs, implement application and infrastructure changes, and validate releases in production. Contribute frontend changes when needed to complete the customer experience.
  • Apply sound engineering judgment to data modeling, API contracts, asynchronous processing, and failure handling. Diagnose and resolve application-level performance and reliability issues, including inefficient queries, queue bottlenecks, and search behavior.
  • Raise the quality and maintainability of the codebase through automated tests, thoughtful code reviews, and incremental refactoring. Share knowledge and mentor teammates on backend design, debugging, and operationally sound software development.
  • Ensure the scalability, reliability, performance, and security of Localize's data stores, specifically Redis and MongoDB, through effective configuration, monitoring, query optimization, and backup management.
  • Own and improve deployment process and release processes, emphasizing automation, repeatability, safe rollouts, and reliable rollback procedures.
  • Partner with product engineers to improve the full SDLC, including development environments, CI/CD, automated quality and security checks, and release readiness. Treat this work as a core engineering responsibility alongside product delivery.
  • Take a leading role in infrastructure security and SOC 2 Type II compliance, partnering with engineering leadership and compliance stakeholders to operate and improve technical controls, maintain audit-ready evidence, support audits, and remediate findings. Responsibilities include access management, vulnerability management, change management, logging, and backup and recovery controls.
  • Help lead incident response and blameless post-incident reviews, translating lessons into improvements that protect customers and reduce recurring operational risk.
  • Prioritize infrastructure and SDLC improvements based on customer impact, business priorities, and risk. Communicate tradeoffs clearly and assess results through reliability, delivery speed, security, and cost-efficiency.
  • Own and improve monitoring of uptime and performance using tools such as Datadog, Clickhouse, HyperDX, and more
  • Identify, plan and implement improvements and optimizations for infrastructure regarding cost, reliability, scalability.
  • Develop and maintain detailed documentation and maps of our infrastructure and dependencies.
  • Play an active role in Developer Experience enhancement
  • Actively learn new technologies and systems to improve the efficiency and capabilities of our infrastructure.

Technologies

Experience with the specific technologies below is a plus unless listed under Must-Have Skills. Security and compliance, including support for SOC 2 Type II, are core responsibilities of this role—not optional areas of involvement.

  • AWS: Elastic Beanstalk, SQS, Cloudfront, EC2, Elasticache, Route 53, VPS
  • Platforms: Kubernetes, AWS Beanstalk, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions
  • Languages: Terragrunt, OpenTofu, Terraform
  • Monitoring: Clickhouse, Datadog, HyperDX, Grafana
  • Security & Compliance: SOC2 Type II
  • Cloudflare DNS, Workers, Zero Trust (WARP)
  • Business Intelligence: Stitch, Metabase, Snowflake
  • Application Technology: MongoDB (Atlas + Cloud Manager), Typescript, React

Must-Have Skills:

  • 5+ years engineering experience. At least 4 years of experience in a Platform Engineer role.
  • Expertise in managing and optimizing infrastructure in AWS.
  • Redis and MongoDB, including configuration, monitoring, optimization, and management of backups.
  • Expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools OpenTofu and Terragrunt
  • Experience with manual or automated deployment & release management.
  • Understanding of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes and tools.
  • Hands-on experience securing production infrastructure, including least-privilege access controls, vulnerability remediation, secrets management, and security monitoring.
  • Ability to translate security and compliance requirements into repeatable engineering practices, maintain evidence of control operation, and support SOC 2 Type II audit readiness and remediation.
  • Experience partnering with product engineers to improve the SDLC and balance feature delivery with reliability, security, and developer productivity.
  • A customer-obsessed, business-aligned approach: understand how infrastructure decisions affect customers, prioritize work by impact, and explain technical tradeoffs to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Skills in assessing and optimizing performance of infrastructure and applications for improved performance, reliability, scalability, and cost-efficiency.
  • Demonstrated senior-level backend engineering experience: independently designing, shipping, and maintaining production application features and services, beyond infrastructure configuration and scripting.
  • Strong hands-on proficiency with Node.js and JavaScript/TypeScript, including API development, asynchronous programming, automated testing, and debugging production systems.
  • Experience designing application data models and reliable background jobs, including safe retries, idempotency, and failure recovery. Ability to reason about performance and correctness across application code, databases, and queues.
  • Ability to work across backend and frontend boundaries, learn the relevant parts of our application stack, and collaborate with product engineers to deliver complete features. Communicate designs and tradeoffs clearly, give constructive code reviews, and help teammates solve difficult technical problems.
  • Proficiency in command line scripting
  • Disaster Recovery Planning including data integrity and availability in case of emergencies.
  • Experience with APM and logging tools such as DataDog, New Relic, Sentry, or Kibana.

Nice-to-Have Skills or Experience:

  • Product Engineering languages and frameworks such as Typescript, React, Mongoose, LESS, and more
  • Applied LLM engineering:
    • Hands-on experience integrating LLMs into production systems (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or similar)
    • Strong understanding of prompt engineering, context engineering, and token management
    • Experience designing or implementing RAG pipelines, embeddings, and vector search
    • Familiarity with emerging LLM infrastructure patterns and protocols (e.g., MCP, tool/function calling, agents)
  • Working in a fast-paced environment where you’re accountable for your work and you’re passionate in working with customers

Benefits & Perks:

You’ll be joining a close knit and talented team, with plenty of opportunity for professional growth. We offer compensation + benefits that are on par with large companies, while also placing a high value on maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

  • Competitive salary
  • 401(k) plan + 4% matching
  • 100% company-paid health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Company-paid life insurance and AD&D insurance
  • Work anywhere in North America (we are 100% remote)
  • New Macbook (or computer of your choice)
  • Monthly stipend for home internet costs
  • Generous PTO package

About Localize:

The Localize platform is used by 700+ companies to automate the translation of their web and mobile applications and bring their products & services to new markets at record speed. We support organizations like The Bay Area Toll Authority in translating their payments website, Baptist Health in making their healthcare site multilingual, and the Massachusetts Department of Elementary and Secondary Education in offering their content in several languages. To see our product in action, click any of those links and use the website's language switcher to switch from English to another language.

Localize works by providing a code snippet (similar to the Google Analytics JavaScript snippet) that our customers add to their website/web app. The Localize snippet pulls in content from the page into the Localize dashboard where our customers log in to add translations and manage their content. Localize automatically deploys those translations to the customer's production site, reducing development costs and accelerating time to market.

We are a team of ~30 people working fully remote. We offer competitive pay, a full benefits package, and a culture with an emphasis on work + life balance.

To apply:

Along with your resume, send us a cover letter that showcases your personality and tells us why we should hire you. Previous experience working in a remote position is a must.

jobs.description:
Our mission is to become the financial and revenue operating system for primary care practices.

We help dental and veterinary clinics manage how money flows into the practice — from patient access and onboarding, to payments, memberships, financing, insurance, and reporting — in one coherent system.

Rather than treating payments, plans, and finance as separate tools, we combine them into a single operating layer that reflects how practices actually run their business.

There are three structural shifts reshaping primary care right now:

  1. Patient access is moving beyond opening hours. Clinics are under pressure to be available when patients want to engage, not just when the front desk is staffed. Voice and chat interfaces are becoming the new front door to care.

  2. Revenue is becoming structured, not ad-hoc. Memberships, financing, and insurance are increasingly used to smooth cashflow, improve access, and increase predictability — particularly as NHS capacity declines and private care expands.

  3. Practices need better financial insight, not more software. Owners and managers want to understand whether their pricing, plans, and utilisation make economic sense — without becoming analysts or relying on opaque tools.

Today, we support over 6,000 dental practices across the UK. 100 more join our platform every month. Tabeo is the dominant market leader for patient finance and seeks to dominate membership plans next. Beyond payments, we are launching a voice/chatAI solution that complements our existing products.

Tabeo is profitable. We seek to grow revenue by 50-60% per year and exceed £25 million ARR in 2028.

jobs.title: Digital Technical Project Manager
jobs.excerpt: Grounded in a talent-centric mindset, Maker Lab is a marketing agency designed to build decentralised technology-led agency teams, rooted in collaboration with clients from the ground up.
jobs.description:
Grounded in a talent-centric mindset, Maker Lab is a marketing agency designed to build decentralised technology-led agency teams, rooted in collaboration with clients from the ground up. Maker Lab’s cross-functional teams of multidisciplinary specialists are embedded into client teams across digital marketing competencies — from measurement & analytics to content production.

Job Summary:

We’re looking for a Digital Technical Project Manager to lead a new B2B website project, bringing teams and external partners together to drive project planning, manage the RFP process, and ensure smooth delivery aligned with business goals.

Role:

Project & Vendor Management

  • Act as the primary project manager for the enterprise website build and MarTech stack refresh.
  • Own the roadmap, milestones, trackers, and documentation (sprints, stand-ups, sprint reviews, steering meetings) to ensure aligned timelines.
  • Partner with Procurement to produce and run the comprehensive RFP pack to evaluate and select web development agencies.
  • Manage the project budget by tracking vendor fees, production, and development costs, flagging any variances early.
  • Plan and execute multi-market UAT, go-live approvals, DNS cut-overs, hypercare, and transition to post-launch support.

Strategy, Requirements & Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Run discovery workshops with cross-functional groups (Marketing, Business Teams, Legal, and regional teams) to define objectives, site architecture, UX flow, and feature requirements.
  • Translate business needs into functional specifications and a single requirements baseline.
  • Coordinate review cycles, consolidate feedback, and manage approvals across internal teams and regional POCs.
  • Control project scope, ensuring every change request is tied to a clear requirement, cost impact, and stakeholder decision.
  • Define the in-market website access model, including central access control, market editing rights, and audit trails.

Technical Oversight & MarTech Integration

  • Audit the existing B2B MarTech stack (Salesforce, Account Engagement/Pardot, GA4, Google Tag Manager) to identify gaps in data flow, lead scoring, tagging hygiene, and CRM integration.
  • Develop an actionable execution plan to fix attribution bottlenecks and capture marketing-influenced revenue.
  • Critically evaluate vendor proposals and output quality (e.g., test coverage, code-review sampling) against modern web development trends, SEO/GEO/AEO baselines, and performance targets.
  • Oversee MarTech best practices, including reconfiguring tag management, pixels, custom dimensions, and Pardot–Salesforce data syncs.

Reporting & Handover

  • Ensure post-launch tracking and analytics are correctly implemented, automating lead reporting to eliminate manual effort.
  • Define post-launch SLAs and support scopes with the selected vendor.
  • Ensure the delivery of comprehensive CMS documentation (editor/admin guides, runbooks) and facilitate training for central and regional teams.
  • Deliver a complete handover package covering site maintenance, content updates, monitoring, and SOPs for data hygiene.

You:

  • BA/BS degree or equivalent experience
  • Experience: Proven track record managing large-scale web builds, CMS implementations, and MarTech integrations in a PMO or lead agency role.
  • Technical Fluency: Deep understanding of enterprise CMS architectures, UI/UX, SEO, QA/testing protocols, and AI-driven web development trends.
  • MarTech Expertise: Hands-on knowledge of B2B tracking, lead attribution models, Salesforce, Pardot, GA4, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Process-driven: Experience running end-to-end RFP processes, budget management, and multi-market UAT.
  • Communication: Exceptional stakeholder management skills, capable of translating complex technical limitations to marketing teams and business needs to developers.

Contract Type: 12 months Fixed Term Contract

Please note: due to the high volume of applications, only successful candidates will be contacted with a follow-up introduction email. If you do not receive an email from Maker Lab, your application has been unsuccessful this time around. Look out for future roles! By submitting your application, you consent to the collection, use and disclosure of your data by the Maker Lab team for the purposes of your application. Where your application contains personal data of third parties, you confirm that you have obtained all necessary consents to provide the Maker Lab team with such personal data and that we may collect, use and/or disclose such data in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Act 2012.

  • Prototyping, integration and development of drivers and components in embedded C for customer audio projects (TWS Earbuds, matching charger cases, Headsets, Speakers) according to the product requirements based on the various SoCs, primarily focused on Qualcomm platforms, specifically the S7 platform
  • Hardware/SW configurations and measurements during prototyping and pre-production

  • Experience with production processes and support

The partners' decade-long history of success in trading and business building and a firm-wide cultural emphasis on alpha generation, open debate, relentless iteration, and teamwork are key to the firm's continued expansion in a challenging market environment that has hamstrung competitors. A hard-wired emphasis on risk management and opportunistic market participation ensure that hermeneutic research will continue its growth trajectory in the coming decades.

Job Overview

We are seeking a seasoned Backend Engineer to help build high-performance, cloud-native infrastructure to support our research, trading, and data pipelines. This role is crucial to enabling real-time data ingestion and processing workflows, and ensuring our systems can meet the demands of a high-uptime, low-latency trading environment.

The ideal candidate brings deep production experience with Go and modern distributed systems, or comparable depth in other backend languages. They have extensive experience in production-grade system design and a strong operational mindset. You will work closely with trading, infrastructure, and data teams to design and maintain systems that are fast, reliable, and observable.

This is a critical position at the technical core of the firm, ideal for individuals who thrive in fast-moving environments and care deeply about performance, robustness, and continuous improvement

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and development of robust high-performance, cloud-native backend systems using Go that support real-time data processing and low-latency workflows.
  • Drive engineering excellence through code quality, best practices, and mentorship of other team members.
  • Make effective use of AI-assisted and agentic development workflows to accelerate delivery, while taking full ownership of the quality, correctness, performance, and maintainability of the resulting code.
  • Work closely with trading, product, and infrastructure teams to understand system requirements and deliver performant solutions.
  • Take ownership of production services, ensuring reliability, observability, and performance tuning. Optimize systems performance and ensure system stability, reliability, and security.
  • Contribute to infrastructure automation and CI/CD improvements to support rapid deployment and operational agility.
  • Conduct in-depth code reviews, lead technical discussions, and influence engineering culture and standards.
  • Implement automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and participate in code reviews and design discussions.
  • Deploy and manage services leveraging cloud-native tools and best practices
  • Monitor, debug, and troubleshoot production systems and be a part of the on-call incident response team in a high-uptime environment.

Requirements

Must Have

  • 5+ years of backend development experience building and supporting production-grade systems, with strong experience in distributed, high-availability, and/or high-throughput environments.
  • 3+ years professional experience building and operating production systems in Go, or a deep professional backend engineering background combined with experience using agentic development workflows.
  • Strong knowledge of concurrency, memory management, performance, and optimization, with the ability to apply these principles effectively to Go-based systems.
  • Experience leading large-scale system design and mentoring engineers on engineering best practices.
  • Proven track record of designing and deploying microservice architectures in high-availability, high-throughput environments.
  • Solid understanding of message queues, event-driven architectures, and asynchronous processing.
  • Strong understanding of networking data transmission protocols (TCP, UDP, WSS, etc.) and of service-to-service API design with REST/gRPC.
  • Experience building and deploying cloud-native applications.
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies (Docker) and orchestration engines (e.g., ECS, Kubernetes).
  • Proficiency with message brokers (e.g., Kafka, Redpanda) and distributed systems.
  • Knowledge of data storage technologies such as PostgreSQL, Redis, and time-series databases like ClickHouse or TimescaleDB.

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of Rust, C++, Python, particularly in data-intensive or performance-sensitive applications.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Experience deploying and operating production systems on public cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Experience with observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).
  • Background in crypto, high-frequency trading, or real-time market data systems.
  • Knowledge of crypto exchanges market data and order routing protocols
  • Contributions to open-source projects or a strong technical blog/portfolio.

Interview Process

  1. CV Screening – We will review your application based on the qualifications and experience outlined above.
  2. Assignment – A take-home assignment to demonstrate your approach, critical thinking, and relevant skills.
  3. Assignment Review – A discussion of your assignment, focusing on your approach, reasoning, and solutions.
  4. CTO Interview – Interview with the CTO to discuss your experience, technical expertise, problem-solving approach, and overall fit for the role.
  5. Co-Founder Interview – A concluding discussion to evaluate cultural fit, strategic alignment, and how you resonate with the firm's values.

Company Values

Throughout the process, you'll be assessed for cultural fit through our company values:

  • Drive – We believe the best team members are deeply passionate about what they do. That passion fuels their growth, drives them to seek out the best teams, and leads them to hold high expectations of themselves in pursuit of excellence.
  • Ownership – We aim to extend ownership as broadly as possible across the firm. In return, we value people who take initiative, step up when needed, and treat the company’s goals as their own.
  • Judgment – We value those who see the big picture and focus on what truly drives impact and results. They use time wisely, adapt across domains, and always prioritize outcomes over comfort zones.
  • Openness – We foster a culture of open communication, mutual challenge, and shared growth. We believe constructive debate and proactive knowledge sharing lead us closer to the truth—and better decisions.
  • Competence – We work with people who bring exceptional intellectual strength. What sets them apart isn’t just what they know—it’s how they use what they know to navigate change, adapt quickly, and contribute meaningfully in fast-changing environments.
  • Resilience – We perform under pressure. Markets move fast, and so do we—but we stay grounded, focused, and calm. We embrace uncertainty, learn from setbacks, and adapt quickly without losing sight of long-term goals.

jobs.excerpt: Job Overview We are looking for a Senior SDET to test the resilience and correctness of distributed backend systems supporting a high-stakes account provisioning and onboarding workflow.
jobs.description:
Job Overview

We are looking for a Senior SDET to test the resilience and correctness of distributed backend systems supporting a high-stakes account provisioning and onboarding workflow. This role is focused on the execution of pre-approved, benign tracer/replay scenarios against staging endpoints, analysis of request/response behaviour, and documentation of observable account/CID lifecycle and downstream state behaviour.

The ideal candidate has strong distributed-systems and API-testing experience and maintains disciplined technical evidence capture and traceability.

This role is not intended to perform unrestricted adversarial testing. Testing activities will be limited to approved staging environments and pre-approved benign scenarios.

Project Details

Title: Senior SDET
Rate: $13.5/hr
Start Date: 19th October
Duration: 5 Weeks
Commitment: 33 Hours per Week
Location: India (Remote)
Job Type: Freelance

Responsibilities

  • Analyze distributed system APIs to validate correctness, consistency, and failure handling across services involved in account creation, data persistence, and related record-linking
  • Execute pre-approved request variations and boundary-validation scenarios using sanitized tracer payloads against designated staging endpoints.
  • Investigate system behavior under malformed, malicious, or unexpected inputs and document findings clearly
  • Capture complete request/response evidence, including HTTP status codes, latency, headers, and payload bodies, subject to approved data-handling requirements.
  • Validate behavior of near-real-time inline checks (evaluated within milliseconds at the gateway) as distinct from longer-running background verification/risk pipelines (evaluated over minutes to hours), confirming each layer of defense behaves as expected
  • Verify data persistence, referential integrity, and correct linkage of related records/relationships written by backend services during processing
  • Execute controlled replay suites and compare expected versus observed API behavior.
  • Correlate replay results with the API schemas and network evidence produced by the Middleware SDET.
  • Document observable account/CID lifecycle behavior and downstream state changes for handoff
  • Capture and archive test logs and evidence in a structured, retrievable format to support audits and post-incident reviews
  • Collaborate with backend engineering teams to reproduce, isolate, and validate fixes for distributed-system defects
  • Contribute to test strategy for backend/middleware reliability, including failure-mode and chaos-style testing
  • Maintain traceability between test evidence, defects, and system requirements
  • Reconcile backend observations with the frontend FSM and middleware/API evidence produced by earlier workstreams.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience of 5-8+ years in testing distributed systems and analyzing inter-service API behavior
  • Hands-on experience with request payload tampering, fuzzing, or adversarial API testing techniques
  • Understanding of layered defense architectures, including the distinction between synchronous/inline validation and asynchronous/background verification processes
  • Familiarity with testing data persistence and relational/hierarchical integrity in backend data stores
  • Demonstrated discipline in test log archival, evidence capture, and structured documentation practices
  • Solid understanding of backend/middleware architecture, failure modes, and system boundaries
  • Familiarity with API testing tools and scripting for building custom fuzzing/tampering test cases
  • Strong analytical and investigative skills for root-causing complex, systemic defects
  • Experience executing controlled API replay or staging validation is strongly preferred.
  • Experience correlating API responses with observable application/account lifecycle states is preferred.
  • Experience supporting audit, compliance, or evidence-based reporting requirements is a plus

Responsibilities

  • Own the technical direction across the platform's tiers — frontend, backend, agentic/AI services, data, and integrations — and hold the shared mental model of how the system actually fits together.
  • Pair closely with the Senior Technical PM and Program Director to translate product intent into a credible technical plan, and to surface what is genuinely hard vs. what is just unfamiliar.
  • Lead architecture and design reviews, write the deciding ADR when needed, and keep a small set of vendor-neutral patterns the team can lean on instead of a sprawl of frameworks.
  • Stay hands-on in the code — pick up meaningful slices of work, especially across tier boundaries (e.g. backend ↔ agentic, frontend ↔ auth/RBAC, infra-aware app changes).
  • Be a first-class code reviewer across the stack: you set the bar for clarity, testability, security, and operability, and you raise the team's bar by reviewing thoughtfully.
  • Mentor mid-level and senior engineers; coach them through technical decisions, on-call experiences, and difficult code reviews.
  • Partner with the Platform Engineer on production reliability — capacity, scaling, observability, and incident response — and own application-side reliability concerns.
  • Drive integration architecture with internal and external systems using API-first and event-driven patterns; ensure identity, authorization, data protection, and auditability are built in, not bolted on.
  • Champion the LLM/agent layer — agent orchestration, tool/plugin design, prompt and evaluation loops, provider abstraction (e.g. Vertex AI, Claude on Vertex, OpenAI) — and keep us out of vendor lock-in we cannot pay for.
  • Build redundancy on yourself — pair, document, rotate ownership, and ensure no critical system has exactly one person who understands it.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years in software engineering, with meaningful time as a hands-on lead, staff engineer, or solutions architect on production systems.
  • Proven experience designing and delivering complex, multi-service platforms — not just one service or one tier.
  • Strong backend depth in at least one modern stack (Java/Spring Boot, Python/FastAPI, Node, Go, .NET); able to ramp on the others.
  • Solid frontend literacy — comfortable reading and reviewing modern React/TypeScript code and reasoning about state management, auth, and performance.
  • Strong cloud architecture background, preferably GCP (we run primarily on GKE); willing to deepen wherever the platform takes us.
  • Deep understanding of API design, integration patterns, distributed systems, and the failure modes that come with them.
  • Experience with containerization, Kubernetes, and modern CI/CD; you do not need to be a DevOps specialist, but you must operate well in that world.
  • Real production experience with AI / LLM systems — agents, RAG, evaluation, tool integration — or a strong, demonstrable plan for getting there.
  • Comfortable working within Agile delivery models (Scrum, Kanban, or whatever variant actually ships).
  • Excellent communication: you can explain a complex architecture to a non-technical executive and disagree with a senior engineer respectfully and with evidence.

Required Soft Skills

  • Hands-on bias — you reach for the code, the logs, and the diagram before you reach for the meeting invite.
  • Calm, decisive judgment when there is no obviously right answer.
  • Strong written communication — you can write a one-page architecture rationale that future-you will still understand.
  • Generous mentorship instinct — you make the people around you better, on purpose.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and willing to make reversible decisions quickly while flagging the irreversible ones for broader input.
  • Pragmatic about technology choices — you optimize for the team's ability to operate the system, not for personal stack preferences.

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience working inside Publicis Groupe or another large holding-company agency network.
  • Production experience with Google ADK, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or comparable agent frameworks.
  • Experience with event-driven architectures, domain-driven design, and contract-first integration patterns.

  • Comfort with Terraform, Kustomize, or other IaC tooling at a 'can read and improve' level.
  • Track record contributing to internal developer experience — patterns, scaffolds, golden paths.

Additional Information

In this hands-on senior technical leadership role, you will help shape the R&D AI strategy and set technical direction for the engineering team, while building critical components yourself and setting best practices for AI-native development within a disciplined, validated SDLC. Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.

What You’ll Be Doing:


Job Description

Position Summary

The Senior Software Engineer leads the design, development, and deployment of complex features in the web user experience for the Evolent Platform. This role builds high-performance React and Next.js (TypeScript) features and works closely with product managers, UX designers, and other engineers to translate business needs into technical solutions.

This individual drives the technical direction of features, contributes to front-end architecture discussions and long-term planning, and mentors junior engineers to foster a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence. The role is expected to use approved AI-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality while remaining fully accountable for every result delivered.

AI-Assisted Engineering Expectations

Evolent engineers are expected to effectively leverage approved AI-assisted development and productivity tools (e.g., code assistants, copilots, automation agents, knowledge assistants, and analytics tools) to improve quality, efficiency, and innovation while maintaining accountability for all delivered work. These expectations span the full engineering lifecycle, not only code generation, including iterating with AI on solution design and architecture, evaluating alternatives, revising existing architecture, and producing design artifacts. Engineers remain responsible for validating outputs, ensuring solution quality, protecting sensitive information, and complying with security, privacy, regulatory, and Responsible AI standards.

Key Responsibilities

Design and Development

  • Lead the design, development, and deployment of complex front-end features in React and Next.js, ensuring scalability, accessibility, and maintainability.
  • Build Server and Client Components that follow the team’s rendering and caching standards, including read-your-writes behavior for decision forms.
  • Implement backend-for-frontend (BFF) endpoints and integrate with .NET (C#) and Python (FastAPI) services, and Entra ID / OpenID Connect authentication.
  • Build data-heavy screens, including large grids, PDF and document viewers, rich-text editors, and workflow wizards, using component libraries such as KendoReact or MUI.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, UX designers, and other engineers to translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Drive the technical direction of features, contributing to front-end architecture discussions and long-term planning.

Agentic User Experience

  • Build streaming user interfaces (SSE) that render agent narratives, tool calls, citations, and generative UI using the Vercel AI SDK, assistant-ui, and CopilotKit over the AG-UI protocol.
  • Implement human-in-the-loop flows that let reviewers approve, modify, or override agent recommendations, including Pydantic AI tool-approval interrupts.
  • Implement robust handling for slow, interrupted, or failed agent calls, including retries, timeouts, resumable streams, and clear status messaging.
  • Contribute to the AG-UI event contract and shared-state design with the agent team.

Engineering Excellence

  • Conduct thorough coding reviews, provide constructive feedback and ensure adherence to best coding practices.
  • Mentor and coach junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.
  • Build accessible components that meet WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 and resolve accessibility defects.
  • Write component and end-to-end tests using Vitest, React Testing Library, and Playwright.
  • Identify and implement improvements to CI/CD pipelines, supply-chain controls, and OpenTelemetry instrumentation.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, working to ensure high availability and reliability of the user experience.

AI-Enabled Delivery

  • Utilize approved AI-assisted engineering tools, such as GitHub Copilot, to accelerate software development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and analysis activities.
  • Evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs for correctness, security, maintainability, compliance, and business appropriateness.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and solution quality through AI-enabled workflows and automation.
  • Contribute reusable prompts, skills, agents, and AI-assisted development patterns to benefit the team.

Governance and Compliance

  • Follow enterprise policies governing AI usage, intellectual property protection, security, privacy, PHI handling, and Responsible AI practices.
  • Handle patient data safely under HIPAA, keeping PHI out of browser storage, client logs, and telemetry.
  • Ensure no confidential, regulated, or protected information is used with unapproved AI services or tooling.
  • Participate in peer reviews and validation processes for AI-assisted solutions.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, including 3+ years building production web applications with React and TypeScript.
  • Hands-on experience with Next.js, including Server and Client Components, server-side rendering, and streaming.
  • Experience building streaming or real-time user interfaces using Server-Sent Events or WebSockets.
  • Experience building data-heavy enterprise screens using component libraries such as KendoReact (Telerik) or MUI.
  • Experience integrating front ends with REST APIs and backend services, including the backend-for-frontend pattern.
  • Experience implementing authentication with Entra ID (Azure AD) and OpenID Connect.
  • Strong knowledge of WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508, with experience building accessible applications.
  • Experience with Vitest or Jest, React Testing Library, and Playwright.
  • Experience with Docker, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, and Git-based workflows, including pull requests.
  • Strong, daily use of AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a globally distributed team of technical and non-technical colleagues.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions, present to stakeholders, and write detailed documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with agentic UI frameworks and protocols such as AG-UI, CopilotKit, assistant-ui, or the Vercel AI SDK.
  • Experience designing human-in-the-loop experiences for AI agents, including approval and override workflows.
  • Familiarity with Python and Pydantic AI.
  • Experience with FHIR R4; Da Vinci Prior Authorization Support (PAS) a plus.
  • Experience consuming events from Azure Service Bus or similar message brokers.
  • Experience with Kubernetes (AKS) and OpenTelemetry.

• Experience with C# and .NET.

  • Experience integrating AI services, models, or agents into production applications.
  • Healthcare domain experience, including handling PHI under HIPAA.

Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration.

jobs.description:
Working Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8am – 5pm Mountain Standard Time

Work Arrangement: Fully Remote

Salary: 2,000 - 2,500 USD

Employer: AI company located in Phoenix, Arizona

The Role

This is a new kind of engineering role. You won't be a code monkey wired into a backlog. You'll own features end-to-end using Claude Code and other coding agents: design, implementation, testing, shipping. You direct the AI, you read every line it produces, and you ship the finished thing.

You'll work across the platform: Threo (the client workspace), Wingtip (agentic execution from plain English requests), Pylon (agent creation and runtime), and Canopy (the control plane for every client tenant).

Our stack spans .NET/C# and FastAPI (Python) on the backend, React on the frontend, and PostgreSQL for data. You don't need to know it all on day one — you need to ramp fast with coding agents and ship in stacks you haven't touched before. We hire for taste and velocity.

What You'll Do

  • Take a problem from rough idea to shipped feature: design, build, test, deploy, working from specs and repo-level agent instructions you and your agents both use. No handoffs for "the real implementation."
  • Read every line the AI produces. You're accountable for what ships, not the model.
  • Operate two, three, or more AI agents at once across separate work streams (new features, bug fixes, refactors), keeping each in its own sandbox or work tree and shipping from all of them the same day without losing state or scope.
  • Ship services in .NET 10 LTS / C# (ASP.NET Core, Minimal APIs, background workers).
  • Build and extend Python services using FastAPI for our agent execution engine and adjacent tooling.
  • Design and evolve data models in PostgreSQL: schema, migrations, indexes, query performance.
  • Build React 19 interfaces with the stable React Compiler — admin consoles, data grids, forms, and chat UIs.
  • Implement streaming chat and live updates, and integrate with LLM providers via tool calling and MCP servers, structured outputs, retries, and fallbacks.
  • Write tests, write docs, close the loop, and debug across services and stacks — the AI helps, but it doesn't excuse you from understanding the system. The bar is "that's done," not "the happy path works."
  • Ship via Docker and GitHub Actions to our cloud infrastructure.

What We're Looking For

We hire on AI fluency, judgment, and velocity, not years of experience. If you live in Claude Code (or Cursor, or Codex) and ship real software with it, we want to talk.

Must Have

  • Daily, fluent use of agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar). We care that you can direct an agent through a non-trivial feature without losing the plot — not which tool you use — and that your first instinct is to design with AI in the loop.
  • Parallel agent management. You can run multiple agents at once across separate work streams (features, bug fixes, refactors) and deliver shipped work from each.
  • Solid programming fundamentals. You can read and reason about code in at least one of: C#, TypeScript/JavaScript, or Python. You understand HTTP APIs, relational databases, and basic async patterns. You can debug what you didn't write.
  • Product sense. You can look at a half-formed requirement, ask the right three questions, then ship something the user actually wants.
  • Ownership and clear async communication. When you pick up a feature, you finish it: tests, docs, no dangling threads, no partial solves left for someone else.
  • Quality checks on AI output. You ship the full loop — traces, trajectory-level evals, and guardrails against prompt injection — and can show a non-deterministic feature is safe in front of paying customers.

Nice to Have

  • Streaming systems (WebSockets, SignalR, or similar).
  • LLM integration work: tool calling and MCP servers, streaming, and retrieval or context engineering.
  • LLM cost and latency optimization: caching, model routing, token budgets.
  • Multi-tenant SaaS architecture.
  • Familiarity with MSP/PSA ecosystems (ConnectWise, Autotask, Datto RMM, etc.).

jobs.title: Principle Systems Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About the RoleWe are hiring a Principal Platform Engineer to help build and scale our Azure-native cloud platform as we migrate services from an on-premises data center to the cloud.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are hiring a Principal Platform Engineer to help build and scale our Azure-native cloud platform as we migrate services from an on-premises data center to the cloud. This is a hands-on engineering role with a strong mentoring component -- you will design and build alongside the team while raising the technical bar for engineers earlier in their careers. You will work across infrastructure, deployment automation, observability, and security tooling, with exposure to both legacy automation modernization and net-new platform capability.

This is an individual contributor role. You will not have direct reports, but you will be expected to mentor and provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level engineers on the team, including reviewing designs, pairing on complex problems, and setting technical direction by example.


What You'll Do

  • Design and build Azure infrastructure using a cloud native approach, leveraging managed services wherever they meet reliability and cost requirements.
  • Lead technical execution of the migration of services from an on-premises data center to Azure, including dependency mapping, migration sequencing, and cutover risk management.
  • Operate and extend our AKS-based platform, including GitOps deployment patterns, namespace isolation, and policy enforcement.
  • Own and evolve reusable Terraform modules that other engineering teams consume, with clear interface contracts between platform-owned and application-owned infrastructure.
  • Build and maintain observability coverage (metrics, logs, alerting) so that platform and application health are measurable and actionable, not just instrumented.
  • Apply policy-as-code to enforce security, compliance, and operational standards across the platform, and reduce reliance on manual review gates.
  • Design and review Identity and Access Management patterns, including workload identity, least-privilege access models, and secrets management -- with a clear bias away from static credentials.
  • Participate in business continuity and disaster recovery planning for platform services, including failover design, RTO/RPO definition, and recovery testing.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipeline design and standards used across engineering teams building on the platform.
  • Use AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as part of the standard workflow, and evaluate where AI-driven platform capabilities (automated remediation, intelligent alerting, natural-language operational tooling) can be responsibly introduced into the platform itself.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code/design review, pairing, and informal technical coaching. Help less experienced engineers build sound judgment around idempotency, error handling, and migration candidacy when evaluating legacy automation.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years in platform, infrastructure, or site reliability engineering roles, with demonstrated Principal-level scope (technical leadership without formal management).
  • Deep hands-on experience with Azure, building cloud native architectures using managed services rather than defaulting to IaaS.
  • Production experience running and operating Kubernetes at scale, ideally AKS specifically.
  • Strong GitOps experience (ArgoCD, Flux, or equivalent) -- all infrastructure and cluster changes should trace to a git commit as a matter of practice, not preference.
  • Experience leading or significantly contributing to a data center-to-cloud migration, including business continuity and disaster recovery planning.
  • Working fluency in policy-as-code tooling (Kyverno, OPA/Gatekeeper, or equivalent) for security and compliance enforcement.
  • Strong Identity and Access Management background: workload identity federation, least-privilege IAM design, secrets management patterns that avoid static credentials.
  • Experience building and maintaining an observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Thanos, or equivalent).
  • Solid Terraform experience, including designing reusable modules consumed by other teams, not just single-project usage.
  • Practical, current experience using AI-assisted development tools in daily engineering work.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor other engineers -- through review, pairing, or informal technical leadership -- without formal authority.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing or operating hub-and-spoke network architectures in Azure.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipeline design for multi-team, multi-repo environments (e.g., GitHub Actions-based runner infrastructure).
  • Exposure to evaluating or building genuinely AI-driven operational tooling (as distinct from rules-based automation mislabeled as AI).
  • Experience presenting technical tradeoffs to both engineering and business stakeholders.
