jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer (Content Management - DIVA)
jobs.excerpt: Telestream is a leading provider of digital media tools and software solutions for the broadcast, streaming, and media industries.
jobs.description:
Telestream is a leading provider of digital media tools and software solutions for the broadcast, streaming, and media industries. We empower content creators and distributors to produce and deliver high-quality video content while optimizing operations and maximizing revenue. Our teams work diligently to innovate and support world-class services, and we are looking for a Senior Technical Support Engineer to join our support team.

Technical Support Engineer – Content Management (DIVA)

  • Department: Support – Content Management
  • Reports To: Manager, Technical Support – Content Management
  • Classification: Individual Contributor
  • Experience: Typically 3–5+ years of technical support or related experience, ideally in a B2B software, storage, or media technology environment
  • Location: US Remote ; global support environment

**Work Authorization - Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. This role is not eligible for employer-sponsored work authorization or visa sponsorship of any kind, now or in the future.

Role Summary

  • The Technical Support Engineer – Content Management is responsible for providing post-sales technical support to customers using Telestream’s Content Management products, with a focus on DIVA, Telestream’s video archive management platform. Customers rely on these systems to archive, protect, and retrieve their most valuable media assets across disk, LTO tape, and cloud storage. This role handles troubleshooting, issue tracking, escalation, and resolution across on-premises and cloud-connected archive deployments, maintaining clear and professional communication with customers throughout the case lifecycle.
  • This is a technically oriented support role, not a call center position. The Technical Support Engineer works directly with customers to diagnose product and infrastructure issues, replicates problems in lab environments, runs database queries and reads application logs as part of the diagnostic process, and collaborates with Engineering when issues require software fixes or product changes. The role requires the ability to understand media workflows spanning multiple systems, such as asset management, storage, tape libraries, and networks, and to determine when to escalate issues to senior team members, subject matter experts, or Engineering.
  • The Technical Support Engineer coordinates closely with the Professional Services (Delivery) team to manage handoffs between implementation and support, and back to Professional Services when customer issues require additional delivery engagement. This role must participate in an on-call rotation to support Telestream’s global customer base. Strong adherence to SLAs (first response and resolution times), accurate case documentation, and disciplined use of Salesforce, Jira, and Confluence are essential to this role.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Troubleshooting and Issue Resolution

  • Provide technical support to customers using the DIVA platform, including its archive, restore, partial restore, copy, and delete operations.
  • Diagnose and resolve issues across the archive environment, including the DIVA software, databases, source and destination storage, tape libraries and drives, cloud storage targets, and the networks that connect them.
  • Troubleshoot integrations between DIVA and customer media asset management, production, and automation systems, such as Avid Interplay and other third-party applications that use DIVA’s APIs.
  • Take ownership of customer issues from initial contact through resolution, including trouble ticket generation, incident diagnosis, root cause analysis, and customer communication throughout the case lifecycle.
  • Replicate customer issues in lab environments to isolate root causes, using database queries, log analysis, and product configuration review as part of the diagnostic process.
  • Identify hardware and software failures that can be addressed through patches, upgrades, configuration changes, or solution redesign, and document findings clearly for Engineering.
  • Maintain strong adherence to SLA targets for first response and resolution times, ensuring service objectives are consistently met.
  • Review assigned cases daily, update each with current status and next steps, and keep customer communication timely and clear.

Escalation and Cross-Team Coordination

  • Determine when to escalate issues to senior staff or subject matter experts within the support team based on complexity, severity, or product area expertise.
  • Prepare clear, well-documented escalation packages for Engineering when issues require software fixes or product changes, including steps to reproduce, error reports, log data, configuration files, and environmental details.
  • Coordinate with the Professional Services (Delivery) team to manage handoffs between implementation and support, ensuring customers experience continuity when transitioning between teams.
  • Follow associated Jira development tickets, follow up with Engineering when progress stalls, and provide logs, configuration files, or other data as requested.
  • Communicate with Sales and Renewals teams regarding licenses, expired support, or project-related issues.
  • Collaborate with teammates (including through Microsoft Teams) to share knowledge, assist on complex cases, and contribute to collective troubleshooting efforts.

On-Call Support

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to provide support outside of standard business hours based on the needs of Telestream’s global customer base, many of whom run 24x7 broadcast and media operations.
  • Respond to urgent issues during on-call periods with appropriate prioritization, diagnosis, and escalation based on severity and customer impact.
  • Documentation and Knowledge Management
  • Maintain accurate, detailed case notes in Salesforce for every customer interaction, ensuring the case record reflects current status, troubleshooting steps taken, and resolution details.
  • Write and maintain documentation concerning support processes, internal tools, known issues, and workarounds.
  • Contribute to the customer-facing knowledge base, creating articles that enable customer self-service and reduce repeat case volume.
  • Document and track issues in Jira, including bug reports, feature requests, and enhancement suggestions surfaced through customer support interactions, and follow up with Engineering on progress.

Customer Advocacy and Communication

  • Communicate clearly and professionally with customers via email, phone, and teleconferencing, maintaining a patient and solution-oriented approach throughout the support engagement.
  • Advocate for customer needs internally to management, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product Management, and Engineering, ensuring customer feedback and recurring issues are visible to the appropriate teams.
  • Initiate follow-up communication with customers after issue resolution to confirm satisfaction and ensure the solution is stable.

Continuous Learning and Readiness

  • Complete product training and build working knowledge of DIVA, including new releases, features, deployment models, and integration capabilities.
  • Stay up to date with evolving industry technical standards, media workflows, archive storage technologies (including LTO tape and cloud storage tiers), and technology developments relevant to the products supported.
  • Participate in internal training, product certifications, and knowledge-sharing sessions to maintain and deepen technical expertise.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 3-5+ years of technical support or related experience in a B2B software, storage, or media technology environment, with a focus on enterprise-level product support rather than call center operations.
  • Experience troubleshooting software applications across Windows and Linux operating systems, including log analysis. Some scripting and AI prompting experience is beneficial.
  • Experience with Windows Server environments and system administration.
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals and protocols (TCP/IP, Ethernet, IP routing, DNS, FTP, CIFS) as they apply to media technology deployments, including storage systems (SAN/NAS).
  • Some experience with databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server) and query tools.
  • Familiarity with APIs, REST services, and metadata formats (XML/JSON).
  • Exposure to media workflows, video formats, or content management systems.
  • Experience with Salesforce (Service Cloud or similar), Jira, and Confluence, or comparable CRM, ticketing, and documentation tools.
  • Experience with remote access tools (VPN, TeamViewer, RDP).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical issues and solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent support cases, prioritize based on severity and SLA requirements, and work with moderate supervision.
  • Ability to understand workflows spanning multiple services, platforms, and integration points, and to extract key facts for clear error reporting and escalation.
  • Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation to support Telestream’s global customer base.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with video archiving or data archive and storage management products such as DIVArchive, DIVAnet, or DIVAdirector, or similar HSM and archive software. Experience with related legacy archive products such as Kumulate, MassStore, or FlashNet a plus.
  • Experience with LTO tape libraries (IBM, Spectra Logic, Oracle) and tape drive troubleshooting.
  • Experience with Fibre Channel infrastructure, including switches and HBAs.
  • Cloud knowledge is helpful, such as AWS and Azure. Understanding cloud storage tiers and egress costs is a plus.
  • Experience supporting media technology, video processing, or workflow automation products, or integrations with media asset management (MAM) systems.
  • Knowledge of video production workflows, captioning, and timecodes.
  • Awareness of broadcast technical standards and regulatory bodies.
  • Multilingual capability (Spanish, French, Portuguese) is advantageous.

Benefits

Perks That Power Your Life
We offer a comprehensive package designed to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance. Our benefits are built to keep you healthy, supported, and free to do your best work.

  • Day-one medical, dental & vision coverage
  • 100% company-paid life + disability insurance
  • 401(k) with a sweet company match (up to 8%)
  • Quarterly HSA boosts & flexible spending accounts
  • Flexible time off (salaried) or PTO (hourly) + generous paid holidays
  • Pet insurance (yes, your dog gets benefits too)
  • Legal plan + extras like accident & critical illness coverage

Telestream is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) to screen, evaluate, or make selection decisions about applicants. All applications are reviewed by our recruiting team and hiring managers to ensure each candidate receives thoughtful, human consideration based on their qualifications and experience.

jobs.description:

Here, collaboration fuels progress, adaptability sparks innovation and every voice can help shape what’s next for R1 and the future of healthcare.

About the Role

The Offensive Security team is hiring a Senior IT Security Engineer to strengthen how we find and fix vulnerabilities before attackers do. You'll run hands-on penetration tests across infrastructure, networks, and applications, work across multiple cloud environments, and help mature testing methodology and tooling for a healthcare technology company operating at real scale. This is an individual contributor role with room to shape process, not just execute against a checklist.


Responsibilities

  • Plan and execute penetration tests across internal and external infrastructure, networks, and web and mobile applications.
  • Perform application security testing — manual and tool-assisted — integrated into the SDLC, including source-code-assisted ("gray box") testing where applicable.
  • Test across multiple cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP), including cloud configuration, IAM, and workload-level exposures.
  • Simulate real-world adversary techniques against production and pre-production systems, in coordination with engineering and infrastructure owners.
  • Build, maintain, and extend a toolkit spanning both open-source and commercial tooling; write custom scripts and tools to close gaps in existing coverage.
  • Document findings with clear risk ratings, reproduction steps, and remediation guidance, for both engineering teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Partner with engineering, infrastructure, and product teams to validate fixes and reduce time-to-remediation.
  • Support testing tied to compliance obligations, including HIPAA, SOC 2, and PCI DSS assessments and audits.
  • Track emerging attack techniques, exploits, and threat intelligence relevant to healthcare and revenue cycle technology environments.
  • Contribute to tabletop exercises, purple-team collaboration, and internal security training as needed.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in penetration testing or offensive security, spanning both infrastructure/network and application security testing.
  • At least one recognized offensive security certification — e.g., OSCP, GPEN, GWAPT, GXPN, CEH, or equivalent demonstrated hands-on skill — with a track record of pursuing further certification.
  • Practical experience testing in multiple cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP), not just on-prem infrastructure.
  • Working knowledge of established methodologies and frameworks: MITRE ATT&CK, the OWASP Testing Guide, and PTES.
  • Fluency with both open-source and commercial security tooling (e.g., Burp Suite, Zap, Nmap, Metasploit, BloodHound, Nuclei, OWASP ZAP) and the judgment to pick the right tool for the job.
  • Scripting or automation ability (Python, PowerShell, or Bash) to build custom tooling and speed up repeatable testing.
  • Experience operating in environments subject to HIPAA, SOC 2, and/or PCI DSS.
  • Strong written and verbal communication — you can explain a finding's real-world impact to an engineer and to a non-technical stakeholder in the same afternoon.
  • Comfort operating independently inside a large, fast-paced, matrixed organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced certifications: OSWE, OSCE/OSEE, GXPN, CISSP, or CCSP.
  • Experience testing containerized environments and Kubernetes.
  • API security testing experience (REST/GraphQL), beyond standard web app testing.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipeline security and secure SDLC integration.
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining open-source security tools.
  • Healthcare, healthcare IT, or financial services industry experience.
  • Experience with AI models, harnesses, and exploiting AI services.

jobs.excerpt: What success looks like in this role: We are seeking a motivated Automation Engineer with 6-8 years of experience to identify and eliminate repetitive manual work across our Steady State teams (Windows, Linux, Storage, and Backup) and turn it into reliable, reusable automation.
jobs.description:
What success looks like in this role:

We are seeking a motivated Automation Engineer with 6-8 years of experience to identify and eliminate repetitive manual work across our Steady State teams (Windows, Linux, Storage, and Backup) and turn it into reliable, reusable automation. This role is centered on discovery as much as delivery: partnering with Steady State to surface recurring tasks through interviews and ServiceNow ticket data, then codifying best practices, critical procedures, and common maintenance/deployment work using Ansible, GitLab CI/CD, HashiCorp Vault, Terraform, and the JFrog Artifactory suite (Xray, Catalog, and Curation).


Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner directly with Steady State teams to understand day-to-day operational work through interviews and shadowing.
  • Mine and analyze ServiceNow ticket data to identify recurring, manual, and time-consuming tasks, and quantify their frequency and effort.
  • Prioritize automation opportunities based on ticket volume, risk, and operational impact, and build use cases in partnership with Steady State leadership.
  • Codify best practices, critical procedures, and common maintenance/deployment tasks into reusable Ansible playbooks and roles.
  • Design and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform for repeatable provisioning and configuration.
  • Build and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines to package, test, and safely roll out automation to production.
  • Manage secrets, credentials, and certificates used by automation workflows through HashiCorp Vault.
  • Utilize JFrog Artifactory, including Xray, Catalog, and Curation, to manage and secure the artifacts produced by automation pipelines.
  • Validate that new automation matches or exceeds existing manual procedures before retiring the manual process.
  • Track and report on automation coverage and the resulting reduction in manual ticket volume.
  • Document automated processes, playbooks, and pipeline configurations.
  • Continuously revisit ticket trends to catch newly emerging repeat work and keep the automation backlog current.

You will be successful in this role if you have:

Qualifications:

  • BA/BS degree or equivalent experience and 6-8 years of experience in automation, DevOps, or platform engineering roles.
  • Hands-on experience with Ansible, Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, and HashiCorp Vault in a production environment.
  • Experience analyzing ticket/incident data (ServiceNow or similar ITSM tool) to identify automation opportunities.
  • Comfortable gathering requirements directly from operations teams through interviews and process walkthroughs.
  • Working knowledge of Windows and Linux systems administration, storage, and backup operations.
  • Solid scripting ability (Bash, Python, PowerShell, or similar).
  • Understanding of DevSecOps principles and software supply chain security.
  • Self-motivated and able to operate independently with minimal oversight.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to work across development, security, and operations teams.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • ServiceNow and Power BI reporting/dashboarding experience for tracking automation impact.

jobs.excerpt: Este es un puesto de trabajo remoto. En DonWeb estamos buscando incorporar a nuestro equipo de IT un profesional con sólida experiencia en la administración de entornos Linux y un fuerte conocimiento en motores de bases de datos.
jobs.description:
Este es un puesto de trabajo remoto.

En DonWeb estamos buscando incorporar a nuestro equipo de IT un profesional con sólida experiencia en la administración de entornos Linux y un fuerte conocimiento en motores de bases de datos. La persona seleccionada se sumará a un equipo multidisciplinario que diseña, implementa, mantiene y actualiza la infraestructura crítica que soporta los servicios de hosting.
El objetivo principal del rol será garantizar la estabilidad, seguridad, escalabilidad y performance de las plataformas Linux sobre las que operan nuestros motores de base de datos, contribuyendo además con la automatización y mejora continua de los procesos.
Responsabilidades:
  • Administrar y mantener servidores Linux (RedHat, CentOS, Debian, Ubuntu u otros) en entornos de alta disponibilidad.
  • Instalar, configurar, optimizar y dar soporte a motores de bases de datos (MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, entre otros).
  • Monitorear la salud, rendimiento y capacidad de los motores de bases de datos, aplicando prácticas de tuning y optimización.
  • Participar en tareas de diseño e implementación de arquitecturas escalables y redundantes.
  • Gestionar parches, actualizaciones y planes de contingencia para las plataformas Linux y de bases de datos.
  • Colaborar con otros equipos de IT (Networking, Storage, Virtualización, Seguridad) para integrar soluciones end-to-end.
  • Automatizar procesos operativos mediante scripting (Bash, Python, Ansible, Terraform u otras herramientas).
  • Asegurar el cumplimiento de políticas de seguridad y mejores prácticas en entornos productivos.
  • Participar en guardias rotativas (on-call/pasivas) para asegurar la continuidad de los servicios críticos.

Requisitos

Requisitos Técnicos
Experiencia comprobable en administración de sistemas Linux en entornos productivos (mínimo 3 años).
Conocimientos sólidos en al menos uno de los siguientes motores de bases de datos: MySQL/MariaDB o PostgreSQL.
Experiencia en clustering, replicación y configuración de alta disponibilidad en bases de datos.
Familiaridad con herramientas de monitoreo (Prometheus, Zabbix, Nagios, Grafana).
Conocimientos de scripting (Bash, Python) y herramientas de automatización (Ansible, Puppet, Chef, Terraform).
Conocimientos en virtualización y contenedores (VMware, KVM, Docker, Kubernetes – deseable).
Buen entendimiento de redes y protocolos TCP/IP.
Inglés técnico (lectura y escritura).
Competencias Personales
​
Capacidad para trabajar en equipo, compartir conocimiento y colaborar.
Autonomía para la resolución de problemas complejos en situaciones críticas.
Perfil analítico con orientación a la mejora continua.
Flexibilidad y capacidad de adaptación a un entorno en constante evolución.
Comunicación clara y efectiva.

Ventajas

Además, en nuestra empresa te ofrecemos una serie de beneficios increíbles para que te sientas valorado y cuidado:
¡Cuida de ti y tu familia con nuestra cobertura de salud en Swiss Medical!
Disfruta de una licencia por paternidad extendida de 7 días corridos, ¡para que puedas pasar tiempo de calidad con tu familia en esos momentos tan especiales!
Nuestro Plan Empresa es una verdadera joya para los emprendedores y sus familias! Con 200GB de almacenamiento SSD, dominio propio, cuentas de correo ilimitadas, certificado SSL y mucho más.
¿Quieres seguir creciendo profesionalmente? Te ofrecemos capacitaciones reconocidas por la empresa en UTNA, ITBA, Siglo21 y descuentos exclusivos. Con un 50% de descuento en Educación IT, un 80% de descuento en los Planes anuales de adultos y un 78% de descuento en planes anuales de niños en Open English (idioma ingles portuges e italiano).
Bono mensual por gastos de teletrabajo
¡Únete a nuestro equipo y disfruta de todos estos beneficios pensados especialmente para ti!

jobs.title: Digital Workplace Scripting & Automation Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Founded in 1999 in Vienna, the Qualysoft Group is a manufacturer-independent IT consulting and services company, which successfully provides support for its international customers with the aim of boosting their competitiveness and economic efficiency through innovative IT solutions.
jobs.description:
Founded in 1999 in Vienna, the Qualysoft Group is a manufacturer-independent IT consulting and services company, which successfully provides support for its international customers with the aim of boosting their competitiveness and economic efficiency through innovative IT solutions.
Its focus is on financial services providers, telecommunications companies, the automotive industry and energy service providers. Over 400 employees in 6 subsidiaries work together to ensure state of the art solutions for our clients.
We are looking for new colleagues in Qualysoft teams for diverse projects providing continuous learning opportunities. Our common goal is to provide honesty, development and a stable background while getting to know the latest technologies. We are waiting for your application for the position below!

About the role

    We are looking for a Digital Workplace Scripting & Automation Specialist to design and deliver practical automation solutions in a large-scale enterprise environment.

    The role focuses on developing scripts, integrations and automated workflows that improve Digital Workplace services, reduce manual effort and enable reliable, repeatable operations. This includes API-based integration, orchestration, error handling, monitoring and the application of AI-enabled approaches where they add value. Collecting, validating and preparing data remains part of the role when needed to power these solutions and support operational insight.

    Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Graph and SharePoint are important technologies in the current environment. The role may also support information management, data ownership, lifecycle and storage use cases, but its core contribution is reusable scripting and automation across the broader Digital Workplace landscape.

    The detailed scope and initial priorities will be agreed with the Product Owner.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, maintain and improve scripts, integrations and automation solutions that support Digital Workplace innovation and operations
  • Build API-based integrations and automated workflows across workplace platforms and services using approved interfaces and methods
  • Create reusable automation components, utilities and patterns that can be maintained, extended and applied across multiple use cases
  • Automate recurring operational and data-related workflows to reduce manual effort while maintaining appropriate controls, traceability and reliability
  • Develop or implement AI-enabled automation, including agent-based solutions, where suitable for the agreed use case.
  • Collect, validate, transform and structure data when required by automation, integration, reporting or decision-support solution
  • Use technologies such as Microsoft Graph, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID and SharePoint where relevant to the solution, without limiting the approach to a single platform.
  • Investigate and resolve issues affecting scripts, integrations, automated workflows, authentication, data quality and solution reliability
  • Collaborate with the Product Owner and relevant engineering, architecture, security and operations colleagues to turn requirements into practical, maintainable technical solutions
  • Test, document, monitor and improve implemented solutions to support reliable operation, maintenance, reuse and handover
  • Follow established enterprise IT processes, security standards, data-handling requirements and documentation practices

Required skills and experience

  • Strong scripting or software-development skills, with practical experience building reliable automation, integrations or operational tools
  • PowerShell, Python or similar scripting experience
  • Hands-on experience with APIs, authentication and integration patterns for connecting enterprise platforms and services.
  • Experience designing automated workflows, reusable components or scheduled processes that are secure, supportable and maintainable
  • Practical understanding of automation design, source control, error handling, logging, testing, monitoring, documentation and maintainability
  • Experience implementing or supporting AI-enabled automation solutions, with an understanding of responsible use, security, data quality and appropriate human oversight
  • Working knowledge of structured data, including the ability to collect, validate and prepare data needed by integrations, automation and operational reporting
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to understand the purpose of a technical task and translate agreed requirements into a workable solution
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of assigned tasks and collaborate with multiple stakeholders
  • Strong communication skills and a practical, solution-focused approach
  • Experience working in a large-scale, process-driven enterprise environment

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience developing AI agents or agent-based solutions, for example using Microsoft Copilot Studio or comparable platforms and frameworks
  • Practical experience with Microsoft Graph API and automation across Microsoft 365 services or Microsoft Entra ID
  • Experience with SharePoint Online administration, reporting, data extraction or automation
  • Experience with data visualization, reporting solutions or the preparation of datasets for business intelligence tools
  • Familiarity with information management, data ownership, lifecycle management, platform governance or storage management
  • Experience with Microsoft Intune, endpoint management or other Digital Workplace service platforms
  • Experience working in ITIL-based service management environments

Why we think you will love working here:

With us you count as a person, our doors are always open.
We live the Qualysoft Team Spirit and stand for transparency!
Fresh wind and new ideas are welcome, because standstill is a foreign word at Qualysoft.
